BARRISS_OFFEE_UPDATE_MESSAGE: Our team has identified an issue with Barriss Offee in which allies were still recovering 20% Max Health whenever they were critically hit even after Barriss was no longer present in the battle. This has been flagged as a bug as her Zeta ability was not meant to persist after death. Today, we will be removing the Zeta upgrade and granting them back to each respective player via inbox message in order to allow them the ability to choose whether or not they want to invest in this character again. We apologize for any inconvenience!

BASICABILITY_RANCORDOORFUNCTIONAL_DESC:
When this device is disabled, the pit door will close on the Rancor, Toppling it for 1 turn and granting attacking units a Morale bonus:

Morale I: All attacking units gain 100% Critical Chance.
Morale II: If the Rancor has 50% Health or less in its current phase, all attacking units gain 25% Speed.
Morale III: All attacking units that have more than 50% Health when the Rancor becomes Toppled gain 50% Offense.

Morale bonuses are lost when the Rancor is no longer Toppled. After being disabled, this device is temporarily inactive.

BOXEDIN_MODIFIER_CRATE_DESC: Units that damage the Crate recover 10% Health and Protection, and all of the DoTs applied by this modifier are removed
BOXEDIN_MODIFIER_CRATE_DESC_V2: Units that damage the Crate recover 50% Health and Protection, and all of the DoTs applied by this modifier are removed
BOXEDIN_MODIFIER_DESC: At the start of the encounter, all the Player's units are inflicted with Healing Immunity for the duration of the battle, which cannot be dispelled or prevented. All the Player's units also receive a DoT at the start of each turn, which cannot be dispelled or prevented.\n\nAt the start of the encounter, a Crate is summoned to the Boss’ ally slot. When the Player attacks the Crate, that unit recovers 10% Health and Protection, and all of the DoTs applied by this modifier are removed.
BOXEDIN_MODIFIER_DESC_V2: At the start of the encounter, all allied characters are inflicted with Healing Immunity until the end of the battle, which can't be prevented. All allied characters are inflicted with Damage Over Time at the start of their turn, which can't be dispelled or prevented.\n\nAt the start of the encounter, a Crate is summoned to the Boss' ally slot. When an allied character damages the Crate, they recover 50% Health and Protection which can't be prevented, and all the Damage Over Time applied to them by this modifier is removed.
BOXEDIN_MODIFIER_DESC_V3: At the start of the encounter, all enemies are inflicted with Healing Immunity until the end of the battle, which can't be resisted. All enemies are inflicted with a Damage Over Time effect at the start of any enemy's turn, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\nAt the start of the encounter, a Crate is summoned to the ally slot. When an enemy damages the Crate, that enemy recovers 50% Health and Protection, which can't be prevented, and removes all of the Damage Over Time effects applied by this modifier.

CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock001: Welcome to the Challenges table. Maybe you're ready to prove yourself as a strategic thinker?
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock001_V2: Welcome to the [f0ff23]CHALLENGES[-] table, where you'll find daily battles to put your wits and your full collection to the test.
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock002: Every day of the week you'll find Challenges here that put your wits, and your full collection, to the test.
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock002_V2: Challenges earn you important rewards like [f0ff23]TRAINING DROIDS[-], [f0ff23]GEAR[-], [f0ff23]ABILITY MATERIALS[-], and of course, [f0ff23]CREDITS.[-]
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock003: Each Challenge will give you important [f0ff23]REWARDS[-]
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock003_V2: Tap Challenge panels to see the rules of engagement for each. They can dramatically affect what happens in battle.
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock004: Some Challenges give you [f0ff23]TRAINING DROIDS[-] so you can train your characters to increase their stats.
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock005: Some will give you hard-to-find [f0ff23]GEAR[-] you can equip on your characters to make them stronger.
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock006: Others will give you [f0ff23]ABILITY MATERIALS[-] to level up your characters' abilities and unlock new combat moves.
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock007: And finally, [f0ff23]CREDITS[-]. You can use those all over the place!
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock008: As it is in war, defeating a Challenge isn't always about using the strongest squad. It's about choosing the right squad for the job.
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock009: Pay attention to the rules for a given Challenge. They can dramatically affect what happens in battle.
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock010: Tap a Challenge panel to see the rules of engagement.
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstUnlock011: I'll start you off with some simple battles. But later on, I won't go so easy on you. Good luck.
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstWin001: Good job! I know you're just getting started, but you're showing promise already.
CantinaChar_Challenges_FirstWin002: Keep coming back to test yourself and I'll keep finding ways to push you.
CantinaChar_Challenges_Locked001: Hmmmmm. No, no. You don't look like you're ready for this Challenge yet.\n\n(Reach [f0ff23]Player Level 15[-] to unlock this feature.)
CantinaChar_Challenges_Locked002: Come back when you're a little more... seasoned.\n\n(Reach [f0ff23]Player Level 15[-] to unlock this feature.)
CantinaChar_Challenges_Locked003: You need to level up more. Complete some Daily Activities first.\n\n(Reach [f0ff23]Player Level 15[-] to unlock this feature.)
CantinaChar_Challenges_Unlocked001: I've been dusting off my old military texts to come up with new Challenges for you.
CantinaChar_Challenges_Unlocked002: The higher your level, the harder the Challenge... and the greater the rewards!
CantinaChar_FleetWar_CompleteFirstWar001: You... did it... I can hardly believe this.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_CompleteFirstWar003: I have never actually won the whole war myself.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_CompleteFirstWar004: Tell me. Tell me how you did it! I must know.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_FirstUnlock001: Hmmm... Maybe you are ready now. But I doubt it. Let us see how you do.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_FirstUnlock002: This is the [f0ff23]GALACTIC WAR[-] table. You can attempt to defeat this table only [f0ff23]ONCE PER DAY[-]--make it count!
CantinaChar_FleetWar_FirstUnlock003: You will play a series of battles against other players' squads.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_FirstUnlock004: It will start easy and get harder the further you progress on the battlefield.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_FirstUnlock005: Important! The health of each character carries over from battle to battle. Keep this in mind!
CantinaChar_FleetWar_FirstUnlock006: Also! Any units that are defeated during a Galactic War cannot be used on this table for the rest of the day.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_FirstUnlock007: Defeated units can, of course, be used on other tables. Just not here until your Galactic War resets.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_FirstUnlock008: After each successful battle, you will be able to open a [f0ff23]SPECIAL REWARD CHEST[-]. Enjoy the spoils of war.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_FirstUnlock009: The further you progress, the greater the rewards.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_FirstUnlock010: Be sure to check the table's [f0ff23]GALACTIC WAR STORE[-] to redeem the [f0ff23]GALACTIC WAR TOKENS[-] you've earned.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_FirstUnlock011: If you forget how the table works, tap the [f0ff23]DETAILS[-] button to learn more.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_FirstUnlock012: Let's see if you have what it takes to survive the war...
CantinaChar_FleetWar_Locked001: Stand back, little one.\n\n(Reach [f0ff23]Player Level 40[-] to unlock this feature.)
CantinaChar_FleetWar_Locked002: Ssssssss! Careful! You would not survive this war.\n\n(Reach [f0ff23]Player Level 40[-] to unlock this feature.)
CantinaChar_FleetWar_Locked003: You need a collection that is large, powerful, and strong to endure this war of attrition.\n\n(Reach [f0ff23]Player Level 40[-] to unlock this feature.)
CantinaChar_FleetWar_Locked004: The weak are not allowed here! Move along.\n\n(Reach [f0ff23]Player Level 40[-] to unlock this feature.)
CantinaChar_FleetWar_SeasonedVet001: Oh, it's you. Please show me how you play. I need to learn!
CantinaChar_FleetWar_SeasonedVet002: So strong... so powerful. How do you do it?
CantinaChar_FleetWar_WarIncomplete001: Keep trying. Build a bigger collection. Make them more powerful. You might just be able to win the war... Maybe.
CantinaChar_FleetWar_WarIncomplete002: Come prove your strength and worth. Can you do it? Probably not! HA!
CantinaChar_Guild_Locked001: You're not quite ready to join a [f0ff23]GUILD[-]. Come back after you've reached [f0ff23]LEVEL 22[-].

CantinaChar_Guild_Locked003: I heard you like [f0ff23]GUILDS[-]. Come see me when you've got some more experience under your belt.\n\n(This feature unlocks at [f0ff23]LEVEL 22[-].)

CantinaChar_ShardShop_Locked002: The [FFE524]SHARD STORE[-] is only available for seasoned players. Come back once you’ve earned your first [FFE524]7-STAR CHARACTER[-].
CantinaChar_ShardShop_Locked003: Once you’ve shown your chops and earned a [FFE524]7-STAR CHARACTER[-], come back and see me. I’ll show you what the [FFE524]SHARD STORE[-] offers for our top players.
CantinaChar_ShardShop_Unlocked001: Welcome to the [FFE524]SHARD STORE[-].\n\nCongratulations! You are now part of an elite group of players who can trade-in [FFE524]EXTRA SHARDS[-] from your existing 7-Star Characters.

CantinaChar_ShardShop_Unlocked004: Remember, the more Characters you have at 7-Stars, the more [FFE524]SHARD STORE TOKENS[-] you get when you visit the [FFE524]SHARD STORE[-]!

CantinaChar_SimTickets_FirstUnlock002: These will help you on your way to building the most powerful team around.

CantinaChar_SquadArena_FirstUnlock001: What? YOU unlocked this already? That doesn't make...
CantinaChar_SquadArena_FirstUnlock002: Well listen... I'm busy. Being the top player isn't as easy as I make it look.
CantinaChar_SquadArena_FirstUnlock004: Oh, hey! Good job! You're really catching on to things quickly.
CantinaChar_SquadArena_FirstUnlock005: Don't mind that Hutt. He can see you're rising through the ranks and he won't like that.
CantinaChar_SquadArena_FirstUnlock006: On this [f0ff23]SQUAD ARENA[-] table, you get to fight against other players to see who's got the strongest characters and the best strategies.
CantinaChar_SquadArena_FirstUnlock007: There are no rules in the Arena, so bring your best units.
CantinaChar_SquadArena_FirstUnlock008: Every day you earn [f0ff23]SQUAD ARENA TOKENS[-] based on your [f0ff23]LEADERBOARD[-] rank! The higher you climb, the better your daily rewards!
CantinaChar_SquadArena_FirstUnlock009: [f0ff23]SQUAD ARENA TOKENS[-] are special and can only be used to buy from this table's [f0ff23]ARENA STORE[-].
CantinaChar_SquadArena_FirstUnlock010: What can you buy with 'em? [f0ff23]EXCLUSIVE CHARACTER SHARDS[-]! Seriously, this is the only place to get these characters.
CantinaChar_SquadArena_FirstUnlock011: These Daily Rewards appear in your [f0ff23]INBOX[-] every morning, so be sure to collect them!
CantinaChar_SquadArena_FirstUnlock012: That's pretty much it. Jump on in. Tap [f0ff23]BATTLE[-] on the player you want to take on, and may the strongest squad win! Good luck!
CantinaChar_SquadArena_Locked001: No autographs, please. I'm busy.\n\n(Reach [f0ff23]Player Level 8[-] to unlock this feature.)
CantinaChar_SquadArena_Locked001_TU07_2: No autographs, please. I'm busy.\n\n(Reach [f0ff23]Player Level 28[-] to unlock this feature.)
CantinaChar_SquadArena_Locked002: You know what separates you from me? Not enough space. Beat it.\n\n(Reach [f0ff23]Player Level 8[-] to unlock this feature.)
CantinaChar_SquadArena_Locked002_TU07_2: You know what separates you from me? Not enough space. Beat it.\n\n(Reach [f0ff23]Player Level 28[-] to unlock this feature.)
CantinaChar_SquadArena_Unlocked001: I get it. Believe me, I do. Everyone wants to know what it's like to be me. Here's the thing: It's incredible! Okay?
CantinaChar_SquadArena_Unlocked002: Oh, hi. I think someone over there was looking for you. Someone who's... uh, not me.
CantinaChar_SquadArena_Unlocked003: I think you're confusing me with someone WHO'S NOT BUSY BEING THE TOP PLAYER!
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock001: Oh wow! You're coming along nicely. Really making a name for yourself around here.
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock001_: You've unlocked the [f0ff23]CANTINA BATTLES[-] table, where you can use any characters you want!\n\nOf course, your enemies can as well. [f0ff23]NO RULES![-]
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock002: You've just unlocked one of our new tables. This one lets you bring in any characters you want. [f0ff23]NO RULES[-]!
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock002_: This table uses its own [f0ff23]CANTINA ENERGY.[-] You can play here without limiting your play elsewhere in the cantina!
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock003: However, the same is true for the enemies you'll face--no rules!
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock003_: It's also a great place to earn [f0ff23]SHARDS[-] and [f0ff23]ABILITY MATERIALS[-] to power up your characters.
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock004: That means... you're going to need to take on whatever this table throws at you.
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock004_: Wins also award [f0ff23]CANTINA BATTLE TOKENS.[-] Redeem them in the [f0ff23]CANTINA BATTLES STORE.[-]\n\nGood luck, and have fun!
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock005: If you're having trouble moving forward, try assembling a different party. You'll need to pay attention to which characters are strong against others.
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock006: When you win, you'll get special [f0ff23]CANTINA BATTLE TOKENS[-]. Be sure to redeem them in the [f0ff23]CANTINA BATTLES STORE[-].
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock007: This is also a great place to win those [f0ff23]ABILITY MATERIALS[-] you need to power up your characters' combat abilities.
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock008: One last thing... because this table is special, it uses its own [f0ff23]CANTINA ENERGY[-]. This allows you to play here without limiting your play elsewhere in the cantina!
CantinaChar_SquadBattles_FirstUnlock009: That's about it. Good luck and have fun!

CHAMPIONSHIP_INFO_LEAGUE_DESCRIPTION: [ACFEFF]There are[-] [FFED8D]five leagues[-][ACFEFF] in Grand Arena Championships, and [FFED8D]each league contains five divisions[-][ACFEFF]. At the end of each Grand Arena event, players can move to a higher or lower division depending on their performance within the event.\n\nAt the end of each Grand Arena season, players who finish in Division 1 of their league are promoted to the next league up, and players who finish in Division 5 are relegated to the next league down.[-]
CHAMPIONSHIP_INFO_LEAGUE_DESCRIPTION_V2: [ACFEFF]There are[-] [FFED8D]five leagues[-][ACFEFF] in Grand Arena Championships, and [FFED8D]each league contains five divisions[-][ACFEFF]. At the end of each Grand Arena round, players can move to a higher or lower division depending on their performance within the round.\n\nAt the end of each Grand Arena season, players who finish in Division 1 of their league are promoted to the next league up, and players who finish in Division 5 are relegated to the next league down.[-]
CHAMPIONSHIP_INFO_MATCHMAKING_DESCRIPTIO: [ACFEFF]Matchmaking looks only at a player's[-] [FFED8D]skill rating[-][ACFEFF], and at the beginning of each Grand Arena event, groups of 8 players with similar skill ratings are created. During each round in an event, players are paired by win-loss record within the event.[-]
CHAMPIONSHIP_INFO_STRUCTURE_DESCRIPTION:
[ACFEFF]A Grand Arena season consists of[-] [FFED8D]four 1-week-long events[-][ACFEFF]. A match-made group of[-] [FFED8D]8 players[-][ACFEFF] competes in each weekly event.

Each event has a 24-hour Join phase, and players may only join the event during this phase. Afterwards, there are 3 rounds, each consisting of two 24-hour phases: the Defense phase and the Attack phase.

Players are matched against new opponents in each round. Players earn round rewards at the end of each round, event rewards at the end of each event, and season rewards at the end of the season.[-]

Get prepared to compete in Grand Arena Championships with the following bonuses!

Combat_Buffs_QUEST_DESC: Gain specific buffs to complete this Quest.\n\nYou must focus on specific Characters and Abilities!
Combat_Buffs_QUEST_REWARDS: One battle does not win a war.
Combat_Buffs_TASK_DESC_1: Gain Defense Up 3 times in battle
Combat_Bullseye_QUEST_DESC: Train Luke Skywalker (Farmboy) to level 13 and practice your aim!\n\nSoon you'll be able to bullseye Womp Rats blindfolded.
Combat_Bullseye_QUEST_REWARDS: A well timed ability can cripple your enemies!
Combat_Bullseye_TASK_DESC_3: Deal 1,000 damage to enemies with Luke Skywalker (Farmboy)
Combat_Challenges_2_QUEST_DESC: Observe your enemy's strategies to defeat them.\n\nEach challenge has a specific puzzle.
Combat_Challenges_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Good, now complete higher Challenge tiers for greater rewards.
Combat_Challenges_3_QUEST_DESC: Build squads based on the requirements for each challenge.\n\nUnlock and level up those types of characters to defeat the challenges.
Combat_Challenges_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Patience and hard work yield success.
Combat_Challenges_4_QUEST_DESC: You’re ready for a fresh challenge.
Combat_Challenges_4_QUEST_REWARDS: You’ve learned much, and you still have much to learn.
Combat_Challenges_4_TASK_DESC_1: Win 2 Tier VI Ability Material challenges
Combat_Challenges_4_TASK_DESC_1_V2: Win 2 Tier IV Ability Material challenge
Combat_Challenges_4_TASK_DESC_2: Win 2 Tier VI Strength Equipment challenges
Combat_Challenges_4_TASK_DESC_2_V2: Win 2 Tier IV Strength Equipment challenge
Combat_Challenges_4_TASK_DESC_3: Win 2 Tier VI Agility Equipment challenges
Combat_Challenges_4_TASK_DESC_3_V2: Win 2 Tier IV Agility Equipment challenge
Combat_Challenges_5_QUEST_DESC: You’ve learned much, and you still have much to learn.
Combat_Challenges_5_QUEST_REWARDS: A good teacher is always learning.
Combat_Challenges_5_TASK_DESC_1: Win 2 Tier V Ability Material challenges
Combat_Challenges_5_TASK_DESC_2: Win 2 Tier V Strength Equipment challenges
Combat_Challenges_5_TASK_DESC_3: Win 2 Tier V Agility Equipment challenges
Combat_Challenges_6_QUEST_DESC: General Quinlan Vos defeated Separatist forces at the Siege of Saleucami.
Combat_Challenges_6_QUEST_REWARDS: A lesson from the Siege of Saleucami; always be aware of your surroundings!
Combat_Challenges_6_TASK_DESC_1: Win 2 Tier IV Ability Material challenges
Combat_Challenges_6_TASK_DESC_2: Win 2 Tier V Strength Equipment challenges
Combat_Challenges_6_TASK_DESC_3: Win 2 Tier V Agility Equipment challenges
Combat_Challenges_Continued_QUEST_DESC: Examine abilities in challenges carefully to solve their puzzles.\n\nThe greatest challenges come from within.
Combat_Challenges_Continued_QUEST_REWARD: Best all of my challenges and you may end up teaching me.
Combat_Championship_Challenge_DARTHTRAYA: The legend of Darth Traya is truly fearsome. Understanding her power and cunning will serve you well in the Grand Arena.
I can see you took this lesson to heart. Just keep in mind that sabotage and betrayal are strictly against Grand Arena regulations.
Win 10 battles on offense with Darth Traya in your squad
Win 3 battles on offense with Darth Traya in an undersized squad
Combat_Championship_Challenge_GENERALKEN: A valiant warrior and an ingenious tactician… I'm sure you'd find it enlightening to follow General Kenobi's example in the Grand Arena.
Victory is certain if you are guarded against every possibility of attack. Sometimes, the best offense is a good defense.
Win 10 battles on offense with General Kenobi in your squad
Win 3 battles on offense with General Kenobi in an undersized squad
Combat_Championship_Challenge_HANSOLO_QU: It is said that no battle plan survives contact with the enemy. You could learn something about on-the-fly solutions in the Grand Arena by studying the techniques of the legendary scoundrel Han Solo.
When the battle descends into chaos, instinct and nerve can win the day. Remember this lesson.
Combat_Championship_Challenge_HANSOLO_TA: Win 10 battles on offense with Han Solo in your squad
Win 3 battles on offense with Han Solo in an undersized squad
Combat_Championship_Contender_1_QUEST_DE: Are you looking for a challenge? Look no further than the Grand Arena! It's the ultimate proving grounds for competitive players.
Combat_Championship_Contender_1_QUEST_RE: Exciting, isn't it? Leading an army all by yourself, just like the generals of legend.
Combat_Championship_Contender_2_QUEST_DE: Your opponents in the Grand Arena will be tough. Give it some time and see what you can learn.
Combat_Championship_Contender_2_QUEST_RE: The Grand Arena may be intimidating at first, but you'll quickly find it's an exciting place to test your tactics.
Combat_Championship_Contender_2_TASK_DES: Win 3 battles on offense with a Tank in your squad
Win 3 battles on offense with a Support in your squad
Combat_Championship_Contender_3_QUEST_DE: If you want to keep growing your skills, you'll need to challenge yourself. Try these exercises in the Grand Arena and see how you do.
Combat_Championship_Contender_3_QUEST_RE: That's the spirit. I can see you're ready to take on all challengers!
Combat_Championship_Contender_3_TASK_DES: Win 3 battles on offense on the first try
Win a battle on offense with an undersized squad
Combat_Championship_Tactical_Genius_1_QU: To succeed in the Grand Arena, you'll need to use every tactic at your disposal. Here are some exercises to get you started.
Well done. Remember, every tactic you master is one more tool in your toolbox.
Combat_Championship_Tactical_Genius_2_QU: Now that you've tried your hand at the Grand Arena, let's move on to some more advanced exercises.
Many great generals have faced defeat because they could not adapt. I can see you have learned the value of flexibility.
Combat_Championship_Tactical_Genius_3_QU: Each victory in the Grand Arena yields great rewards, but also greater challenges. You will need to master advanced tactics to outsmart your opponents.
Commendable performance. With these tactics at your disposal, you should be able to face any foe.
Combat_Debuffs_QUEST_DESC: I’ve seen you apply buffs, now show me you can inflict debuffs.\n\nI could tell you such tales of heroism.
Combat_Debuffs_QUEST_REWARDS: Have I told you of the Battle of Cato Neimoidia?
Combat_Elites_Bosses_1_QUEST_DESC: Elite enemies have greater health and do more damage.\n\nQuickly defeat weaker enemies when possible.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_1_QUEST_REWARDS: Larger foes still tend to have weaknesses. Use speed and health to overpower Elite enemies.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_2_QUEST_DESC: Seek out specific enemies to prove yourself in this quest.\n\nChoose your battles carefully.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_2_QUEST_REWARDS: You've won the battle, but the war continues.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_3_QUEST_DESC: Find and eliminate certain enemies.\n\nEach holotable contains many battles with various foes.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_3_QUEST_REWARDS: An opponent’s weakness is your strength.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_4_QUEST_DESC: Hunt down and defeat Separatist foes like the great hero General Kenobi who defeated Grievous at the Battle of Utapau.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_4_QUEST_REWARDS: Understand your opponent’s strategy, even when they do not.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_5_QUEST_DESC: One battle does not win a war.\n\nThis reminds me of the battle of Endor.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_6_QUEST_REWARDS: I knew as soon as you entered the Cantina you’d be a fine strategist.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_7_QUEST_DESC: Do not let distractions sway you from the path to victory.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_7_QUEST_REWARDS: This reminds me of the battle of Hoth.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_8_QUEST_DESC: Examine not only your strengths, but also your weaknesses.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_8_QUEST_REWARDS: Sometimes brute strength is the most effective strategy.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_9_QUEST_DESC: Invest in powerful squad leaders to benefit the characters they lead.
Combat_Elites_Bosses_9_QUEST_REWARDS: This reminds me of the Battle of Geonosis.
Combat_Ewok_Quest_1_QUEST_DESC: Do not let the Ewoks' size fool you. They can be powerful allies or enemies.\n\nPair Wicket with other Ewoks to maximize his damage output!
Combat_Ewok_Quest_1_QUEST_REWARDS: Few have tighter synergy than the Ewoks. Collect a full squad of them to see what they are capable of.
Combat_Ewok_Quest_2_QUEST_DESC: Help the Ewoks to defend their home by defeating Stormtroopers.
Combat_Ewok_Quest_2_QUEST_REWARDS: The forest is safe, for now.
Combat_Ewok_Quest_3_QUEST_DESC: The forest is not safe until the Empire is fully pushed back.\n\nLead the Ewoks to defeat the Sith Lord Darth Vader!
Combat_Ewok_Quest_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Endor is safe once again, thanks to you.
Combat_Ewok_Quest_4_QUEST_DESC: Knowing the strength of the Ewoks, recruit one of their strongest warriors into your ranks.\n\nPromote Wicket to 3 stars!
Combat_Ewok_Quest_4_QUEST_REWARDS: As primitive as these creatures are, they are powerful allies to have in your team.
Combat_Ewok_Quest_4_TASK_DESC_1: Get Wicket to 3 Stars or more
Combat_Farmboy_Luke_QUEST_DESC: Train Luke Skywalker (Farmboy) to level 4, give him some gear, and win a battle with him in your squad.\n\nLuke's Bullseye ability does special damage. Watch out for Tuskens!
Combat_Farmboy_Luke_QUEST_REWARDS: If you keep completing the quests I give, you'll become a master of battle strategy.
Combat_Focus_Fire_QUEST_DESC: Alright, you're ready for Stage 2. Remember, finish off low health enemies to reduce the damage your squad takes.
Combat_Focus_Fire_QUEST_REWARDS: That was good training for your future battles.\n\nKeep training to be ready for anything the holotables throw at you!
Combat_Jedi_Healing_QUEST_DESC: The Droid says you've trained up a Jedi Consular. Let's see how you've done. \n\nThe Jedi are selfless and the consular embodies the principles of the Jedi Order.
Combat_Jedi_Healing_QUEST_DESC_V2: The Droid says you've trained up Ahsoka Tano. Let's see how you've done.
Combat_Jedi_Healing_QUEST_REWARDS: Using a healer can save your units with low health, just remember to time those heals wisely.
Combat_Leader_Abilities_QUEST_DESC:
Hmm, have you been practicing?

Let's see what you know about Leader Skills.

The best leaders inspire their teams!
Combat_Leader_Abilities_QUEST_REWARDS: Great, remember to use a character with a Leader Skill as your squad leader. And pay attention to the squad you ask them to lead!
Combat_Leader_Abilities_TASK_DESC_1: Win 3 Battles with Clone Wars Chewbacca
Combat_Leader_Abilities_TASK_DESC_1_V2: Win 3 Battles with Obi-Wan Kenobi (Old Ben)

These offers consist of Crystals and ability materials to power up your characters and ships. Purchase these exclusive bundles to get your characters and ships ready for the new Light Side Geonosis Territory Battle!

Combat_Resist_QUEST_DESC: You've learned the combat basics, now let's focus on new strategies.\n\nCharacters with high Tenacity can better Resist enemy attacks.
Combat_Resist_QUEST_REWARDS: Study a character's Tenacity by tapping on their stats.
Combat_Royal_Guard_QUEST_DESC: Stun key enemies and grant allies defense.\n\nRoyal Guards are stoic protectors of the Empire.
Combat_Royal_Guard_QUEST_DESC_V2: Stun key enemies and use Taunt to draw in enemy attacks.\n\nKylo Ren was a dominating leader of the First Order.
Combat_Royal_Guard_QUEST_REWARDS: Their ceremonial armor can deflect some lightsaber blows.
Combat_Royal_Guard_QUEST_REWARDS_V2: Kylo Ren's rage makes him a fierce opponent in battle!
Combat_Rushing_Attack_QUEST_DESC: Your Ewok Scout is best as an Attacker.\n\nUse Attackers to quickly deal damage to enemies while protecting them with Tanks.
Combat_Rushing_Attack_QUEST_DESC_V2: Rey (Scavenger) is best as an Attacker.\n\nUse Attackers to quickly deal damage to enemies while protecting them with Tanks.
Combat_Rushing_Attack_QUEST_REWARDS: Unlock more Ewoks to create a powerful tribe.
Combat_Rushing_Attack_QUEST_REWARDS_V2: Unlock more attackers to build strong and diverse teams.
Combat_Rushing_Attack_TASK_DESC_3: Deal 2,000 damage to enemies with Ewoks
Combat_Rushing_Attack_TASK_DESC_3_V2: Deal 2,000 damage to enemies with Rey (Scavenger)
Combat_Sith_Agent_1_QUEST_DESC: Becoming a Sith was hard work -- and it will take hard work to earn the title of SITH AGENT too!
Combat_Sith_Agent_1_QUEST_REWARDS: Sith against Jedi is as old as time. My grandfather told me these stories as a kid.\n\nLet's continue your story toward the title of SITH AGENT!
Combat_Sith_Agent_1_TASK_DESC_1: Get Asajj Ventress to Gear XII
Combat_Sith_Agent_1_TASK_DESC_3: Defeat 200 Jedi with Asajj Ventress present
Combat_Sith_Agent_2_QUEST_DESC: Count Dooku was once a Jedi and trained by Master Yoda himself.\n\nHe became disillusioned with the Jedi Order. Let's support his pursuit of power as a loyal SITH AGENT!
Combat_Sith_Agent_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Count Dooku was one of the most resilient Sith during the Clone Wars.\n\nNow you need resilience to complete your quest of becoming a SITH AGENT!
Combat_Sith_Agent_2_TASK_DESC_1: Win 10 Squad Arena Battles with only Sith
Combat_Sith_Agent_2_TASK_DESC_2: Defeat 1,000 Galactic Republic enemies with Count Dooku present
Combat_Sith_Agent_2_TASK_DESC_3: Get Count Dooku to Gear XII
Combat_Sith_Agent_3_QUEST_DESC: Sith take over the galaxy one calculated battle at a time.\n\nProve yourself in combat to earn the title SITH AGENT.
Combat_Sith_Agent_3_QUEST_REWARDS: You're an impressive force to contend with on the dark side.\n\nKeep going and you're almost to your goal of SITH AGENT!
Combat_Sith_Agent_3_TASK_DESC_1: Finish off 200 enemies with Count Dooku
Combat_Sith_Agent_4_QUEST_DESC: Sith only show compassion by making your annihilation brief!\n\nDominate the holotable with top Sith to earn the Cantina title SITH AGENT!
Combat_Sith_Agent_4_QUEST_REWARDS: The dark side of the Force is strong with you. Be mindful your ambition does not betray you.\n\nCongratulations! You are now a SITH AGENT!
Combat_Sith_Agent_4_TASK_DESC_1: Get Savage Opress to Gear XII
Combat_Sith_Master_1_QUEST_DESC: Give yourself to the dark side. It is the only way you can...earn the title SITH MASTER.
Combat_Sith_Master_1_QUEST_REWARDS: You've begun walking the path of the dark side.\n\nIn order to become a true SITH MASTER, you must understand the passion of Darth Maul. Seek him out!
Combat_Sith_Master_1_TASK_DESC_1: Defeat 1,000 Light Side characters with Darth Vader present
Combat_Sith_Master_2_QUEST_DESC: Darth Maul mastered the dark side and survived long after weaker souls would have perished.\n\nShow your commitment -- gear up that SITH MASTER and take out some Jedi!
Combat_Sith_Master_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Two hundred and twelve Jedi were sent to rescue Senator Amidala -- and almost all were destroyed! Power to the SITH!
Combat_Sith_Master_2_TASK_DESC_1: Win 20 Squad Arena Battles with only Sith
Combat_Sith_Master_2_TASK_DESC_2: Get Darth Maul to Gear XII
Combat_Sith_Master_2_TASK_NAME_2: He Will Find your Lost Ship
Combat_Sith_Master_3_QUEST_DESC: The Sith know that passion leads to strength--and the power to build an Empire.\n\nUse what you've learned and become a SITH MASTER!
Combat_Sith_Master_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Your conquest skills are growing! There is great darkness inside you.\n\nKeep going - just one more to earn the title SITH MASTER!
Combat_Sith_Master_3_TASK_DESC_1: Win 10 Territory War attacks with a Sith present
Combat_Sith_Master_4_QUEST_DESC: Through war, Sith seek only victory and the freedom that comes with dominance.\n\nExecute your will and embrace your new Cantina title of SITH MASTER!
Combat_Sith_Master_4_QUEST_REWARDS: Congratulations! You earned the title SITH MASTER! Be sure to show it off in the cantina.\n\nI expect there to be few disagreements with you!
Combat_Sith_Master_4_TASK_DESC_2: Defeat 500 Rebel characters with Emperor Palpatine present
Combat_Snowtrooper_QUEST_DESC: Train and utilize the Snowtrooper.\n\nEach Trooper is molded for combat to be prepared for specific battle environments.
Combat_Snowtrooper_QUEST_DESC_V2: Train and utilize the Dark Trooper.
Combat_Snowtrooper_QUEST_REWARDS: Characters like the the Snowtrooper are best in a full squad of the same faction like Imperial Troopers or Empire.
Combat_Snowtrooper_QUEST_REWARDS_V2: Collect more Imperial Remnants to build a powerful squad.
Combat_Snowtrooper_TASK_DESC_1_V2: Train the Dark Trooper to Level 28
Combat_Snowtrooper_TASK_DESC_3: Deal 3,000 damage to enemies with Snowtrooper
Combat_Snowtrooper_TASK_DESC_3_V2: Deal 3,000 damage to enemies with the Dark Trooper
Combat_Supressive_Fire_QUEST_DESC: Time your attacks.\n\nWhen your squad can do damage to all enemies at once, you can use it to take out a weak character while damaging others.
Combat_Supressive_Fire_QUEST_REWARDS: Good strategizing. It may be time to teach you some more advanced tactics.
Combat_Supressive_Fire_TASK_DESC_1: Train Clone Sergeant - Phase 1 to Level 9
Combat_Supressive_Fire_TASK_DESC_1_V2: Train Jedi Knight Anakin to Level 9
Combat_Supressive_Fire_TASK_DESC_3: Deal 1,000 damage to enemies with Clone Sergeant
Combat_Supressive_Fire_TASK_DESC_3_V2: Deal 1,000 damage to enemies with Jedi Knight Anakin
Combat_Talia_QUEST_DESC: Wield Talia's versatile abilities.\n\n Use Water of Life to transfer her health to allies, while Harrowing deals burst damage.
Combat_Talia_QUEST_DESC_V2: Wield Moff Gideon's versatile abilities.\n\nDisruptive Shot can lead to a Subversive Volley, while Darksaber Lunge can Armor Shred an opponent.
Combat_Talia_QUEST_REWARDS: Collect a full Nightsister squad to reveal their full potential.
Combat_Talia_QUEST_REWARDS_V2: Collect a full Imperial Remnant squad to reveal their full potential.
Combat_Territory_Battle_Geo_Droid_Factor: Show your might by mastering the Droid Factory to defeat the Galactic Republic!\n\nB1 Battle Droids saw extensive service as the front-line soldier of the Trade Federation's mechanized droid army.
Victory by overwhelming numbers is still victory.
Get the B1 Battle Droid to 7 Stars
Use the Droid Factory ability 50 times
Combat_Territory_Battle_Geo_TSeries_QUES: Hinder the Separatist army's combat readiness by defeating T-Series Tactical Droids.
General Kalani finds the T-series Tactical Droids inferior anyway, and he can prove it mathematically.
Combat_Territory_Battle_Geo_TSeries_TASK: Defeat 30 T-Series Tactical Droids in Geonosis: Republic Offensive with Galactic Republic characters.
Combat_Wookie_Rage_QUEST_DESC: I'm Shar, your new battle instructor.\n\nDuring the Clone Wars, Chewbacca famously shielded his allies. Use his Wookiee Rage to draw attacks!
Combat_Wookie_Rage_QUEST_DESC_V2: I'm Shar, your new battle instructor.\n\nObi-Wan Kenobi used the Force to aid him in battle. Use his Mind Tricks to suppress his opponents!
Combat_Wookie_Rage_QUEST_REWARDS: You just took your first step toward mastering Battle strategy!
Combat_Wookie_Rage_TASK_DESC_1: Train Clone Wars Chewbacca to Level 3
Combat_Wookie_Rage_TASK_DESC_1_V2: Train Obi-Wan Kenobi (Old Ben) to Level 3
Combat_Wookie_Rage_TASK_DESC_3: Win 2 battles with Clone Wars Chewbacca
Combat_Wookie_Rage_TASK_DESC_3_V2: Win 2 battles with Obi-Wan Kenobi (Old Ben)

Armed with his father's lightsaber, Luke is a heroic Rebel leader who supplements his allies' strengths with counter attacks, resists debilitating effects, and drives the enemy back with powerful strikes.

CONNECTIVITY_ISSUE_MESSAGE:
Greetings heroes,

We are aware that players have been experiencing issues connecting to the game. If you are seeing this message, that means the game team is aware of the issue and working on a solution. Connectivity issues can be difficult to track down, so please bare with us while we investigate this issue. We will do our best to post updates on our progress when we can, and we will be sure to let you know when the game is back to 100%.

Once connectivity has been restored, we may compensate players proportional to the severity and duration of the issues. Please be aware that we may not be able to compensate players immediately, but we will make it a priority to do so within the next few days.

The Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes dev team

CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_KFR_END_1_TEXT: I've been looking forward to this for a long time.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_KFR_SHIP_END_1: You don't know the power of the dark side!
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_KFR+_BESPINWIN: The Empire is trying to stop our citizens from evacuating. Please, help!
Please free Administrator Calrissian from the clutches of the evil empire!
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_KFR+_LANDOBESP: Attention! This is Lando Calrissian. The Empire has taken control of the city. I advise everyone to leave before more Imperial troops arrive.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_KFR+_SANDTROOP: We're looking for a pair of droids. We think they might have been captured by Jawas. Make your way to the edge of the Dune Sea. If any Jawas get in your way, eliminate them!
We've been receiving reports that Tusken Raiders have been attacking moisture farms. Head out there and fight them off!
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_01: This hero has the highest Speed so he takes the first turn. \nTap his Basic Ability icon to attack.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_01a: Take out those droids!\n\nTry out the Jedi's [f0ff23]BASIC ATTACK[-] first.
Take out those droids!\n\nUse the Jedi's [f0ff23]BASIC ATTACK[-].
Take out those droids!\n\nUse Anakin's [f0ff23]BASIC ATTACK[-].
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_01b: Now try the Clone Trooper's [f0ff23]BASIC ATTACK[-].
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_02: Let's use the Clone Trooper's [f0ff23]SPECIAL ABILITY[-] to finish them off!
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_02a: Those droids did some damage! \nUse your Jedi's [f0ff23]SPECIAL ABILITY[-] to [f0ff23]HEAL[-].
Those droids did some damage! \nUse Ahsoka's [f0ff23]SPECIAL ABILITY[-] to attack the droids and [f0ff23]HEAL[-] her allies.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_02b: Now use the Clone Trooper's [f0ff23]SPECIAL ABILITY[-] to [f0ff23]TARGET ALL[-] enemies and finish them off!
Now use the Clone Trooper's [f0ff23]SPECIAL ABILITY[-] to [f0ff23]DAMAGE ALL[-] enemies and finish them off!
Now use Anakin's [f0ff23]SPECIAL ABILITY[-] to [f0ff23]DAMAGE ALL[-] enemies and finish them off!
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_03: great work!  You've earned enough crystals to \nbuy a rare data pack.  Let's go get one.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_04: In time you'll be able to collect characters and use them to crew your very own ships.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_05: Let's show you some of the STRATEGIC elements of the game.\n\nFirst, ATTACK the enemy fleet with your ships.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_06: Pretty neat, huh? Now it's time to show you the STRATEGIC side of the game.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_07: Nice work! Now try tapping on an enemy ship to TARGET it.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_07b: With an enemy targeted, your ship portraits will now display who is stronger against that selected opponent.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_08: That ship was strong against that enemy and does extra damage.\nGo ahead and finish off the rest of the ships now.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_09: Remember, ships also have powerful [8fe2ff]SPECIAL ABILITIES[-].\n\nBe sure to use them when the situation calls for it.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_10: Your health is really low.  Use your \nSpecial Ability to finish them off
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_11: Great work!  You've earned enough crystals \nto buy a rare data pack.  Let's go get one!
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_ENE: Hmm. Looks like the [f0ff23]B2 SUPER BATTLE DROID[-] boss is getting healed.\n\nTap to [f0ff23]TARGET[-] the smaller droid healing him and destroy him first.
Hmm. Looks like the [f0ff23]B2 SUPER BATTLE DROID[-] boss is getting healed.\n\nTap to [f0ff23]TARGET[-] the weaker droid healing him first.
Hmm. Looks like the [f0ff23]B2 SUPER BATTLE DROID[-] boss is getting healed by the weaker droid.\n\nTap to [f0ff23]TARGET[-] the healer, and then attack it first.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_LEA: See that? Clone Wars Chewbacca's Leader Ability just increased your squad's Defense. Now see if you can win this battle yourself!
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_ONY: I'll bet you can win this Battle yourself...
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_ONBOARDING_TAU: You just used Clone Wars Chewbacca's [f0ff23]TAUNT[-] ability!\n\nNow all enemies will target him.
That unit just used a [f0ff23]TAUNT[-] ability!\n\nNow all of their opponents must target them!
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_STORY_MID01_IN: We are looking for two droids, they would have been wandering the Jundland Wastes.
<Ah, yes! We recovered those droids yesterday. Perhaps we can interest you in...>
Sir, we have followed one of the droids' tracks to this point. It looks like it was picked up by a large vehicle.
Sir! There's a group of Tusken Raiders over the ridge, heading this way.
Raiders... Get ready men. We'll deal with those scavenging Jawas after we're done with this lot.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_STORY_MID01_OU: Well done, men. Where are the droids?!
<We sold them to a moisture farmer... by the name of Lars!  Please, we are only scavengers...>
Thank you for your cooperation.  Men, make this look like the Tusken Raiders were here.  Let's go find that moisture farm.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_STORY_MIL01_IN: Jedi Knight Secura, failing the Western Front is. Pushed back it must be.
Yes, Master Yoda, We'll attack now. Let's go, squad!
CONTEXTUALMSG_CHAR_DIALOG_STORY_MIL01_OU: The Western Front has been secured, Master Yoda.
Good, very good. Find Kit Fisto. Alongside him next you must fight.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CONSUMABLE_PHASE_TEXT: You can use consumables at the start of each round.
CONTEXTUALMSG_CRAFTING_01_TEXT: You have unlocked the materials needed to craft your first item.
CONTEXTUALMSG_DAILY_ACTIVITIES_TEXT_01: Welcome to [f0ff23]DAILY ACTIVITIES[-]. Complete all activities daily to gain XP and [f0ff23]LEVEL UP FASTER[-]!
CONTEXTUALMSG_DARKSHIPCAMPAIGN_UNLOCK_DE: TRAIN and PROMOTE your characters to increase the power of your Ships!
CONTEXTUALMSG_DARKSHIPCAMPAIGN_UNLOCK_TI: You unlocked Dark Side Ship Battles!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_ADVANCEDVIEW_: [f0ff23]TAP[-] a mod to view its stats.
View the Mod Stats on the right and tap a Mod in your Inventory to [f0ff23]COMPARE STATS[-].
In [f0ff23]ADVANCED[-] View, you can also view your entire Mod Inventory and filter your Mods.
I’ll charge you a small [f0ff23]FEE TO REMOVE[-] a mod so you can assign it to another character.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_BASICVIEW_01: [f0ff23]BASIC[-] view gives you quick access to Mod suggestions that will improve your characters!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_BASICVIEW_02: Basic view will [f0ff23]SUGGEST[-] certain mods that are known to be useful on a character.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_BASICVIEW_03: [f0ff23]RECOMMENDED MOD SETS[-] are only suggestions. Quickly assign mods using Recommended Mod Sets or choose your own mod configurations in Advanced view.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_BASICVIEW_04: Toggle between [f0ff23]BASIC[-] and [f0ff23]ADVANCED[-] views whenever you want!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_BASICVIEW_05: Tap [f0ff23]AUTO ASSIGN[-] or an individual Mod slot to quickly assign suggested Mods for a Character.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_BASICVIEW_06: Sometimes Auto Assign will suggest exchanging a current Mod Set Bonus you have to change your mods to the [f0ff23]RECOMMENDED SET BONUSES[-].
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_CONQUEST_ARTI: Important! [f0ff23]Data Disks[-] can help you overcome difficult battles. Data Disks you pick up remain in your inventory for the entire event - and disappear before the next Conquest. Remember to equip them!
Each Data Disk has a [f0ff23]Data Capacity[-]. You need to stay within the limit, but try out different ones to come up with unique builds.
There's just a small tax of Conquest Credits for swapping those...
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_CONQUEST_CONS: Ahhh... [f0ff23]Consumables[-]! These are powerful items that will push the strength of your squads even higher.
You can have one of each category active at a time, and each Consumable has a limited duration. Make sure to check back often to keep your squads in fighting shape.
Consumables also disappear at the end of a Conquest event - so don't hold back.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_CONQUEST_DIFF: You'll need to prove your worth by completing easier difficulties before attempting harder ones. You'll have an opportunity to view the challenges that await you before committing to a difficulty.
Higher difficulties have stricter requirements before you can access them. And of course, the spoils of war will be greater in harder difficulties... As long as you can win.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_CONQUEST_MAP_: Ssssssss! You'll need to battle your way across the map to reach the Boss. From here, pick whichever path you think you can overcome.

There are several different types of nodes that comprise the map: Combat missions, Scavengers, and Data Disk Stockpiles. [f0ff23]Scavengers[-] are hidden throughout the map and offer you powerful items - for a cost - to help you progress.

[f0ff23]Data Disk Stockpiles[-] offer a choice between unique items that will help you succeed in battle. Gather both Data Disks and Consumables to help you along your journey. Some nodes are hidden from view until you move closer to them.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_CONQUEST_REWA: The more [f0ff23]Conquest Keycards[-] you get, the better the reward will be at the end of the event. There are even some spoils of war that you'll be able to get immediately!
Get Keycards by being victorious in combat and completing Feats. There are Event, Sector, and Boss feats, so you'll want to complete as many as possible to earn the best rewards.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_CONQUEST_SECT: On the left, you can access [f0ff23]Sectors[-] - which unlock in sequence. On the right, you have helpful information related to your progress in the event.
At the end of each Sector, you'll have to defeat the Boss before you can move on to the next Sector. Tap on the info button to see the Boss Squad and more information about the enemies you'll face.
Take a look at what challenges await you! Once you're ready, select [f0ff23]COMMIT[-]. Unless you're afraid of the challenge...
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_CONQUEST_STAM: When your allies are victorious in battle, they'll lose [f0ff23]Stamina[-]. Allies with lower Stamina have reduced stats.
Stamina refills over time, but sometimes you'll want to win immediately! You can use [f0ff23]Stim Packs[-] to regain some stamina.
Stim Packs can be purchased from the Conquest Store. Tap the button to the left to go there now.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_CONQUEST_UNLO: Hmm... It's been a while. Maybe you're finally ready for [f0ff23]CONQUEST[-].
These events might be longer than the ones you're used to... hope you have it in you to stick around. If you do, you could earn valuable [f0ff23]REWARD CRATES[-].
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_GUILDEXCHANGE: This is the Guild Exchange console.
From this area you are able to seek assistance from your fellow guild members by Requesting items.
You may issue a Request by viewing required Gear on a Character. If you're lacking some of the components to Craft, then the Request button will be made available.
Requests may only be made periodically, so choose carefully which Gear pieces to request of your guild members!
From here you may also donate toward other member requests.
Aiding fellow guild members is a great way to further secure success toward Raids and other Guild Activities!
Notice the Request button?\n\nThis item is eligible to be requested through the Guild Exchange!
If you decide to Request this item, then your other guild members will be able to make Donations toward your goal.
Requests last for a limited amount of time.
Once your Request goal has been met, or the time expires, then the Donations made toward your Request will be delivered to your Inbox.
Guilds thrive with all of its members advancing.\n\nSo be sure to return the favor back to your guild and help other members as often as possible!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODACQUIRED_0: Well done, you've just earned your first Mod!\n\nLet's go equip it.
Well done, you've just earned a [f0ff23]MOD[-]!\n\nLet's go assign it to a character.
Tap here to view your collection of Characters eligible for Mods.
Cantina rules require Characters be at least level 50 to have Mods assigned.\n\nOnly qualified Characters will be displayed here.
Characters must be level 50 or higher to have Mods assigned.\n\nOnly qualified characters will be displayed here.
Let's assign the Mod you just earned to this Character.
Every character has six Mod slots. Each of which requires Mods that fit that slot.
Transmitters fit only in this slot.\n\nLet's assign it there now.
Only Transmitters (Square Shaped Mods) fit in this slot.\n\nLet's assign it now.
Now tap here to select the Transmitter.
Unassigned Mod information is displayed in this area.
If you had a Mod already assigned to this slot, its information would be displayed in this upper area for quick comparison.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODACQUIRED_1: You can see how your stats will change based upon your decision.\n\nNumbers in red means a decrease whereas green is an increase.
If you haven't noticed, this slotted Mod is blinking slightly.\n\nThis means that this change is pending and has not yet been confirmed.
This allows you to try out numerous configurations to plan the best assignments for a character!
Congratulations on assigning your first Mod!
Assigning a Mod to an empty slot is a trivial task for me.\n\nRemoving them is a bit more difficult.
I can yank them out, destroying them in the process, or charge a small fee to carefully remove them without being damaged in any way.
Mods are very powerful augments to your Characters and there are many more you can win throughout the Cantina.
Do you wish to return to Mod Battles now?
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODACQUIRED_2: Do you wish to return to Mod Battles now?
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODBATTLES_01: Welcome to the Mods table.\n\nFrom this point forward, your level 50 Characters will be customizable!
Welcome to the [f0ff23]MOD BATTLES[-] table.\n\nHere you will [f0ff23]EARN MODS[-] to make your level 50+ characters more powerful!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODBATTLES_02: Customization occurs through modding a Character's data card to accentuate their strengths...
Customize your characters with [f0ff23]MODS[-] you earn from [f0ff23]MOD BATTLES[-] to amplify their strengths...
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODBATTLES_03: ... or to bolster their weaknesses.\n\nBest part of it all is that it's entirely up to your strategy.
... or to bolster their weaknesses.\n\nUse your [f0ff23]MOD ENERGY[-] daily to earn more [f0ff23]MODS[-].
... or to bolster their weaknesses.\n\nUse your [f0ff23]CANTINA ENERGY[-] daily to earn more [f0ff23]MODS[-].
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODBATTLES_04: Mods might seem a bit daunting at first but I will walk you through it.
Mods make your characters stronger! Earn several different types of mods here in [f0ff23]MOD BATTLES[-].
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODBATTLES_05: First things first, you need to complete one of my Mod Battles to earn one.
First things first, you need to complete one of my [f0ff23]MOD BATTLES[-] to earn a mod.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODBATTLES_06: Tap here, win this Battle, and earn your very first Mod!
Win this [f0ff23]MOD BATTLE[-] to earn a Mod!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODCHALLENGES: Nice! You've unlocked Mod Challenges. If you have the right squads you can earn higher rarity mods here than in Mod Battles. Try it out!
Nice! You've unlocked [f0ff23]MOD CHALLENGES[-].\n\nEarn [f0ff23]RARITY 3-5[-] mods here. Try it out!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODENERGY_01: A new [f0ff23]DAILY ACTIVITY[-] has been added. Finish 3 battles using [f0ff23]MOD ENERGY[-] daily!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODMAXLEVEL_0: Congratulations!\n\nThis Mod is now at its maximum level.
If all Mods of this set are also brought to their maximum level, then the Max Set Bonus is unlocked!
Upgrade each Mod of a matching set assigned to a character to unlock the Level 15 Set Bonus!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODSETCOMPLET: You just completed your first Mod Set!
Mod Sets provide a huge boost to a Character's stats.
There are numerous types of Mod Sets, each providing a unique boost.
Tap here to learn more about Mod Set Bonuses.
Some sets require two of the same Mod Type whereas others require four.
That means you're able to combine the effects of a single four piece set with that of a two piece.
Or you're able to fashion together three complete, two piece sets!
You're also able to complete multiples of the same set and their bonuses will all apply.
This allows you to have three completions of the Health Mod Set resulting in a massive amount of Health!
Mod Set Bonuses gain additional power once all its included Mods reach level 15 but I'll explain more about that later.
Every character is unique, so experiment with various sets to discover the best strategy.\n\nGood luck!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODSLICE_00: Welcome to [f0ff23]MOD SLICING[-]. [f0ff23]SLICE[-] your mods to increase their stats!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODSLICE_01: [f0ff23]SLICING[-] takes Credits and Mod Salvage. Increase your Mod’s stats through [f0ff23]SLICING[-]!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODSLICE_02: When you [f0ff23]SLICE[-] to increase a mod’s Tier, one of your mod’s Secondary Stat rolls will increase.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODSLICE_03: Each Secondary Stat has a max of [f0ff23](5)[-] rolls.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODSLICE_04: When you [f0ff23]SLICE[-] to increase a mod’s Rarity, the mod will reset to Tier E and increase all of its stats.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_MODUPGRADED_0: When I successfully Upgrade a Mod, it will always result in an increase of its Primary Stat.
[f0ff23]UPGRADE[-] a Mod to increase its [f0ff23]PRIMARY STAT[-].
At levels three, six, nine, and twelve the Mod will gain or, in some cases, increase a preexisting Secondary Stat.
At levels [f0ff23]3[-], [f0ff23]6[-], [f0ff23]9[-], and [f0ff23]12[-] the Mod will gain a [f0ff23]SECONDARY STAT[-] or increase a preexisting [f0ff23]SECONDARY STAT[-]. Upgrade a mod up to level 15!
Upgrading a Mod to its next level takes longer as it reaches higher levels, but with each Upgrade, I get closer to upgrading the Mod to its next level.
[f0ff23]UPGRADE MODS[-] often to power up your Characters!
Each Upgrade attempt I perform has a chance to instantly succeed!
When this happens, the Mod will immediately gain its level.\n\nOtherwise its Upgrade progress will be presented so you know how close I am to upgrading the Mod to its next level.
Upgrading Mods is very important to competition so visit often!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_RELICS_01: It's about time you gained access to a [c][F0FF23]Relic Amplifier[-][/c]. Do you have any idea how long I've been waiting?
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_RELICS_02: These devices empower innate traits in your characters, and boost their combat effectiveness.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_RELICS_03: Relic Amplifiers use [c][F0FF23]scrap parts[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]signal data[-][/c] to improve Base Attributes and grant an additional stat called Mastery. Mastery is determined by your character's Role and Primary Attribute.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_RELICS_04: You should talk to that filthy little Jawa that just took up residence at table seven.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_SCAVENGER_01: This little scamp is offering you its services for Scavenging. Fortunately, I'm fluent in Jawaese. I suppose I'll translate, but I refuse to tax my processors for you.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_SCAVENGER_02: [c]"You look like you've got a bantha-load of gear cards you don't need. Bring 'em over here and I'll smash 'em for scrap parts."[/c]
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_SCAVENGER_02_: You look like you've got a bantha-load of gear cards you don't need. Bring 'em over here and I'll smash 'em for scrap parts.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_SCAVENGER_03: [c]"Scrap parts are good for all sorts of things! Starfighters, speeders, droids, Relic Amplifiers, holotables... The list goes on and on."[/c]
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_SCAVENGER_04: [c]"Here, lemme show you how it's done. Gimme a piece of gear you don't want. I dunno, maybe one of them sensor arrays or somethin'."[/c]
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_SCAVENGER_05: [c]"That's a good start, but it looks like we're gonna need more gear if we want to get anything done here. Tap and hold a piece of gear, or use the quantity toggle if you wanna grab more than one."[/c]
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_SCAVENGER_06: [c]"All right, now we're talkin'. Now tap convert, sign on the dotted line, and we'll get this sandcrawler rollin'."[/c]
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_SCAVENGER_07: [c]"Last chance to change your mind. Once we crush this junk, it's not comin' back. Don't worry about any extras though. I'll throw those into the next one for you."[/c]
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_SCAVENGER_08: [c]"There you go, a few more of those things and you'll be able to power up that Relic Amplifier of yours. If you need more, you know where to find me."[/c]
CONTEXTUALMSG_FEATUREINTRO_SCAVENGER_JAW: Utinni! M'um m'aloo eyeta! Ikee kurruzza dooka. Uwanna waa opakwa?
CONTEXTUALMSG_FIRST_HARD_UNLOCK_DESC: Each time you defeat an enemy BOSS character you unlock the Hard Difficulty of that Battle.\n\nCompleting a Battle on Hard Difficulty provides a chance to grant Shards towards collecting that character.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FIRST_UNIT_SHARD_DROP_DESC: You just earned a Character Shard! Earn enough Shards of a character to unlock them in your collection.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_ABILITYUPGRADE_01_DES: You can spend credits to upgrade the [f0ff23]ABILITIES[-] of your characters. Let's do that now!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_ABILITYUPGRADE_02_DES: You have enough credits and [f0ff23]MATERIALS[-] to upgrade this character's Ability. Tap here to start.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_ABILITYUPGRADE_03_DES: Now just tap [f0ff23]UPGRADE[-] to finish!\n\nSpend your credits here and upgrade character abilities often.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_ACTIVITIES_01: New challenges and Battles await in the [f0ff23]DAILY ACTIVITIES[-] section.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_ACTIVITIES_02: You can earn a Player XP [f0ff23]REWARD[-] by completing 2 Light Side Battles.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_ACTIVITIES_03: Let's continue to the next Light Side Battle.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_ACTIVITIES_04:
This is where you set your [f0ff23]SQUAD[-].

You're already getting close to filling it up!

Tap here to [f0ff23]BATTLE[-].
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_ALLY_DESC: Add a temporary ally to your squad.\n\nAn ally's Leader Ability can activate during battle.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_BOSS_INTRO_TEXT: This is a BOSS character which boasts much higher stats and is guaranteed to attack multiple times per turn.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CAMPAIGN_FLOW_01_TEXT: Completing Campaigns earns many valuable resources.\n\nTap here to begin your journey.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CAMPAIGN_FLOW_02_TEXT: The first Campaign is Turning Points. Be a part of many eras and many battles and explore "what could have been".\n\nTap here to continue.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CAMPAIGN_FLOW_03_TEXT: Numerous worlds are a part of this Campaign but the journey begins on the infamous planet Hoth.\n\nTap here to continue.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CAMPAIGN_FLOW_04_TEXT: Each node on a world is filled with Battles. Completing the Battles rewards you with many resources needed to progress.\n\nTap here to continue.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CAMPAIGN_FLOW_05_TEXT: This is where the journey begins. It costs 3 Energy to attempt it but don't worry, Energy refreshes over time.\n\nTap here to continue.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CHALLENGESUNLOCK_DESC: Challenges are high difficulty puzzle-like battles you can complete for higher rewards. \n\nTry one now!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CHARACTERDROPPEDINBAT: You have a chance to acquire a new Character when defeating it in Battle.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CLAIM_DAILY_01_DESC: Excellent! You've completed another [f0ff23]DAILY ACTIVITY[-]! Let's go claim it now!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CLAIM_DAILY_02_DESC: Great job! Don't forget to check in to see what [f0ff23]DAILY ACTIVITIES[-] you have left to complete.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CLAIMDAILYACTIVITYREW: You've completed your first Daily Activity!\n\nLet's go [f0ff23]CLAIM[-] your reward!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CLASSMATCHUP_TEXT:
Use the CLASS WHEEL to
see who is strong against the targeted foe.

Then tap to attack!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CLASSWHEELINTRO: This CLASS WHEEL shows all faction matchups
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CRAFTING_01_TEXT: Craft Consumables before you enter Battle.\n\nHOME -> MANAGE -> CRAFTING
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_CRAFTING_FLOW_05_TEXT: Engage in Battle and check for shipments in the store for more materials to craft additional recipes.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_DAILYACTIVITYREWARD_0: You'll find yourself coming here often to collect rewards.
We're only one battle away from claiming that Daily Activity reward. Let's go there now.
Speed matters! Each Character has a [f0ff23]SPEED[-] stat that indicates when they can take their next turn.
Characters take turns based on their [f0ff23]SPEED[-].
The blue [f0ff23]SPEED BAR[-] (under the health bar) indicates which characters are ready to act.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_DARKSIDESQUAD_UNLOCK_: Form a dark side squad and battle the light side to earn CRYSTALS and Shards to unlock new characters!
New Feature Unlocked: Dark Side Battles
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_DARKSIDEUNLOCKPATH_DE: Collect 3 dark side characters and reach [f0ff23]Player Level 12[-] to unlock [f0ff23]DARK SIDE BATTLES[-]!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_DARKSIDEUNLOCKPATH_TI: You collected a dark side character!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_ELITE_INTRO_TEXT: This is an ELITE character which boasts increased stats and also has the ability to attack multiple times per turn.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_FACEBOOK_CONNECT_01_D: Connect to Facebook and invite your friends to become your allies! You will receive 200 Crystals when you connect.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_GEAR_EQUIP_1_DESC: You can equip [f0ff23]GEAR[-] to a hero to make them even stronger.

Each Event has 3 [c][F0FF23]ROUNDS[-][/c], in which you'll face an opponent 1-on-1 in the Grand Arena!
Each [c][F0FF23]ROUND[-][/c] you'll face an opponent [c][F0FF23]1-on-1[-][/c] in the Grand Arena!
In each round you are matched with your opponent with the [c][F0FF23]CLOSEST WIN RECORD[-][/c] in the event!
Each event consists of multiple rounds and each round you will face an opponent with the [c][F0FF23]NEAREST WIN RECORD[-][/c]. Greater success leads to greater challenges...
Prepare for the Grand Arena by setting your [c][F0FF23]DEFENSE[-][/c].

Win every round to earn the [c][F0FF23]GREATEST REWARDS[-][/c]!

CONTEXTUALMSG_INTRO_SCREEN_EVENT_TEXT: You just unlocked Events. Let's head over there now!
CONTEXTUALMSG_INTRO_SCREEN_EVENT_TEXT_01: This is the Events table. It contains many special Battles that have unique and plentiful rewards.
CONTEXTUALMSG_INTRO_SCREEN_EVENT_TEXT_02: Many of them are available for a limited time. These will always be the first thing on the left in the list.
CONTEXTUALMSG_INTRO_SCREEN_EVENT_TEXT_03: They will also display a countdown timer to display how much time is left before it goes away.
CONTEXTUALMSG_INTRO_SCREEN_EVENT_TEXT_04: These limited time Events change regularly so be certain to check back often!
CONTEXTUALMSG_INTRO_SCREEN_EVENT_TEXT_06: Once you attain Player Level 50, some permanently-available Battles become available.
CONTEXTUALMSG_INTRO_SCREEN_EVENT_TEXT_07: A couple examples of these are Profit Mining, which awards a substantial amount of Credits with chances for even higher rewards, and...
CONTEXTUALMSG_INTRO_SCREEN_EVENT_TEXT_08: Training Droids Hunt which is a great place to earn all the Training Droids you could possibly want.
There are also timed events that appear and disappear. This includes the Credit Heist which awards a substantial amount of Credits!
Also, be on the lookout for Basic Training events where you can learn effective combat techniques with a set of borrowed faction units.
Also, I have set up a few different Training Events where you can learn effective combat techniques with a set of borrowed faction units.
CONTEXTUALMSG_INTRO_SCREEN_EVENT_TEXT_09: That's all for now. Best of luck!
Rebel Basic Training is available now!

CONTEXTUALMSG_NEWSLETTER_DEVICEBLACKLIST: With our next game update, we will no longer be supporting Android devices with less than 1GB of memory. Although we have invested considerable effort in reducing the amount of memory needed to run our game, we still cannot guarantee an acceptable level of performance and stability on Android devices that have less that 1GB of RAM.\n\nIf you are using a device that has less than 1GB of RAM, you can save your progress in the game by linking your account to a Google Play account. CONTEXTUALMSG_SHIPSFTUE_STORE_FLOW_03: Let's prepare your [f0ff23]SHIPS[-] for the next [f0ff23]FLEET BATTLE[-]!
CONTEXTUALMSG_STARTER_GUILD_ACTIVITIES_T: These are your [f0ff23]GUILD ACTIVITIES[-]. There are [f0ff23]TWO DIFFERENT[-] Guild Activities to do daily.
The [f0ff23]FIRST[-] Guild Activity is to [f0ff23]SPEND 600 ENERGY[-] which earns 600 [f0ff23]RAID TICKETS[-]. These Tickets are used to start Raids.

The [f0ff23]SECOND[-] Guild Activity [f0ff23]CHANGES DAILY[-]! When your Guild does this activity more, the [f0ff23]REWARD TIER[-] goes up, increasing rewards for all! The more you contribute, the higher your rewards!
You’ll earn [f0ff23]GUILD TOKENS[-], which you can spend in the [f0ff23]GUILD STORE[-] for top-tier characters and premium [f0ff23]GEAR[-].
Do both of your Guild Activities every day to maximize your [f0ff23]REWARDS[-]!
CONTEXTUALMSG_STARTER_GUILD_JOIN_ALLY_TU: This is [f0ff23]GUILD SEARCH[-] where you can look for different Guilds to join!
As a new player, we recommend staying with your Starter Guild until you're leveled enough to join a normal Guild.
Remember - if you search for and join a different guild, you will be leaving your Starter Guild! You shouldn't do this until you’ve reached the higher levels of Starter Guilds!
As a new player, we recommend staying with your Starter Guild until you're leveled enough to join a normal guild.
Remember - if you search for and join a different guild, you will be leaving your Starter Guild! You shouldn't do this unless you're ready!
CONTEXTUALMSG_STARTER_GUILD_JOIN_TUT_01_: Welcome to [f0ff23]GUILDS[-]! Guilds unlock the most spectacular battles and unite the highest ranking players.
CONTEXTUALMSG_STARTER_GUILD_JOIN_TUT_02_: Join a Guild to fight cooperatively in thrilling [f0ff23]BOSS RAIDS[-], earn exclusive [f0ff23]REWARDS[-], [f0ff23]TRADE[-] valuable gear, battle in massive [f0ff23]TERRITORY WARS[-], and more!
In Guilds, fight cooperatively in thrilling [f0ff23]BOSS RAIDS[-], earn exclusive [f0ff23]REWARDS[-], trade [f0ff23]VALUABLE GEAR[-], battle in massive [f0ff23]TERRITORY WARS[-], and more!
CONTEXTUALMSG_STARTER_GUILD_JOIN_TUT_03_: You’ll begin in a [f0ff23]STARTER GUILD[-], which has other players around your level.
You've been added to the [f0ff23]MURDER OF PORGS[-] Starter Guild. Starter Guilds have other players around your level.\n\n[f0ff23]EXCHANGE GEAR[-] and [f0ff23]CHAT[-] with Guild Members!
CONTEXTUALMSG_STARTER_GUILD_MANAGE_TUT_0: Here is where you [f0ff23]VIEW[-] your Guild. Tap on any [f0ff23]PLAYER[-] to see more information.
CONTEXTUALMSG_STARTER_GUILD_RAID_DETAILS: Unlock new raids by advancing to the next level of Starter Guilds by completing [f0ff23]GUILD QUESTS[-]!
There are six [f0ff23]LEVELS[-] for Starter Guilds that progressively unlock new, more challenging, Raids.
CONTEXTUALMSG_STARTER_GUILD_RAIDS_TUT_01: Welcome to [f0ff23]RAIDS[-]! Raids include besting a flesh-eating [f0ff23]RANCOR[-], facing an indomitable [f0ff23]AAT TANK[-] led by the powerful [f0ff23]GENERAL GRIEVOUS[-], and battling notorious [f0ff23]ANCIENT SITH LORDS[-]!
CONTEXTUALMSG_STARTER_GUILD_RAIDS_TUT_02: [f0ff23]SPEND 600 ENERGY[-] to earn 600 Raid Tickets [f0ff23]EVERY DAY[-]. These Tickets are used to start Raids. More Tickets means more Raids!
CONTEXTUALMSG_STARTER_GUILD_RAIDS_TUT_03: The more you contribute to the defeat of a Raid Boss, the more [f0ff23]REWARDS[-] you will earn!

CONTRABAND_INJECTOR_BUNDLE_DESC:
This bundle contains some of the key salvage needed to create Characters' G12 Injectors, including Kyrotechs and all forms of Injector Salvage!

Each Bundle contains 25 each of: Injector Cell Salvage, Injector Head Salvage, and Injector Handle Salvage.

Additionally, each Bundle awards a varying number of Mk 7 Kyrotech Shock Prod Prototype Salvage and Mk 9 Kyrotech Battle Computer Prototype Salvage. The number of each item awarded is determined separately. There is a [b]20% chance[/b] to obtain 15 of the Item, a [b]45% chance[/b] to obtain 25 of the Item, a [b]30% chance[/b] to obtain 50 of the Item, and a [b]5% chance[/b] to obtain 100 of the Item!

Purchase today and upgrade your Gear before this valuable deal disappears from the store!

[i]Please note: Once crafted, Power Cell Injectors are unique and can only be equipped to the character they are crafted for.[/i]

Purchase limit: 2

DAILY_GUILD_CONTRIBUTION_CHANGE_DESC:
The Daily Activity “Personal Guild Contribution” has been removed and a new way to contribute Guild Bank Coins has been implemented! Track your personal contribution to your guild in the new Guild Activities section in the Guild area of the Cantina.

Due to this change, we are going to grant some Guild Bank Coins to offset any loss of Coins accrued. In addition, we know that last week there was a server bug where Guilds completed a Raid with a single individual doing an extraordinary amount of damage. Due to this bug, we've decided to increase the amount of Guild Bank Coins your Guild will receive, from 15,000 to 75,000.

All Guilds will receive 75,000 Guild Bank Coins when the Guild Leader logs in.
DAILY_GUILD_CONTRIBUTION_CHANGE_NAME: Guild Contribution Changes and the Raid Bug

DARTHTRAYA_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: As the Lord of Betrayal and Dark Lord of the Sith Triumvirate, Darth Traya was deceptive, manipulative, and untrusting. Traya unleashes a storm of three force-controlled lightsabers on her foes in an overwhelming and unavoidable assault. Using her prodigious and powerful knowledge of the Force, she Isolates her enemies from their allies and exploits their compassion to drain their Health and their will to fight. True to her title, Traya betrays her allies to increase her own power - converting their suffering into damage and Dazing enemies.

DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_AAT_DIFF01_PHASE01_TE: [23C8F5]On one of the many battlefields of the Clone Wars, the nefarious General Grievous has made a rare appearance to personally direct the battle. Defeating him here would surely turn the tide of the war![-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_AAT_DIFF01_PHASE02_TE: [23C8F5]Grievous's patience has worn thin--he orders one of his dreaded AATs to cover his retreat. With nigh-impervious armor and a small arsenal of anti-personnel weaponry, it is one of the deadliest weapons on the battlefield.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_AAT_DIFF01_PHASE03_TE: [23C8F5]The AAT has been disabled, but the battle is far from over--Grievous summons a squad of B1 Battle Droids, led by one of his special B2 Rocket Troopers, to hold the line while the AAT is repaired.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_AAT_DIFF01_PHASE04_TE: [23C8F5]Grievous has ordered an all-out offensive, deploying additional B2 Battle Droids to support the AAT, as well as granting clearance for air strikes to crush any opposition.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_GRANTEDABILITY_EMPIRE: [23C8F5]All of your Empire characters gain the following ability:[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_GRANTEDABILITY_HERO_G: [23C8F5]All of your Geonosis Heroes gain the following ability:[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_GRANTEDABILITY_HERO_H: [23C8F5]All of your Hoth Hero Characters gain the following ability:[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_GRANTEDABILITY_REBEL_: [23C8F5]All of your Rebel Characters gain the following ability:[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_GRANTEDABILITY_TEXT: [23C8F5]All of your Characters gain the following ability within the Raid:[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_RANCOR_DIFF01_PHASE01: [23C8F5]Pig-like brutes known as Gamorreans stand as the first line of defense toward the inner sanctum of The Pit. Their captain, heavily guarded by his seemingly-endless waves of reinforcements, must be defeated to breach the sanctum door.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_RANCOR_DIFF01_PHASE02: [23C8F5]The terror residing within the inner sanctum has been unleashed. Riled from the sounds of battle, the Rancor's enduring defenses are nearly impenetrable. Beware of its insatiable appetite![-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_RANCOR_DIFF01_PHASE03: [23C8F5]Taking on a more aggressive nature, the Rancor is more susceptible to damage. Sometimes, however, the best defense is a strong, debilitating offense.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_RANCOR_DIFF01_PHASE04: [23C8F5]Wounded but not tiring, the Rancor's rage during its final stand is unquestionable.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_SITHRAID_PHASE01_TEXT: [23C8F5]At the doors to the Trayus Academy, the Lord of Hunger makes an appearance. The Sith Lord Nihilus has come to drain the force of those who wish to enter the Academy. Defeat Nihilus here to find the Core.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_SITHRAID_PHASE02_TEXT: [23C8F5]As Nihilus retreats into the depths of the Academy, a new foe shows his face in the Sparring Room. The seemingly unkillable Lord of Pain is now on the offensive and seeks to destroy all who would try to stand in his way.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_SITHRAID_PHASE03_TEXT: [23C8F5]Darth Sion is seemingly defeated, left lying in the Sparring Room. Inside of the Trayus Academy Core, the Master of the previous Sith lurks in the shadows. The Lord of Betrayal, Darth Traya, comes forward to destroy those who would defy her.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_SITHRAID_PHASE04_TEXT: [23C8F5]Darth Nihilus and Darth Sion rejoin the fight alongside Darth Traya. Face the deadly Sith Triumvirate all at once![-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_TERRITORYBATTLE_GEONO: [23C8F5]The Republic has amassed some of its best fighting forces in its onslaught on Geonosis. Be on the lookout for Elite characters – not only are they much stronger than normal characters, but they also have powerful Elite abilities![-]

[23C8F5]The Galactic Republic has amassed some of its best fighting forces in its onslaught on Geonosis. Be on the lookout for Elite characters – not only are they much stronger than normal characters, but they also have powerful Elite abilities![-]

EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n In this event, you will face a determined team of Jedi! These formidable warriors once led the clone armies of the Galactic Republic. \n Successfully eliminating General Kenobi is the key to being free to attack Anakin and Ahsoka.
EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n[c][F0FF23]DROID BATTALION[-][/c] - B1s can't score critical hits. B1s have 1 Health and you start with a number of B1s at your disposal. B1s gain Offense while Separatist allies gain Tenacity and Critical Hit Avoidance for each B1 on the battlefield. When B1s are destroyed, Separatist allies gain Turn Meter.
EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n[c][F0FF23]B1 BARRAGE[-][/c] - Deals Physical damage to target enemy. If the damaged enemy is Target Locked, all Droid allies recover Health and Protection.
EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n[c][F0FF23]BLAST THEM![-][/c] - Deals Physical damage to all enemies and inflicts Target Lock on the selected target. Target ally recovers Health and Protection for each B1 remaining.
EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n[c][F0FF23]ROGER ROGER[-][/c] - Whenever another Separatist ally attacks an enemy with their Basic ability, the B1s assist with reduced damage. When another Droid uses a Special ability, the B1s gain Turn Meter.
EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n B1 Battle Droids are best with Droid or Separatist allies; deploy them with those factions to maximize the potential of the droid army! \n In this battle, you will be using B1 in a full Separatist squad. Enjoy!

EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]PREY ON THE WEAK[-][/c] deals Physical damage and will Critically Hit the weakest enemy if they are the target
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]HUNTING PARTY[-][/c] Stuns the target and calls Bounty Hunters to assist for reduced damage
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]PREDATOR INSTINCTS[-][/c] dispels all Debuffs on Bossk and grants him Taunt and Frenzy
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]ON THE HUNT[-][/c] grants all Bounty Hunters bonus Tenacity and Protection
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]TRANDOSHAN RAGE[-][/c] grants Bossk Health and Defense while Taunting, and Offense and Health Steal while attacking buffed enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M06_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Bossk will be forced into the Leader position. Use this mission to perfect your strategy with Bossk!
