EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_BONUS_DE: This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]TOOTH AND NAIL[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy and dispels all debuffs from Hound's Tooth\n - Hound's Tooth recovers Health and Protection if it has Taunt
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DEVOURER OF PREY[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy and inflicts Breach, then Hound's Tooth gains Taunt\n - [c][F0FF23]BREACH[-][/c] reduces Speed and Defense
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_M03_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - [c][F0FF23]TRANDOSHAN BARRICADE[-][/c] grants Hound's Tooth Protection Up (stacking) whenever it takes damage from an enemy
 - While not Taunting, Hound's Tooth has increased Tenacity and gains Turn Meter whenever an ally takes damage from an enemy
 - When Hound's Tooth loses Taunt, it gains Taunt if an enemy is Breached
 - While Hound's Tooth is active, Breached enemies have reduced Evasion
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SECURE THE HUNT[-][/c] is a Reinforcement Ability that grants all allies Tenacity\n - Additionally, all Bounty Hunter allies gain Counter Chance (stacking) whenever they Resist a detrimental effect
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_PRACTICE: This is a Practice Tier. Hound's Tooth and the Executrix will be forced units, and you do not need to bring a full fleet in order to experiment with different strategies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_SUMMARY: Join forces with the [c][F0FF23]HOUND'S TOOTH[-][/c] and hunt an elusive bounty across the galaxy!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus Tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DISMANTLING SHOT[-][/c] dispels all buffs from the target enemy and deals Physical damage
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]KYUZO WAR HELMET[-][/c] deals bonus damage based on Embo's Max Protection, then Embo loses 50% Protection
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]THE QUIET ASSASSIN[-][/c] grants Bounty Hunter allies Counter Chance and Health Steal when Embo is in the Leader slot\n - When fully upgraded, Bounty Hunter allies gain Offense Up when they score Critical Hits
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M04_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - [c][F0FF23]WAY OF THE KYUZO[-][/c] grants different bonuses based on whether or not Embo has Protection
 - When Embo receives damage from an attack and has no Protection, he gains Foresight
 - When fully upgraded, Embo can't be Critically Hit
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M05_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - Embo's [c][F0FF23]CONTRACT[-][/c] is active when he is in the Leader slot, and not the Ally slot
 - Damage enemies without Buffs to complete the Contract (only Bounty Hunter allies can contribute)
 - When completed, Embo gains a chance to take a bonus turn after scoring a Critical Hit and all Bounty Hunter allies gain Offense and deal bonus damage based on the target's Max Protection
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M06_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - When fully upgraded, [c][F0FF23]EMBO'S PAYOUT[-][/c] grants Embo the Special Ability [c][F0FF23]ELUSIVE STRIKES[-][/c] when a Bounty Hunter Contract is completed\n - [c][F0FF23]ELUSIVE STRIKES[-][/c] ignores Protection, deals Physical damage, and recovers Protection equal to the damage dealt
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_PRACTICE_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Embo will be forced into the Leader slot. Use this mission to perfect your strategy with Embo!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_SUMMARY: Join forces with [c][F0FF23]EMBO[-][/c] and track bounties across the galaxy!

EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]EXPLOIT IDENTIFIED[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy\n - If the enemy is Breached, the IG-2000 attacks again
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]INERTIAL DAMPENERS DISABLED[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and inflicts Stun and Target Lock \n - Deals more damage to Breached enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_M03_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - [c][F0FF23]RECONSTRUCT PROTOCOL[-][/c] recovers the IG-2000's Health at the start of each turn
 - The IG-2000 gains Offense for each debuffed enemy
 - While the IG-2000 is active, Breached enemies have lowered Critical Chance
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_M04_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - [c][F0FF23]INITIATE SLICE SEQUENCE[-][/c] is a Reinforcement Ability that grants a random Attacker ally Offense Up
 - All enemies are inflicted with Critical Chance Down
 - Additionally, Target Lock is inflicted on the highest and lowest Health enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_PRACTICE_DESC: This is a Practice Tier. The IG-2000 and the Executrix will be forced units, and you do not need to bring a full fleet in order to experiment with different strategies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_SUMMARY: Join forces with the [c][F0FF23]IG-2000[-][/c] to propagate cold, metal, and evil across the galaxy!

EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]HULL BREACH[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts [c][F0FF23]BREACH[-][/c]\n - Breach lowers enemy Defense and Speed by 25%
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]ROGUE MANEUVER[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies, inflicts Target Lock on the weakest enemy, then calls a targeted ally to assist\n - If any enemy is already Target Locked, they are inflicted with Breach
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CLOAK AND DAGGER[-][/c] grants Stealth at the start of an Encounter or when a Scoundrel ally suffers a critical hit, and lowers the Offense of Breached enemies\n - When fully upgraded, Bounty Hunter allies will also deal additional damage when attacking a Breached enemy
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]INTO THE BREACH[-][/c] inflicts Breach on the target enemy when Xanadu Blood enters from Reinforcement\n - When fully upgraded, Scoundrel allies also gain Retribution when Xanadu Blood enters from Reinforcement and all enemies gain Defense Down
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_PRACTICE_DESC: This is a Practice Tier. Xanadu Blood and Executrix will be forced allies. Experiment with different team compositions and strategies to learn the power of the Xanadu Blood.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_SUMMARY: Form a fleet and battle with Cad Bane’s [c][F0FF23]XANADU BLOOD[-][/c]!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_BONUS_BOUNTY_0: [c][B5E7F5]Requirements:[-][/c] Bounty Hunters\n\n  A member of one of the criminal cartels has information that could jeopardize our plan. You will eliminate this criminal and ensure nobody interferes.

[c][B5E7F5]Requirements:[-][/c] Bounty Hunters\n\n  An opportunity has arisen to eliminate a high ranking Jedi Temple Guard who has left Coruscant for unknown reasons. Use extreme caution and eliminate the target and any Jedi present.
[c][B5E7F5]Requirements:[-][/c] Bounty Hunters\n\n  A group of witches has been isolated on Dathomir. This is a rare opportunity to eliminate some potential competition, so see to it.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]UNSCRUPULOUS GUNFIRE[-][/c] deals damage which increases for each debuff the enemy is suffering from\n - When fully upgraded, Jango will attack again if the enemy is debuffed
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SHRAPNEL BLAST[-][/c] deals damage to the primary target and another random enemy, in addition to applying Healing Immunity\n - When fully upgraded, enemies are also inflicted with Stagger
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CONFLAGRATION[-][/c] inflicts BURNING and deals damage, which can't be Evaded\n - [c][F0FF23]BURNING[-][/c] minimizes Evasion chance on afflicted units and deals damage over time
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M04_DESC:
[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]
 - [c][F0FF23]ANYTHING TO GET AHEAD[-][/c] grants Scoundrel allies Speed, lowers enemies Tenacity, and has other beneficial effects
 - When fully upgraded it adds a Contract ability to damage Debuffed enemies with a Basic or Special ability
 - When Jango fulfills his Leadership Contract, all allies gain [c][F0FF23]BOUNTY HUNTER'S RESOLVE[-][/c] and increased Critical Chance
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]NOTORIOUS REPUTATION[-][/c] grants Jango bonus Defense Penetration and Health, and prevents enemies he defeats from being Revived\n - When fully upgraded, Jango Fett has 100% Defense Penetration making him extremely powerful against high Defense targets
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M06_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Jango Fett's [c][F0FF23]CONTRACT[-][/c] grants Jango a large Offense boost\n - When fully upgraded, Jango gains Damage Immunity briefly once his Contract is fulfilled

EVENT_MARQUEE_GREEFKARGA_M01_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][F0FF23]Dual Shot[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy twice and inflicts Daze.

EVENT_MARQUEE_GREEFKARGA_M02_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Greef Karga

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][F0FF23]Bring Them in Cold[-][/c] dispels all buffs on target enemy and Bounty Hunter allies are called to assist.
- When fully upgraded, allies with payouts deal more damage and if an enemy is defeated this way, Bounty Hunter allies gain Offense Up, Defense Penetration, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and Health Steal.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GREEFKARGA_M03_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Greef Karga

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][F0FF23]Sweeten the Deal[-][/c] gives all Bounty Hunter allies Retribution and they recover Health and Protection. These effects are doubled if they have a Payout active. Allies with active Payouts gain bonus Turn Meter.
- When fully upgraded, allies with Payouts also have their debuffs dispelled, gain Tenacity Up and Turn Meter.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GREEFKARGA_M04_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Greef Karga
- The Mandalorian

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Greef Karga's Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Loyalty Pays[-][/c], gives Bounty Hunter allies more Max Protection.
- Fully upgraded, when a Bounty Hunter ally gains a buff, they recover Protection.
- If Greef Karga is in the Leader slot, his Contract is active.
- Bounty Hunter allies who attack out of turn contribute to Greef Karga's Contract and gain Critical Chance and Offense.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GREEFKARGA_M05_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Greef Karga

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][F0FF23]Boss of the Guild[-][/c] gives Greef Karga stealth at the start of encounter.
- Fully upgraded, when any Bounty Hunter earns their Payout while Greef Karga is alive, allied Bounty Hunters' cooldowns are reduced and Greef Karga gains a stacking bonus to Counter Chance, Critical Avoidance and Max Health.
- Greef Karga recovers Health and Protection and gains Stealth at the end of each of his turns. Fully upgraded, Greef dispels all debuffs on Bounty Hunter allies and whenever he becomes inflicted with a debuff, his cooldowns are reduced.

EVENT_MARQUEE_JEDISTARFIGHTERANAKIN_BONU: This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_JEDISTARFIGHTERANAKIN_M01_: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]LOCKED ON[-][/c] deals Physical damage and inflicts Target Lock\n - If the enemy was already Target Locked, grant a random ally Valor
EVENT_MARQUEE_JEDISTARFIGHTERANAKIN_M02_: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]IMPEDING ASSAULT[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies and inflicts Healing Immunity and Buff Immunity on the target enemy\n - Anakin's Starfighter gains Protection Up for each Critical Hit
EVENT_MARQUEE_JEDISTARFIGHTERANAKIN_M03_: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SURGE ALL POWER[-][/c] grants all Jedi and Clone allies Offense, and Anakin's Starfighter gains Turn Meter and Bonus Damage whenever an ally is defeated or falls below 100% Health\n - Anakin's Starfighter also regains Valor whenever it expires
EVENT_MARQUEE_JEDISTARFIGHTERANAKIN_M04_: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]AGGRESSIVE APPROACH[-][/c] is a Reinforcement Ability that grants all allies Accuracy Up\n - When fully upgraded, Anakin's Starfighter also grants Galactic Republic allies Offense Up, and inflicts Expose on all enemies for 2 turns
EVENT_MARQUEE_JEDISTARFIGHTERANAKIN_SUMM: Deploy your fleet and join forces with Jedi Knight Anakin in his [c][F0FF23]Eta-2 Starfighter[-][/c]!
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_BONUS_DES: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]JEDI ASSAULT[-][/c] deals Special damage and inflicts Ability Block\n - When fully upgraded, this ability gains 20% Damage and Potency for each active Jedi ally
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]RALLY[-][/c] Dispels Bastila and a target Ally, then grants them both a suite of buffs, and then calls that ally to assist\n - When fully upgraded, this ability grants Bastila and the target Ally Offense, Defense, Speed, Accuracy, and Critical Chance Up
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SUBVERT DEFENSES[-][/c] deals Special damage and removes all Buffs on an enemy\n - This ability also has a chance to Stun the target
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]LEGENDARY BATTLE MEDITATION[-][/c] gives Turn Meter and a buff to allies at the start of Bastila's turns\n - This buff grants Potency and Counter Chance, and the effect is doubled on Jedi allies
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]INITIATIVE[-][/c] provides powerful early battle bonuses for Jedi including Turn Meter and an undispellable Protection Up\n - When fully upgraded, this ability also grants Jedi Tanks [c][F0FF23]TAUNT[-][/c] at the start of battle and increases the damage of allied Jedi who have Protection Up
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_M06_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Bastila's leader ability, [c][F0FF23]INITIATIVE[-][/c], gives Jedi a very powerful early battle advantage and survivability\n - Use the full squad of Jedi in this Mission to defeat your enemies and see the power [c][F0FF23]BASTILA SHAN[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]JOLEE BINDO[-][/c] provide to a Jedi squad
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_NAME: LEGENDS OF THE OLD REPUBLIC I\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_PRACTICE_: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Bastila Shan will be placed into the Ally slot, and you can bring as little as a single unit in order to experiment with different strategies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_SUMMARY: Join forces with [c][F0FF23]BASTILA SHAN[/c][-] and escape the Sith!
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]NO OTHER OPTIONS[-][/c] deals Physical damage and heals Jolee\n - When fully upgraded, this ability also reduces Jolee's cooldowns when he deals damage during his turn
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]EH, YOU DO IT[-][/c] calls a target Ally to assist\n - Jolee's second Unique Ability, [c][F0FF23]EXPERIENCE AND WISDOM[-][/c], synergizes with Eh, You Do It when fully upgraded
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]THAT LOOKS PRETTY BAD[-][/c] heals a targeted ally and dispels any debuffs on them\n - When upgraded fully, this ability also revives all defeated Jedi and grants them Critical Avoidance for 5 turns
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DON'T INTERRUPT ME[-][/c] grants Jolee immunity to Turn Meter Reduction effects and bonus Tenacity\n - When upgraded fully, this Ability grants Jolee 100% Tenacity and additional survivability
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]EXPERIENCE AND WISDOM[-][/c] increases Jolee's Max Health\n - When fully upgraded, this ability also grants Protection Up to targets of Eh, You Do It and That Looks Pretty Bad, and heals the target as well as heals all Jedi
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_M06_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - In this Mission your Jedi allies will be defeated at the start. Use Jolee to revive them with a fully upgraded [c][F0FF23]THAT LOOKS PRETTY BAD[-][/c] and then defeat your enemies\n - [c][F0FF23]BASTILA SHAN[-][/c] is the leader here, and her leader ability causes Jedi with Protection Up to deal increased damage
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_NAME: LEGENDS OF THE OLD REPUBLIC II\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_PRACTICE_DE: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Jolee Bindo will be placed into the Ally slot, and you can bring as little as a single unit in order to experiment with different strategies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_SUMMARY: Join forces with [c][F0FF23]JOLEE BINDO[/c][-] and rescue a friend from enemies in the sewers!
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_03_SITHFIGHTER_BONUS: This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_03_SITHFIGHTER_M01_D: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]STIFLE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Healing Immunity\n - This attack deals high damage
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_03_SITHFIGHTER_M02_D: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]FIRST STRIKE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Health Down\n - If the target is below 50% Health, this ability deals increased damage
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_03_SITHFIGHTER_M03_D: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SWARM TACTICS[-][/c] allows Sith fighter to ignore Protection on Debuffed enemies and provides other benefits to allied Sith ships\n - This ability makes Sith fighter especially powerful against ships with large amounts of Protection
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_03_SITHFIGHTER_M04_D: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]EXTREME MANEUVERABILITY[-][/c] is a Reinforcement Ability that grants Foresight when entering battle or when a Sith ally Critically hits\n - When Sith Fighter has Foresight, it deals increased Damage and loses Max Health (stacking) at the start of its turns
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_03_SITHFIGHTER_PRACT: This is a Practice Tier. Sith Fighter and the Executrix will be forced units, and you do not need to bring a full fleet in order to experiment with different strategies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_03_SITHFIGHTER_SUMMA: Deploy your fleet and join forces with a [c][F0FF23]SITH FIGHTER[-][/c]!
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DISABLE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Ability Block\n - When fully upgraded, the Ability Block cannot be resisted by Target Locked enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]REPAIR KIT[-][/c] dispels all debuffs on the target, and if the target was a Droid they are Healed\n - When fully upgraded, this ability also restores Protection and grants Offense Up and Critical Hit Immunity to Droids
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CARBONITE PROJECTOR[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies, dispels their Defensive buffs, removes Turn Meter, and inflicts Critical Chance Down\n - When fully upgraded, this ability also adds Offense Down and Target Locked enemies can't resist the Debuffs
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]COMBAT LOGIC UPGRADE[-][/c] grants T3-M4 stacking Potency and Critical Hit Chance each time he uses an ability\n - When fully upgraded, Droid allies also gain T3-M4's stacks of Potency and Critical Hit Chance
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]MASTER GEARHEAD[-][/c] grants T3-M4 bonus Defense Penetration and inflicts Target Lock on enemies\n - When fully upgraded, this ability grants Droid allies 100% of T3-M4's Defense Penetration
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_M06_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - In this battle you will be using T3-M4 in a full squad of Droids. Enjoy!

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_SUMMARY: Join forces with [c][F0FF23]T3-M4[-][/c] and infiltrate a Sith base!
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_05_MISSION_BONUS_DES: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_05_MISSION_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DON'T BLINK[-][/c] deals damage and can inflict Daze\n - When fully upgraded, Mission gains Turn Meter if her target was debuffed
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_05_MISSION_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]STREET SMARTS[-][/c] dispels all debuffs on Mission, grants her Turn Meter, and Stealth\n - This ability also inflicts [c][F0FF23]BLIND[-][/c] which causes the enemy to miss their next attack
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_05_MISSION_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]NOW YOU SEE ME[-][/c] grants Mission increased Potency and she will inflict Damage over Time on her target when using abilities\n - When fully upgraded, Mission gains additional Potency if the Damage over Time is resisted until she successfully inflicts Damage over Time
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_05_MISSION_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]ME AND BIG Z FOREVER[-][/c] grants Mission bonus Offense, which Zaalbar also gains\n - When fully upgraded, Mission will also Assist Zaalbar
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_05_MISSION_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Mission and Zaalbar have strong ally synergy thanks to [c][F0FF23]ME AND BIG Z FOREVER[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]MISSION'S GUARDIAN[-][/c]\n - When paired together, they strongly complement one another and enable powerful strategies

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_BONUS_DES: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]STALWART ALLY[-][/c] deals Physical damage and Zaalbar recovers Health\n - When fully upgraded, the target is also inflicted with Damage Over Time
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]POWER BLAST[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies and Zaalbar gains Taunt\n - When fully upgraded, Critical Hits inflict Armor Shred
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]WOOKIEE TOUGHNESS[-][/c] grants Defense (stacking) whenever Zaalbar takes damage until the end of his next turn
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]MISSION'S GUARDIAN[-][/c] Zaalbar and Mission gain additional Critical Avoidance and Zaalbar gains Taunt and Retribution when any ally drops below Max Health\n - When fully upgraded, they recover Health and Protection for each Damage over Time effect on enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Zaalbar and Mission have strong ally synergy thanks to [c][F0FF23]MISSION'S GUARDIAN[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]ME AND BIG Z FOREVER[-][/c] \n - When paired together, they strongly complement one another and enable powerful strategies

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_BONUS_: This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_M01_DE: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]LASER BARRAGE[-][/c] deals Physical damage and the B-28 has a chance to gain Defense Up on a Critical Hit\n - When fully upgraded, the B-28 has a 100% chance to gain Defense Up on a Critical Hit
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_M02_DE: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]BOMBING RUN[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies and places Concussion Mines on them\n - [c][F0FF23]CONCUSSION MINES[-][/c] deal 10% Max Health damage and Daze the target when they explode
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_M03_DE: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]HIGH-VALUE TARGET[-][/c] grants the B-28 Taunt the first time other Sith allies take damage and any time other Sith allies drop below 100% Health, and the B-28 recovers Protection any time a Concussion Mine explodes\n - When fully upgraded, the B-28 gains Critical Avoidance while Taunting, and any time a Sith ally takes damage or evades an attack from an enemy, there is a chance to place a Concussion Mine on that enemy
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_M04_DE: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]BOMBER BACKUP[-][/c] is a Reinforcement Ability that places Concussion Mines on all enemies when the B-28 enters battle\n - When fully upgraded, Sith allies recover Protection any time a Concussion Mine explodes (while the B-28 is active) and an additional Concussion Mine is placed on all enemies when the B-28 enters battle
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_NAME: OUT OF THE BLACK II\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_SUMMAR: Deploy your fleet and join forces with the [c][F0FF23]B-28 EXTINCTION-CLASS BOMBER[-][/c]!
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Face a squad of deadly Raiders! These powerful foes terrorized the Old Republic, and now wreak havoc on the peaceful world of Dantooine. Use all Carth Onasi's tricks to defeat his enemies and make the galaxy a safer place.\n - Raider attacks are more effective against enemies suffering from Armor Shred. Only the Raider Marshal can apply Armor Shred in this mission.

Inflicting [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c] also reduces the cooldown of [c][F0FF23]HELD BY HATRED[-][/c].
EVENT_MARQUEE_SITH_03_SION_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]TORMENT[-][/c] deals AoE damage, dispels all buffs on enemies, and inflicts [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c].
EVENT_MARQUEE_SITH_03_SION_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]BREAK WILL[-][/c] deals Physical damage and inflicts [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c]. If the target already has [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c], this attack deals bonus damage and Sion recovers Protection.
EVENT_MARQUEE_SITH_03_SION_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]HELD BY HATRED[-][/c] removes all debuffs on Sion and recovers some of his Health and Turn Meter.\n - Sion then gains [c][F0FF23]HATRED[-][/c] which increases his Critical Chance, Defense, and Offense. If Sion is defeated while he has [c][F0FF23]HATRED[-][/c], he revives at full Health and Turn Meter.
EVENT_MARQUEE_SITH_03_SION_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]LORD OF PAIN[-][/c] grants Sion additional Defense and Tenacity against enemies afflicted with [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c]. If an enemy has [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c] at the start of their turn, Sion gains [c][F0FF23]TAUNT[-][/c].

EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_04_NEST_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CUT THROUGH[-][/c] deals damage, dispels Defensive Buffs, and can't be Evaded\n - Defensive Buffs include Defense, Health, Protection, Evasion, Tenacity Up, as well as Taunt, Stealth, Foresight, Heal Over Time, and Crit Immunity
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_04_NEST_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SUDDEN IMPACT[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Buff Immunity. If the target has Protection it deals more damage and ignores Armor
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_04_NEST_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]KINETITE CHARGE[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies, inflicts Daze, and removes Turn Meter from enemies with full Health
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_04_NEST_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]FIGHTING INSTINCT[-][/c] grants Nest Counter Attack chance, bonus Protection, and Critical Chance when she takes damage until the end of her next turn
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_04_NEST_PRACTICE_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Enfys Nest will be forced into the Ally position\n - You can enter with less than maximum squad members to experiment with different team compositions
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_04_NEST_SUMMARY: \nJoin forces with [c][F0FF23]ENFYS NEST[-][/c] and fight for your life!
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_L3_37_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus Tier features powerful enemies and requires careful strategy
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_L3_37_M00_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This tutorial tier will review [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] with a full team of Scoundrels.
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_L3_37_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DARING ADVANCE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Defense Down\n - If L3-37 is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c], she gains Max Health (stacking) until end of encounter
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_L3_37_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SPARK OF HOPE[-][/c] deals damage to target enemy, and L3-37 gains Taunt\n - If L3-37 is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c], she heals all Scoundrel and Droid allies
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_L3_37_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - If L3-37 takes damage from an attack, her unique ability, [c][F0FF23]FOR THE DROIDS[-][/c], will dispel debuffs from a random Scoundrel ally at the end of the turn
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_L3_37_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SELF MODIFICATION[-][/c] grants L3-37 a new Special ability that can enhance her combat capabilities
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_L3_37_PRACTICE_DES: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. L3-37 will be forced into the Ally position\n - You can enter with less than maximum squad members to experiment with different team compositions
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_L3_37_SUMMARY: \nJoin forces with [c][F0FF23]L3-37[-][/c] and fight for your life!
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_YLANDO_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus Tier features powerful enemies and requires careful strategy
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_YLANDO_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SILENT SHOT[-][/c] deals damage, inflicts Potency Down, and deals 25% more damage for each Prepared ally
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_YLANDO_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]HOT HAND[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Ability Block. For each debuffed enemy there is a 50% chance to reduce the cooldown of [c][F0FF23]HOT HAND[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_YLANDO_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DEALER'S CHOICE[-][/c] dispels an ally, and Lando gains Turn Meter. If Young Lando Calrissian is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] he grants it to that ally and all Prepared allies gain Speed Up
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_YLANDO_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]PERFECT TIMING[-][/c] gives Young Lando Calrissian a chance to become [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] at the start of his turn, and grants Critical Chance and Critical Damage to himself if he's buffed or [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_YLANDO_PRACTICE_DE: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Young Lando Calrissian will be forced into the Ally position\n - You can enter with less than maximum squad members to experiment with different team compositions
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_05_YLANDO_SUMMARY: \nJoin forces with [c][F0FF23]YOUNG LANDO CALRISSIAN[-][/c] and fight for your life!
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_07_FALCON_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus Tier features powerful enemies and requires careful strategy
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_07_FALCON_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][ffff33]DOUBLE DOWN[-][/c] deals damage to an enemy with a chance to grant Defense Penetration Up to Lando's Millennium Falcon and a random ally
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_07_FALCON_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][ffff33]BUCKLE UP[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Offense Down, this attack deals more damage against debuffed enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_07_FALCON_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][ffff33]CALCULATED ENHANCEMENT[-][/c] deals damage and Dispels all buffs on an enemy, then Lando's Millennium Falcon gains Offense (stacking) based on how many buffs were Dispelled
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_07_FALCON_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][ffff33]COIN TOSS[-][/c] grants Lando's Millennium Falcon Critical Damage for each enemy without buffs\n - Lando's Millennium Falcon has a chance to apply positive effects to allies and negative effects to enemies at the start of its turn
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_07_FALCON_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - When Lando's Millennium Falcon Reinforces with [c][ffff33]ALL IN[-][/c], it copies all buffs on all other ships\n - Lando's Millennium Falcon takes a bonus turn for each Reinforcement previously called in by the allied Capital Ship this encounter
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_07_FALCON_PRACTICE_DE: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Lando's Millennium Falcon will be forced into the Ally position\n - You can enter with less than maximum squad members to experiment with different team compositions
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_08_RT_BONUS_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus Tier features powerful enemies and requires careful strategy
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_08_RT_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]TAKE AIM[-][/c] deals damage and if Range Trooper is buffed, it deals 30% more damage!
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_08_RT_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]STEADY[-][/c] grants all Empire allies Protection Up and then Range Trooper and a random ally attack the selected target. Imperial Troopers also gain other beneficial effects
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_08_RT_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]POWER IN NUMBERS[-][/c] grants Range Trooper bonus Tenacity while buffed and while Range Trooper is active, buffed Imperial Troopers have a 50% chance to call another Imperial Trooper to assist when they use an ability
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_08_RT_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Range Trooper shines in a squad with his fellow [c][F0FF23]IMPERIAL TROOPERS[-][/c]. In this mission, battle with a squad of Troopers and see their full power!
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_08_RT_PRACTICE_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Range Trooper will be forced into the Ally position\n - You can enter with less than maximum squad members to experiment with different team compositions
EVENT_MARQUEE_SOLO_08_RT_SUMMARY: \nJoin forces with a [c][F0FF23]RANGE TROOPER[-][/c] and battle criminals!

EVENT_MARQUEE_TFA_01_HAN_M02_DESC: [c][B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [23C8F5]Use[/c] [c][F0FF23]CAN I TRY THAT?[-][23C8F5] to Stun the target and inflict Ability Block on all enemies[/c]

EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_BONUS_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- The Mandalorian

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Careful use of [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] can turn the tide of battle in your favor.
- Bring other Bounty Hunters with the Mandalorian to complete his contract more quickly and gain access to [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c].
EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_M01_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- The Mandalorian

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][F0FF23]Swift Shot[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and the Mandalorian gains Critical Chance Up.
- When fully upgraded, on a critical hit, grant another random Bounty Hunter ally Critical Chance Up who does not already have it.
EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_M02_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- The Mandalorian

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][F0FF23]Transpierce[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and calls another target Bounty Hunter ally to assist.
- When fully upgraded, the Mandalorian and the assisting ally gain Critical Damage Up.
EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_M03_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- The Mandalorian

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- The Mandalorian's Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Asset Acquisition[-][/c], gives all Scoundrel allies Speed, Tenacity and Critical Chance.
- If the Mandalorian is in the Leader slot, his Contract is active.
- Bounty Hunter allies who score critical hits while buffed contribute to the Mandalorian's Contract.
- After Contract completion: While a Bounty Hunter ally is attacking, they have bonus Offense and Health Steal for each buffed ally.
EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_M04_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- The Mandalorian

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- With [c][F0FF23]Disciplined Bounty Hunter[-][/c], each time the Mandalorian scores a critical hit, he gains bonus Turn Meter. At the start of encounter, the Mandalorian has Bounty Hunter's Resolve until he is defeated.
- When fully upgraded, each time the Mandalorian scores a critical hit, other Bounty Hunter allies gain half the amount of bonus Turn Meter.
EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_M05_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- The Mandalorian

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Whenever the Mandalorian receives a Reward from a Contract, he also gains his Payout which grants him Critical Damage and the Special ability [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] until the end of battle.
- If the Mandalorian does not have Critical Chance Up or Critical Damage Up at the start of his turn, [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] can't be used.
- [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] instantly defeats the target enemy, which can't be evaded. Enemies defeated by this ability can't be revived.
- Each time the Mandalorian scores a critical hit while buffed, the cooldown of [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] is reduced.
EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_NAME: TALES FROM THE OUTER RIM III\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_SUMMARY: Join forces with [c][F0FF23]the Mandalorian[/c][-] and hunt bounties across the outer rim!
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_01_FOSFTP_DESC: Earn First Order SF TIE Pilot Shards!
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_01_FOSFTP_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]RECIPROCATION[-][/c] inflicts Defense Down and gives Advantage to First Order SF TIE Pilot
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_01_FOSFTP_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DRUMFIRE[-][/c] does AoE damage and inflicts Defense Down on critically hit enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_01_FOSFTP_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]OPPRESSIVE BURST[-][/c] calls an ally to assist; assisting First Order allies gain Advantage
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_01_FOSFTP_NAME: THE FIRST ORDER RELENTLESS I\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_01_FOSFTP_SUMMARY: \nJoin forces with the [c][F0FF23]FIRST ORDER SF TIE PILOT[-][/c] and crush the enemies of the First Order!
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_02_FOSFTIE_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]L-s9.6 LASER CANNONS[-][/c] inflict Target Lock on a Critical Hit
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_02_FOSFTIE_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DOUBLE OFFENSIVE[-][/c] does AoE damage and removes Turn Meter
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_02_FOSFTIE_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CONCUSSION MISSILE[-][/c] inflicts Ability Block and calls an ally to assist; assisting First Order allies gain Advantage
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_03_TIESILENCER_M01_DES: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DISRUPTIVE ADVANCE[-][/c] deals damage and enemies with 50% Turn Meter, or higher, are Stunned
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_03_TIESILENCER_M02_DES: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - If the TIE silencer has Advantage, [c][F0FF23]OVERWHELMING ADVANTAGE[-][/c] does increased damage and grants Foresight if the opponent dies
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_03_TIESILENCER_M03_DES: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - If the TIE silencer is damaged, or damages an enemy with Target Lock, [c][F0FF23]FRENZIED RAGE[-][/c] grants Speed and Offense Up (stacking)
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_04_KYLORENTLJ_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]AGGRESSIVE STRIKE[-][/c] inflicts Tenacity Down and, if the enemy was already debuffed, Kylo gains Taunt
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_04_KYLORENTLJ_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]HALT[-][/c] dispels the target’s buffs, stuns them, and Kylo gains Taunt; this is unresistable and cannot be evaded
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_04_KYLORENTLJ_M03_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]FOCUSED RAGE[-][/c] deals double damage if the target is Stunned, and Kylo is healed equal to the damage dealt
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_04_KYLORENTLJ_M04_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]MERCILESS PURSUIT[-][/c] grants Speed and Critical Hit for First Order allies; they also gain Health and Protection when receiving status effects
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_04_KYLORENTLJ_M05_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SCARRED[-][/c] grants Kylo numerous bonuses; when he takes damage he is healed and a random First Order ally gains Advantage
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_04_KYLORENTLJ_NAME: THE FIRST ORDER RELENTLESS IV\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_04_KYLORENTLJ_SUMMARY: \nJoin forces with [c][F0FF23]KYLO REN (UNMASKED)[-][/c] and crush the enemies of the First Order!
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_05_EXECUTIONER_M01_DES: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]JUDGEMENT[-][/c] deals physical damage and grants First Order Executioner Health Up
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_05_EXECUTIONER_M02_DES: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DEATH SENTENCE[-][/c] deals physical damage and dispels all Buffs on the target
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_05_EXECUTIONER_M03_DES: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]TOTAL ORDER[-][/c] grants First Order Executioner bonus health until the end of the encounter
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_05_EXECUTIONER_M04_DES: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Use the full power of the First Order Executioner to emerge victorious
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_05_EXECUTIONER_NAME: THE FIRST ORDER RELENTLESS V\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_05_EXECUTIONER_SUMMARY: \nJoin forces with [c][F0FF23]FIRST ORDER EXECUTIONER[-][/c] and battle the enemies of the First Order!
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_06_ROSE_M01_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]COURAGEOUS SHOT[-][/c] deals damage and grants Tenacity Up to a random Resistance ally.
EVENT_MARQUEE_TLJ_06_ROSE_M02_DESC: [B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DAUNTLESS BRAVERY[-][/c] grants Resistance allies Defense Up and Rose gains Turn Meter based on the types of allies and foes

EVENT_MARQUEE_VULTUREDROID_BONUS_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Vulture Droid
- General Grievous' Malevolence

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- Malevolence is most effective alongside Separatist and Droid ships.
- Summoned ships will escape from battle if they're the only ones left. Don't let your opponent use this to their advantage!
EVENT_MARQUEE_VULTUREDROID_M01_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Vulture Droid
- Grand Moff Tarkin's Executrix

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][F0FF23]Unrelenting Attack[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy. If this attack is a critical hit, it deals more damage if the target is debuffed.
- The damage from this attack doesn't remove Buzz Droids.
EVENT_MARQUEE_VULTUREDROID_M02_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Vulture Droid
- Grand Moff Tarkin's Executrix

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][F0FF23]Discord Missile[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy and inflicts [c][F0FF23]Buzz Droids[-][/c]. Buzz Droids can't be copied or resisted.
- A ship inflicted with Buzz Droids has lowered Defense and takes damage over time. They lose a Buzz Droid by taking damage.
- When fully upgraded, Discord Missile also inflicts Buff Immunity on the target enemy.
EVENT_MARQUEE_VULTUREDROID_M03_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Vulture Droid
- General Grievous' Malevolence
(See [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- With [c][F0FF23]Swarming Terror[-][/c], the Vulture Droid will assist every time a Separatist or Droid ally attacks an enemy inflicted with Buzz Droids.
- If an enemy has at least 1 Buzz Droid on them at the start of their turn, the stack resets. If Buzz Droids are dispelled from the enemy, they are inflicted with Ability Block.
- When fully upgraded, the first time the Vulture Droid is defeated, another Vulture Droid is summoned to the battle if the allied Capital Ship is Separatist and there is another allied combatant.

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] General Grievous' Malevolence will be granted to you for use in the remaining tiers of this event.
- Detailed information can be found by inspecting the ship when selecting your fleet.
- This ship is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.
EVENT_MARQUEE_VULTUREDROID_M04_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- Vulture Droid (Reinforcement)
- General Grievous' Malevolence

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- [c][F0FF23]Buzz Droid Barrage[-][/c] inflicts all enemies with Buzz Droids when the Vulture Droid reinforces.
- When fully upgraded, all enemies are Blinded and a random Droid ally is called to assist.
EVENT_MARQUEE_VULTUREDROID_SUMMARY: \nJoin forces with a [c][F0FF23]Vulture Droid[-][/c] and defeat the Galactic Republic!
EVENT_MARQUEE_YWINGCLONEWARS_BONUS_DESC:

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]

[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] You will be facing General Grievous' Malevolence in this event.
- This ship is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.
EVENT_MARQUEE_YWINGCLONEWARS_M02_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]

EVENT_MARQUEE_YWINGCLONEWARS_M03_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]
- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)

[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]
- BTL-B Y-wing Starfighter
- General Kenobi's Negotiator

[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- With [c][F0FF23]Astromech Advantage[-][/c], the Y-wing has increased Max Protection for each Galactic Republic ally, including reinforcements.
- It also recovers Health when a Galactic Republic ally is critically hit, and Taunts when the effects of Unending Loyalty are triggered.
- When fully upgraded, all Galactic Republic allies gain Counter Chance for the rest of the battle when the Y-wing is defeated.
EVENT_MARQUEE_YWINGCLONEWARS_M04_DESC:
[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]

EVENT_MARQUEE_YWINGCLONEWARS_SUMMARY: \nJoin forces with a [c][F0FF23]BTL-B Y-wing[-][/c] and defeat the Separatists!
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER01_DESC:
You will only be able to use Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker and R2-D2 in the first encounter.

You will only be able to use Han Solo, Lando Calrissian, and Chewbacca in the final encounter.

Chewbacca can only use his Basic ability in the final encounter.

Han Solo has Carbonite Sickness and is inflicted with Blind for 13 turns at the start of the final encounter.

Victory is achieved by defeating Boba Fett in the final encounter.
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER04_DESC:
Jedi Master Luke Skywalker begins the encounter with 100% Ultimate Charge (even if you have not unlocked his Ultimate ability) and must use Heroic Stand during his first turn.

Supreme Leader Kylo Ren has Blinding Rage and starts Blind for 1 turn. Whenever he loses Blind, he gains Rage for 1 turn. Whenever he loses Rage, he gains Blind for 1 turn.

You will lose this battle if Jedi Master Luke Skywalker is defeated.
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER05_DESC:
Jedi Master Luke Skywalker begins the encounter with 100% Ultimate Charge (even if you have not unlocked his Ultimate ability) and must use Heroic Stand during his first turn.

Supreme Leader Kylo Ren has Blinding Rage and starts Blind for 1 turn. Whenever he loses Blind, he gains Rage for 2 turns. Whenever he loses Rage, he gains Blind for 1 turn.

You will lose this battle if Jedi Master Luke Skywalker is defeated.
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER06_DESC:
Jedi Master Luke Skywalker begins the encounter with 100% Ultimate Charge (even if you have not unlocked his Ultimate ability) and must use Heroic Stand during his first turn.

Supreme Leader Kylo Ren has Blinding Rage and starts Blind for 1 turn. Whenever he loses Blind, he gains Rage for 3 turns. Whenever he loses Rage, he gains Blind for 1 turn.

After each ally who is not Jedi Master Luke Skywalker takes a turn, they are defeated.

You will lose this battle if Jedi Master Luke Skywalker is defeated.
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER01_DESC:
Mace Windu will gain one stack of Shatterpoint at the end of each of his turns for each Galactic Republic Jedi ally. When Mace Windu has 20 or more stacks of Shatterpoint, his next Smite will deal double massive damage.

Mace Windu cannot be defeated in this encounter.

Defeat Agen Kolar, Kit Fisto, and Saesee Tiin to be victorious.
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER01_DESC_V2:
Whenever Mace Windu uses an ability, he will gain one stack of Shatterpoint for each Galactic Republic Jedi ally. When Mace Windu has 20 or more stacks of Shatterpoint, his next Smite will deal double massive damage.

Mace Windu cannot be defeated in this encounter.

Defeat Agen Kolar, Kit Fisto, and Saesee Tiin to be victorious.
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER02_DESC: Mace Windu will gain one stack of Shatterpoint at the end of each of his turns. When Mace Windu has 5 or more stacks of Shatterpoint, his next Smite will deal double massive damage.
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER02_DESC_V2: Whenever Mace Windu uses an ability, he will gain one stack of Shatterpoint. When Mace Windu has 5 or more stacks of Shatterpoint, his next Smite will deal double massive damage.
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER03_DESC:
You will only use Darth Vader in the first encounter.

You will only use Emperor Palpatine in the final encounter.

Bring Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker below 25% health in the first encounter to proceed to the final encounter.
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER04_DESC:
While Ben Solo is active, Rey can't be defeated.

Rey has leadership bonuses granted to her by several of the Jedi spirits who came to her in her hour of need: General Kenobi, Jedi Knight Anakin, Luminara Undulli, Mace Windu, Aayla Secura, Grand Master Yoda, Qui-Gon Jinn, Ahsoka Tano, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker.

Sith Eternal Emperor has access to his Ultimate ability (even if you have not unlocked it) and gains 10% Ultimate Charge whenever Ben Solo or Rey take damage, and 34% at the end of each of his turns. (NOTE: This is different from the player-obtainable version)
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER05_DESC:
While Ben Solo is active, Rey can't be defeated.

Ben Solo cannot be defeated while Rey is over 50% health.

Rey has leadership bonuses granted to her by several of the Jedi spirits who came to her in her hour of need: General Kenobi, Jedi Knight Anakin, Luminara Undulli, Mace Windu, Aayla Secura, Grand Master Yoda, Qui-Gon Jinn, Ahsoka Tano, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker.

Sith Eternal Emperor has access to his Ultimate ability (even if you have not unlocked it) and gains 10% Ultimate Charge whenever Ben Solo or Rey take damage, and 34% at the end of each of his turns. (NOTE: This is different from the player-obtainable version)
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER06_DESC:
While Ben Solo is active, Rey can't be defeated.

Ben Solo cannot be defeated while Rey is over 50% health.

If Sith Eternal Emperor's turn begins with Ben Solo defeated, at the end of the turn Ben Solo revives with 51% of his Max Health.

Rey has leadership bonuses granted to her by several of the Jedi spirits who came to her in her hour of need: General Kenobi, Jedi Knight Anakin, Luminara Undulli, Mace Windu, Aayla Secura, Grand Master Yoda, Qui-Gon Jinn, Ahsoka Tano, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker.

Sith Eternal Emperor has access to his Ultimate ability (even if you have not unlocked it) and gains 10% Ultimate Charge whenever Ben Solo or Rey take damage, and 34% at the end of each of his turns. (NOTE: This is different from the player-obtainable version)

FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_01_TEXT: Welcome back, Galactic Champion!\n\nHave you heard about Squad Tournaments?
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_02_TEXT: They're a new addition to the Cantina where you compete with other Galactic Champions to earn [c][f0ff23]extremely rare rewards[-][/c]!
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_03_TEXT: Would you like to go to the Squad Tournament now?
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_MATCHMAKING: Looks like you've set your Defensive Squad and you're almost ready to go!
Scoring within a Squad Tournament is different than other locations within the Cantina.
Tournament Ranking Points are earned for defeating each of your opponent's Characters.
You also earn them for each of your surviving Characters.
Go ahead and choose your opponent now.
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_PREBATTLE_0: At the start of a Squad Tournament, all of your Characters are granted a status of [c][99ff33]READY![-][/c]
A Character with a [c][99ff33]READY![-][/c] status means they are able to enter Battle freely.
Each Character participating in a Battle will consume their [c][99ff33]READY![-][/c] status, requiring a refresh for additional Battles.
Characters requiring a refresh may still Battle for a specified cost. You'll be asked to confirm your selection if any cost is involved.

GALACTIC_BUNDLE_EXCHANGE_VIEW_SUBTITLE: You have received a Hyperdrive Token. Unlock the Hyperdrive Bundle and make the jump to hyperspace!
GALACTIC_BUNDLE_INFO:
[c][F0FF23]HYPERDRIVE QUESTS[-][/c]
Purchase of the Hyperdrive Bundle grants access to a series of Hyperdrive quest chains.

[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]
Units included in the Hyperdrive Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Hyperdrive Bundle does not directly grant character shards, ship blueprints, or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.

Each unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.

If your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.

[c][AFFFFFFF]CHARACTERS[-][/c]
- 5 Stars
- Level 80
- Gear Tier 8
- Ability Tier 5

[c][AFFFFFFF]SHIPS[-][/c]
- 5 Stars
- Level 80
- Ability Tier 4
- Reinforcement Ability Tier 1

[c][AFFFFFFF]CAPITAL SHIPS[-][/c]
- 1 Star
- Level 80
- Ability Tier 2

NOTE: The Hyperdrive Bundle grants additional resources beyond those used for the upgrade of units.

[c][F0FF23]UNIT ABILITIES[-][/c]
Specified ability ranks can be viewed by tapping on a unit in the corresponding Hyperdrive Bundle screen.

[c][F0FF23]ACTIVITY UNLOCKS[-][/c]
Purchase of the Hyperdrive Bundle allows for the specified holotable nodes to be completed using Sim Tickets.

Light Side Battles Stages 1-8 (Including Hard Stages)
Dark Side Battles Stages 1-8 (Including Hard Stages)
Cantina Battles Stages 1-8
Mod Battles Stages 1-8

Training Droids Challenges 1-5

STR Gear Challenges 1-4
AGI Gear Challenges 1-4
TAC Gear Challenges 1-4
Ship Enhancement Droids Challenges 1-3
Ship Building Materials Challenges 1-3
Ship Ability Materials Challenges 1-3

[c][F0FF23]HYPERDRIVE TOKEN[-][/c]
Purchasing this item rewards the player with a Hyperdrive Token, which is redeemed for the specified contents of the Hyperdrive Bundle.

Purchase Limit: 1

GENERALKENOBI_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: As the Clone Wars engulfed the galaxy, Obi-Wan Kenobi became a general in the Army of the Republic. Kenobi exemplifies the expression of non-aggression in Jedi through his practice of the Soresu form and by negotiating his allies' debuffs into buffs, yet as a General, he leads the charge into combat and intuitively strikes his foes while calling his allies to assist him. General Kenobi is also the commander of the 212th Attack Battalion, exemplifying his leadership of Clone Troopers, Jedi, and the Galactic Republic.

GENERALSKYWALKER_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Anakin Skywalker has been many things over the years; podracer pilot, droid builder, Jedi Padawan and even a legendary star pilot, but his confidence and his exceptional connection to the Force was clear to anyone who came in contact with him. As the Chosen One, and due to his mastery of the Force, Skywalker can unleash a barrage of abilities each turn. General Skywalker can take Cover in the heat of battle and wait for the right moment to Advance towards the enemy while his Clone allies lay down fire. Between the shower of Furious Slashes and using Sundering Strikes to tear apart his enemy’s defenses, General Skywalker is a force to be reckoned with.

GRANTEDABILITY_GENERALSKYWALKER_DESC: Deal Physical damage to target enemy.  If possible, this attack will critically hit enemies with Armor Shred. If the target enemy is Dazed, reduce General Skywalker's ability cooldowns by 1. This attack ignores Defense.

GRANTEDABILITY_GRANDMASTERLUKE_BLOCKED: This ability can't be used if there are no other active Jedi allies.
GRANTEDABILITY_GRANDMASTERLUKE_DESC:
Gain Jedi Lessons for 3 turns and call target other Light Side ally to assist, dealing 90% less damage. Then, they deal true damage to the target enemy based on 60% of Jedi Master Luke Skywalker's base Max Protection, which can't be evaded.

If that ally is a Jedi, they gain Jedi Lessons for 3 turns and 15% Turn Meter, recover Protection equal to 5% of Luke's base Max Protection, and reduce the cooldown of their Inherited Teachings ability by 1.

This ability can't be used if there are no other active Jedi allies.
GRANTEDABILITY_GRANTEDUNIT_DESC: This unit has been granted to you for use in this event. It is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.
GRANTEDABILITY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_DESC: Dispel all debuffs on all allies then call all Jedi allies to assist, dealing 20% less damage. All Jedi allies (excluding Old Republic Jedi) recover 25% Health and Protection and gain Jedi's Will for 2 turns. Then Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker gains 100% Turn Meter.\n\nThis ability is on a shared cooldown between allies who have Heroes Arise and is immune to cooldown manipulation.
GRANTEDABILITY_JUMP_TO_HYPERSPACE_DESC: Make the jump to Hyperspace and escape the battle.
GRANTEDABILITY_JUMP_TO_HYPERSPACE_FALCON: Make the jump to Hyperspace and escape the battle!\n\nEscape with the Falcon to win!

[c][f0ff23]Limit one use per battle. Requires 100% Download progress to activate.[-][/c]

Dispel all debuffs on all Rebel allies and recover 50% Health and Protection. Grant all allies [c][f0ff23]Suprosa Supercomputer[-][/c] for the rest of the encounter which can't be copied, dispelled or prevented.

[c][f0ff23]Suprosa Supercomputer:[-][/c] Gain 100% Critical Chance and an additional bonus based on the ship's role.

- [c][f0ff23]Attacker[-][/c] At the start of turn, dispel Stealth and Taunt from all enemies and inflict Defense Down for 1 turn on a random enemy
- [c][f0ff23]Tank[-][/c] All Rebel allies recover 10% Health and Protection whenever this ship receives damage
- [c][f0ff23]Support[-][/c] At the start of turn, inflict Target Lock on a random enemy for 2 turns and remove 20% Turn Meter
GRANTEDABILITY_STANDYOURGROUND_DESC: Dispel all stacks of Trampled from target ally. The character in the Leader slot gains this ability at the start of encounter.

GuildRaid_RulesDescription:
[23c8f5]Guild raids are feats of strength where Guilds work together toward victory. These epic battles are against some of the most imposing opponents throughout the galaxy. Bolster your collection of Characters and help your Guild toward being the best, most powerful, and wealthiest within the Cantina!

- Only Guild Leaders and Guild Officers may start a Guild Raid
- Starting a Guild Raid requires Raid Tickets
- Raid Tickets are produced through "Personal Guild Contribution" Daily Activity
- Individual player rewards determined by contribution Rank
- Individual player rewards delivered via Inbox
- Guild Raids have multiple Difficulty Tiers
- Difficulty Tiers may have different settings, pay careful attention to these
- Boss Health persists for the entire Guild
- Boss ability cooldowns persist per individual player

Good luck![-]

HANSOLO_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: As captain of the Millennium Falcon, Han Solo became a notorious smuggler and daredevil. Much like the Falcon, Han is fast - shooting first in combat. Thanks to his Deadeye aim and Quick Draw, he can end fights before they even start (even if it leaves a mess). Han's daring nature leads him to ignore the odds of any situation to act quickly and decisively while evading his enemies.
HAPPY_ONE_YEAR_ANNIVERSARY_INBOX_MESSAGE:
Greetings, galactic heroes!

Today marks the one year anniversary of the game’s worldwide launch. Please join us in celebrating this august occasion and enjoy these free gifts!

On behalf of the entire Capital Games team, we want to express our gratitude to you and the millions of other players around the world who have played and supported the game. Without your enthusiasm, passion, and contributions this game would not be possible.

This past year has been a whirlwind of updates, new features, and new content. That being said, we want you to know that we are just getting started.

Thank you!

HELPMENU_BATTLE_01_DESC: Tap the icon in the bottom right corner to attack. You can also tap enemies to set a target.
HELPMENU_BATTLE_02_DESC: When a special ability is active, tap its icon to activate it. You can also press and hold it for details.
HELPMENU_BATTLE_03_DESC: Some abilities take multiple rounds to cooldown. Watch the round counter on an ability to see when it's ready.
HELPMENU_BATTLE_04_DESC: Some characters have passive abilities that activate automatically. Press and hold on their icons for details.
HELPMENU_BATTLE_05_DESC: Leader abilities are passive abilities that affect the entire squad. The squad leader's leader ability is applied to your squad.
HELPMENU_BATTLE_06_DESC: Speed determines Turn Meter fill rate. The Turn Meter is displayed under the health bar and determines the attack order.
HELPMENU_PROGRESS_01_DESC: New characters can be unlocked by collecting their required Shards. Earn Shards in hard difficulty battles and events or find them in data cards and shipments.
HELPMENU_PROGRESS_02_DESC: Complete Battles, Challenges, Events, and Keycard Battles to increase your player level and unlock new features.
HELPMENU_PROGRESS_02_DESC_TU3: Complete Battles, Challenges, and Events to increase your player level and unlock new features.
HELPMENU_PROGRESS_03_DESC: Complete daily activities to earn unique rewards.
HELPMENU_PROGRESS_04_DESC: Complete achievements by participating in select Keycard Battles, Light & Dark Battles, Daily Activities, and many other features.
HELPMENU_PROGRESS_04_DESC_TU3: Complete achievements by participating in select Light & Dark Battles, Daily Activities, and many other features.
HELPMENU_PROGRESS_05_DESC: Earn crystals in battles and use them to open data cards that contain materials and Shards. Crystals can also be purchased in the store and can be used in a variety of ways.
HELPMENU_SQUADS_01_DESC: Collect XP materials from battles and Keycard Battles to train characters and increase their level.
HELPMENU_SQUADS_01_DESC_TU3: Collect XP materials from battles to train characters and increase their level.
HELPMENU_SQUADS_02_DESC: Use gear sets to increase a character's Gear Level and unlock new abilities. Gear can be collected or crafted.
HELPMENU_SQUADS_03_DESC: Collect character Shards to promote their star count and increase their stats.
HELPMENU_SQUADS_04_DESC: Combine characters with similar categories in battle to create new strategies.

Hyperdrive_Bundle_Quest_7StarPromotion_0: Let's start with the basics - promotion.\n\nSomething I've been denied here at the Cantina for far too long.
At least there's someone who recognizes my contribution.
Repetition is the key to mastery. Are you listening? I don't want to have to repeat myself.

Where did I end when we last conversed?

Ah yes, repetition.

Have I told you it's the key to mastery?
Hyperdrive_Bundle_Quest_AllDailyComplete: Completing all Daily Activities will award Crystals and other valuable materials.\n\nMake it a habit and watch your resources grow!
I think its safe to say you're a regular at this point. We're happy to have you here!
Hyperdrive_Bundle_Quest_ChampionshipsFea: There's more to victory than just winning.\n\nGoing above and beyond can give you a tactical advantage.
Impressive work. Now press the advantage!
Hyperdrive_Bundle_Quest_CharacterGear10_: Gear is a crucial part of obtaining the stats characters need to be effective in battle.
I wouldn't mind receiving an upgrade every now and then...
Hyperdrive_Bundle_Quest_CharacterGear11_: Please excuse me, that pesky MSE-6 droid is caught under the Holotable again.
You can't expect all droids to have my level of knowledge and expertise.
Hyperdrive_Bundle_Quest_CharacterGear12_: I've lectured at length about the intricacies of of the gearing system.\n\nNow if only there were accolades for doing so...
I'm quite happy to see you come this far. It means there's another who can shoulder the burden of educating newcomers.
Hyperdrive_Bundle_Quest_CharacterLevel85: I find myself frightfully short of free time these days...
I don't mind delivering these rewards, however I fear Fey has mistaken me for a CZ-series droid.
Hyperdrive_Bundle_Quest_DefeatAATTurret_: The Separatists wage war with great displays of power.\n\nMeet them with equal force!
Hyperdrive_Bundle_Quest_DefeatRancorDoor: Your plan of attack is just as important as your performance in battle.\n\nExecute this battle strategy!
Enter battle without strategy and you will be crippled by the fear of its outcome.
Destroy the Rancor's door panel 10 times
Hyperdrive_Bundle_Quest_DefeatSTRSabers_: Even Dark Lords of the Sith have their weak points.\n\nEnter The Sith Triumvirate Raid and exploit those weaknesses!
These shards will help increase your power, but the true reward was your moment of victory over the opponent.
Destroy Darth Traya's front lightsaber 10 times
Destroy Darth Traya's left lightsaber 10 times
Destroy Darth Traya's right lightsaber 10 times

INBOX_DEATHMARK_UPDATE_MESSAGE:
We have made some changes to Deathmark and how it interacts with Taunt and Marked. Previously, Taunt and Marked took priority over Deathmark, and now Deathmark has equal priority.

For example, in prior battles, if you Marked one enemy and Deathmarked another enemy, you had to target the Marked character. Now, you can choose to target either the Marked or Deathmarked character.

Please note that a character who “ignores Taunt” has always also ignored Deathmark and Marked. This will not be affected by the changes above.

INBOX_LUCASFILM_50TH_ANNIVERSARY_MESSAGE:
Hi, Holotable Heroes!

Today, we celebrate a grand achievement with Lucasfilm's 50th Anniversary!

For the past half century, Star Wars has resonated with our hearts, inspired our imaginations, and become a part of who we are. From movie theaters and living rooms, to weddings and theme parks, a Galaxy Far, Far Away has felt like home and ingrained itself into the zeitgeist of our culture.

We are honored to take part in this phenomenon with not only our partners at Lucasfilm and Disney, but most importantly, you - our incredible community of players!

So, let's raise a glass of blue milk and make a toast in celebration of the magic, wonder, and grandeur the Star Wars experience has created over the past five decades!

Be sure to collect your [b]FREE Lucasfilm 50th Anniversary Rewards Calendar[/b] from the Store!

INBOX_SITH_RAID_CHANGES_MESSAGE:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

We are reworking the Sith Triumvirate Raid to make non-Heroic tiers faster and increase the rewards in the upper tiers. Rewards for Tier 6 and above now include Mod Salvage and a better chance to get the gear you need to progress to the next tier. We are removing some of the Challenge gear from rewards that has been stacking up in your inventory because you’re already earning it in Daily Challenges.

Both Nihilus' Annihilate and Traya's lightsabers are hard to anticipate, so we are adjusting these mechanics to be more predictable.

- Nihilus' Basic attack no longer reduces cooldowns in any tier, including Heroic

- Traya's lightsabers no longer dispel or apply debuffs in Tiers 1-6 (this mechanic is still active in the Heroic Tier)

We're also reducing Raid boss health across the board in every tier except Heroic. As guilds work their way up to Heroic, they will be able to beat the raids they're already doing faster and get a bit of encouragement to give the next tier a shot.

Find the full details on the official Star Wars Galaxy of Heroes Forums!

INBOX_SWGOH_MESSAGE_MESSAGE:
Hello Holotable Heroes!

I’m so pleased to be able to thank you all for being with us on the three year anniversary of Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes. This game would not have made it to its third year without you, and we are excited about where the next three (and beyond) will take us. We have many more Star Wars stories to tell, and we want to give you all the tools to play competitively and collaboratively, both individually and as guilds and communities.

This year we have made an effort to connect more with the community, and our vision for the future of this game is a lot about continuing to widen those touchpoints, and find more ways to grow this game together.

I recognize this is exceptionally sappy, but you make up one of the most hardcore and passionate communities that exist in all of gaming, and I’m proud that you are a part of our game. We can only endeavor to be worthy of your investments, and look forward to exploring new paths together.

As always, I’ll see you on the holotables,
Carrie Gouskos
Senior Producer

INBOX_TU16_RELEASE_UNIT_UPDATES_MESSAGE:
We’ve made some improvements to General Grievous and IG-100 MagnaGuard!

General Grievous
- [c][F0FF23]Grievous Wounds[-][/c]: This attack can no longer be evaded. This affects all ability tiers.
- [c][F0FF23]Daunting Presence[-][/c]: While Grievous is the Leader, Target Locked enemies can no longer counter attack. This affects the final tier (Zeta level).

IG-100 MagnaGuard 
- [c][F0FF23]Relentless Assault[-][/c]: MagnaGuard now gains Taunt whenever it uses an ability, not just when it uses an ability during its turn. Additionally, MagnaGuard grants Stealth for 1 turn to all other Separatist Droid allies at the start of each encounter if Grievous is an ally. Both of these additions affect all ability tiers.

[c][F0FF23]Wetwork[-][/c]: Whenever a Bounty Hunter scores a Critical Hit, they Dispel all debuffs on themselves and gain stacking Critical Damage for the rest of the battle.

InboxView_ClientExceptionApology1Message:
Greetings hero, 
We detected that you may have encountered a known bug with Cantina Battles. If you are seeing this bug, the Cantina Battles screen will appear with incorrect data and will be difficult to interact with. We are very sorry about this bug, and have already prepared a fix for our next app update.

In order to work around this issue, you may access Cantina Battles through the following method:
- From the Home screen, tap the Characters screen
- Tap the Geonosian Soldier
- Tap "Find"
- Tap the 10 Energy button for the battle called Battle A (NORMAL)

This will take you to Cantina Battles screen. Once you've done this, Cantina Battles should be fixed.

The bug CAN happen again, though. If it does, you can follow these steps again.

You can view more information about this at our forums, at http://bit.ly/cantina_issue

Please accept these Crystals and Ability Materials as compensation for the inconvenience.

INTERSTITIAL_SOCIAL_NEWSLETTER_SEP_15_DE:
Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes features several ways to connect with your friends and with other players.

Allies - Remember, your Allies' characters will be available to help you in Campaign battles, and their Leader Abilities will apply to your squad. When you use allies in a battle, you will earn Ally Points which you can use to open packs!

Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes Forum - Visit the Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes Forums to connect with other players, discuss strategy, and even submit questions for Capital Games to answer in our weekly Q&A.

Facebook Connect - Use Facebook Connect to enable viewing real names of your friends playing the game.

Visit the official Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes web site to view the forums - http://starwars.ea.com/starwars/galaxy-of-heroes
INTERSTITIAL_UNLOCKS_NEWSLETTER_SEP_15_D:
Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes includes many features that unlock as you collect characters and increase your Player Level. Here's the complete list of unlockable features and their requirements:

Light Side Battles: Use your light side characters to battle dark side characters. Unlocked at the beginning of the game.

Dark Side Battles: Use your dark side characters to battle light side characters. Unlocks after reaching Player Level 12 and collecting 3 or more dark side characters.

Squad Arena: Battle other players' squads using any characters in your Collection. Unlocks at Player Level 8.

Challenges: Uniquely difficult Battles that drop unique rewards. Unlocks at Player Level 15.

Events And Keys: Collect Keys that allow you to fight in Event Battles that drop valuable rewards. Unlocks at Player Level 50.

We will be adding more features over the coming months.

JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Luke Skywalker understands that to truly become a Jedi, he has to eventually face down his father, Darth Vader. Father and son eventually cross blades in a ferocious lightsaber duel, ending when Darth Vader redeems himself and Luke earns his title of Jedi Knight. Jedi Knight Luke is a powerful Jedi Leader that boosts his Jedi allies with a new buff, Jedi's Will, which provides a variety of bonuses. Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker is especially equipped to defeat faster enemies by lowering their speed to his own to control the pace of the battle.
JEDIKNIGHTREVAN_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Revan was a Jedi Knight who was influential in shaping the history of the Jedi Order, and was part of many pivotal battles to stop the growing threat of the Sith. This warrior of legend is an influential Jedi leader and tactician who controls the battlefield through the use of synchronized attacks, a devastating saber throw, and the ability to single out high value targets and subvert the enemy's strategies.
JEDIMASTERGUARDIAN_BASIC_TIER07_DESC: Deal Physical damage to target enemy and recover 30% Health. If this attack deals any damage, reduce the cooldowns of Jedi Master Guardian's other abilities by 1.
JEDIMASTERGUARDIAN_SPECIAL01_TIER07_DESC: Another target ally assists. Heal that ally for 30% of Jedi Master Guardian's Max Health, then all other Jedi allies recover half that amount.
JEDIMASTERGUARDIAN_SPECIAL02_TIER07_DESC: Dispel all debuffs on target ally and they recover 40% Health. Then, revive all defeated Jedi allies at 80% Health and grant those allies Critical Hit Immunity for 5 turns.
JEDIMASTERKENOBI_T1_TO_T6: Critical Damage and Health mods help Jedi Master Kenobi deal more damage and increase his survivability.
JEDIMASTERKENOBI_T7_AND_UP: Critical Damage and Health mods help Jedi Master Kenobi deal more damage and increase his survivability.

JMK_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Jedi Master Kenobi is one of few Jedi who survived Order 66. He reluctantly fought his former student, Anakin Skywalker, on the lava planet of Mustafar, after discovering that Anakin led the attack on the Jedi Temple on Coruscant.
JMLS_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Jedi Master Luke Skywalker was in self-exile for his perceived failures as a Jedi and a leader, but through training Rey in the ways of the Jedi and reconnecting with Master Yoda, Luke reconnected with the Force and returned to the Resistance to lend his full power as a Jedi Master against Kylo Ren and the First Order. With his mastery of the Force, Luke performed feats that were never thought possible.
JMLS_GUIDE_DETAILS_TITLE: Galactic Legend: Jedi Master Luke Skywalker

- Leaves Cover and takes a bonus turn when all other 501st allies are defeated

If a Dark Side Unaligned Force User ally was present at the start of battle, for the rest of the battle all Empire or Dark Side Unaligned Force User allies take 30% reduced damage from enemy Light Side Unaligned Force User attacks. If all allies are Dark Side at the start of battle, Empire and Dark Side Unaligned Force User allies are immune to Fear, Empire Tanks gain Taunt for 2 turns, and when an Empire ally loses Taunt, they are inflicted with Marked for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, prevented, or resisted.

Whenever a Dark Side ally loses a buff, Empire and Dark Side Unaligned Force User allies gain 1% Mastery (stacking) until the end of encounter. Whenever a debuffed Dark Side ally takes damage, Lord Vader gains 2% Ultimate Charge, increased to 3% if that ally was an Unaligned Force User.

Empire and Dark Side Unaligned Force User allies have +35% Critical Chance and Critical Damage when targeting a Galactic Republic enemy. Whenever an enemy critically hits an Empire or Dark Side Unaligned Force User ally, that enemy has -30% Critical Damage (stacking) for 3 turns.

While Empire and Dark Side Unaligned Force User allies are at certain Health thresholds, they gain different benefits.

- [c][ffff33]While above 35% Health:[-][/c] During an enemy's attack they are immune to Max Health reduction and other damage that is based on Max Health
- [c][ffff33]While above 50% Health:[-][/c] They are immune to Damage Over Time and Thermal Detonator effects
- [c][ffff33]While below 80% Health:[-][/c] Can't be critically hit
