LUCAS_50TH_ANNIVERSARY_LP_BODY: Raise a glass of blue milk and join us in toasting this great achievement! \n\nFrom 11/17 to 11/26 PT, jump into the Store to claim your FREE Lucasfilm 50th Anniversary reward before its gone!
LUCASFILM_50TH_ANNIVERSARY_DESC: Celebrate Lucasfilm's 50th Anniversary with us by redeeming this FREE 30-day calendar and collecting the rewards every day! Make sure you log back in every day to take advantage of all the great items we've chosen to celebrate this grand achievement!\n\nLimit: 1
LUCASFILM_50TH_ANNIVERSARY_MESSAGE: Celebrate a grand achievement with Lucasfilm's 50th Anniversary! We've personally secured some of our greatest and most valuable items for you. Log in every day to collect!\n\nUnclaimed rewards are forfeited when calendar expires.
LUNAR_NEW_YEAR_PACK_DESC: Celebrate the Lunar New Year by claiming a free Red Data Card from the store that can contain between 10k and 100k Credits! Use these credits to level up your favorite characters and make them even stronger. The Red Data Cards will be available each day from February 3rd to February 12th.
LUNAR_NEW_YEAR_PACK_MESSAGE_DESC: Greetings Heroes,\n\nCelebrate the Lunar New Year by claiming a free Red Data Card from the store that can contain between 10k and 100k Credits! Use these credits to level up your favorite characters and make them even stronger. The Red Data Cards will be available each day from February 3rd to February 12th.
LV_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: After siding with the Chancellor as he was being arrested by Mace Windu, Anakin Skywalker was bestowed the title and name of Darth Vader, the newest Lord of the Sith, by the revealed Darth Sidious.
MAGNAGUARD_BUNDLE_DESC:
Purchase this bundle and receive 50 shards of IG-100 MagnaGuard!

This Tank protects its Droid allies by Taunting frequently and consistently dispelling their debuffs.

[f0ff23]BONUS[-]: This bundle also includes materials to immediately power up MagnaGuard to:

Character level: 40
Gear level: V

Purchase limit: 1
MAGNAGUARD_BUNDLE_TEXT: The IG-100 MagnaGuard Bundle is now in the Store for a limited time! This Tank protects its Droid allies by Taunting frequently and consistently dispelling their debuffs.
Main_Allies_Unlock_QUEST_DESC: At some holotables you can borrow ally characters.\n\nMany players frequent the Cantina, update your Ally list for stronger allies.
Main_Allies_Unlock_QUEST_REWARDS: The Force is also a good ally.
Main_Cantina_Battles_Unlock_QUEST_DESC: In the new Holotable, Cantina Battles, you can mix and match Dark Side and Light Side characters.\n\nCome up with interesting squads or opt to utilize your 5 best characters
Main_Cantina_Battles_Unlock_QUEST_DESC_V: In the new Holotable, Cantina Battles, you can mix and match Dark Side and Light Side characters.\n\nCome up with interesting squads or opt to utilize your 5 best characters.
Main_Cantina_Battles_Unlock_QUEST_REWARD: Great! And remember, Cantina Battles can award Character Shards too!
Main_Challenges_Unlock_QUEST_DESC: Our Challenges table tests how much you've progressed in various categories of characters and rewards valuable gear!
Main_Challenges_Unlock_QUEST_REWARDS: Keep focusing your efforts on specific characters to advance in Challenges.
Main_Dark_Battles_25_QUEST_DESC: Remember, some Characters Shards are rewarded only at the Dark Side holotable.\n\nUnlock all Dark Side hard levels to find more shards!
Main_Dark_Battles_25_QUEST_REWARDS: Find useful Gear in the Dark Side battles too.
Main_Dark_Battles_25_TASK_DESC_1: Train 3 Dark Side Characters to level 25
Main_Dark_Battles_32_QUEST_DESC: Conquering the Dark Side holotable gives you access to more character shards!\n\nMost players tend to prefer the Light or Dark Side, how about you?
Main_Dark_Battles_32_QUEST_REWARDS: I don't mind which side you choose, as long as you keep coming to my Cantina.
Main_Dark_Battles_32_TASK_DESC_1: Train 3 Dark Side Characters to level 32
Main_Dark_Battles_46_QUEST_DESC: You’re a regular now.\n\nI'm rooting for you to beat that Hutt. Don't let me down!
Main_Dark_Battles_46_QUEST_REWARDS: Impressive, you just might surpass Garudda the Hutt afterall.
Main_Dark_Battles_46_TASK_DESC_1: Train 3 Dark Side Characters to level 46
Main_Dark_Battles_5_QUEST_DESC: To prove yourself as a Cantina contender you'll need to be versed in Dark Side battles as well as Light Side battles\n\n You can earn additional character shards in Dark Side battles!
Main_Dark_Battles_5_QUEST_REWARDS: Keep it up, you're one shard closer to a new character.
Main_Dark_Battles_5_QUEST_REWARDS_V2: Keep it up, you're two shards closer to a new character.
Main_Dark_Battles_54_QUEST_DESC: Stop by the store and see our latest arrivals.
Main_Dark_Battles_54_QUEST_REWARDS: That droid of mine seems to be giving bad advice, may have to wipe her data again.
Main_Dark_Battles_54_TASK_DESC_1: Train 3 Dark Side Characters to level 54
Main_Dark_Battles_63_QUEST_DESC: That Hutt has been boasting more and more that he's the best Ships player, no humility.
Main_Dark_Battles_63_QUEST_REWARDS: I most certainly do not need your help.
Main_Dark_Battles_63_TASK_DESC_1: Train 3 Dark Side Characters to level 63
Main_Dark_Battles_73_QUEST_DESC: That Hutt has been spreading rumors that you don't even have your own ships.\n\nYou're going to have to face him head on.
Main_Dark_Battles_73_QUEST_REWARDS: Let me get you a drink, your success is attracting business to the cantina.
Main_Dark_Battles_73_TASK_DESC_1: Train 3 Dark Side Characters to level 73
Main_Dark_Battles_Unlock_QUEST_DESC: The best holotable players develop both Light Side and Dark Side squads.\n\nDevelop your dark side units to have a well rounded roster.
Main_Dark_Battles_Unlock_QUEST_DESC_V2: The best holotable players develop both Light Side and Dark Side squads.\n\nDevelop your dark side units to have a well rounded roster.
Main_Dark_Battles_Unlock_QUEST_REWARDS: Your dark side squad is coming along. Just be mindful not to develop abilities that some consider to be... unnatural.
Main_Dark_Side_Stage_1_QUEST_DESC: Keep winning Dark Side battles to gain a balanced collection.\n\nThis is useful anywhere you can use both light and dark side characters.
Main_Dark_Side_Stage_1_QUEST_REWARDS: I'm glad you're taking my advice.
Main_Dark_Side_Stage_1_TASK_DESC_2: Complete all Stage 1 Dark Side Battles
Main_Galactic_War_QUEST_DESC: Reach level 40 to unlock Galactic War, a new game mode with a series of battles against other player Squads.\n\nAny Holotable player's Squad could come up as your foe.
Main_Galactic_War_QUEST_REWARDS: You were smart to choose my Cantina, I have all the best tables.
Main_Galactic_War_TASK_DESC_1: Reach level 40 to unlock Galactic War
Main_Guild_Events_QUEST_DESC: Choosing a side is helpful, but some great squads can also be built with characters from both alignments.
Main_Guild_Events_QUEST_REWARDS: You've earned the respect of almost every player in the Cantina...
Main_Guild_Unlock_QUEST_DESC: You've almost earned entrance to the Guild Room.\n\nJoin a Guild to attack the Rancor.
Main_Guild_Unlock_QUEST_REWARDS: Congratulations, now you have a Guild on your side.
Main_Guild_Unlock_TASK_DESC_1: Reach Player Level 22 to unlock Guilds
Main_Light_Battles_33_QUEST_DESC: Each holotable stage requires stronger characters.\n\nHave you seen B7-N5 lately? She seems to be more on the fritz than usual.
Main_Light_Battles_33_TASK_DESC_1: Train 3 Light Side characters to level 33
Main_Light_Battles_45_QUEST_DESC: Let me get you a drink, your success is attracting business to the cantina.
Main_Light_Battles_45_QUEST_REWARDS: Whoa, slow down there, you're only getting one free drink out of me.
Main_Light_Battles_45_QUEST_REWARDS_V2: Good work attracting a crowd, business is really picking up since you showed up!
Main_Light_Battles_45_TASK_DESC_1: Train 3 Light Side characters to level 45
Main_Light_Battles_52_QUEST_DESC: Some people don’t understand this is a peaceful Cantina, they bring the battle outside the Holotables.
Main_Light_Battles_52_TASK_DESC_1: Train 3 Light Side characters to level 52
Main_Light_Battles_61_QUEST_DESC: Sorry about my droid, she’s an experienced Cantina unit, but she needs constant maintenance.
Main_Light_Battles_61_QUEST_REWARDS: I want you to be the best Holotable player, it's good for the Cantina\n\nYou'll need to prove your worth the sponsorship some day.
Main_Light_Battles_61_TASK_DESC_1: Train 3 Light Side characters to level 61
Main_Light_Battles_71_QUEST_DESC: Maybe I should install a Dejarik game in the Cantina.\n\nIt seems like you still have a ways to go in Light Side Battles.
Main_Light_Battles_71_QUEST_REWARDS: Is B7-N5 giving you good instructions?\n\nShe hasn't been the same since I yanked those Speed Mods.
Main_Light_Battles_71_TASK_DESC_1: Train 3 Light Side characters to level 71
Main_Light_Side_Stage_2_QUEST_DESC: Win Light Side Battles to unlock more stages and new Hard Mode stages!\n\nB7-N5 told me you interrupted her oil bath. Protocol Droids, heh?
Main_Light_Side_Stage_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Completing stages of Light and Dark Side battles will earn you Achievement rewards too!
Main_Light_Side_Stage_2_TASK_DESC_2: Complete all Stage 2 Light Side Battles
Main_Mods_Challenges_QUEST_DESC: Win a few Mod battles and then lets talk Mod strategy.\n\nThis will let you show off your training.
Main_Mods_Challenges_QUEST_REWARDS: If you need help with Mods you can look up the user manual under the Holotable or talk to your Guild.
Main_Mods_QUEST_DESC: I’ve met all sorts of people in here.\n\nThat's part of the fun in running a cantina.
Main_Mods_QUEST_REWARDS: If you see Vryssk tell her she scaring customers away...
Main_Reach_Level_6_QUEST_DESC: Reach higher levels to unlock features.\n\nDoing battles is a great way to earn XP to level up faster.
Main_Reach_Level_6_QUEST_REWARDS: Great, now where is that droid? You've got more to learn.
Main_Shipments_QUEST_DESC: Check regularly--new Shipments come through my Cantina all time. \n\nWe can get you almost anything: Characters, Gear, and more. Just NO Porgs in my Cantina! They make a mess everywhere...
Main_Shipments_QUEST_REWARDS: Check back on shipments after they refresh to see new items. You'll always find something to use if you know how to look!
Main_Ships_QUEST_DESC: Seems like just yesterday you walked into my Cantina for the first time.\n\nTo win Ship battles you'll have to compete with players like the Hutt, good luck!
Main_Ships_QUEST_REWARDS: Let me get you a drink, your success is attracting business to the cantina.
Main_Ships_TASK_DESC_2: Complete Prelude events to unlock Ships
Main_Squad_Arena_QUEST_DESC: Have you seen my Squad Arena table? It's the best in the galaxy.\n\nHere you can prove yourself against other players.
Main_Squad_Arena_QUEST_REWARDS: Climb the ranks to earn better rewards.
Main_Squad_Arena_Wins_2_QUEST_DESC: Win Squad Arena battles to prove you're the best player in the cantina\n\nTop Squad Arena ranks are highly prestigious positions and have great rewards!
Main_Squad_Arena_Wins_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Great job, those games had the whole cantina on the edge of their seat!\n\nAlso, you have some spiced Mynock wing stuck in your teeth.
Main_Squad_Arena_Wins_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Practice picking out your enemy targets!
Main_Squad_Arena_Wins_QUEST_DESC: Win Squad Arena Battles to rise in the ranks for better rewards\n\nEach Holotable player is completing against the Squads of other players for rank.
Main_Squad_Arena_Wins_QUEST_REWARDS: You’ve really proven yourself here, let’s keep it going.
Main_Win_1_Light_Side_Battles_1_QUEST_DE: Win Light Side battle 1-A to unlock the next battle.\n\nHolotable battles take place in different environments with many different characters.
Main_Win_1_Light_Side_Battles_1_QUEST_RE: Great, you picked up the basics quickly!\n\nHere are some Quest Rewards to get you started.
Main_Win_1_Light_Side_Battles_2_QUEST_DE: Win Light Side battle 1-B to unlock the next battle\n\nLight Side battles are just one of many Holotables here in the Cantina to unlock.
Win Light Side battle 1-B to unlock the next battle.\n\nLight Side battles are just one of many Holotables here in the Cantina to unlock.
Main_Win_1_Light_Side_Battles_2_QUEST_RE: As you clean up the Light Side battles you'll get more difficult enemies and eventually, Dark Side battles!
Main_Win_1_Light_Side_Battles_3_QUEST_DE: Win Light Side battle 1-C to unlock the next battle.\n\nIf you want to be great at Holotable battles, you'll need to upgrade your characters and collect new ones!
Main_Win_1_Light_Side_Battles_3_QUEST_RE: You've finished the first set of Quests. Next you'll be running the Holotables!
Main_Win_1_Light_Side_Battles_4_QUEST_DE: Successful holoplayers are not gifted - they work hard and succeed through skill.\n\nFinish Light Side Stage 1 to unlock hard mode. I know you'll go far!
Main_Win_1_Light_Side_Battles_4_QUEST_RE: Success! Great battle. One more to go to unlock hard battles!
Main_Win_1_Light_Side_Battles_5_QUEST_DE: Once you finish a stage's last normal battle, it unlocks Hard Battles for that stage.\n\nEarn character shards in Hard Battles to Activate new characters and Promote your existing ones!
Main_Win_1_Light_Side_Battles_5_QUEST_RE: Congratulations, now you can earn Character Shards in Hard battles.\n\nAlso continue to do regular Light Side battles to unlock new stages.
Main_Win_1_Light_Side_Battles_QUEST_DESC: Win Light Side battle 1-A to unlock the next battle.\n\nHolotable battles take place in different environments with many different characters.

MAP_BESPIN_DESC: A gas giant in the Bespin system of the Anoat sector.\n\nHome planet of Cloud City.
MAP_ENDOR_DESC: Located in the Outer Rim Territories, the Forest Moon of Endor is a lush world. During the Galactic Civil War, the Empire established an outpost here while they built the second Death Star. During the Battle of Endor, the Death Star was destroyed and the Emperor killed, marking the end of a galactic era.
MAP_GEONOSIS_DESC: Geonosis is a desert world and home to the insectoid Geonosians. During the twilight of the Galactic Republic, this planet was one of the first to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Geonosis housed great droid factories and the Battle of Geonosis was the first major conflict of the Clone Wars.
MAP_HOLOCRON_DESC: Test your Battle Skills on a Holotable
MAP_HOTH_DESC: Hoth is an ice world in a remote sector of the Outer Rim. After the Battle of Yavin, the Rebel Alliance established a hidden base there. Their stay was cut short when they were discovered by an Imperial probe droid, thereby triggering the Battle of Hoth.
MAP_TATOOINE_DESC: A desert world in the binary Tatoo star system within the Anoat sector.\n\nHome planet of both Anakin and Luke Skywalker.
MAP_YAVINIV_DESC: One of three habitable moons surrounding the gas giant Yavin.\n\nA strategic location for a number of galactic struggles.

MILLENIUMFALCON_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: She may not look like much, but you would be hard-pressed to find a more legendary ship than Han’s Millennium Falcon, which has eluded Star Destroyers, bested Darth Vader, and destroyed a Death Star -- all with a somewhat unpredictable hyperdrive. The Falcon is a Rebel Attacker that strengthens Home One and the Rebel fleet as a whole by enabling relentless assist calls. Piloted by Han Solo and Chewbacca, the Falcon also Outmaneuvers its enemies with extra Evasion, and can't be targeted while other allies are present.

MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER01_DESC:
[c][24CCF4]Required:[-][/c]
7-Star, 40,000+ Power
- Anakin's Eta-2 Starfighter
(See [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)
- Galactic Republic Capital Ship
- Galactic Republic Ships

[c][24CCF4]Recommended:[-][/c]
- 50,000+ Power
- Crew Relic Level 3
- Crew Mods rarity Mk VI

[c][24CCF4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- The Soulless One will inflict Marked on the weakest other Droid ally at the start of each ship's turn, making itself difficult to target.
- Use Taunt effectively in order to weather the storm of Buzz Droids from enemy Vulture Droids.
- Make effective use of attacks that damage all enemies to avoid being overwhelmed.

[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] Anakin's Delta-7B Starfighter will replace your version of Anakin's Eta-2 Starfighter in this battle.
- This version of Anakin's Delta-7b has the same abilities as Anakin's Eta-2 and will inherit its stats from the version of Anakin's Eta-2 you bring into battle.
- This ship is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.

MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER02_DESC:
[c][24CCF4]Required:[-][/c]
7-Star, 17,700+ Power
- Ahsoka Tano
- C-3PO
- General Kenobi
- Padmé Amidala
- Shaak Ti

[c][24CCF4]Recommended:[-][/c]
- 22,000+ Power
- Relic Level 3
- Mods rarity Mk VI
- Zeta ability upgrades

[c][24CCF4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]
- General Grievous can't be targeted until both Droidekas have been defeated.
- While the Droidekas' shields are active, they have Damage Immunity.
- Defeat IG-100 MagnaGuards in order to drop the Droidekas' shields, allowing your squad to damage and defeat them. New MagnaGuards will appear when the Droidekas redeploy their shields.
- Defeating the Droidekas efficiently will be key to victory; the longer the fight goes on, the more Max Health Grievous gains from his Unique ability.

MODIFIER_BESPIN_DESC: At the start of each unit's turn, they gain [c][FFFF33]Collected Wealth[-][/c] until the end of battle if they haven't taken damage since their last turn. This effect can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Collected Wealth:[-][/c] +10% Critical Chance and Critical Damage (stacking, max 25)
MODIFIER_BESPIN_DESC_V2:
At the start of the battle, all characters have their Accuracy reduced by 15%.

Gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Collected Wealth[-][/c] whenever a character damages an enemy. This effect can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. Lose all stacks of Collected Wealth when damaged.

[c] [F0FF23]Collected Wealth:[-][/c] +10% Critical Chance and Critical Damage (stacking, max 10)
MODIFIER_BESPIN_SPACE_DESC: Player: At the start of battle, target ally gains Stealth for 2 turns and [c][FFFF33]Contraband[-][/c] which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Contraband:[-][/c] Disable Protection and increase Speed by 35; If this ship is defeated, the battle ends in defeat

MODIFIER_BOUNTYHUNTER_DESC: All Bounty Hunter allies gain 9 stacks of [c][FFFF33]True Defense[-][/c] at the start of battle. Whenever a Bounty Hunter gains their payout, they also gain Frenzy for 1 turn, 100% increased damage, and their cooldowns are reset.\n\n[c][FFFF33]True Defense:[-][/c] 10% reduced damage taken per stack; lose one stack of True Defense when receiving damage
MODIFIER_BOUNTYHUNTER_DESC_V2: All Bounty Hunter allies gain 9 stacks of [c][FFFF33]True Defense[-][/c] at the start of battle, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. Whenever a Bounty Hunter gains their payout, they also gain Frenzy for 1 turn, 100% increased damage, and their cooldowns are reset.\n\n[c][FFFF33]True Defense:[-][/c] 10% reduced damage taken per stack; lose one stack of True Defense when receiving damage
MODIFIER_BOUNTYHUNTER_SHIPS_DESC: All Bounty Hunter allies deal 10% more damage to debuffed enemies and gain 25% turn meter whenever you attack a debuffed enemy.
MODIFIER_CLONES_DESC:
Whenever a Clone Trooper gains a buff, they also gain a stack of 

[c][FFFF33]Dauntless Courage[-][/c].

[c][FFFF33]Dauntless Courage:[-][/c] +5% Offense, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and +1% Health Steal
MODIFIER_CLONETROOPER_DESC: Whenever a Clone Trooper gains a buff, they also gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Dauntless Courage[-][/c].\n\n[c][FFFF33]Dauntless Courage:[-][/c] +5% Offense, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and +1% Health Steal
MODIFIER_CLONETROOPER_DESC_V2: Whenever a Clone Trooper gains a buff that can be dispelled, they also gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Dauntless Courage[-][/c], which can't be copied or dispelled.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Dauntless Courage:[-][/c] +5% Offense, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and +1% Health Steal
MODIFIER_CLONETROOPER_DESC_V3: Whenever a Clone Trooper gains a buff that can be dispelled, they also gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Dauntless Courage[-][/c] until the end of battle, which can't be copied or dispelled.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Dauntless Courage:[-][/c] +5% Offense, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and +1% Health Steal
MODIFIER_CORUSCANT_DESC: Defeating the enemy Leader wins the battle. When your Leader is defeated, you lose the battle.
MODIFIER_DATHOMIR_DESC: Every 10 turns, all defeated characters are revived at 50% Health.
MODIFIER_DEATHSTAR_DESC: At the start of battle all units gain the Volatile Energies ability. When a unit with this ability starts their turn, this ability gains 5% energy. Units with this ability deal increased damage equal to the amount of energy present. If this ability is fully energized at the start of a unit's turn, they may activate it to expend all energy and destroy target enemy, which can't be evaded. Units defeated by this ability can't be revived.
MODIFIER_DEATHSTAR_DESC_V2: At the start of battle all units gain the Volatile Energies ability which starts at 0% energy. When a unit with this ability starts their turn, this ability gains 5% energy. Units with this ability deal increased damage equal to the amount of energy present. If this ability is fully energized at the start of a unit's turn, they may activate it to expend all energy and destroy target enemy, which can't be evaded. Units defeated by this ability can't be revived.
MODIFIER_DROID_DESC: Droid allies have +30% Offense. Whenever a Droid ally scores a critical hit during their turn, they inflict Target Lock on target enemy for 2 turns if that enemy didn't already have it. Whenever a Droid ally damages an enemy with Target Lock, that ally recovers 10% Protection.
MODIFIER_DROID_DESC_SHIPS: Droid allies have +10% Offense. Whenever a Droid ally scores a critical hit during their turn, they inflict Target Lock on target enemy for 2 turns if that enemy didn't already have it. Whenever a Droid ally damages an enemy with Target Lock, that ally recovers 10% Protection.
MODIFIER_EMPIRE_DESC: If there is an Empire ally in the Leader slot, they gain +30% Max Health and Max Protection, and other Imperial Trooper allies will instantly revive when defeated. When an Imperial Trooper ally is revived, the ally in the Leader slot Taunts for 2 turns. Whenever an Empire ally in the Leader slot uses a Special ability during their turn, all Empire allies increase the damage they deal by 10% until the end of the encounter, and then all other Empire allies are called to assist.\n\nIf no summon is present at the start of the encounter, summon a Snowtrooper Operative if the ally slot is available.
MODIFIER_EMPIRE_DESC_V2: If there is an Empire ally in the Leader slot, they gain +30% Max Health and Max Protection. Whenever an Empire ally in the Leader slot uses a Special ability during their turn, all Empire allies increase the damage they deal by 10% until the end of the encounter, and then all other Empire allies are called to assist.\n\nIf no summon is present at the start of the encounter, summon a Snowtrooper Operative if the ally slot is available.
MODIFIER_EMPIRE_SHIPS_DESC: Whenever an Empire capital ship uses a Special ability during their turn, all Empire allies increase the damage they deal by 10% until the end of the encounter. Whenever an Empire ally is defeated, reduce cooldown of Call Reinforcement on allied Capital Ship by 1.
MODIFIER_EMPIRE_SHIPS_DESC_V2: Whenever an Empire capital ship uses a Special ability (except Call Reinforcement) during their turn, all active Empire allies gain 10% Offense (stacking) until the end of the encounter. Whenever an Empire ally is defeated, reduce cooldown of Call Reinforcement on allied Capital Ship by 1.
MODIFIER_ENDOR_DESC:
All characters gain the [c][FFFF33]Rally the Tribe[-][/c] ability.

[c][FFFF33]Rally the Tribe:[-][/c] Each ally gains an effect based on this character's role. This ability is on a shared cooldown between all allies and is immune to cooldown manipulation (Cooldown: 8).

[c][B5E7F5]- Attacker:[-][/c] All allies gain Defense Penetration Up for 2 turns and assist dealing 50% less damage
[c][B5E7F5]- Healer or Support:[-][/c] All allies gain Protection Over Time (20%) for 2 turns and 30% Turn Meter
[c][B5E7F5]- Tank:[-][/c] All allies gain Critical Hit Immunity and Foresight for 2 turns; Tanks Taunt for 2 turns

MODIFIER_EWOK_DESC: Ewok allies have +50% Counter Chance and +20% Speed. Whenever an enemy targets an Ewok ally while attacking out of turn, that enemy is Stunned for 1 turn at the end of the turn (limit once per turn per enemy), which can't be evaded or resisted.
MODIFIER_FIRSTORDER_DESC: Whenever a First Order ally gains Advantage, they lose 20% Critical Chance and gain 35% Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of battle. If a First Order unit does not score at least 1 critical hit during their turn, they gain Advantage for 2 turns at the end of that turn if they did not already have it.
MODIFIER_FIRSTORDER_SHIPS_DESC: Whenever a First Order ally scores a critical hit, they gain Protection Up (25%) for 2 turns. Hunted enemies deal 50% less damage to First Order allies. If a First Order ally defeats a Hunted enemy, that ally recovers 100% Health and Protection.
MODIFIER_GALACTICREPUBLIC_DESC: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally takes damage from an enemy, they reflect 100% of that damage back at that enemy. The damage of this ability is increased by 10% for each time this ally has dealt damage this way.
MODIFIER_GALACTICREPUBLIC_DESC_SHIPS_V2: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally takes damage from an enemy, they reflect 100% of that damage back at that enemy. The damage of this ability is increased by 10% for each time this ally has dealt damage this way. The reflected damage can't be avoided or prevented, and defeat enemies.
MODIFIER_GALACTICREPUBLIC_DESC_V2: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally takes damage from an enemy, they reflect 100% of that damage back at that enemy. The damage of this ability is increased by 10% for each time this ally has dealt damage this way. Enemies cannot be defeated by this reflected damage.
MODIFIER_GALACTICREPUBLIC_DESC_V3: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally takes damage from an enemy, they reflect 100% of that damage back at that enemy. The damage of this ability is increased by 10% for each time this ally has dealt damage this way. The reflected damage can't be avoided or prevented, and defeat enemies.
MODIFIER_GALACTICREPUBLIC_DESC_V4: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally receives damage from an enemy, they deal true damage to that enemy equal to 100% of the damage received. The damage dealt by this ability is increased by 10% for each time that ally has dealt damage this way. This damage can't be evaded and can't defeat enemies.
MODIFIER_GALACTICREPUBLIC_EASY_DESC: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally takes damage from an enemy, they reflect 20% of that damage back at that enemy. The damage of this ability is increased by 10% for each time this ally has dealt damage this way. Enemies cannot be defeated by this reflected damage.
MODIFIER_GALACTICREPUBLIC_EASY_DESC_V2: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally takes damage from an enemy, they reflect 20% of that damage back at that enemy. The damage of this ability is increased by 10% for each time this ally has dealt damage this way. The reflected damage can't be avoided or prevented, and defeat enemies.
MODIFIER_GALACTICREPUBLIC_EASY_DESC_V3: Whenever a Galactic Republic ally receives damage from an enemy, they deal true damage to that enemy equal to 20% of the damage received. The damage dealt by this ability is increased by 10% for each time that ally has dealt damage this way. This damage can't be evaded and can't defeat enemies.
MODIFIER_GEONOSIS_DESC: Whenever a unit uses a Special ability, they gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Entertainment[-][/c] which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Entertainment:[-][/c] +10% Max Health, Offense and Potency per stack
MODIFIER_HOTH_DESC:
All units gain the [c][FFFF33]Thermoregulate[-][/c] ability. At the start of each unit's turn, they are inflicted with [c][FFFF33]Frostbite[-][/c] until they are defeated, which can't be resisted.

[c][FFFF33]Frostbite:[-][/c] -10% Speed per stack. This unit is defeated upon reaching 10 stacks

[c][FFFF33]Thermoregulate:[-][/c] Remove two stacks of Overheat and Frostbite from target ally.
MODIFIER_HOTH_DESC_V2:
All units gain the [c][FFFF33]Thermoregulate[-][/c] ability. At the start of each unit's turn, they are inflicted with [c][FFFF33]Frostbite[-][/c] until they are defeated, which can't be resisted.

[c][FFFF33]Frostbite:[-][/c] -2% Critical Chance, Potency, and Speed per stack; this unit is defeated upon reaching 10 stacks

[c][FFFF33]Thermoregulate:[-][/c] Remove two stacks of Overheat and Frostbite from target ally.
MODIFIER_HOTH_SPACE_DESC: At the end of every other turn, all units are inflicted with Damage Over Time until defeated, which can't be resisted.
MODIFIER_HOTH_V2_DESC:
All units gain the [c][ffff33]Smells Bad on the Outside[-][/c] ability. At the start of battle, all units are inflicted with [c][ffff33]Deadly Storm,[-][/c] which can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted. The first time an ally would be defeated, they instead dispel all debuffs on themselves and remove Deadly Storm, recover 100% Health and Protection, gain Damage Immunity and Stun for 1 turn. These status effects can't be copied or dispelled.

[c][ffff33]Deadly Storm:[-][/c] -100% Critical Chance, -50% Offense, -25% Speed, and characters take damage at the start of their turn equal to 10% of their Max Health

[c][ffff33]Smells Bad on the Outside:[-][/c] Remove Deadly Storm from self and gain Critical Chance Up, Offense Up, and Speed Up for 2 turns. (Cooldown: 5)
MODIFIER_ILUM_DESC:
All units are inflicted with 10 stacks of [c][F0FF23]Doubt[-][/c] at the start of the battle, which persists through defeat and can't be resisted, dispelled, or prevented. Whenever a character uses a special ability, dispel 1 stack of [c][F0FF23]Doubt[-][/c]. At 0 stacks, recover 50% Health and gain [c][F0FF23]Clarity[-][/c], which persists through defeat and cannot be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

[c][F0FF23]Doubt:[-][/c] -5% Offense and -5% Tenacity per stack. Can't assist or gain bonus Turn Meter.
[c][F0FF23]Clarity:[-][/c] +50% Tenacity and +30% Offense. Whenever a debuff is resisted, gain 5% Critical Chance and 5% Critical Damage (stacking) for the rest of the battle.
MODIFIER_IMPERIALTROOPER01_OPPONENTSIDE_: At the start of battle, Imperial Troopers gain 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c] for each Imperial Trooper ally (max 3 stacks).\n\n[c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c]: When defeated, remove 1 stack of Endless Ranks from all Imperial Trooper allies and revive with 30% Health and Protection, which can't be prevented
MODIFIER_IMPERIALTROOPER01_PLAYERSIDE_DE: At the start of battle, Imperial Troopers gain 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c] for each Imperial Trooper ally (max 3 stacks).\n\n[c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c]: When defeated, remove 1 stack of Endless Ranks from all Imperial Trooper allies and revive with 60% Health and Protection
MODIFIER_JAKKU_DESC:
All units gain the [c][FFFF33]Thermoregulate[-][/c] ability. At the start of each unit's turn, they are inflicted with [c][FFFF33]Overheat[-][/c] until they are defeated, which can't be resisted.

[c][FFFF33]Overheat:[-][/c] -10% Max Health per stack. This unit is defeated upon reaching 10 stacks

[c][FFFF33]Thermoregulate:[-][/c] Remove two stacks of Overheat and Frostbite from target ally.
MODIFIER_JAKKU_SPACE_DESC: Whenever a ship's protection reaches 0%, they gain Retribution for 1 turn. Whenever a ship falls below 50% Health, they gain Defense Up for 1 turn. The first time each ship falls below 25% Health, that ship gains Damage Immunity for 1 turn.
MODIFIER_JAKKU_SPACE_DESC_V2: Whenever a ship's Protection reaches 0%, they gain Retribution for 1 turn. Whenever a ship falls below 50% Health, they gain Defense Up for 1 turn. The first time each ship falls below 25% Health, that ship gains Damage Immunity for 1 turn.
MODIFIER_JAWA_DESC: Jawa allies have +100% Protection. Whenever a Thermal Detonator deals damage, Jawa allies recover 100% Protection and gain 5% Speed, to a maximum of +100%. At the end of each turn, if a Jawa ally was damaged by a debuffed enemy that turn, inflict a Thermal Detonator for 2 turns on each enemy, which can't be evaded or resisted. This effect occurs for each time a Jawa ally was damaged by a debuffed enemy that turn.
MODIFIER_JEDI_DESC: Whenever an enemy buff is dispelled or expires during a Jedi ally's ability, that Jedi gains Advantage for 2 turns and 25% Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of battle.
MODIFIER_JEDI_DESC_V2: Whenever an enemy buff is dispelled or expires during a Jedi ally's ability, that Jedi gains Advantage for 2 turns and 25% Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of battle (limit once per ability).
MODIFIER_JEDI_DESC_V3: If any enemy buffs are dispelled or expire during a Jedi ally's ability, that Jedi gains Advantage for 2 turns and 25% Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of battle.
MODIFIER_KAMINO_DESC:
At the start of battle, all units have their current Max Health, Max Protection, Offense, Defense, and Critical Chance reduced by 80%. Additionally, they gain the [c][FFFF33]Superior Training[-][/c] ability.

[c][FFFF33]Superior Training:[-][/c] This unit gains [c][FFFF33]Superiority[-][/c] (stacking) until they are defeated, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

[c][FFFF33]Superiority:[-][/c] +20% current Max Health, Max Protection, Offense, Defense, and Critical Chance
MODIFIER_KAMINO_GRANTED_ABILITY_DESC: This unit gains [c][FFFF33]Superiority[-][/c] (stacking) until they are defeated, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Superiority:[-][/c] +20% current Max Health, Max Protection, Offense, Defense, and Critical Chance
MODIFIER_KASHYYYK_DESC: Whenever a unit takes damage, they gain 20% Critical Damage (stacking) until they score a critical hit.\nWhenever a unit is debuffed, they recover 10% Protection.\nWhenever a unit is defeated, another random ally takes a bonus turn.
MODIFIER_LOTHAL_DESC: Whenever an ally uses a special ability during their turn, call a random other ally to assist. Whenever a character attacks out of turn, they gain a stack of [c][F0FF23]Rebellious[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. At 20 stacks of Rebellious, they gain an additional 30% Offense.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Rebellious:[-][/c] +2% Critical Chance and Critical Damage (stacking, max 20)
MODIFIER_LOTHAL_SPACE_DESC: Whenever a ship has 4 or more buffs, they are inflicted with Breach and Expose for 1 turn.
MODIFIER_LOTHAL_SPACE_DESC_V2: Whenever a ship has 4 or more buffs, they are inflicted with Breach and Expose for 1 turn. These effects can't be resisted.
MODIFIER_MALACHOR_ABILITY_DESC: All other allies lose 25% Max Health and Max Protection. Gain 5% Offense per ally affected this way. Then, gain a bonus turn.
MODIFIER_MALACHOR_DESC: Characters in the Leader slot gain the [c][FFFF33]Drain Essence[-][/c] ability at the start of the encounter.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Drain Essence:[-][/c] All other allies lose 25% Max Health and Max Protection. Gain 5% Offense per ally affected this way. Then, gain a bonus turn.
MODIFIER_MANDALORIAN_DESC: Whenever a Mandalorian ally takes damage, all Mandalorian allies gain a stack of Clan Loyalty, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. If there is exactly one non-Mandalorian ally at the start of battle, that ally also gains Clan Loyalty if they are not in the Leader slot. Allies with Clan Loyalty have a 50% chance to assist when another ally attacks during an enemy's turn (limit once per turn), dealing 95% less damage.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty:[-][/c] +1% Max Protection and counter chance, -1% damage penalty when assisting
MODIFIER_MANDALORIAN_DESC_V2: Whenever a Mandalorian ally takes damage, all Mandalorian allies gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty:[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. If there is exactly one non-Mandalorian ally at the start of battle, that ally also gains [c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty:[-][/c] if they are not in the Leader slot. Allies with [c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty:[-][/c] have a 50% chance to assist when another ally attacks during an enemy's turn (limit once per turn), dealing 95% less damage.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty:[-][/c] +1% Max Protection and counter chance, -1% damage penalty when assisting
MODIFIER_NEVARRO_DESC: Whenever a character inflicts a debuff, they gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Imperial Rule[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Imperial Rule:[-][/c] +2% Offense and Potency per stack
MODIFIER_NIGHTSISTER_DESC: Whenever an ally is revived, all other Nightsister allies gain Ichor (stacking), which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Ichor:[-][/c] +5% Health, Protection, Damage, and Speed
MODIFIER_NIGHTSISTER_DESC_V2: Whenever an ally is revived, all other Nightsister allies gain Ichor (stacking), which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Ichor:[-][/c] +5% Max Health, Max Protection, Offense, and Speed
MODIFIER_OLDREPUBLIC_DESC: Old Republic allies are immune to Tenacity Down. At the start of battle, Old Republic allies gain 20% Tenacity for each Old Republic ally. Whenever an Old Republic ally resists a detrimental effect, all Old Republic allies gain 4% Turn Meter. Whenever an Old Republic ally uses a Basic ability, they also deal True damage to all enemies, which can't be evaded.
MODIFIER_REBELS_DESC: Whenever a Rebel ally scores a critical hit during their turn, they have a 100% chance to attack again. This chance is reduced to 25% for bonus attacks beyond the first. Rebel allies gain 50% Health Steal and can't be countered.
MODIFIER_REBELS_SHIPS_DESC: Whenever a Rebel ally scores a Critical Hit during their turn, they have a 100% chance to attack again. This chance is reduced to 10% for bonus attacks beyond the first. Rebel allies can't be countered.
MODIFIER_REBELS_SHIPS_DESC_V2: Whenever a Rebel ally scores a Critical Hit during their turn, they have a 100% chance to attack again. Rebel allies can't be countered.
MODIFIER_REBELS_SHIPS_DESC_V3: Whenever a Rebel ally scores a critical hit during their turn, they have a 100% chance to attack again. This chance is reduced to 10% for bonus attacks beyond the first. Rebel allies can't be countered.
MODIFIER_REBELS_V2_DESC: Rebel allies gain 50% Health Steal and can't be countered. Whenever a Rebel's Health drops below 40%, they are inflicted with [c][F0FF23]Cornered[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. When a Rebel ally's Health is above 70%, [c][F0FF23]Cornered[-][/c] is dispelled and they gain 10% Offense (stacking, max 50%) for the rest of the encounter.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Cornered:[-][/c] +30% Offense, calls a random Rebel ally to assist when using an ability, and can't attack out of turn.
MODIFIER_RESISTANCE_DESC: Whenever an enemy resists a detrimental effect from a Resistance ally, that ally gains Heal Over Time for 1 turn. Whenever a Resistance ally gains a buff, they also gain 5% Potency, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage (stacking) until end of battle, and 10% Turn Meter.
MODIFIER_RESISTANCE_SHIPS_DESC: Whenever an enemy resists a detrimental effect from a Resistance ally, that ally gains Heal Over Time for 1 turn. Whenever a Resistance ally gains a buff, they also gain 3% Potency, Critical Chance, and Critical Damage (stacking) until end of battle, and 10% Turn Meter.
MODIFIER_SCOUNDREL_DESC: Whenever a Scoundrel ally deals damage to their target enemy, for each buff that enemy has, that ally gains that buff for 3 turns. Then, dispel all buffs on target enemy.
MODIFIER_SCOUNDREL_DESC_V2: Whenever a Scoundrel ally deals damage to their target enemy, for each buff that enemy has, that ally gains that buff for 3 turns (except Taunt). Then, dispel all buffs on target enemy.
MODIFIER_SCOUNDREL_V2_DESC: Scoundrel allies gain +30% Max Health, +20 Speed, and are immune to Buff Immunity. While buffed, Scoundrel allies take 30% less damage, have +50% counter chance, and inflict Defense Down for 2 turns when attacked, which can't be resisted. While debuffed, Scoundrel allies gain +10 Speed.
MODIFIER_SEPARATIST_DESC: Summoned Separatist allies have +25% Speed, Max Health, and Max Protection, and damage they deal is increased by 25%. All other Separatist allies gain half of these bonuses.
MODIFIER_SEPARATIST_RANK_2_DESC: Summoned Separatist allies have +50% Speed, Max Health, and Max Protection, and damage they deal is increased by 50%. All other Separatist allies gain half of these bonuses.\n\nIf there is a Separatist in the Leader slot and no summon is present at the start of the encounter, summon a Sniper Droid to the ally slot.
MODIFIER_SHIPS_ATTACKER_DESC_V2: At the start of each Attacker's turn they gain Speed Up for 1 turn. Whenever an Attacker is targeted by an enemy, if they have Speed Up, they lose Speed Up and gain Chaff until the end of the turn.
MODIFIER_SHIPS_ATTACKER_DESC_V3: At the start of each Attacker's turn they gain Speed Up for 1 turn. Whenever an Attacker is targeted by an enemy, if they have Speed Up, they lose Speed Up and gain Chaff for 1 turn.
MODIFIER_SHIPS_CARGO_DESC: At the start of each Cargo Ship's turn, they gain Evasion Up for 2 turns and gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Primed Thrusters[-][/c] which cannot be copied, dispelled, or prevented. Whenever a Cargo Ship takes damage or is inflicted with a debuff, they gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Primed Thrusters[-][/c] which cannot be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Primed Thrusters:[-][/c] Whenever a Cargo Ship uses a Special ability, remove all stacks of Primed Thrusters and gain 10% Turn Meter for each stack removed.
MODIFIER_SHIPS_SUPPORT_DESC: At the start of each Support's turn, inflict Target Lock on a random enemy. Whenever a Target Locked enemy is attacked, a random ally has a 50% chance to assist.
MODIFIER_SHIPS_SUPPORT_DESC_V2: At the start of each Support's turn, inflict Target Lock on a random enemy for 2 turns. Whenever a Target Locked enemy is attacked, there is a 50% chance to call an Ally to assist.
MODIFIER_SHIPS_TANK_DESC: At the start of each Tank's turn, they gain Potency Up for 1 turn. Whenever a Tank is critically hit, they gain Protection Up (15%) for 2 turns.
MODIFIER_SITH_DESC: Whenever a Sith ally is defeated, all Sith allies gain 50% Max Health and Offense (stacking) until end of battle, gain 50% Turn Meter, and recover 50% Health. Whenever a Sith ally defeats an enemy, they gain [c][FFFF33]Dark Ascension[-][/c] (stacking), which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Dark Ascension:[-][/c] Damage received decreased by 15% and damage dealt increased by 30%
MODIFIER_SITH_EASY_DESC: Whenever a Sith ally is defeated, all Sith allies gain 20% Max Health and Offense (stacking) until end of battle and recover 25% Health. Whenever a Sith ally defeats an enemy, they gain [c][FFFF33]Dark Ascension[-][/c] (stacking), which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][FFFF33]Dark Ascension:[-][/c] Damage received decreased by 15% and damage dealt increased by 30%
MODIFIER_SMUGGLER_DESC: At the start of the encounter, all Smugglers gain Critical Damage Up and Protection up (20%) for 2 turns, and are Prepared.
MODIFIER_SMUGGLER_OVERCHARGED_DESC: At the start of the encounter, all Smugglers gain Critical Damage Up and Protection up (20%) for 2 turns, and are Prepared.\nMax Duration: 2 battles
MODIFIER_TAKODANA_DESC: The first unit to deal damage to an enemy while no units are Deathmarked is inflicted with Deathmark until the end of battle, which can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted.
MODIFIER_TATOOINE_DESC: At the end of every other turn, all units are inflicted with Damage Over Time until defeated, which can't be resisted.
MODIFIERABILITY_GETMESSY_DESC: Allies with no debuffs have -25% Offense. Allies with debuffs have +50% Offense for each debuff they have.
MODIFIERABILITY_GRIT_DESC: Allies have no Protection, but have +50% Max Health, and gain +200% Defense while below half Health.
MODIFIERABILITY_HYPERDRIVE_DESC: All units have -50% Offense. Whenever any unit uses a Special ability, all other units gain 20% Turn Meter and +10% Offense (stacking) for the rest of the battle.
MODIFIERABILITY_OUTMANEUVER_DESC: Allies deal 50% less damage when attacking during their turn, but 100% more damage when attacking out of turn.
MODIFIERABILITY_PANIC_DESC: Whenever an ally is damaged by an attack, they suffer Offense Down and Daze for 1 turn unless they have a defensive buff (can't be Resisted).
MODIFIERABILITY_SHORTTEMPER_DESC: Raid Bosses have -50% Speed, but gain 50% Turn Meter whenever they suffer a Critical Hit (limit once per turn).
MODIFIERABILITY_SHOWTIME_DESC: At the start of each ally's third turn, they Dispel all debuffs on themselves and deal 900% more damage for the rest of that turn. After that turn, they deal 75% less damage for the rest of the battle.
MODIFIERABILITY_SPITE_DESC: Allies have -50% Offense, but +20% Offense for each debuff on all enemies.
Mods_Battles_Table_1_QUEST_DESC: Complete Mod battles to unlock additional Mod stages and get better Mods.\n\nI'll keep all the good mods for myself, get your own!
Mods_Battles_Table_1_QUEST_REWARDS: Mods will let you accelerate in Holobattles all over the Cantina.
Mods_Battles_Table_1_QUEST_REWARDS_V2: Mods will increase your success in Holobattles all over the Cantina.
Mods_Battles_Table_2_QUEST_DESC: Select Mods to boost various stats, check the stats to match them to your Characters!\n\nI just experiment until I find the right combinations.
Mods_Battles_Table_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Switch mods to rearrange them into the best configurations.
Mods_Battles_Table_3_QUEST_DESC: Complete stages in Mod battles to gain additional Mods.\n\nRemember, secondary Mod stats vary quite a bit, so chase your favorites!
Mods_Battles_Table_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Have you tried putting together Speed Mods and Speed secondary stats?\n\nThey make a winning combination!
Mods_Battles_Table_4_QUEST_DESC: I'll let you in on a Mod secret, match Mod sets of two or four to activate bonuses. \n\nFind combinations that complement your Characters.
Mods_Battles_Table_4_QUEST_REWARDS: Maybe you'll be giving me tips on Mods someday.
Mods_Battles_Table_9_ABC_QUEST_DESC: Earn Slicing materials to make your Mods stronger in stage 9 Mod Battles.\n\nIf you see a Fusion Disk I could use an extra...
Mods_Battles_Table_9_ABC_QUEST_REWARDS: Each battle in Stage 9 Mod Battles has a different possible Slicing material.
Mods_Battles_Table_9_DEF_QUEST_DESC: Carefully choose which mods to Slice.\n\nSlicing a mod increases its stats, results may vary.
Mods_Battles_Table_9_DEF_QUEST_REWARDS: Remember, you can view recommendations on which Mod sets to use on your characters!

Mods_Challenges_2_QUEST_DESC: Mods can vary greatly from stat to stat and slot to slot.\n\nIf you find a 30 speed secondary, Crit Avoidance, or Tier A mod consider yourself lucky.
Mods_Challenges_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Here are a few rewards, keep an eye out for the Mod Store.
Mods_Challenges_3_QUEST_DESC: Health Mods are a great way to increase Health quickly on your characters.\n\nMix and Match mod set bonuses!
Mods_Challenges_3_QUEST_DESC_V2: Health Mods are a great way to increase Health quickly on your characters.\n\nAssign two for a Set Bonus.
Mods_Challenges_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Mods make a difference on battle outcomes, find the best Mods to win more!
Mods_Challenges_3_QUEST_REWARDS_V2: Mods make a difference on battle outcomes, find the best Mods to win more!
Mods_Challenges_3_TASK_DESC_1_V2: Win Health Mod Challenge: Tier I
Mods_Challenges_3_TASK_DESC_2_V2: Win Health Mod Challenge: Tier III
Mods_Challenges_3_TASK_DESC_3_V3: Win Health Mod Challenge: Tier II
Mods_Collect_CritChance_Mods_QUEST_DESC: Crit Chance Mods give your characters better odds at scoring critical hits.\n\n Assign two for a Set Bonus.
Mods_Collect_CritChance_Mods_QUEST_REWAR: Assigning any mod to a character could increase it's power.\n\nFor best results, choose mods that work well with your characters abilities!
Mods_Collect_CritChance_Mods_TASK_DESC_1: Win Crit Chance Mod Challenge: Tier I
Mods_Collect_CritChance_Mods_TASK_DESC_2: Win Crit Chance Mod Challenge: Tier III
Mods_Collect_CritChance_Mods_TASK_DESC_3: Win Crit Chance Mod Challenge: Tier II
Mods_Collect_CritDamage_Mods_QUEST_DESC: Crit Damage Mods increase the amount of damage your characters deal when they score a critical hit!\n\n Assign four for a Set Bonus.
Mods_Collect_CritDamage_Mods_TASK_DESC_1: Win Crit Damage Mod Challenge: Tier I
Mods_Collect_CritDamage_Mods_TASK_DESC_2: Win Crit Damage Mod Challenge: Tier III
Mods_Collect_CritDamage_Mods_TASK_DESC_3: Win Crit Damage Mod Challenge: Tier II
Mods_Collect_Defense_Mods_QUEST_DESC: Defense Mods allow your characters to reduce damage taken per enemy attack.\n\n Assign two for a Set Bonus.
Mods_Collect_Defense_Mods_QUEST_REWARDS: Mix and Match mod set bonuses!
Mods_Collect_Defense_Mods_TASK_DESC_1: Win Defense Mod Challenge: Tier I
Mods_Collect_Defense_Mods_TASK_DESC_2: Win Defense Mod Challenge: Tier III
Mods_Collect_Defense_Mods_TASK_DESC_3_V2: Win Defense Mod Challenge: Tier II
Mods_Collect_Offense_Mods_QUEST_DESC: Offense Mods boost the damage your characters deal.\n\n Assign four for a Set Bonus.
Mods_Collect_Offense_Mods_QUEST_REWARDS: Excuse me, you're going to have to do more mod battles until you get the hang of things...
Mods_Collect_Offense_Mods_TASK_DESC_1: Win Offense Mod Challenge: Tier I
Mods_Collect_Offense_Mods_TASK_DESC_2: Win Offense Mod Challenge: Tier III
Mods_Collect_Offense_Mods_TASK_DESC_3_V2: Win Offense Mod Challenge: Tier II
Mods_Collect_Potency_Mods_QUEST_DESC: Potency Mods grant your characters a higher chance to inflict debuffs on enemies.\n\n Assign two for a Set Bonus.
Mods_Collect_Potency_Mods_QUEST_REWARDS: Assign Potency mods to characters you wish to inflict debuffs more frequently.
Mods_Collect_Potency_Mods_TASK_DESC_1: Win Potency Mod Challenge: Tier I
Mods_Collect_Potency_Mods_TASK_DESC_2: Win Potency Mod Challenge: Tier III
Mods_Collect_Potency_Mods_TASK_DESC_3_V2: Win Potency Mod Challenge: Tier II
Mods_Collect_Speed_Mods_QUEST_DESC: Speed Mods make your characters take turns at a faster rate.\n\n Assign four for a Set Bonus.
Mods_Collect_Speed_Mods_QUEST_REWARDS: It's tough to go wrong with Speed mods, some characters benefit from speed more than others.
Mods_Collect_Speed_Mods_TASK_DESC_1: Win Speed Mod Challenge: Tier I
Mods_Collect_Speed_Mods_TASK_DESC_2: Win Speed Mod Challenge: Tier III
Mods_Collect_Speed_Mods_TASK_DESC_3_V2: Win Speed Mod Challenge: Tier II
Mods_Collect_Tenacity_Mods_QUEST_DESC: Tenacity Mods augment your characters ability to resist detrimental effects.\n\n Assign two for a Set Bonus.
Mods_Collect_Tenacity_Mods_QUEST_REWARDS: Assign Tenacity mods to characters you want to prevent from recieving many debuffs in battle.
Mods_Collect_Tenacity_Mods_TASK_DESC_1: Win Tenacity Mod Challenge: Tier I
Mods_Collect_Tenacity_Mods_TASK_DESC_2: Win Tenacity Mod Challenge: Tier III

MODS_DOUBLE_DROPS_SUMMARY: Mod Battles and Challenges are rewarding double drops on 12/11, 12/12, and 12/13!
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_1_QUEST_DESC: Fulcrum was a codename used by various Rebel operatives.\n\nIf you want to understand them, you'll need to start with studying Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)!
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_1_QUEST_REWARDS: Great start! After the Empire came to power, Ahsoka joined Bail Organa's Rebels and adopted the codename Fulcrum, where she provided intel to Rebels.
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_1_TASK_DESC_1: Get Ahsoka (Fulcrum) to Gear Tier XII
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_1_TASK_DESC_3: Defeat 1,000 Empire enemies with Ahsoka (Fulcrum) present
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_2_QUEST_DESC: Alright, now we need to contact another Fulcrum--Cassian Andor!\n\nThey say he was part of Rogue One...
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Great work! And you probably know this already, but not all Imperial Security Droids are so friendly...
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_2_TASK_DESC_1: Get Cassian Andor to Gear tier XII
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_2_TASK_DESC_2: Finish off 200 enemies with Cassian Andor
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_2_TASK_DESC_3: Win 5 Territory War attacks with Cassian Andor
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_5_QUEST_DESC: You can't exactly recruit rebels in the open, not while the Empire is watching.\n\nThat's why Cassian adopted the Fulcrum name while recruiting on Wecacoe.
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_5_QUEST_REWARDS: Cassian's undercover work led him to become a great hero of the Rebellion.\n\nKeep working like this and you'll follow in his footsteps as FULCRUM!
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_5_TASK_DESC_1: Win 5 Squad Arena battles with only Rebels
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_5_TASK_DESC_3: Defeat Hoth Rebel Assault phase 6 Rogue One mission
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_6_QUEST_DESC: Through history, the fight against tyranny has been waged by brave rebels!\n\nEmploy these rebels and you can earn the Cantina title of FULCRUM!
Mods_Fulcrum_Agent_6_QUEST_REWARDS: Congratulations! It's been a long journey, but your security clearance passed and you've earned the top secret title FULCRUM!

MODS_PACK_DESC:
Guarantees between 5 and 8 Mods of any set: Health, Defense, Critical Damage, Critical Chance, Tenacity, Offense, Potency, Speed

Mods augment your character's abilities. Will you choose to make a strength even stronger or overcome a weakness?

[c][99FF33]Health[-][/c] - increases the amount of damage your character can take before being defeated
[c][99FF33]Defense[-][/c] - decreases the amount of damage your character takes from an enemy’s attack
[c][99FF33]Critical Damage[-][/c] - Increases the amount of damage dealt when your character lands a Critical Hit on an enemy
[c][99FF33]Critical Chance[-][/c] - Increases the chance your character lands a Critical Hit on an enemy
[c][99FF33]Tenacity[-][/c] - Decreases the likelihood of an enemy landing a negative status effect on your character
[c][99FF33]Offense[-][/c] - increases the amount of damage your character inflicts on an enemy during an attack
[c][99FF33]Potency[-][/c] - Increases the chance your player successfully applies a negative status effect to an enemy
[c][99FF33]Speed[-][/c] - Increases the rate at which your character takes a turn

Maximum 5 purchases per day.

Power up Moff Gideon with this brand new bundle! Each bundle includes 30 shards for Moff Gideon!

[f0ff23]BONUS:[-] This bundle also includes materials to immediately power up Moff Gideon to:

Character level: 40

Gear level: V

Purchase limit: 1
MOFF_GIDEON_BUNDLE_TEXT: The Moff Gideon Bundle and Pack are now available in the Store for a limited time! The Imperial leader is a Dark Side Support specialist that uses his intelligence to boost his Empire allies. Unlock Moff Gideon now!
MOFF_GIDEON_BUNDLE_TITLE: Moff Gideon Shards are Now Available in Store
MOFF_GIDEON_PACK_DESC:
Power up Moff Gideon with this brand new pack!

Each pack guarantees at least 10 shards for Moff Gideon and may drop up to [f0ff23]330 SHARDS[-]!

Possible shard drops include: 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 50, 80, 145, 230, 330

Power up your Moff Gideon with this brand new bundle! Each bundle includes 30 shards for Moff Gideon!

Purchase Limit: 1
MOFF_GIDEON_UPGRADE_BUNDLE_LP_DESC: The Moff Gideon Upgrade Bundle is here! This Imperial Remnants leader is perfect to pair with Dark Trooper and other Imperial Troopers. Unlock or Upgrade Moff Gideon now!\n\nPurchase Limit: 1
