NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_CHALLENGE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

In this update, we’re proud to present [c][F0FF23]Galactic Challenges[-][/c]! This all-new game mode represents a huge step for Galaxy of Heroes, as it lays the foundation of our new content initiative, allowing us to generate fresh content, challenges, and feats on a regular basis going forward.

With Galactic Challenges, players will be presented with new battles that provide the opportunity to utilize many parts of their character and ship roster in a fun and meaningful way. Galactic Challenge events keep the game fresh and engaging by offering interesting and unique encounters that feature always-changing combinations of modifiers, locations, and conditions, along with multiple tiers of difficulty. Modifiers add a wide range of positive and negative effects to the battle, meaning you’ll have to mix up your strategies to succeed.

The best part? This is just the beginning. Galactic Challenges will lay a foundation that allows Capital Games to continue expanding the variety of content we are able to offer now and in the future. We’re all really excited at the studio and can’t wait for our passionate community of players to dive in!

See you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_CHALLENGE_TITLE: Are You Ready For A Galactic Challenge?
NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_CONQUEST_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The latest update to Galaxy of Heroes expands the Galactic War table with a new game mode, [c][F0FF23]Conquest[-][/c]! You will face increasingly difficult foes as you advance from sector to sector, but special [c][F0FF23]Data Disks[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]consumables[-][/c] will help power up your squads along the way. You’ll need a variety of squads and your favorite combination of Data Disks to defeat some of your most difficult challenges yet! Complete feats and battles to improve your reward crate at the end of the event and for this Conquest, earn a very special ship, the [c][F0FF23]Razor Crest[-][/c]! Conquest begins with the first exhibition event on March 1st with another to follow closely thereafter.

Unlock the Razor Crest via the new Conquest mode and put it through the types of battles it’s become famous for enduring... not counting that whole thing on Tython. The famed transport has seen its fair share of adventure, from its start as a military patrol ship to being picked apart by Jawas and put back together by Din Djarin and Kuiil. 

With Breach and Bounty Hunter synergy, the Razor Crest stands ready to raise the faction’s competitiveness in ship battles. The new buff, [c][F0FF23]Reinforced Hull[-][/c], adds to the Razor Crest’s survivability, while cooldown reduction, calling allies to assist, and inflicting enemies with Marked ensures it packs a punch. 

Good luck in this month’s Conquest and see you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_GEAR_PACK_DESC: Need extra gear to get your remaining characters ready for Raids? The Galactic Gear Pack is now in the Store!\n\nFor a limited time you can get the gear you need, and have a chance to get exclusive Raid Gear.
NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_LEGENDS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

A new type of character is joining the Holotables, [c][f0ff23]Galactic Legends[-][/c]! [c][f0ff23]Supreme Leader Kylo Ren[-][/c] and [c][f0ff23]Rey[-][/c] are the first Galactic Legends and are some of the most powerful units in Galaxy of Heroes. Each Galactic Legend has a unique [c][f0ff23]Ultimate ability[-][/c] that charges over the course of a battle, such as Rey's [c][f0ff23]Heir to the Jedi[-][/c] or Kylo's [c][f0ff23]Depths of Rage[-][/c]. These powerful abilities can aid a variety of different squads with incredible bonuses to turn the tide of battle.

Want to get started on either Rey or Supreme Leader Kylo Ren? Find all the requirements for either character in the Journey Guide. These events are available permanently once you qualify for them; you can unlock these new characters whenever you are ready.
NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_WAR_REWARD_INCREASE_: Galactic War rewards have been adjusted. If you are brave enough to face the challenge of 12 consecutive battles and strong enough to beat them then you will be seeing an increase in the rewards you receive.\n\nTake your squad to war and get more rewards than ever!

This will ensure that if you ever have technical issues or switch devices, your account and progress will be safe. Thanks!
NEWSLETTER_GAMORREAN_GUARD_DESC:
Greetings, 

A new character is now available in Guild Store, Gamorrean Guard. This aggressive tank can Taunt, Counter and inflict multiple Damage Over Time effects. 

Will you be adding Gamorrean Guard to your collection?
NEWSLETTER_GAS_EVENT_DESC:
[i]"A true leader always leads from the front."[/i] -Anakin Skywalker to Captain Rex

[c][f0ff23]Anakin Skywalker[-][/c] has been many things over the years; pod racer, droid builder, Jedi padawan and even a legendary pilot, but his confidence and his exceptional connection to the Force was clear to anyone who came in contact with him. Now a General in the Grand Army of the Republic, Skywalker fights to stop the growing Separatist threat along side the 501st Clone Troopers. 

As the Chosen One, and due to his mastery of the Force, Skywalker can unleash a barrage of abilities each turn. General Skywalker can take [c][f0ff23]Cover[-][/c] in the heat of battle and wait for the right moment to [c][f0ff23]Advance[-][/c] towards the enemy while his Clone allies lay down fire. Between the shower of [c][f0ff23]Furious Slashes[-][/c] and using [c][f0ff23]Sundering Strike[-][/c] to tear apart his enemy’s defenses, General Skywalker is a force to be reckoned with.

Unlock General Skywalker starting today in the [c][f0ff23]Epic Confrontation, Clash on Kamino[-][/c].
NEWSLETTER_GAS_EVENT_TITLE: A General of the Grand Army of the Republic
NEWSLETTER_GENERAL_KENOBI_DESC:
General Kenobi is now available to add to your collection! Acquiring this legendary Jedi Master will take not only your best efforts, but also the best efforts of your guild as he is only available as the Heroic Tier reward in the new Tank Takedown Raid.

General Kenobi was both a shrewd negotiator and tactician during the Clone Wars. These traits translate into him being an ideal leader for both Jedi and Clone squads, granting both increased health and defense to his allies. A front-line combatant, his “Lead the Charge” ability allows him to call all other buffed allies to join in his attacks. In addition to his substantial combat abilities, his negotiating skills enable him to not only dispel all debuffs from his squad, but also grant the opposite buffs for the next 2 turns. With an array of abilities and buffs, General Kenobi is a great addition to any squad!

Will you be adding this hero of the Republic to your collection?
NEWSLETTER_GENERAL_KENOBI_TITLE: General Kenobi now available in the Tank Takedown Raid!
NEWSLETTER_GENERAL_TFA_UNIT_PROMO_DESC: New characters from Star Wars: The Force Awakens are now available! Collect and battle with Kylo Ren, Rey, Poe Dameron, Captain Phasma, Finn and the First Order Officer today. All six characters are available in Chromium Data Cards or as shard drops - View them in the characters screen to see where you can find them!
NEWSLETTER_GEONOSIAN_SPY_MISSION_DESC: Geonosian Spy is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 4 Mission D. This stealthy attacker provides great synergies with squads that can apply multiple debuffs to enemy units and take advantage of his “Silent Strike” ability which dispels both debuffs and buffs from the enemy target and Geonosian Spy but deals increasing damage for each effect removed. Additionally, his unique passive “Illicit Insect” gives him increased turn meter every time a Geonosian ally inflicts a negative status effect, ensuring that the Geonosian Spy can take advantage of weakened enemies.\n\nBe sure to add this cunning attacker to your collection and takedown your enemies one negative status effect at a time!
NEWSLETTER_GEONOSIAN_SPY_MISSION_TITLE: Geonosian Spy is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 4 Mission D!
NEWSLETTER_GEONOSIANS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The Geonosians are emerging from the hive with all-new tactics! [c][F0FF23]Sun Fac[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Poggle the Lesser[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Spy[-][/c], and [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Soldier[-][/c] have all been reworked to make use of the Hive Mind buff and are ready to join forces in battle.

Each Geonosian has received some big changes to their kit, and while under the influence of Hive Mind, they gain even more deadly effects. With the [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Brood Alpha[-][/c] in the Leader slot, this squad really takes flight, attacking with a persistent swarm of assists while applying a whole host of debuffs to the enemy. This squad has evolved to a whole new level, and they're ready to take on brutal opponents in the Petranaki arena.

Find the full list of changes on the Official Forum. See you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_GL_REQ_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The final requirements have been revealed for Galactic Legends [c][f0ff23]Supreme Leader Kylo Ren[-][/c] and [c][f0ff23]Rey[-][/c]! Head over to the Journey Guide to find out which characters and what gear you'll need to start unlocking either of these Galactic Legends as soon as they are available. Stay tuned to the official forums for the announcement of when both Galactic Legends events will begin.

See you on the holotables!

NEWSLETTER_GRAND_ARENA_CHAMPIONSHIPS_DES:
Grand Arena Championships are beginning next week with the exhibition Championship! Compete with other Holotable Heroes and see your progress on the first-ever global leaderboards for individual players in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes. We'll finally be able to answer the question: "Do you have what it takes to be the greatest in the galaxy?"

Reach higher Leagues in Championships by defeating opponents in Grand Arena and completing Feats. Feats are unique time-sensitive challenges that reward you for going above and beyond, and they're a great way to progress to new Leagues.

At the end of each Championship, you'll be able to receive your rewards, review your progress, and prepare for the next one. Your League icon – and of course, bragging rights – remains until the start of the next Championship. Then it resets and you can try again for an even higher position!

or the full details on Championships, visit the forums.

With the release of Grand Arena Championships, we're also adding the last slot of Gear XII pieces so you can upgrade your characters to Gear XIII. For the full details on Championships and Gear XII finishers, visit the forums.

Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nReady your best squads and prepare to battle for glory, Grand Arena Championships returns on 10/2/2019! In Grand Arena Championships, players compete in several Grand Arena events over the course of multiple weeks to climb the ranks and earn awesome prizes. Face off against players with a similar roster and skill to be the best in the galaxy! Is your team strong enough to become the next Champion?
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_ARENA_DESC:
Get ready for some serious competition: Grand Arena is here! For the first time, Level 85 players across the game are paired in a 1-on-1 competition that is the ultimate test of skill.

-Use your collection of characters and ships to battle against a player with a similar collection

-Compete to win the most rounds in the event

-Earn Portraits for accomplishing great feats like Prestigious Quests

-Change your Squad Arena payout time twice a year
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_MOFF_TARKIN_DESC: Greetings, \n\nGrand Moff Tarkin is now available in the Arena Store. Strengthen your Empire squad and dominate the holotables with this powerful Support character.
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_MOFF_TARKIN_TITLE: Grand Moff Tarkin now available in the Arena Store
NEWSLETTER_GRANDMASTERS_TRAINING_DESC:
Do you have what it takes to train against a Jedi Grand Master?

Add Grand Master Yoda to your collection through completing some of his trials.

Raise him to Seven Stars through besting them all.

Try it now!
NEWSLETTER_GREEF_CARA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Two new arrivals have showed up in the cantina and they look like they must be from the Outer Rim!

First up is [c][F0FF23]Cara Dune[-][/c], a veteran Rebel Shock Trooper who has reinvented herself as a mercenary since leaving military life behind. This tough, no-nonsense brawler hasn’t forgotten how to fight an enemy like the Empire and can be difficult to take down in battle. While Cara can find a place as a deadly ambusher on a Scoundrel squad, she’s equally at-home under a Rebel leader, defending her allies as a front-line combatant.

Also joining the Holotables is [c][F0FF23]Greef Karga[-][/c], a notorious scoundrel and the go-to-guy for connecting Bounty Hunters with clients on Nevarro. Greef is always trying to spot the most lucrative solution to whatever predicament he finds himself in, and his abilities reflect this. He prefers to hang back while other Bounty Hunters work to achieve their Payouts and he supports the squad with mass assist calls and frequent recovery of Health and Protection.

See you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_GREEF_CARA_TITLE: Some Of My Favorite People Are Bounty Hunters

From now until April 24, WWF will receive 100% of the proceeds from your Ewok bundle purchases. Head to the store now to see these bundles being offered. \n\nIf you would like more information on how your purchase will help our planet please visit: http://appstore.com/appsforearth
NEWSLETTER_GREEN_LANTERN_02_DESC: The time to save the Forest Moon of Endor is now! Form a squad of at least three Ewoks to battle the forces of the Empire. \n\nFinishing the event each day will award you with various prizes, such as additional character Shards for your Ewoks.
NEWSLETTER_GRIEVOUS_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC:
Greetings Heroes,

The feared Jedi hunter General Grievous is now available in the Shard Shop!

General Grievous is an Attacker who is at his best when leading a squad of Droids. His unique abilities lower the health of enemies or boost his own maximum health for each living Droid ally.

Will you be among the first to form a powerful Droid squad led by General Grievous to hunt down the Jedi?
NEWSLETTER_GRIEVOUS_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE: General Grievous available in the Shard Shop
NEWSLETTER_GUILD_BANK_CURRENCY_CAP_DESC:
A new cap has been placed on the total amount of Guild Bank Coins that can be earned each day. The new cap is 30,000 Guild Bank Coins earned by a guild per day. Once the cap has been reached, any additional Guild Bank Coins earned by players that day will not be counted.

The new cap will still allow Guilds with a full roster of 50 to have each of their members contribute their full energy contribution each day (600/600).

The cap will reset every 24 hours.
NEWSLETTER_GUILD_BANK_CURRENCY_CAP_TITLE: New Cap: Daily Earned Guild Bank Coins
NEWSLETTER_HAN_ACTIVATED_DESC:
Congratulations to Yukikase! The first player in the world to unlock Han Solo from the Heroic Guild Raid. This smuggler turned Rebel hero was one of the great leaders of the Rebel Alliance. 

Han Solo is a hard hitting critical attacker that always shoots first. Han’s unique ability gives him a free attack at the start of combat that stuns his target before any other unit can take an action. Capable of buffing his entire team with his lucky nature (Critical Chance Up), dealing extra damage to slower enemies, and his unique shoot first ability, Han Solo is capable of turning the tide of battle from the very first shot. 

Join Yukikase in adding this Rebel hero to your Squad by defeating the Heroic Rancor Raid to collect his shards!
NEWSLETTER_HAN_ACTIVATED_TITLE: Congratulations Yukikase! First to Unlock Han Solo!
NEWSLETTER_HAN_SOLO_DESC:
Greetings,

Han Solo, one of the most iconic characters in the galaxy, is now available! Collect shards for this hero by clearing The Pit on Heroic tier. 

Han Solo's abilities will be hidden until the first player activates him. The first player to activate Han Solo will have their name featured prominently in an announcement for all players to see. 

Will you be the first to activate Han Solo? Is your Guild ready to defeat the Rancor on Heroic tier?
NEWSLETTER_HANS_MILLENNIUM_FALCON_DESC: She may not look like much, but you would be hard-pressed to find a more legendary ship than Han’s Millennium Falcon, which has eluded Star Destroyers, bested Darth Vader, and destroyed a Death Star -- all with a somewhat unpredictable hyperdrive. On the holotables, the Falcon is a Rebel Attacker that strengthens Home One and the Rebel fleet as a whole by enabling relentless assist calls. Piloted by Han Solo and Chewbacca, the Falcon also [c][F0FF23]Outmaneuvers[-][/c] its enemies with extra Evasion, and can't be targeted while other allies are present.
NEWSLETTER_HERO_REY_DESC:
Rey (Jedi Training) is arriving soon in Galaxy of Heroes! This Resistance hero is embarking on a journey that will change both her and the Galaxy. Rey (Jedi Training) enables many new strategies and is a powerful addition to any roster of heroes. Her powerful and devastating abilities synergize well with Resistance members, but can be used in many different squads.

This Resistance Hero will unlock through the Hero's Journey event as a Seven Star character. To unlock Rey (Jedi Training), players will require a Seven Star Rey (Scavenger), Finn, Veteran Smuggler Han Solo, Veteran Smuggler Chewbacca, AND BB-8. In celebration of the Hero's Journey event, we've brought back BB-8's Legendary Event.

We've updated BB-8's Legendary Event to include a new, additional event - the Mythic Event! Upon completing the Legendary "Pieces and Plans" Event, the Mythic "Pieces and Plans" Event will open to players and run for two days during the course of the Legendary Event. In the Mythic version, players will be able to replay the original Legendary Event final tier, play a new, more difficult tier where they can take any characters in, and a third tier that reverses the encounter! Best of all, the new Mythic Event is recurring - meaning everytime the Legendary Event returns, so does the Mythic Event.
NEWSLETTER_HERO_REY_TITLE: Rey's Hero's Journey and Introducing the Mythic Event
NEWSLETTER_HEROES_HOLIDAY_DESC: Celebrate the holidays with EA’s Star Wars games by joining the new Heroes Holiday community event! During our first ever community event, all eligible players must defeat Boba Fett in the Training Droid Challenge an average of two times per day on Sunday, Monday, and Thursday between Dec 23rd and January 1st. If our community can complete this challenge, all players will be given 10 shards for Rey! Are you ready to battle Boba Fett? Let the contest begin! More details available in the forums.

NEWSLETTER_HOLIDAY_BONUS_CRYSTALS_2021_T: Holiday Special on select Crystal Bundles!
NEWSLETTER_HOLIDAY_BONUS_CRYSTALS_DESC: Special, limited Crystal offers are available now! Welcome the holidays with bonus Crystals on select Crystal Bundles in the store! For a limited time, you can gain a one-time 25% bonus on the Chest of Crystals and Box of Crystals! NEWSLETTER_HOLIDAY_BONUS_CRYSTALS_TITLE: Holiday Special! Up to 40% Bonus Crystals on Select Crystal Bundles!
NEWSLETTER_HOLIDAY_CRYSTAL_EVENT_DESC:
Greetings!

The Holiday Crystal event has started! 

For a limited time, get 25% more Crystals on select crystal packs in the store. 

Limited one time purchase. Head to the Store now!
NEWSLETTER_HONOR_GUARD_ZEB_DESC:
Karabast! Pirates are attacking Chopper Base and Zeb needs your squad's help to defend it in this limited-time Event.

Garazeb Orrelios, or Zeb for short, buffs his allies by providing Tenacity Up and attacks his foes with his Bash and Staggering Sweep abilities. Under the lead of Hera Syndulla, Zeb grants the Shrug Off ability to all members of Phoenix Squadron allowing them to recover Protection at the start of their turn.

Add this powerful Lasat to your collection by participating in the Honor Guard Event this month!
NEWSLETTER_HUNTER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes!

The commanding officer of Clone Force 99 has joined the Holotables! The clone nicknamed [c][F0FF23]Hunter[-][/c] leads the elite but unconventional squad known as the [c][F0FF23]Bad Batch[-][/c] for the Grand Army of The Republic.

Hunter can lead a squad of Clone Troopers but doesn't usually work with the “regs” and prefers to have his Bad Batch allies at his side. He has chosen a different path compared to other clones and prefers covert tactics. Hunter ambushes his foes with [c][F0FF23]Shrouded Approach[-][/c], an ability that allows him and his Clone Trooper allies to gain Stealth while allies with the new Bad Batch faction tag also gain Critical Chance Up and Offense Up. Under Hunter’s leadership, Bad Batch allies have increased Max Health, Max Protection, and Potency and can take down those pesky clankers or Separatist enemies with ruthless efficiency.

Unlock Hunter in the all new Marquee event: [c][F0FF23]Clone Force 99 I[-][/c]
NEWSLETTER_HUNTER_TITLE: Maps can be wrong. Hunter never is.
NEWSLETTER_HYPERDRIVE_BUNDLE_SALE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

For the first time ever the Hyperdrive Bundle is on sale for 50% off! Starting November 17th, celebrate the 50th anniversary of LucasFilm and get this huge bundle at a discount. The Hyperdrive bundle unlocks a massive stockpile of Core gear, Ability Material, Currencies, Energy, as well as unlock 65 characters and 13 ships at 5 stars.

Don't miss out on this amazing offer; the Hyperdrive Bundle is only on sale until November 24th.
NEWSLETTER_HYPERDRIVE_BUNDLE_SALE_TITLE: Hyperdrive Bundle - 50% Off For A Limited Time
NEWSLETTER_IDEN_VERSIO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Iden Versio[-][/c], the tenacious Imperial pilot who escaped the destruction of the Death Star during the Battle of Yavin, is landing on the holotables! A cunning mission planner, Iden was installed as the Commander of Inferno Squad and went to great lengths in her attempts to crush the Rebel Alliance.

Iden Versio is more than capable of calling the shots during battle, as evidenced by the fact her abilities often rely on the exclusion of other leaders in her squad. Iden strengthens Imperial Troopers, especially in Grand Arenas where her Omicron ability increases Imperial Trooper Health and Protection, and allows them to recover Health, Protection, and gain Turn Meter when enemy's attack out of turn. Iden also brings the new buff, [c][F0FF23]We Adapt, Or Die[-][/c], to the holotables, which can grant allies boosts to their Critical Chance, Offense, and Speed, as well as a self revive should the buffed ally be defeated. Iden’s resilience is also worth noting, given she revives with full Health and Protection if there is another active Imperial Trooper ally when she is defeated.

Unlock Iden Versio, the fan-favorite [i]Star Wars Battlefront II[/i] protagonist, by playing the all-new [c][F0FF23][i]Embers of the Empire[/i][-][/c] Marquee Event, and make today the day “the Rebellion dies!”
NEWSLETTER_IDEN_VERSIO_TITLE: They Have Hope. We Have Me.
NEWSLETTER_IG11_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]IG-11[-][/c], the former assassin droid-turned-nurse, is coming to the holotables! As a nanny who takes a different approach to “tough love,” IG-11 is a steadfast protector of the Child and trusted colleague to Kuiil.

In addition to having a pack filled with ridiculously cute cargo, IG-11 brings some nursing skills to battle by granting allies additional Max Health. He also serves as a protector by Taunting and stealing the enemy's health to keep his allies safe. IG-11 adds even more utility to Droids and Scoundrels, as he assists during their turns and dispels debuffs.

Take IG-11 for a spin after unlocking him via Galactic Challenges!
NEWSLETTER_IMPERIAL_TIE_BOMBER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The [c][F0FF23]Imperial TIE Bomber[-][/c] is making its way to the Holotables, ready to enforce the Empire's will on those who dare to rebel. Often serving in the first line of attack, TIE bombers drop vast quantities of munitions, delivering devastating attacks with frightening accuracy.

Although the TIE bomber is the first ship in Galaxy of Heroes to apply [c][F0FF23]Burning[-][/c], its main strength lies in being a defensive stalwart for Imperial factions. Crippling the enemy's offense and exhibiting bravado by taunting is all in a day's work as these crewless ships seek glory for the Empire. Add the TIE bomber to your fleet and show those Rebel scum the Empire will not tolerate insubordination.

Join the [c][F0FF23]Galactic Chase[-][/c] for the Imperial TIE Bomber and earn blueprints as a bonus reward on all [c][F0FF23]Cantina Battles[-][/c] nodes for a limited time starting June 4th!
NEWSLETTER_JANGO_FETT_DESC:
Master assassin, father of Boba Fett, and one of the galaxy’s best Bounty Hunters, Jango Fett has joined the Holotables! Jango is a strong leader for any Bounty Hunter squad with his powerful attacks and amazing buffs for your entire team. Complete Jango’s Contract to give all allied Bounty Hunters an incredible buff: [c][f0ff23]BOUNTY HUNTER’S RESOLVE[-][/c] will revive your Bounty Hunters when they are defeated and allow them to ignore Taunt.

Cad Bane received a rework recently and now he’s getting his modified Rogue-class starfighter, Xanadu Blood! This stealthy support ship uses [c][f0ff23]BREACH[-][/c] to weaken its foes while protecting its allies. Form the ultimate Bounty Hunter fleet with Xanadu Blood, Slave I and the Hound’s Tooth.

There was another Bounty Hunter still looking for a Contract out in the galaxy, and she’s found it. The shapeshifter Zam Wesell has a few new tricks up her sleeve and maybe even a Thermal Detonator or two. Zam’s explosive new reworked kit means she loves to team up with anyone that can lob more detonators in the enemy squad’s direction. In addition, all characters that use Thermal Detonators received an upgrade: All Thermal Detonators can no longer be dispelled!
NEWSLETTER_JANGO_FETT_TITLE: Any Job for the Right Price
NEWSLETTER_JAPAN_GACHA_PACK_MESSAGE: Head to the store now for a [c][f0ff23]LIMITED TIME[-][/c] Jedi pack offer including a guaranteed Jedi character, Crystals, Credits, and XP materials!
NEWSLETTER_JAPAN_GACHA_PACK_TITLE: Prepare for Yoda with the new Jedi Pack!
NEWSLETTER_JAPAN_GACHA_PACK_TITLEV2: Make your characters more powerful with the new Embersteel pack!
NEWSLETTER_JAWA_ENGINEER_DESC:
Greetings, 

A new character is now available in Guild Store, Jawa Engineer. This unit is a high-speed Healer with a Critical Chance buff for both Jawas and Droids. 

Will you add this Jawa to your squad to form the ultimate Droid and Jawa synergy?
NEWSLETTER_JAWA_SCAVENGER_CHIEF_NEBIT_DE:
Chief Nebit and Jawa Scavenger are now available in Arena Shipments and Cantina Shipments, respectively.

Chief Nebit is a Jawa Tank and a natural choice for Jawa and Droid squads, granting them additional Critical Chance and the ability to lower the Critical Chance of their targets. His cunning also gives him the ability to call his allies to assist his attacks, grant stealth to his allies, and reduce their cooldowns. This synergy gives a great advantage to any Jawa or Droid in his squad.

Jawa Scavenger is a versatile Support who can inflict a variety of status effects on his enemies and buff his allies. Utilizing his ability, “Scrap Bomb”, Jawa Scavenger is able to detonate all Thermal Detonators and debuff affected enemies making them easy targets for his squad mates. In addition his unique ability, “Salvaged Equipment”, randomly grants Offense Up and Defense Up to his allies whenever he is stealthed.

Complete your Jawa party with these two desert dwellers!
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_LUKE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Despite his humble beginnings as a Tatooine moisture farmer making runs to Tosche Station for power converters, we always knew [c][F0FF23]Luke Skywalker[-][/c] was destined for greater things. His victory over Jabba the Hutt was a mere hint at the strong bond Luke shared with the Force as a [c][F0FF23]Jedi Knight[-][/c], a lesson the Empire would later learn firsthand during the Battle of Endor. Luke's leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Return of the Jedi[-][/c], helps to restore balance to the Force by granting bonuses and dispelling negative effects from allies, while also setting all enemies to his base Speed.

Unlock [c][F0FF23]Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker[-][/c] by participating in the all new "[c][F0FF23]The Journey Continues - Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker[-][/c]" event.
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_LUKE_REHEAT_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nJedi Knight Luke has been added to the Journey Guide and his event, The Journey Continues is back for a limited time! His quiet upbringing on Tatooine belied his destiny to become a Jedi Master but Luke faced many challenges as a Jedi Knight that shaped his connection with the Force. Feel like you could take on the whole empire by yourself? Unlock Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker and get ready for Galactic Legend, Jedi Master Luke Skywalker!
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_LUKE_REHEAT_TITLE: Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker Joins the Journey Guide
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_MASTER_OBI_WAN_EVENT_DES:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Jedi Master Kenobi[-][/c] has joined the holotables!

Brimming with references to iconic Revenge of the Sith moments, Galactic Legend Jedi Master Kenobi has a kit that is as powerful as it is reverent to Episode III. Health and Protection recovery, Defense Penetration, Foresight, and Mastery, along with Speed and Health increases for allies are just the tip of the lightsaber. In addition to Galactic Republic characters, he also acts as a robust leader when paired with Light Side Unaligned Force Users.

When it comes to the opposition, Jedi Master Kenobi inflicts enemies with [c][F0FF23]Vulnerable[-][/c] and calls allies to assist, showcasing the intelligence and camaraderie he regularly displayed during battle.

Worthy of both the Jedi Master and Galactic Legend titles, if you’re not excited for this version of Obi-Wan, “then, you are lost!”
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_TRAINING_AAYLA_SECURA_DE: Gather up your party and prepare for a special 7-day Event to earn Jedi shards! This limited time event will be available at levels 55, 65 and 75 and will have you overcome 4 different battles to earn both credits and shards of members of the Jedi Order. \n\nMake sure your squad is ready for the return of the Grand Master's Training event by completing this week’s limited time event!
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_TRAINING_KIT_FISTO_DESC: The Force Champions event continues with 4 different battles and more shards! Available at levels 55, 65 and 75 this limited time event gives you another chance to add and power-up the Jedi in your collection!\n\nKeep adding and powering up these guardians of peace and justice so that you're prepared for the return of the Grand Master Yoda Event!
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_TRAINING_MACE_WINDU_DESC: The last Force Champions event before the return of Grand Master Yoda is here! Available at levels 55, 65 and 75. This is your chance to triumph in 4 different battles to earn both credits and Jedi shards!\n\nMake sure your Jedi squad is ready for Grand Master Yoda’s return by completing this week’s limited time event and powering up your Jedi characters!
NEWSLETTER_JG_DARTH_MALAK_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Darth Malak's event, [c][f0ff23]Star Forge Showdown[-][/c], is now permanently playable in the Journey Guide for players who meet the requirements.

Darth Malak is a powerful Sith tank who uses Force Lightning to torture his enemies and drains their life in order to sustain himself. He tracked down the Star Forge under the orders of the Sith Emperor and eventually usurped the title of Dark Lord of the Sith from Revan, his old friend and Sith Master.

Head over to the Journey Guide to find out which characters and what gear you'll need to unlock his event.

See you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_JG_DARTH_MALAK_TITLE: Darth Malak now in the Journey Guide!
NEWSLETTER_JOURNEY_GUIDE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Unsure how to unlock the greatest heroes and villains in the galaxy? The [c][F0FF23]Journey Guide[-][/c] is here to help - and it's available now! As part of this update, all existing Legendary, Journey, and Ancient Journey events have moved into the Journey Guide and are now replayable. Future versions of these events, as well as Epic Confrontations, will move into the Journey Guide sometime after their initial release. That means you can try many of these exciting events right now or any time you are ready!

The Journey Guide also reveals the newest type of character to the holotables: [c][F0FF23]Galactic Legends[-][/c]. The Galactic Legend designation will be reserved for the most famous and powerful characters in the galaxy, and the Journey Guide will be your path to unlocking them in future releases.

Speaking of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, the holotables have received some nefarious reinforcements in preparation for the conclusion of the Skywalker saga. The new [c][F0FF23]Sith Trooper[-][/c] is a powerful attacker with both Sith and First Order faction synergies. Alongside the Sith Trooper, [c][F0FF23]General Hux[-][/c] is also coming to the holotable. Both these new units heavily utilize Advantage and can quickly turn the tide of battle by bombarding the enemy with critical hits. General Hux can use Advantage to trigger a variety of beneficial effects for First Order allies, but watch out for his new Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Dominance[-][/c], which stops his foes from counter-attacking while boosting the counter chance for his allies.

Earn these units in upcoming marquee events starting soon!
NEWSLETTER_JOURNEY_GUIDE_UPDATE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The Journey Guide has been updated with a streamlined experience and a brand new look! The Ships and Characters buttons have been combined into a single Collections button and you can now access the Journey Guide directly from the Cantina screen.

We have reorganized the Journey Guide into a gallery sorted by types of events and tiers of difficulty. Now you can quickly access all of the relevant information you need to unlock an exciting new character or ship. All requirements for each tier and the rewards are front and center so you can easily find what you need to complete your next battle.

In addition, there is a new option in the Journey Guide called [i]Begin Journey[/i] for each unit that will assist you in tracking its requirements. Once selected, you can find all the units needed for the entire event in a tab on the Collections screen and the units and gear required for the next step of the journey are clearly marked throughout the game with new icons.

We hope you enjoy the new streamlined Journey Guide experience! See you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_JYN_ERSO_PVP_TOURNAMENT_DESC:
Rogue One's JYN ERSO has arrived, available as a reward in the new HERO OF THE REBELLION Squad Tournament! This tournament will take place on December 17th. You will need to be at least level 30 to have a chance to compete and win this iconic character.

Jyn Erso is a Rebel Attacker eager to bring the fight to the Empire. Her “Into the Fray” ability gives Rebel allies a Potency buff from the start of the encounter, with a chance to also inflict Expose whenever they inflict a debuff on enemies and recovering some Protection when they gain buffs. Not content to fight from the sidelines, Jyn leads from the front with her “Press the Attack” ability which deals damage to her enemy with a chance of giving her Advantage for 2 turns. If she finds her squad under fire, Jyn is also capable of utilizing a unique “Rebel Counterattack” ability, dealing AOE damage to her enemies, reviving a random Rebel ally, granting full Turn Meter to an ally of her choice!

Dominate the leaderboard in the Hero of the Rebellion tournament on December 17th to add Jyn Erso to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_JYN_ERSO_PVP_TOURNAMENT_TITLE: HERO OF THE REBELLION Squad Tournament with Rogue One’s JYN ERSO!
NEWSLETTER_JYN_ERSO_PVP_TOURNAMENT02_DES:
The Hero of the Rebellion Squad Tournament returns next week! You will need to be at least level 30 to have a chance to compete and earn shards for Rogue One's JYN ERSO.

Jyn Erso is a Rebel Attacker eager to bring the fight to the Empire. Her “Into the Fray” ability gives Rebel allies a Potency buff from the start of the encounter, with a chance to also inflict Expose whenever they inflict a debuff on enemies and recovering some Protection when they gain buffs.

Not content to fight from the sidelines, Jyn leads from the front with her “Press the Attack” ability which deals damage to her enemy with a chance of giving her Advantage for 2 turns. If she finds her squad under fire, Jyn is also capable of utilizing a unique “Rebel Counterattack” ability, dealing AOE damage to her enemies, reviving a random Rebel ally, granting full Turn Meter to an ally of her choice!n
Dominate the leaderboard in the Hero of the Rebellion tournament and add Jyn Erso to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_JYN_ERSO_PVP_TOURNAMENT02_TIT: HERO OF THE REBELLION Squad Tournament returns next week!
NEWSLETTER_K2SO_DESC:
A Limited Time, Google Play Exclusive!
A reprogrammed Imperial security Droid turned Rebel agent, K-2SO is FREE to Google players! Collect him from the [i]Rogue One Heroes[/i] pack in the Store.

K-2SO is a Rebel tank capable of Dazing and Taunting his enemies while having a chance to counter attack whenever he takes damage. Assigned to Cassian Andor for several missions, he can also provide extra synergy if paired in the same squad, calling on Cassian to assist him with his Conductive Charge ability.

Head to the Store to collect your FREE K-2SO and participate in the limited time Event, ESCAPE FROM JEDHA to earn shards and level him up!
NEWSLETTER_K2SO_TITLE: Rogue One’s K-2SO is now available EXCLUSIVELY ON GOOGLE PLAY!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_FISTO_CANTINA_MISSION_MES: Kit Fisto is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 4 Mission F! This Nautolan Jedi is a versatile attacker with a multi-attack, great counters and the ability to buff an entire team with Potency Up.\n\nWill you add this Jedi Master to your collection?
NEWSLETTER_KIT_FISTO_CANTINA_MISSION_TIT: Kit Fisto is now available in Cantina Battles!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_01_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Rose Tico and Captain Phasma have been updated with Omicron Ability tiers! Both characters have a new tier added to one of their abilities that will boost their effectiveness in a specific game mode. The new top tier of each of these abilities will require the new Omicron material to unlock.

Rose Tico's Unique, [c][F0FF23]Valiant Spirit[-][/c], has been updated with a new tier that enhances Resistance allies in Grand Arena Championships. While in Grand Arena, Valiant Spirit will not only boost Rose's Offense for each Exposed enemy but will also apply this effect to Resistance squad mates. In addition, all Resistance allies will gain Turn Meter whenever a Resistance ally scores a critical hit while in Grand Arena.

Captain Phasma now has a new tier added to her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Fire at Will[-][/c], which boosts First Order squads while in Territory Wars. In this mode, Fire at Will provides Health and Protection recovery when a First Order ally attacks out of turn and stacking Offense and Turn Meter whenever a First Order ally gains Advantage.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_01_TITLE: Omicron Additions for Rose Tico and Captain Phasma
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_02_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds a new mode specific Omicron ability tier to Rebel Officer Leia Organa and Chief Nebit!

Rebel Officer Leia Organa's new Omicron tier on her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Battlefront Command[-][/c], increases the effectiveness of Rebels in Territory Battles and particularly during longer multi-encounter battles. Under this improved Leader ability, Rebel allies fully recover Health and Protection at the start of each encounter and whenever a Rebel ally is defeated. In addition, all friendly Rebels gain their Rebel ally's Offense when a Rebel ally is defeated.

Watch out! He's holding a thermal detonator! The Jawa squad explodes on to the Territory Wars map with Chief Nebit's freshly updated Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Raiding Parties[-][/c]. In this mode, Jawas now dispel buffs whenever they deal damage to an enemy and inflicts Thermal Detonators for every buff dispelled. All those Thermal Detonator are really going to add up as Jawa allies recover Health and Protection, and gain Turn Meter whenever an enemy takes damage from a Thermal Detonator. When those Thermal Detonators explode, they also have a chance to apply another Thermal Detonator to keep the cycle going on and on!

Both of these Leader ability upgrades are now available for Omicron materials.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_02_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tiers for Rebel Officer Leia Organa and Chief Nebit
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_03_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to Qui-Gon Jinn and Zam Wesell!

Qui-Gon Jinn has a new Omicron tier added to his Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Agility Training[-][/c], which powers up Jedi allies while battling in Grand Arena Championships. Jedi allies will attack with incredible force in this mode as they gain up to 60 times their Speed as Offense! Additionally, Jedi allies fully recover their Health and Protection, and gain four times Qui-Gon's Offense when Qui-Gon Jinn is defeated while in Grand Arena.

Zam Wesell is also getting a boost in Grand Arena Championships with her upgraded Unique, [c][F0FF23]Shapeshifter[-][/c]. In Grand Arena battles, Zam will receive triple the stat bonuses from her Unique and provide Bounty Hunter allies with a portion of her Offense, Max Protection, Max Health, and Speed after those stats are increased.

Both of these new ability tiers are available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_03_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tiers for Qui-Gon Jinn and Zam Wesell
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_04_DESC:
Chief Chirpa has a new Omicron tier added to his Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Simple Tactics[-][/c], which bolsters Ewok allies while battling in Grand Arena Championships. Release the full furry frenzy of Endor as Ewok allies gain additional Speed, deal more damage with their Basic abilities, and have 100% chance to call an Ewok ally to assist when using a Special ability in this mode.

Darth Sidious and his fearsome squad of Sith are getting a boost in Territory Wars with his upgraded Unique, [c][F0FF23]Sadistic Glee[-][/c]. In Territory Wars, Darth Sidious' ability, [c][F0FF23]Demoralizing Blows[-][/c], is as disheartening as ever with a reduced cooldown based on the number of Sith allies and now provides 50 Speed to Darth Sidious for several turns. Additionally when paired with all Sith allies, friendly non-Galactic Legend Sith gain max Health based on Darth Sidious' Potency.

Both of these new ability tiers are available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_04_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tiers for Chief Chirpa and Darth Sidious
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_05_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to Imperial Probe Droid and Hera Syndulla!

Imperial Probe Droid has a new Omicron tier added to their Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Imperial Logistics[-][/c], which upgrades this self destructing droid in Territory Battles. With this upgrade, Imperial Probe Droid can be revived after using [c][F0FF23]Self-Destruct[-][/c], and revives at the start of each encounter while in this mode. The Self-Destruct ability is also more potent in Territory Battles and deals additional damage to the target enemy equal to 200% of Imperial Probe Droid's Max Health and other Empire allies gain Offense equal to 300% of Imperial Probe Droid's Offense.

Hera Syndulla and Phoenix allies will excel in Territory Wars under her upgraded Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Rise Together[-][/c]. When Hera uses [c][F0FF23]Backup Plan[-][/c] in Territory Wars, all Phoenix allies gain the Backup Plan buff and whenever a Phoenix ally uses a Special ability, all Phoenix allies gain additional stacking Offense. Additionally, Phoenix allies also gain increased counter chance, Max Health, and Speed while in Territory Wars.

Both of these new ability tiers are available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_05_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tiers for Imperial Probe Droid and Hera Syndulla
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_06_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to Carth Onasi!

Carth Onasi has a new Omicron tier added to their Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Soldier of the Old Republic[-][/c], which boosts Old Republic squads in Territory Battles. With this upgrade, Old Republic allies gain even more stats (Max Health, Defense, and counter chance) for each Old Republic ally while in Territory Battles. Additionally, whenever an Old Republic ally uses a Special ability, they inflict multiple Damage Over Time effects on their target and whenever an Old Republic ally attacks out of turn, they recover Health and Protection and gain stacking Offense until the end of the encounter.

This new ability tier for Carth Onasi is available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_06_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tier for Carth Onasi
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_07_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to Admiral Ackbar!

Admiral Ackbar has a new Omicron tier added to their Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Rebel Coordination[-][/c], which upgrades this daring Rebel leader in Grand Arena Championships. With this upgrade, all allies gain Tenacity Up at the start of battle in Grand Arenas. Additionally in Grand Arenas and if all allies are Rebel, allies gain Turn Meter whenever a buff expires, and all allies recover Health, call the other two weakest allies to assist, and reduce their cooldowns whenever an ally uses an ability that isn't an attack.

Admiral Ackbar's new ability tier is available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_07_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tier for Admiral Ackbar
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_08_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to Princess Leia!

Princess Leia has a new Omicron tier added to her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Against All Odds[-][/c], which powers up Rebel squads in Grand Arena Championships. Whenever Leia attacks in this mode, she has a chance to grant all Rebel allies Retribution and Tenacity Up while all other Rebel allies recover Health and Protection.

Princess Leia's new ability tier is available for upgrade with Omicron materials now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_08_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tier for Princess Leia
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_09_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Director Krennic has a new Omicron tier added to his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Immeasurable Power[-][/c], which powers up Krennic and Death Trooper in Grand Arena Championships. In this mode, Krennic gains additional Defense Penetration, Health, and Offense and shares these bonuses with Death Trooper. While Death Trooper is active, both Krennic and Death Trooper ignore Taunt and whenever Krennic attacks, Death Trooper's cooldowns are reduced and is called to assist.

Director Krennic's new ability tier is available for upgrade with Omicron materials now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_09_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tier for Director Krennic
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_10_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to the fierce bounty hunter, Embo!

Embo has a new Omicron tier added to his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Way of the Kyuzo[-][/c], which powers up Bounty Hunter squads in Territory Wars. While in this mode, Bounty Hunter allies gain additional Max Protection, and at the end of Embo's turn, Bounty Hunter allies recover Protection based on Embo's Max Protection. While Embo has Protection, Bounty Hunter allies gain additional Defense and Turn Meter whenever a Bounty Hunter ally receives damage while debuffed.

Embo's new ability tier is available for upgrade with Omicron materials now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_10_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tier for Embo
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_11_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to the feared beast of Hoth, [c][F0FF23]Wampa[-][/c]!

Wampa has a new Omicron tier added to his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Cornered Beast[-][/c], which powers up Wampa when deployed alone in Grand Arenas. While in this mode, if there are no other active allies at the start of battle, Wampa gains additional Defense, Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense, and double those bonuses instead if there is only one active enemy at the start of battle. Whenever Wampa is damaged by an attack, the attacking enemy is inflicted with Damage Over Time debuffs, and the cooldown of [c][F0FF23]Furious Foe[-][/c] is reduced.

Wampa's new ability tier is available for upgrade with Omicron materials now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_11_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tier for Wampa
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_12_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Mace Windu's kit has been updated with reworked abilities along with a new Special and Unique!

The debuff [c][F0FF23]Shatterpoint[-][/c] is the centerpiece of Mace’s updated kit. Attacking enemies with Shatterpoint reduces the target enemy's Attack, Defense, and Max Health for the rest of the encounter, and enables Mace to swap Turn Meter with Galactic Republic allies, stun his enemies, or recover his squad's Health and Protection depending on which ability he uses. This rework introduces a new buff, [c][F0FF23]Resilient Defense[-][/c], which works similarly to Taunt but only lasts for a certain number of attacks.

Mace also has a new Omicron ability tier which enables other Light Side allies to apply Speed Down and Shatterpoint to a random enemy while in Territory Wars. Additionally, in this mode all allies gain Turn Meter whenever an ally damages an enemy with Shatterpoint.

As part of this rework, we have returned all ability materials used to upgrade any of Mace Windu's abilities to your inbox.

See you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_12_TITLE: Mace Windu Rework and New Omicron Ability Tier
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_13_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]T3-M4[-][/c]’s kit!

T3-M4 has a new Omicron tier added to their [c][F0FF23]Master Gearhead[-][/c] Unique ability, which elevates the Droid faction by providing healing and Target Lock support in Territory Wars.

With the new Omicron ability unlocked, T3-M4 will gain Stealth for 2 turns at the start of the encounter. Droid allies will benefit from receiving increases to their Armor Penetration and Max Health as well as a boost to Defense while buffed and debuffed, and for each Target Locked enemy. At the start of T3-M4's turn a random enemy who does not already have Target Lock will be inflicted with it for two turns, which can't be evaded. Then, all allies recover some Health and Protection for each Target Locked enemy.

This new ability tier for T3-M4 is available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_13_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tier for T3-M4
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_14_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Jyn Erso’s[-][/c] kit and upgrades her Unique Zeta!

Jyn Erso has a new Omicron tier added to their [c][F0FF23]Fierce Determination[-][/c] Unique ability, which boosts Rogue One allies in Territory Wars.

With the new Omicron ability unlocked, Rogue One allies gain additional Max Health, Potency, and Speed and whenever a Rogue One ally's buff expires during an enemy's turn, Jyn gains Turn Meter. In addition, whenever Jyn critically hits an enemy and all allies were Rogue One at the start of battle, all allies recover Health and gain an additional bonus depending on their role while in this mode.

The Zeta tier of her Unique, [c][F0FF23]Fierce Determination[-][/c], has also received an update. Rogue One allies are immune to Buff Immunity in all modes with this upgrade!

This new ability tier for Jyn Erso is available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_14_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tier for Jyn Erso
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_15_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Luke Skywalker (Farmboy)'s[-][/c] kit! Luke Skywalker (Farmboy) has a new Omicron tier added to their [c][F0FF23]Draw a Bead[-][/c] Unique ability, which increases Defense, Max Health, and Tenacity in Territory Wars. Additionally at the start of each of his turns, Luke will be granted stacking Offense and Defense until the end of the encounter.

But wait, there’s more! When Luke is prevented from using an ability, he will recover a large amount of Health and Protection.

This new ability tier for Luke Skywalker (Farmboy) is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_15_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tier for Luke Skywalker (Farmboy)
NEWSLETTER_KRENNIC_AND_DEATH_TROOPER_DES:
Two new characters have arrived, DIRECTOR KRENNIC and the DEATH TROOPER! These powerful Imperial characters have great synergy together and are specialized in taking out Rebels.

Director Krennic is a potent support character that uses powerful debuffs against his foes, including the all-new debuff STAGGER! This debuff is inflicted using his DEATH TROOPER ASSAULT ability, and removes 100% turn meter when the Staggered enemy takes damage. When Director Krennic uses his EXPERIMENTAL WEAPONRY ability, he will inflict a different type of debuff on each type of character, such as stunning Attackers, inflicting ability block on Healers, and placing Buff Immunity on Tanks.

Death Trooper is a powerful attacker and the perfect addition to a squad with Director Krennic in it. Whenever the Death Trooper scores a critical hit, he and Director Krennic recover Health. The DEATH TROOPER'S GRENADE ability removes all buffs from enemies and inflicts healing immunity on them, punishing squads that rely on buffs. TERMINATE is the Death Trooper’s most powerful ability, guaranteeing a critical hit if the enemy has any debuffs on them and making them unable to be revived if defeated by it once upgraded.

Unlock both of these powerful new units in the all-new SPECIAL OPERATIONS Marquee Event!
NEWSLETTER_KRENNIC_AND_DEATH_TROOPER_TIT: NEW CHARACTERS - Director Krennic and Death Trooper
NEWSLETTER_KRENNIC_DEATHTROOPER_CHROMIUM: Director Krennic and Death Trooper are now available in Chromium Packs. Add these powerful Imperial characters to your collection today!\n\n*For a full list of the changing Chromium Characters, check out the SWGOH forum (https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com)
NEWSLETTER_KRENNIC_EVENT_DESC:
Get ready to earn shards for Director Krennic and one of his Death Troopers in an all-new limited time event!

Throughout this four phase event, you will have the chance to play with Director Krennic and his Death Trooper, and later battle against them. If you manage to defeat Krennic and his Death Troopers, you will be rewarded with a chance to unlock them both!

These Special Operation events each have multiple tiers of difficulty and will be available starting at Level 20. These events can only be completed once.
NEWSLETTER_KUIIL_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

One of the Galaxy’s most mechanically-inclined ugnaughts, [c][F0FF23]Kuiil[-][/c], is making his way to the holotables! Although Kuiil had worked for years to escape Imperial servitude to find solace on Arvala-7, fate came calling with other plans. Soon Kuiil found himself rescuing a Mandalorian, reprogramming a menacing IG unit, and protecting an adorable, tiny green creature.

Kuiil’s Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I Have Spoken[-][/c], introduces the new [c][F0FF23]Mechanic’s Savvy[-][/c] buff, which works with Scoundrels and Droids. Scoundrels will benefit from increased Critical Damage perks, while Light Side Droids receive increased Offense and revive capabilities. One Droid in particular, IG-11, will help Kuiil during battle by ensuring he can’t be critically hit or Stunned while they stand together in arms.

Adding Kuiil to your collection of heroes is easier than facing off with a feral blurrg. For the first time ever, you’ll be able to unlock a new character by heading over to the Galactic Challenges.
NEWSLETTER_KYLE_KATARN_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The Rebel Fighter and reluctant Jedi, [c][F0FF23]Kyle Katarn[-][/c], joins the holotables! Kyle Katarn always felt a connection to the Force during his time working as a covert Rebel agent. It took many years for Kyle to realize he was force-sensitive and, after facing down the Sith himself, he finally accepted his destiny of becoming a Jedi Knight. During battle, Kyle Katarn builds up his [c][F0FF23]Force Connection[-][/c] to gain a new buff, [c][F0FF23]Jedi Knight[-][/c], which grants his abilities additional effects and his allies increased Offense and Defense.

Kyle Katarn works well with Rebel Fighters or Jedi squads, and excels when used in Territory Battles. In this mode, his new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Force Influence[-][/c], which stops the enemy from counterattacking, assisting, or gaining buffs, can't be resisted.

While Kyle Katarn is not a leader himself, his unique, [c][F0FF23]Blue Milk Run[-][/c], powers up his Rebel Fighter allies and increase their Offense when they attack out of turn. While in Territory Battles, these bonuses and the bonuses from Jedi Knight are also extended to Jedi allies.

Confront the dark side and earn shards of Kyle Katarn in the all new Marquee event, Dark Forces!
NEWSLETTER_KYLE_KATARN_TITLE: This Should Be A Total Blue Milk Run
NEWSLETTER_KYLO_REN_UNIT_PROMO_DESC: Dominate the hologames with this First Order attacker character inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn Kylo's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
NEWSLETTER_LANDO_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC:
Greetings Heroes,

Shards for Lando Calrissian can now be obtained from Cantina Battles 1-E and 5-F.

We hope you all enjoy another way to collect Shards for Lando Calrissian!
NEWSLETTER_LANDO_L3_DESC:
To celebrate the release of the new film, Solo: A Star Wars Story, Young Lando Calrissian, L3-37 and Lando's Millennium Falcon join Young Han Solo, Vandor Chewbacca and Qi'ra on the Holotables! Power up these new units and complete the new Solo team.

Rounding out the [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] squad, Young Lando Calrissian and L3-37 bring their own spin to hustling the holotables. Young Lando deals more damage with his basic attack for each [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] ally. He can also grant his [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] buff to another ally while providing all other [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] allies with Speed Up. L3-37 can use [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] to gain stacking Max Health from her basic attack and can use [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] to grant health and protection to Scoundrel and Droid allies. L3-37 also brings her penchant for [c][F0FF23]Self-Modification[-][/c] to the table and can upgrade her Counter Chance, Critical Avoidance, and Defense over the course of battle.

Not only do these two new Scoundrels make excellent additions to the [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] squad, but they are also the crew for Lando's Millennium Falcon! This Millennium Falcon delivers a devastating new Reinforcement Ability to the holotable – when the Falcon enters combat it gains Critical Damage Up, copies all buffs on all other ships, and takes a turn for each reinforcement previously called! Collect and power up these all new characters in the final set of the Preparation Perfection Marquee event series!
NEWSLETTER_LANDO_L3_TITLE: Young Lando Calrissian, L3-37, and Lando's Millennium Falcon have arrived!
NEWSLETTER_LEVEL_CAP_INCREASE_80_DESC:
Greetings!

Are you once again ready to make your heroes stronger, faster and smarter than ever before? Let the training begin - the maximum level is being raised to level 80!

Have thoughts about the level cap increase? Share them in the forums.

Start training today to be the first player to reach level 80 and dominate the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_LEVEL_CAP_INCREASE_85_DESC:
Greetings!

Are you once again ready to make your heroes stronger, faster and smarter than ever before? Let the training begin - the maximum level is being raised to LEVEL 85!

Start training today to be the first player to reach level 85 and dominate the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_LEVEL_CAP_INCREASE_DESC:
Greetings!

Are you ready to make your heroes stronger, faster and smarter than ever before? Let the training begin - the maximum level is being raised to level 70!

Have thoughts about the level cap increase? Share them in the forums.

Start training today to be the first player to reach level 70 and dominate the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_LOGIN_CALENDAR_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Title Update brings a number of changes to Galaxy of Heroes! One of the first things you will notice is an update to something you see everyday when you login to the game, the [c][F0FF23]Login Calendar[-][/c]! We have reworked the Login Calendar with a new look and now additional calendars can be activated for extra daily rewards. These Login Calendars can be free or purchasable and may coincide with special occasions or monthly themes.

You can activate multiple at a time and gather rewards from each calendar every day. Don’t forget to login each day to collect your rewards!

Check out the other newsletters for the rest of the changes that were released with this Title Update.
NEWSLETTER_LORD_OF_HUNGER_DESC:
Introducing the "Lord of Hunger", a 4 part Event! In the first 3 Events, fight alongside Darth Nihilus, the Sith Empire Trooper, and the Sith Assassin. In the final Event, bring your best squad to fight against them.

The Events unlock at level 20 with four tiers of difficulty at 20, 40, 60, and 80. There are no restrictions on the characters you may put in your squad, so bring your most powerful characters to earn shards for Darth Nihilus, Sith Empire Trooper, and the Sith Assassin.

Do you have what it takes to defeat The Lord of Hunger and add him to your collection?
NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Lord Vader[-][/c] marches onto the Holotables! Having purged the weakness of Anakin Skywalker, the former Jedi is now the newest Lord of the Sith and apprentice to the vile Darth Sidious.

Rising from the ashes of the Republic, Lord Vader will provide the Empire faction with a dedicated Galactic Legend. With his anger fueling his attacks, Lord Vader is not to be underestimated. His Ultimate allows him to gain additional effects, ensures that enemies defeated during Lord Vader's turn can't be revived, and makes him immune to Ability Block.

In addition to increasingly more damaging attacks and massive synergy with both Empire and Dark Side Unaligned Force Users, Lord Vader can deal damage to all enemies while applying Daze and Damage Over Time. Lord Vader's attacks can't be evaded and he is immune to Turn Meter manipulation, all of which is just the beginning of his extensive and powerful kit. Cue the heavy breathing!

Obtain Lord Vader now through the all-new [c][F0FF23]Hero’s Fall[-][/c] event, which can be accessed via the Journey Guide. While it is the same structure as Jedi Master Kenobi’s Galactic Legend event, we feel the title “Hero's Fall” is only fitting for this event in contrast to the Hero's Journey events in our game.
NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_REQUIREMENTS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Lord Vader[-][/c] is coming to Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes! The first group of requirements to unlock Lord Vader's event have been added to the Journey Guide.

Lord Vader Requirements Group 1:

Hunter - Relic 5
Tech - Relic 5
Wrecker - Relic 5
Tusken Raider - Relic 5
Padmé Amidala - Relic 8

Lord Vader Requirements Group 3 Sneak Peak:

General Skywalker - Relic 8
NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_REQUIREMENTS_TITLE: Galactic Legend Lord Vader's 1st Requirements Added To The Journey Guide
NEWSLETTER_LUKE_FLASH_EVENT_DESC: The month of May sees the introduction of our new Flash Events! Unlike other events, Flash Events only last one to four hours in each instance and repeat several times a day, so be sure to catch them when they launch! Flash Events difficulty and rewards are based off your account level. All initial runs of a Flash Event have more generous rewards, so be sure to participate early and often!\n\nOur first Flash Event takes you to the harsh desert planet of Tatooine. This lawless world holds many dangers and mysteries, especially for moisture farmers. To participate in this multi-tiered event, task Luke Skywalker with inspecting the perimeter of the farm as you join forces with Jawas to square off against marauding Tusken Raiders.
NEWSLETTER_MAGMATROOPER_ANNOUNCEMENT_DES:
Greetings Heroes,

The daily login and brand new character for March is the Magmatrooper from Star Wars Battlefront! Log in each day this month in order to obtain enough Shards to unlock him.

Be sure to play with your sound on when you have the Magmatrooper in your squad to hear the sound of his Thermal Imploder ability!
NEWSLETTER_MAGMATROOPER_ANNOUNCEMENT_TIT: Daily Login Character for March: Magmatrooper
NEWSLETTER_MAGMATROOPER_SHIPMENT_DESC: Greetings Heroes,\n\nThe Magmatrooper from Star Wars Battlefront is now available in Galatic War Shipments! We hope you all enjoy another way to collect Shards for Magmatrooper!
NEWSLETTER_MANDO_BESKAR_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)[-][/c] is heading to the Holotables in spectacular, shiny fashion! From his meek beginnings as a foundling to his transformation into a fully Beskar-clad protector of the Child, Din Djarin embodies the toughness required to survive in the frontier of the Outer Rim. Whether they’re brought in warm or brought in cold, The Mandalorian always delivers his bounty.

Equipped with [c][F0FF23]Whistling Birds[-][/c], The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) is prepared to lead Scoundrels into battle, while adding survivability to the faction by dispelling debuffs and equalizing Protection. His immunity to Ability Block and some help from a little, adorable friend add to an already impressive array at Mando’s disposal.

Unlock The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) by heading to his Hero’s Journey, immediately and permanently available in the Journey Guide now!

This is the way.
NEWSLETTER_MANDO_DESC: Known to many as [c][F0FF23]the Mandalorian[-][/c], this mysterious man of few words works as a Bounty Hunter at the far edge of the galaxy. No one really knows where he came from or how he's so well-equipped for battle but few question his ability to bring in a target. Whether taking a [c][F0FF23]Swift Shot[-][/c] with his blaster pistol or readying his Amban sniper rifle to instantly disintegrate his enemy, the Mandalorian is always prepared to take on whatever gets in his way.\n\nUnlock the Mandalorian this week in the new event, [c][F0FF23]Tales From The Outer Rim[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_MANDO_TITLE: Bounty Hunting Is A Complicated Profession
NEWSLETTER_MARA_JADE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

One of the most feared assassins of Legends, [c][F0FF23]Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand[-][/c], is storming the holotables! As the Emperor's Hand, Mara Jade carried out missions some may have viewed as impossible against Rebels and corrupt Imperials alike. Even when tasked with the assassination of Luke Skywalker, Mara Jade never backed down as she pursued her objective with fervor.

As an Unaligned Force User, Mara Jade strengthens the Empire faction, particularly in Territory Wars where her Omicron ability powers up an Emperor Palpatine-led squad. Utilizing Stealth and Turn Meter to her advantage, Mara Jade also inflicts a bevy of debuffs on enemies, such as Daze, Offense Down, Shock, Stagger, Stun, Tenacity Down, Vulnerable, and - fittingly - Blind on Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker. Like Darth Talon, Mara Jade also gains the [c][F0FF23]Loyal Hand[-][/c] effect, as well as introducing [c][F0FF23]Useful Pawn[-][/c], an effect that gives her increased Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and Offense at the cost of making some of her allies weaker.

Add this powerful fan-favorite character from Legends to your roster through the all-new “[c][F0FF23]By The Emperor’s Hand[-][/c]” Marquee event, and unleash the ultimate predator on your holotable foes!
NEWSLETTER_MARCH_TW_UPDATE_DESC:
It’s time for Geonosians to get some new unique abilities, and for the return of the Clone Troopers in the next Territory War!

Geonosians are hunkering down and bringing out the big guns. The passive, [c][f0ff23]Industry of War[-][/c], will help keep these bugs alive with extra Health and Protection but using Special abilities will decrease the cooldown of [c][f0ff23]Heavy Artillery[-][/c], an ability that can destroy even the strongest opponents with ease.

Clone Troopers are back with [c][f0ff23]Army of the Galactic Republic[-][/c], which boosts damage and survivability while also dispelling debuffs on other Clone Trooper allies.

Check out the forums for more details on these abilities and see you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_MAUL_CONQUEST7_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Conquest 7 returns with Maul from Season 7 of The Clone Wars! Turns out, [c][F0FF23]Maul[-][/c] didn’t die when a young Kenobi defeated him. He’s lost the title of Darth since he's no longer a Sith apprentice and thus also lost the Sith tag in-game. Maul is now an Unaligned Force User and will strengthen a number of Dark Side squads, but the real surprise here is that he has the Mandalorian tag! While not a Mandalorian by birth, his kit pays tribute to his time as the usurper of the throne of Mandalore. When Maul is in the Leader slot, he has the [c][F0FF23]Mand'alor[-][/c] status effect until he is defeated and then passes the mantle on to the character that defeated him.

Maul has had a rough time since we last saw him face off against Qui-Gon Jinn and is out for revenge. He has a new status effect called Anguish, which damages himself while boosting his Offense, enabling one of his abilities and providing additional effects. After all these years of rage and anguish, there is one thing Maul hates more than anything else: Kenooooobi! Maul gains extra stacks of Anguish whenever he faces off against any version of Kenobi in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes.

Reclaim your rightful place in the galaxy and earn Maul shards in the upcoming Conquest 7!
NEWSLETTER_MAY4_CRYSTAL_EVENT_DESC:
Greetings!

The May the Fourth Crystal Event has started! For a limited time, get 25% more Crystals on select crystal packs in the store. Limited one time purchase.

Bonus Crystal offer ends soon.
NEWSLETTER_MAY4TH_2020_DESC:
Star Wars Day 2020 is here and Galaxy of Heroes is getting ready to celebrate this occasion with our Holotable Heroes!

Later today you will be able to add the Princess Leia portrait and the title "Princess" to your profile to commemorate this event. We will also be sending you a gift in your inbox of Credits, Ship Building Materials, Character Shards, and Slicing and Relic materials. In addition, we have added several days of double drops on Mod Battles, Challenges and Normal Nodes to the calendar, along with Crystal promotions and new items in the store.

Thank you for another exciting year of Star Wars. We hope you enjoy the festivities and May the 4th be with you!
NEWSLETTER_MAY4TH_CRYSTALS_2019_DESC:
Greetings!

The May the 4th Crystal Event has started! For a limited time, get 25% more Crystals on select Crystal packs in the Store. Each of these packs is available for a one-time purchase.

This bonus Crystal offer ends soon.

NEWSLETTER_MESSAGE_DESC_KEY1: Be sure to take advantage of these limited time items
NEWSLETTER_MESSAGE_PROMOTE_EVENT_DESC_KE: Want to make your characters and ships more powerful? Go to the Keycard Battles page for this one day event to collect rare promotion materials! Promote materials upgrade your character's star rating!

NEWSLETTER_MESSAGE_TITLE_KEY1: New Shipments are Now Available in the Store
NEWSLETTER_MESSAGE_TRAINUP_EVENT_DESC_KE: Train your characters now for higher chances at 150% or 200% bonus XP!
NEWSLETTER_MISSION_ZAALBAR_DESC:
Mission Vao, the wisecracking street urchin, and Zaalbar, her exiled Wookiee companion, bonded together on the rough streets of Taris' lower city. Mission is a strong attacker that can [c][F0FF23]BLIND[-][/c] enemies, causing them to miss their next attack. "Big Z” can hold his own as a reliable tank while shredding the enemy team's defenses!

In addition to these Scoundrels, T3-M4 has rolled his way onto the holotable! This unique Droid brings his fellow droids some much needed support with healing and some powerful buffs.

T3-M4 and his Marquee event are available exclusively on Android for a limited-time! He will appear on all other platforms at a later date!

Finally, the Sith Assassin has taken to the skies with the new Sith fighter ship! The Sith fighter is an agile attacker that packs a serious punch and can tear through enemy defenses.
NEWSLETTER_MISSION_ZAALBAR_TITLE: Scoundrels and Droids, and Ships, Oh My!
NEWSLETTER_MODS_6_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

6-D through 6-A mods are available for slicing! Earn Mk II slicing materials from Galactic Challenges and upgrade your 6-E mods all the way up to 6-A! Use the new Mk II Pulse Modulator, Thermal Exchange Unit, Variable Resistor, and Microprocessor to enhance your best mods and bring your top squads to a whole new level. Check out the forums for a list of recipes for crafting 6-D through 6-A mods.

See you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_MODS_UPDATE_DESC:
Mods 2.0 is here! Whether you're a Mod expert or you’re confused about where to get started, this update will vastly improve your Mods game. We’ve added many quality of life improvements, upgraded some of less used Mod stats and introduced a new feature, Slicing!

Improve your best Mods even more with Slicing! Slicing increases the rarity or tier of a Mod and boosts their stats. Earn Slicing materials from the all new Stage 9 Mod Battles.

Finding great Mods for each character is quick and simple with the new Mod Recommendations tool. You can also search through your mods or swap them between characters more easily than ever thanks to Mod Loadouts, Advanced Filters, and Sorting.

All that and so much more! Find the full list of patch notes on the Official Forum
NEWSLETTER_MOFF_GIDEON_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Moff Gideon[-][/c] has arrived to impose his will on the Holotables! The formidable Moff, once an officer in the Imperial Security Bureau and now wielder of the legendary Mandalorian Darksaber, uses his unique talents to lead Imperial Troopers into battle.

Always tactical and looking for every advantage, Moff Gideon controls the battlefield by utilizing AoE attacks, Turn Meter manipulation, and applying both Daze and a new debuff that leaves his foes [c][F0FF23]Demoralized[-][/c].

With the Darksaber in hand, Moff Gideon turns his attention to chasing down the Child. Use his unrelenting focus and astute battlefield knowledge to lead your squad of Imperial Troopers onto the Holotables and bring glory to the Empire by unlocking Moff Gideon in an all-new Marquee event. Long live the Empire!
NEWSLETTER_MON_MOTHMA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Mon Mothma[-][/c], the Chancellor of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, is arriving on the Holotables! Mon Mothma's leadership and fearlessness propelled her to the top of the Empire’s “Most Wanted” list and served as an inspiration to all members of the Rebellion. Ever mindful of the consequences of war, but always willing to stand for justice, Mon Mothma is a welcome addition to Rebel squads as she uses the [c][F0FF23]Field Promotion[-][/c] ability to summon increasingly stronger Rebel units to battle.

Thankfully, many Bothans don’t have to die for you to add Mon Mothma to your band of Rebels. You can obtain this Rebel non-combatant leader by completing the new Marquee Event, [c][F0FF23]The Alliance Chancellor[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_NEST_DESC: To celebrate the release of the new Solo: A Star Wars Story film in theaters, Enfys Nest has arrived to the holotables! Use this powerful marauder to crush your enemies and scatter their squads.\n\nEnfys Nest is a new, powerful attacker that will bring powerful new offensive capabilities to your PvP squads. Nest has a penchant for using an enemy's defenses against them. Her basic attack, [c][f0ff23]Cut Through[-][/c], dispels all defensive buffs and [c][f0ff23]Sudden Impact[-][/c] will do extra damage if an enemy has any Protection. Always the opportunist, Nest's [c][f0ff23]Kinetite Charge[-][/c] will Daze her enemies and either boost Nest's Turn Meter or drain the enemy's based on their Health totals! Nest is also an elusive enemy, gaining stacking Protection for each hit she endures with her [c][f0ff23]Fighting Instinct[-][/c], while also stacking Critical Chance and Damage to turn the tables. This relentless warrior is an excellent addition to any Scoundrel squad!
NEWSLETTER_NIGHTSISTER_EVENTS_DESC:
This month three new Nightsister allies will join their dark sisters on the Holotable. Along with these new additions, the existing Nightsisters have received a faction rework.

Mother Talzin is a powerful Nightsister witch that brings new abilities to her coven. Her ability, [c][F0FF23]DARK MAGICK[-][/c], inflicts the new unique stacking debuff, [c][F0FF23]PLAGUE[-][/c]. This new debuff can only be removed with healing and inflicts percent health damage while preventing enemies from dispelling debuffs!

Additionally, the new Nightsister Spirit ability, [c][F0FF23]POSSESSION[-][/c], will dispel all buffs on an enemy and Stun them. The Nightsister Zombie gains Taunt at the end of each of her turns and revives if she is defeated while any other Nightsister allies are active.

Mother Talzin will be obtainable in her Marquee event, "The Rituals of Revenge". Players can also find shards of Mother Talzin in the "Defense of Dathomir" event; fight Separatist enemy forces with your Nightsister squad as you defend Dathomir! Finally, take your strongest units in the "Ghosts of Dathomir" event and investigate rumors of the Dathomir undead. In the "Ghosts of Dathomir" event, you can earn shards of the Nightsister Zombie and the Nightsister Spirit.

"Defense of Dathomir" and the "Ghosts of Dathomir" events will be rare, recurring Special Events - so play as much as you can, while you can!
NEWSLETTER_NIGHTSISTER_EVENTS_TITLE: The Call from Beyond - Nightsisters Rise!
NEWSLETTER_NIHILUS_AND_SITH_DESC:
Now is the time of the Sith! Three new members of this order are now available to add to your collection: Darth Nihilus, Sith Assassin, and Sith Empire Trooper.

Darth Nihilus is a powerful support character that buffs his Sith allies and can instantly defeat an enemy after a number of rounds using the ability, ANNIHILATION. The Sith Assassin is able to stealth and uses powerful attacks to stun enemies, while the Sith Empire Trooper is able to taunt and ignores enemy protection when attacking.

Add these powerful characters to your squad and become truly feared at the holotables.
NEWSLETTER_NIHILUS_AND_SITH_TITLE: NEW CHARACTERS: Darth Nihilus, Sith Empire Trooper, Sith Assassin
NEWSLETTER_NIHILUS_TEASER_DESC: Prepare your best squads for the Lord of Hunger Event, coming this month!
NEWSLETTER_NIHILUS_TEASER_TITLE: Darth Nihilus comes to Galaxy of Heroes
NEWSLETTER_NINTH_SISTER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,
