The [c][F0FF23]Ninth Sister[-][/c], formerly a Jedi known as Masana Tide, is coming to the holotables to reinforce the Inquisitorius! Having survived Order 66, Masana became the Ninth Sister after being captured and tortured by the Empire until she cracked. Notably, Ninth Sister earned a permanent distinguishing feature, losing her left eye during a training session with Darth Vader.

Like Second Sister, Ninth Sister interacts with the [c][F0FF23]Purge[-][/c] debuff. She can use it to inflict Damage Over Time on her enemies while granting herself Heal Over Time, adding to her sustainability. Ninth Sister also has special callouts in her kit that make her extra powerful against Jedi enemies. In addition to inflicting debuffs on her foes, Ninth Sister utilizes Taunt to protect her allies, and gains Defense, Max Health, and Tenacity when surrounded by other Empire units.

Ninth Sister’s Omicron ability gives her additional utility in Territory Wars, where Empire allies gain Defense and all Inquisitorius allies are immune to Ability Block and Stun.

Unlock Ninth Sister in the all-new [c][F0FF23]Ruthless Efficiency II[-][/c] Marquee event.
NEWSLETTER_OLD_BEN_KENOBI_ANNOUNCEMENT_D:
Greetings,

Obi-Wan Kenobi (Old Ben) character Shards are now available from Cantina Battles 2-F and 6-B in addition to Chromium Packs. 

There are also two new characters available in Chromium Packs: Chief Chirpa and Magmatrooper.
NEWSLETTER_OLD_BOBA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Boba Fett, Scion of Jango[-][/c] is coming to Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes! This veteran Bounty Hunter is the first character to have mode specific abilities, like [c][F0FF23]Dangerous Reputation[-][/c], which greatly boosts himself and his squad's effectiveness in Territory Wars. Boba Fett, Scion of Jango uses his [c][F0FF23]Momentum[-][/c] during battle to grant his abilities additional effects and take down enemy squads with ruthless efficiency. You do not want to get between Boba Fett and his quarry.

Can't wait to get your hands on the highly prized Mandalorian armor? Earn shards of Boba Fett, Scion of Jango in the next Conquest event!
NEWSLETTER_OLD_BOBA_TITLE: Let's Just Say They Might Recognize My Face
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_DESC:
Greetings,

To help prepare players for the Guilds and Raids update at the end of this month we are releasing a special limited time event.

This event will require you to form a squad of 3 from a list of pre-selected characters each day of the week. There will be 3 difficulty levels for each day, rewarding Ability Materials and Credits upon completion. If players can complete the hardest difficulty they will be rewarded with an Omega Ability Material!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_NOV_DESC: Log in every Saturday in November for the Omega Battle Events! Earn rare Ability Material Omega pieces during these limited time events!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_NOV_TITLE: Omega Events Every Saturday in November!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_NOV5_DESC: The Omega Battle Event is this weekend! Please note this event will run for 24 HOURS ONLY.
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_NOV5_TITLE: Omega Ability Material Event - One Day Only!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_REGULAR_SCHEDUL: Log in every 1st and 3rd weekend of the month for the Omega Battle Events! Earn rare Ability Material Omega pieces during these limited time events!
Omega Events are now on a regular schedule!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Omega[-][/c], the enhanced clone from Kamino, has made her way to the holotables to round out the Bad Batch faction. Her interest in Clone Force 99 eventually led to her joining the ragtag bunch...as well as her being the catalyst for an impromptu food fight. Although Omega often felt like a misfit, the Bad Batch embraced her and became the family she never had.

Under a Bad Batch lead, Omega gains Speed and Offense. When stealthed, she also assists Bad Batch allies when they use a Special ability. Her Special ability [c][F0FF23]Adaptive Learner[-][/c] introduces a new buff and new status effect to the game, [c][F0FF23]Target Practice[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Zeroed In[-][/c]. The buff grants damage bonuses while the status effect allows her to ignore Taunt on enemies affected by Zeroed In. Omega can also inflict Blind and Daze on enemies with her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Disarming Shot[-][/c].

Omega is the piece of the puzzle the Bad Batch didn’t know they needed, but accepted wholeheartedly. On the holotables, she adds some high single-target damage output to an already fun faction. Play the new marquee event to unlock Omega and complete your Bad Batch squad.
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_EVENT_REDEPLOY_DESC:
The Omega Battles have returned! Starting this weekend, and for the next 3 weekends, you’ll be able to participate in events to earn the coveted Ability Material Omega.

The events have been modified some to allow you to bring additional squad members, and your enemies will be a little tougher since your characters have had time to power-up as well!

Jump in these events today and earn those rare Omega materials!
NEWSLETTER_OMICRONS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Mode specific abilities are coming to characters in Galaxy of Heroes! New units and some existing characters will have a new final tier added to their abilities that boosts those units to the next level in a specific mode. This new type of ability tier will require a unique material called [c][F0FF23]Omicron[-][/c]. However the effects contained in this tier are restricted to only being active in a specific game mode, like Grand Arena or Territory War. Omicrons are available primarily as rewards from Galactic Challenges, but can also be earned in Conquest and from Cantina nodes.

Omicrons allow users to create multiple diverse metas in the game and give characters interesting effects that are contained to specific game modes. For example Boba Fett, Scion of Jango has effects in his abilities that only activate in Territory War. In that game mode you will see a higher-performing Boba Fett if you have customized him by unlocking his Omicron abilities.

While many upcoming characters will have mode specific ability tiers, we will also be adding Omicron tiers to older characters at a slow but steady pace. By adding a new final Omicron tier to an existing ability, we are looking to improve these characters in specific game modes and reignite the excitement they brought to the game when they were first introduced. 

Check out the Official Forums for which characters will be updated and for additional details on mode specific abilities.
NEWSLETTER_OMICRONS_TITLE: New Mode Specific Ability Material: Omicron
NEWSLETTER_OT_CHEWBACCA_DESC: This loveable, shaggy giant has fought in practically every major recent galactic conflict. He is a military strategist, skilled Dejarik player and an expert smuggler, known for his short temper but also his fierce loyalty to his friends. None other than the co-pilot of the Millennium Falcon, Chewbacca - as seen in the Original Trilogy - will be joining the Holotable!\n\nBounty Hunters will be on the lookout for this wanted Wookiee. Earn Chewbacca in a special Bounty Hunter event coming soon!
NEWSLETTER_OUTRIDER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Dash Rendar’s ship, the [c][F0FF23]Outrider[-][/c], is docking with the holotables! As a heavily modified YT-2400 light freighter, the Outrider was a top-notch smuggling vessel and (according to Dash himself) almost as famous as the Millennium Falcon.

The Outrider deals multiple instances of damage with its [c][F0FF23]Illegal Laser Cannons[-][/c] Basic and [c][F0FF23]Concealed Concussion Missiles[-][/c] Special abilities. In addition to damage, the Outrider can inflict enemies with Critical Damage Down and Target Lock, as well as dispel buffs and reduce Defense. Outrider lifts its allies by doling out Health and Protection Recovery, Speed Up, Tenacity Up, and Turn Meter, and dispelling debuffs.

Outrider introduces the new [c][F0FF23]Suprosa Supercomputer[-][/c] effect and the new [c][F0FF23]Data Transmission[-][/c] granted ability, which together provide Rebel allies with powerful bonuses based on their role.

Unlock the Outrider during the upcoming Galactic Chase event to add this ship to your fleet collection!
NEWSLETTER_PADME_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC: Padmé Amidala, the brave former Queen of Naboo turned tenacious Galactic Senator, is coming to the holotables! During the Clone Wars, Padmé’s quick thinking allowed her and her friends to repeatedly outsmart their enemies.\n\nEnter the Geonosis arena with a squad of Separatists to earn Padmé in the Legendary event, Aggressive Negotiations!
NEWSLETTER_PADME_LIVE_DESC:
[c][F0FF23]Padmé Amidala[-][/c], the courageous Queen-turned-Senator from Naboo, has arrived on the holotables! Don’t expect her to sit idly by while her planet (and the galaxy) are under attack from a threat far bigger than anyone realizes.

As a Senator during the Clone Wars, Padmé stayed true to her ideals with risky diplomatic missions for the Galactic Republic. Always willing to do what it took to defend democracy, Padmé could be counted on to dodge assassination attempts, commandeer a speeder, or rescue a Jedi or two.

This fearless diplomat is also an excellent shot with a blaster when need be. In battle, Padmé leads her Galactic Republic allies by using Protection Up to grant them [c][F0FF23]Courage[-][/c] and deal bonus damage. Take your Separatists into the Geonosis arena in the Aggressive Negotiations Legendary event to earn Padmé.
NEWSLETTER_PADME_LIVE_TITLE: No, I Call It Aggressive Negotiations
NEWSLETTER_PAO_DESC:
The daily login character for April is the amphibious Drabata, Pao!

Pao has the ability to lower his enemies defense with his Sonic Grenade ability or bolster his allies Turn Meter with his special battle cry Sa’kalla! In addition to Pao’s abilities, he also has his cooldowns reduced each time a Rebel ally uses a basic attack.

Log in daily this month to unlock Pao!
NEWSLETTER_PAO_TITLE: Daily Login Character for April – PAO
NEWSLETTER_PHOENIX_FLASH_EVENT_DESC:
It's time to rise up in the Phoenix Squadron Flash Event! Earn gear and power up your [c][F0FF23]PHOENIX SQUADRON[-][/c] as you embark on a mission to Lothal to deal a blow to the [c][F0FF23]EMPIRE'S[-][/c] carefully laid plans. But be warned, this [c][F0FF23]REBEL[-][/c] show of force has not gone unnoticed. It's imperative that your Squadron engage in this mission and arise victorious as a looming threat is beginning to close in, keen to ensure that the Rebellion become the architects of their own demise.

These events come back every three days starting on June 9th and will appear at 10am, 2pm, 6pm, and 9pm (player local time).

The Rebellion is counting on you!
NEWSLETTER_PHOENIX_SQUADRON_REBELS_DESC:
Phoenix Squadron has arrived!

Throughout the month of March players will be able to partake in events to earn shards of characters from Star Wars Rebels™ such as Chopper, Hera, Kanan, Zeb, Ezra, and Sabine.

Participate in the first of the Rebels events on March 9th, Supply Sabotage, to unlock Hera and the amazing synergies she brings to the entire Phoenix faction!

Be sure to collect all of the members of Phoenix Squadron this month as you’ll need them to participate in a special Event in April featuring their ships, Ghost and Phantom II.

For complete details on Phoenix Squadron and their Events be sure to check out the blog at https://www.ea.com/games/starwars/galaxy-of-heroes/news/phoenix-squadron-has-arrived
NEWSLETTER_PHOENIX_SQUADRON_REBELS_TITLE: Characters from Star Wars Rebels™ are here!
NEWSLETTER_PLAYTOGIVE_2017_DESC: Games permeate all areas of our lives today – across multiple devices and platforms, and reach players of all ages and genders around the world. With millions of hours spent in play every day, games are a powerful platform for positive, inclusive connections. That is why EA is partnering with several charities to give back to our player communities and support a more inclusive environment in video games. Tap below to learn more about EA Play to Give 2017.
NEWSLETTER_POE_UNIT_PROMO_DESC: Soak up damage with this resistance tank character inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn Poe's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
NEWSLETTER_POWER_FORMULA_CHANGE_DESC: The Power rating has long been a prominent display of a unit's general effectiveness. Though this rating is intended to be a useful way to identify how strong a unit is, it has become less and less effective for this purpose over time. This is primarily due to the formula being based entirely on the raw base stats of the unit, which doesn't account for all upgrades such as abilities.\n\nIn the interest of making the Power formula more reliable as a reference point for a unit's effectiveness, we've modified the formula to recognize every upgrade made to a unit. This change will result in your units appearing to have a much higher power, however this will NOT have any impact on their performance in combat. The changes are purely intended to be a shorthand representation of a unit's general effectiveness.
NEWSLETTER_PRACTICE_MAKES_PERFECT_EZRA_D:
Ezra Bridger is ready to continue his Jedi training at Chopper Base!

This young Jedi specializes in powerful, high-damage attacks to quickly dispatch his enemies. Under Hera Syndulla’s lead, Ezra grants other members of Phoenix Squadron a powerful stacking buff that increases their offense at the end of their turns if they aren’t debuffed.

Take part in the Practice Makes Perfect Event to unlock Ezra Bridger and his incredible Phoenix Squadron synergies!
NEWSLETTER_PRACTICE_MAKES_PERFECT_EZRA_T: PRACTICE MAKES PERFECT EVENT – Ezra Bridger
NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_LEIA_DESC: Princess Leia is now available in the Arena Store! This fearless Rebel leader is a powerful attacker type character with extra attacks and the ability to buff an entire team with Critical bonuses.\n\nWill you be adding one of the greatest leaders of the Rebel Alliance to your collection?
NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_LEIA_TITLE: Princess Leia is now available in the Arena Store!
NEWSLETTER_PROTECTIONSTAT_DESC:
Protection provides Characters with additional survivability and first becomes available when a Character reaches [c][9341ff]Gear Lvl VII[-][/c].

When battling against a Character with Protection, the Protection meter must be depleted prior to affecting the Character's health.

Visit the forums for discussion on this new statistic!
NEWSLETTER_PVP_ARENA_PAYOUTS_ADJUSTMENTS: Greetings,\n\nWe recently made an adjustment to the way Arena rewards work. Payouts for your rank in Squad Arena now reward 100 less Arena Tokens, but you will now receive 100 more when completing the daily challenge by participating in 3 Arena battles.
NEWSLETTER_PVP_TOURNAMENT_KICKOFF_EVENT_: Prepare your squads for the upcoming Squad Tournaments with a special limited-time Squad Tournament Kickoff Weekend! All weekend long you will receive DOUBLE DROPS on Light and Dark Hard battles, Mod Challenges and Cantina Battles! In addition, you will receive a 25% BONUS across all crystal packs in the store (one-time bonus for each pack)!\n\nTake advantage of this limited-time bonus weekend, and get your best squads ready to battle for the top of the leaderboards in our first PVP Squad Tournament! The new Squad Tournaments unlocks at level 30.
NEWSLETTER_QIRA_DESC: To celebrate the release of the new Solo: A Star Wars Story film in theaters, Qi'ra has arrived to the Holotables! Acquire, power up, and fight with this new Scoundrel leader. Use Qi'ra, Young Han Solo, and Vandor Chewbacca to maximize their powerful [c][f0ff23]Prepared[-][/c] abilities!\n\nQi'ra is a new Scoundrel leader that increases the faction's Critical Chance and helps with their recovery and sustain in a fight. Qi'ra's leader ability also increases Scoundrel's power by their Role. Attackers gain more Offense, Tanks gain Critical Avoidance, and Supports gain Speed. Qi'ra can also use [c][f0ff23]Prepared[-][/c] to dispel all buffs on her enemies! This resourceful Scoundrel is an excellent addition to any Scoundrel squad and can be used to devastating effect with other allies that use [c][f0ff23]Prepared[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_QUALITY_OF_LIFE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

We made some big improvements to the Cantina since you last visited. The updated holotables contain many highly requested Quality of Life changes from you, the community! You’ll notice immediately that battles are much easier to see with an option that lets you toggle the way buffs and debuffs are shown. We have also added an exciting new feature for guild leaders that allows them to Sim a raid for their entire guild, speeding up the rewards for guilds who are already easily clearing The Pit.

There's so much more in this update but I can’t let you go without mentioning the new "Leader" tag for characters with Leader abilities. This means you have another useful way to filter your characters and decide who to focus on upgrading or who to use in your next Grand Arena!

Head over to the official Galaxy of Heroes forums for the full list of changes.
NEWSLETTER_QUIGONJINN_CANTINA_SHIPMENTS_:
Greetings Heroes,

Qui-Gon Jinn is now available in Cantina Shipments. Previously, Qui-Gon Jinn was only available by opening Chromium Packs. We will continue to move characters from being exclusively in Chromium Packs as we add new characters to the game.

We hope you are all excited to have another way to acquire character shards for Qui-Gon Jinn!
NEWSLETTER_R2D2_EVENT_DESC:
In celebration of May the Fourth, R2-D2 arrives to Galaxy of Heroes!

The versatile Support Droid, R2-D2, has been seen on the Death Star! Gather your best EMPIRE forces and defeat the famous crew of the Millennium Falcon to capture R2 in THE DARING DROID, a very rare multi-tiered event!

Can you foil the REBELS' plans and capture this Legendary astromech?
NEWSLETTER_R2D2_EVENT_TITLE: R2-D2 arrives in the Daring Droid Event!
NEWSLETTER_R2D2_LEGENDARY_REOCURRING_EVE: Luke Skywalker's Hero's Journey returns for the first time! Luke is also bringing back his astromech friend, R2-D2, in the updated "The Daring Droid" Legendary event. Just like BB-8's Legendary Event, "The Daring Droid" has had a Mythic Event added. In the Mythic version, players will be able to replay the Legendary Event's final tier, a more difficult tier, where they can take any characters in, and a tier that reverses the encounter! Battle against the Empire with the team from a A New Hope!\n\nLike all Legendary Events going forward, R2-D2's Mythic Event will return every time the Legendary event is run. So don't wait, Commander Luke Skywalker and R2-D2 are ready to join your party!
Commander Luke Skywalker Returns and the Mythic "Daring Droid"
NEWSLETTER_RACE_TO_UNLOCK_KYLO_REN_DESC: The Race to Unlock Kylo Ren has begun! Now that Star Wars: The Force Awakens is in theaters and new heroes have been added to the game, we’re celebrating by giving players new ways to unlock Kylo Ren. Beginning today, Chromium packs will have a chance to unlock Kylo Ren and Kylo Ren shards. Starting tomorrow, you will also be able to get shards from Cantina Mission 4C. On top of this, for the next 7 days, all players will receive a Kylo Ren shard each day in their inbox. Will you be the first to unlock Kylo Ren? Let the race begin! More details available in the forums.
NEWSLETTER_RACE_TO_UNLOCK_KYLO_REN_TITLE: The Race to Unlock Kylo Ren
NEWSLETTER_RADDUS_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nLegendary Resistance Cruiser, the [c][F0FF23]Raddus[-][/c], has exited hyperspace and landed on the Holotables. Named after the Mon Calamari admiral who gave his life capturing the Death Star plans in the Battle of Scarif, the Raddus was equipped with experimental deflector shields designed to outlast even the heaviest First Order bombardment. These shields provide the fleet with an incredible amount of protection and allows allied ships to take quite a beating before succumbing to enemy fire. Ultimately, the ship lived up to its name when Commander Amilyn Holdo sacrificed the Raddus and herself, using the Holdo Maneuver, to stop the First Order from wiping out the Resistance. Unlock this Resistance Capital Ship in the new [c][F0FF23]Advanced Fleet Mastery - Admiral's Maneuver[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_RAID_REWARD_COOLDOWN_TIME_DES: A new cooldown on Raid rewards has been implemented for players who leave, or are kicked from, a Guild. During this cooldown period, players who participate in a Raid will not receive any of the rewards from that Raid. However, players will receive a smaller consolation reward if they complete any Raids while under the cooldown period*. The cooldown goes into effect as soon as a player leaves a Guild (regardless of how they leave) and lasts for approximately 30 hours. /n/n*If a raid is completed after the cooldown period (even if it was started during the cooldown) a player will receive the raid rewards as normal.
NEWSLETTER_RANCOR_UPDATE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Has your Guild mastered the Heroic Raids? It's time to step it up with a brand new Challenge Tier for the The Pit Raid! Face off against an even more challenging version of the Rancor and earn better rewards such as the all new Relic 8 materials. Use these materials to upgrade your best squads to Relic 8 and challenge your strongest Arena opponents. As part of this update, Guilds can now sim The Tank Takedown if they meet the requirements of completing the Heroic Tank Takedown 50 times and have 35 members with 7* General Kenobi.

Galactic Challenges are also receiving an update that changes how rewards are earned. Earn Key Cards by completing tiers and feats to unlock a reward box based on your progress. At the end of each event, you'll receive a reward box based on the number of Key Cards you unlocked.

See you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_RANGE_TROOPER_DESC:
Attention Holotables Heroes! We've got some exciting changes in today's update: a new Imperial Trooper appears, a reworked Grand Master Yoda, and the all new Fleet Battles table!

Unlock the new PvE Table, Fleet Battles, at Level 60 to start earning Ship shards, Reinforcement Materials and even [b] Ship Omega Ability Materials[/b]! With a new energy dedicated exclusively to ship combat, the Fleet Battles table is a great place to test out new strategies and collect your favorite Star Wars ships.

Unleash your Jedi team's potential with the newly reworked Grand Master Yoda! Yoda's improved abilities transform the Jedi into a powerful offensive force that punishes enemies for trying to apply debuffs!

Expand your ranks of Imperial Troopers with some of the coolest looking armor around, the Range Trooper! Protecting his Empire allies and supporting their fellow troopers with many ways to assist when they use an ability. See the Range Trooper in action in Solo: A Star Wars Story in theaters now.
NEWSLETTER_RANGE_TROOPER_TITLE: Fleet Battles, Grand Master Yoda, and the Range Trooper have arrived!
NEWSLETTER_RAZOR_CREST_FARM_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Razor Crest[-][/c] blueprints have left Conquest Merchants to open up room for upcoming units. While this ship will no longer be available in the Conquest store for Crystals, you can now pick up blueprints in Shipments for Crystals or for Fleet Arena tokens in the Fleet Arena Store. Razor Crest blueprints will continue to be available for Conquest Currency in the Conquest Store.
NEWSLETTER_REBEL_YWING_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe iconic [c][F0FF23]Rebel Y-wing[-][/c] is flying onto the Galaxy of Heroes Holotables! Prized for its durability and versatility, the Y-wing has gone through several iterations while serving as a valuable contributor to various fleets since its galactic debut. It is sure to bolster any Rebel fleet with its new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Shield Disruption[-][/c], which weakens enemies, making them more susceptible to attacks. The Rebel Y-wing also acts as a powerful crewless tank, giving its squad more survivability while distracting enemy units.
NEWSLETTER_REBEL_YWING_TITLE: The Starfighter that Broke the Empire's Back
NEWSLETTER_RELIC_9_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today’s release brings Relic 9 to the holotables, updates Territory Wars, and kicks off a number of changes coming to Gear availability.

First up, Relic 9 can now be crafted from 2 new materials, the Gyrda Keypad from the Jawa Scavenger and the new Droid Brain material that is exclusively available from Territory Wars reward boxes.

The new Relic 9 prize is not the only change coming to Territory Wars. This mode has expanded with additional Defenses in the upper divisions, extra reward boxes (outside of the Droid Brain with Relic materials), and a new system for matchmaking your Guild against another of similar power.

Last but certainly not least, there are many upcoming changes aimed at increasing the availability of Gear! As part of the first steps towards those Gear changes, we have expanded Territory Wars to also reward Aeromagnifiers and flatten the rewards from the Challenge tier of The Pit to reward more players with this Relic 8 material. This sets the stage for a whole host of Gear changes, the details of which are available on the Official Forum right now.

See you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_RELIC_9_TITLE: Relic 9, Territory Wars, and Upcoming Changes to Gear
NEWSLETTER_RELICS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Take your squad to the next level and power up your characters with [c][F0FF23]Relic Amplifiers[-][/c] from the Star Wars universe! Each character has a special Relic that provides stat boosts based on their role and aptitudes. Enhance the power of relics such as Han Solo's pistol, Yoda’s walking stick or Kylo Ren's lightsaber, and other legendary items from the movies and TV shows.

Upgrade these unique items through the new [c][F0FF23]Jawa Scavenger holotable[-][/c]. Bring the Scavenger your unused gear and turn it into the scrap parts you need to bolster your Relics. Head over to the official forums for more information on these exciting new artifacts.

To celebrate the launch of Relics, Normal nodes in Light Side, Dark Side, and Fleet Battles are rewarding double drops on 9/13, 9/14, and 9/15.

See you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_REMOVING_SELL_FEATURE_DESC:
Greetings Heroes,

You may have noticed that Mining Droids were removed from the game recently and replaced with direct Credit rewards. This was done in order to streamline the game, removing an unnecessary step.

With the latest major update, the Sell feature has been removed entirely from the game. Any Mining Droids not yet sold will be credited directly to your account as Credits. A message will be sent to your Inbox if your account fits this criteria.

For complete details on this update please visit our forums at https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
NEWSLETTER_RESISTANCE_HERO_FINN_DESC: Rally the Resistance and stop the First Order from seizing the galaxy in the upcoming marquee event, [c][F0FF23]HEROES OF THE RESISTANCE[-][/c]. Inspired by the indomitable will of his allies, [c][F0FF23]Resistance Hero Finn[-][/c] becomes super charged with new effects and protects his allies from the crushing grip of the First Order. Earn shards of Resistance Hero Finn and find out if FN-2187 is ready to lead in the Resistance to victory!
NEWSLETTER_RESISTANCE_POE_FINN_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nOne of the leaders of the Resistance, [c][F0FF23]Resistance Hero Poe[-][/c], joins the holotables! Poe overpowers his enemies with debilitating effects and an onslaught of blaster fire. He has proven himself to be a valuable asset to the Resistance, despite his signature bravado in battle. When [c][F0FF23]INSPIRED[-][/c] by his ally, Resistance Hero Finn, Poe weakens the enemy squad with an assortment of debuffs that leaves them Vulnerable to Critical Hits. Help the Resistance combat the First Order and unlock Resistance Hero Poe in an upcoming Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_REVAN_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC:
Have you heard the tale of the Hero who led the Jedi to victory against the Mandalorians in the ancient war? How the Savior of the Republic faced down the armies of Mandalore and took their leader’s mask? Or, perhaps, the story of a great fall and a return to the light? Learn all about one of the great mysteries and myths of the Old Republic. Prepare to follow the journey of... Jedi Knight Revan!

Are you ready to face the dark side with Jedi Knight Revan? You will need the following characters at 7 stars to complete the event and unlock Jedi Knight Revan:

-Bastila Shan
-Jolee Bindo
-T3-M4
-Mission Vao
-Zaalbar

Packs and Bundles for Old Republic characters are available to help you prepare for this rare event.
NEWSLETTER_REVAN_B28_DESC:
[i]"Savior, conqueror, hero, villain. You are all things, Revan… and yet you are nothing. In the end, you belong to neither the light nor the darkness. You will forever stand alone." - Darth Malak[/i]

The legendary Jedi Knight Revan has joined the Holotables! This warrior of legend is an extremely powerful Jedi leader and tactician who controls the battlefield with a wide mix of powerful abilities. Revan was rumored to have been very influential in shaping the history of the Jedi Order, and was part of many pivotal battles to stop the growing threat of the Sith.

This update also introduces the B-28 Extinction-class Bomber! This tactical bomber is capable of launching vast amounts of ordnance in order to wreak havoc and sow terror into the minds of the Sith’s enemies. The B-28 was used by the Sith Empire in the Great Galactic War and is most well known for laying waste to the Republic capital, Coruscant.
NEWSLETTER_REVAN_B28_TITLE: Who I Am Is Not Important, My Message Is
NEWSLETTER_REX_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC:
Greetings Heroes,

Today we are happy to announce a new character initially only available in Chromium Packs: CT-7567, or as most of you know him, Rex!

Rex is a leader who supports Clone squad members by boosting their turn meter with his unique abilities. In addition to supporting Clone Troopers, Rex also has an ability that does more damage to enemies the higher their maximum health is.

Will you be among the first to form a squad with Rex as a leader?
NEWSLETTER_REY_UNIT_PROMO_DESC: Crush the competition with this high damage attacker character inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn Rey's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
NEWSLETTER_RISE_TOGETHER_EVENT_DESC:
Take part in the RISE TOGETHER event to unlock the Phoenix Squadron’s ships: Ghost and Phantom II.

Ghost is an elusive Rebel ship that synergizes with Stealthed allies to deliver devastating attacks. Phantom II acts as a decoy for Ghost, while also providing ally support and debuffing enemies.

This event will combine ground and space combat! See first-hand how fearsome the Phoenix Squadron is under the lead of Hera Syndulla and her unique-sharing leader ability. Afterwards, use the devastating Ghost and Phantom II in a new ship Event.

Be sure to add these powerful ships and their amazing abilities to your fleet by participating in these limited-time events.
NEWSLETTER_RISE_TOGETHER_EVENT_TITLE: RISE TOGETHER EVENT - Ghost and Phantom II
NEWSLETTER_ROGUE_ONE_CHROMIUM_DESC: A new selection of characters has been rotated into Chromium Packs, including Rogue One's Jyn Erso, Chirrut Îmwe, Cassian Andor and K-2SO!\n\n*For a full list of the changing Chromium Characters, check out the SWGOH forum (https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com)
NEWSLETTER_ROGUE_ONE_EVENT_BISTAN_MESSAG:
Play every day to unlock Bistan early and increase his star count by the end of the month!

A new daily event for the month of November is now available! You will need to put together a crack team of Rebels (recommended for levels 20 and above) in order to battle on Scarif and earn extra shards towards unlocking Bistan!

Be sure to participate each day in order to add this Rogue One character to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_ROSE_HOLDO_DESC:
In the darkest hour of the Resistance, Admiral Holdo and Rose Tico rise up to defeat the First Order!

A seasoned tank with powerful ally support and enemy debuffs, Admiral Holdo is the premier support tank for any Resistance-led squad. Her basic, [c][F0FF23]MEASURED SHOT[-][/c], gives the least healthy Resistance ally Foresight, which heals them when it expires. When she uses her special, [c][F0FF23]REPRIEVE[-][/c], target other ally has their debuffs dispelled and they'll gain Health and Protection in return.

Rose Tico is an attacker who grants allies buffs and can stun the target enemy. Her unique, [c][F0FF23]VALIANT SPIRIT[-][/c], grants Rose Offense for each Exposed enemy and Rose gains Turn Meter when another Resistance ally scores a Critical Hit.

Both of these valiant heroes are ready to join your Resistance squad and lead you to victory!
NEWSLETTER_ROSE_HOLDO_TITLE: Admiral Holdo and Rose Tico Join the Resistance!
NEWSLETTER_ROYAL_GUARD_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Royal Guard has received a touchup to their kit! These changes will help Royal Guard serve as a strong Empire tank who synergizes with Galactic Legend Lord Vader and other Empire characters.

The following abilities for Royal Guard have been updated:

“Force Pike” Basic ability has been increased to a 100% Stun chance (previously 80%).

“Imperial Phalanx” Special ability now states “All Dark Side allies gain Defense Up and Heal Over time for 2 turns and Empire allies gain Health Up and Retribution for 2 turns. Royal Guard gains Taunt for 1 turn.”

“Unyielding Defender” Unique ability now states, “At the start of the encounter, if the allied Leader is Empire, Royal Guard gains Max Health equal to 5% of the allied Leader's Max Health and then doubles his Health until the end of the encounter. At the end of each turn, if another ally took damage that turn, all Empire allies recover 6% Health. In addition, Royal Guard Taunts for 1 turn whenever another ally falls below 50% Health.”

As part of these changes, all resources that you have used to upgrade TIER VIII of Royal Guard's unique, Unyielding Defender, have been returned to your inbox.
NEWSLETTER_SCARIF_DAILY_BATTLE_MESSAGE:
Play every day to unlock the Scarif Rebel Pathfinder early and increase his star count by the end of the month!

A new daily event for the month of September is now available. You will need to put together a crack team of Rebels (recommended for levels 30 and above) in order to board and assault an Imperial vessel and rescue a captured Scarif Rebel Pathfinder (character shard).

Be sure to participate each day in order to add Rogue One’s first character to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_SCARIF_REBEL_CANTINA_DESC: The Scarif Rebel Pathfinder is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 1 Mission D! This brave Rebel tank is capable of self-healing and taunting to protect his allies. His determination to his allies and the Rebel cause gives him the ability, “Do or Die,” which allows him to self-revive as long as he has a buff when defeated, making him a hero to his allies and a menace to his enemies.\n\nAdd this Rogue One character to your collection today!
NEWSLETTER_SCARIF_REBEL_CANTINA_TITLE: Scarif Rebel Pathfinder is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 1 Mission D!
NEWSLETTER_SCARIF_REBEL_MESSAGE: Rogue One’s first character has arrived! Login daily this month to unlock the Scarif Rebel Pathfinder. This brave Rebel tank is capable of granting Turn Meter to his allies while Taunting to protect them. His determination to his allies and the Rebel cause gives him the ability, “Do or Die,” which allows him to self-revive as long as he has a buff when defeated, making him a hero to his allies and a menace to his enemies.\n\nBe sure to login daily during the month of September and add the first Rogue One character to your collection.
NEWSLETTER_SCARIF_REBEL_TITLE: September’s Daily Login: Rogue One’s Scarif Rebel Pathfinder
NEWSLETTER_SCBI_CROSS_PROMO_DESC: Build your dream city in the world's most popular city builder, made for mobile. Watch your city come to life as you complete quick, fun challenges and experience vivid 3D-quality graphics. Customize your city with famous landmarks, expand onto the beach, and launch disasters to rebuild in new ways!
NEWSLETTER_SECOND_SISTER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The [c][F0FF23]Second Sister[-][/c], formerly known as Trilla Suduri, is storming on to the holotables! As an Inquisitor who had previously been trained in the ways of the Force by a Jedi but felt betrayed by her master and the Jedi Order, Second Sister is a fierce lightsaber duelist who uses her skill in combat along with her intellect to subdue her foes.

Second Sister’s Omicron ability is focused on Territory Wars, and she introduces the [c][F0FF23]Inquisitorius[-][/c] faction along with a new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Purge[-][/c]. When upgraded, her Omicron ability debuffs enemies at the start of battle with Purge and prevents Jedi enemies from recovering Health or Protection from their Unique abilities. Purge can also be used to remove enemy Turn Meter, ensures that Second Sister's Special abilities cannot be evaded, and increases her Critical Chance. As a Leader, Second Sister grants Empire allies increases to their Offense and Critical Damage, and when an ally is Marked all other allies are Marked.

Add Second Sister to your roster via the all-new “[c][F0FF23]Ruthless Efficiency I[-][/c]” Marquee Event, and win Lord Vader’s approval by hunting down members of the treasonous Jedi Order!
NEWSLETTER_SECOND_SISTER_TITLE: You Will Refer to Me as Inquisitor
NEWSLETTER_SERVER_MAINTENANCE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes!

Our servers will undergo maintenance starting approximately March 29th 00:00 PDT / March 29th 07:00 UTC.

The game will be down for a period of roughly one hour as we work on the servers. Our goal is to be back online as soon as possible.

Updates will be provided on the forums https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/categories/game-updates
NEWSLETTER_SEVENTH_SISTER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Seventh Sister[-][/c], an Inquisitorius who harbors a mysterious past, is coming to the holotables! Although her identity before becoming known as Seventh Sister is murky, this newest member of the Inquitorius faction was rumored to have been a Jedi who somehow survived Order 66.

Seventh Sister’s Omicron ability is focused on Territory Wars. In addition to bringing support and healing to the Inquisitorius faction, Seventh Sister is accompanied by her Droid, ID9. Like other members of her faction, she has a Leader ability designed to make her powerful against Jedi enemies, and she will make use of the [c][F0FF23]Purge[-][/c] debuff.

Her kit has the ability to dispel buffs and remove Turn Meter from enemies, and inflict Ability Block and Daze. Seventh Sister also provides allies with Critical Hit Immunity, Evasion Up, Health, and Protection. Inquisitorius allies also get Foresight. Seventh Sister also assists whenever an Inquisitorius ally uses an ability during their turn.

Unlock Seventh Sister in the all-new “[c][F0FF23]RUTHLESS EFFICIENCY III[-][/c]” Marquee Event, and bring glory to the Empire by extinguishing the last of the Jedi!
NEWSLETTER_SEVENTH_SISTER_TITLE: My Pet Told Me You Were Here
NEWSLETTER_SHAAK_TI_DESC: Jedi Master [c][F0FF23]Shaak Ti[-][/c] personally oversaw the training and development of clone forces on Kamino during the Clone Wars. This wise general and member of the Jedi High Council expected much from the clones, but she was also known for valuing their lives as individuals, not just rank and file troops. In battle, Shaak Ti is a fierce Leader who significantly increases the power of Clone Trooper allies. She can call an [c][F0FF23]Assault Team[-][/c] to attack, and her [c][F0FF23]Heightened Reflexes[-][/c] are especially effective against enemies who deal damage to multiple Clones at once.\n\n[c][F0FF23]The Shaak Ti event, bundle, and packs unlock for players at level 60![-][/c]
NEWSLETTER_SHARD_SHOP_EXCLUSIVE_DESC:
Greetings Heroes,

We hope you're enjoying the latest update. For those of you who have unlocked the Shard Shop, we would like to let you know that in a few weeks there will be a brand new character whose shards can be purchased in the Shard Shop. We're telling you now so you can make a better decision about whether to save up your extra Shards or spend them.

Thanks for playing Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes!
NEWSLETTER_SHIP_CHANGES_DESC:
Ships just got even better!

[b]Fleet Combat Just Got Personal:[/b]
Now you can see the crew behind your ships as they fight to defeat their enemies.

[b]Ship Health Bars:[/b]
To better differentiate between the health of ships, we have reduced the number of health bar segments. Ship Health has NOT been changed.

[b]Target Lock:[/b]
To make it easier to remember which Ship Abilities can inflict Target Lock and have bonuses due to Target lock, we have added visual messaging on the Ability buttons.
NEWSLETTER_SHIP_FORUM_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC: Ships are coming soon! To learn more about the ways you can prepare for their arrival, check out the forum post here: https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/discussion/74238/ships-preview-post
NEWSLETTER_SHIP_FORUM_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE: Ships are coming to Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes!
NEWSLETTER_SHORETROOPER_AVAILABLE_TOURNA:
A new character from Rogue One has arrived! Available exclusively through the new Squad Tournaments you will need to be at least level 30 in order to have a chance of unlocking this Empire tank for your collection.

The Shoretrooper is a fearless tank who will Taunt at the start of every encounter. His tactical aptitude also gives him the ability, “Regroup,” allowing him and his allies to recover health and gain Critical Hit Immunity. "Regroup" also gives him Taunt, allowing his allies even further reprieve.

Be sure to dominate the Squad Tournaments this week and add this Rogue One character to your collection!
Rogue One’s Shoretrooper available in Squad Tournaments
NEWSLETTER_SHORETROOPER_PVP_TOURNAMENT_D: The new Squad Tournaments are here! Unlocked at level 30, you will need to gather your most powerful squad together and set up your best defensive squad in order to compete for rare prizes in this limited time event! You will battle against other players' chosen squads in order to earn points and climb the tournament leaderboard. The higher you climb the better prizes you will receive including "The Pit" Raid Prize Boxes, Credits, Omega Ability Materials, and more! And if you're able to climb and maintain a top position on the leaderboard you can also earn shards for the new Rogue One Shoretrooper!\n\nGather your squad and dominate the new Squad Tournaments to earn your prizes!
NEWSLETTER_SHORETROOPER_PVP_TOURNAMENT02: The [c][ffff33]Shores of Scarif[-][/c] Squad Tournament is returning for its second appearance! Tournaments now use ALLY POINTS for squad refresh instead of Crystals! Battle your opponents, earn points and climb the leaderboard to earn prizes including “The Pit” Raid Prize Boxes, Credits, Omega Ability Materials, and shards for the Rogue One Shoretrooper.
The [c][ffff33]Shores of Scarif[-][/c] Squad Tournament returns!
NEWSLETTER_SITH_MARAUDER_DESC: Shadows gather upon Malachor as strength is found in rage. The Sith Marauder enters the holotable to prepare your squad for the Sith Triumvirate Raid. Join forces with this terrifying attacker in order to infiltrate the Jedi temple and cut through Jedi defenses in his very own Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_SITH_TRIUMVIRATE_RAID_DESC:
The Ancient Sith Triumvirate has arrived in Galaxy of Heroes! Darth Nihilus, Darth Sion, and Darth Traya await only the boldest of players in the depths of the Trayus Academy. 

Our newest raid, THE SITH TRIUMVIRATE, invites players to join their fellow guild members and assemble their finest squads to best the Lords of Hunger, Pain, and Betrayal. Only the strongest can defeat the Heroic Tier and earn shards of the legendary Lord of Betrayal herself: DARTH TRAYA.

Do you dare face THE SITH TRIUMVIRATE?

Continue the Shadow of Malachor Marquee Event series and unlock VISAS MARR and the dreaded Lord of Pain: DARTH SION. 

VISAS MARR is a healer with two potent buffs: Health Steal Up and Defense Penetration Up. VISAS MARR also has powerful anti-Sith synergy and will prove invaluable to those looking to lay siege to the Trayus Academy. 

DARTH SION is the fearsome Lord of Pain and a new Sith tank. Using his powerful PAIN debuff, Sion can cripple foes while making himself more powerful as he works to activate his HATRED buff - which prevents him from being defeated! 

Add these characters to your collection today!
NEWSLETTER_SMUGGLERS_HAN_CHEWBACCA_DESC:
Welcome our newest additions to Galaxy of Heroes - Veteran Smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca! This powerful duo have incredible synergies between them, making them devastating allies on the battlefield.

These Veteran Smugglers have each other's back, sharing the Unique ability: Partner in Crime. Whenever one of these old friends is damaged, the other becomes much more dangerous by gaining additional Critical Damage. And, if you defeat one of these Smugglers, the other immediately takes two turns back to back.

Add these The Force Awakens characters to your roster today!
NEWSLETTER_SMUGGLERS_HAN_CHEWBACCA_TITLE: Veteran Smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca Arrive!
NEWSLETTER_SOCIAL_SEP_15_DESCRIPTION:
Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes features several ways to connect with your friends and with other players.

Allies - Remember, your Allies' characters will be available to help you in Campaign battles, and their Leader Abilities will apply to your squad. When you use allies in a battle, you will earn Ally Points which you can use to open packs!

Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes Forum - Visit the Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes Forums to connect with other players, discuss strategy, and even submit questions for Capital Games to answer in our weekly Q&A.

Visit the official Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes web site to view the forums - http://starwars.ea.com/starwars/galaxy-of-heroes
NEWSLETTER_SOLO_VANDOR_DESC:
To celebrate the upcoming release of the new Solo: A Star Wars Story film in theaters, Young Han Solo and Vandor Chewbacca have arrived to the holotables! Acquire, power up, and fight with these new Scoundrels and plan your own galactic heists!

Few heists turn out exactly as planned - but when you've got the natural skill of a Young Han Solo or the courage of Vandor Chewbacca, you're [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] for anything!

When Young Han Solo or Vandor Chewbacca gains the new [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] effect, they can increase the power of some of their abilities or expend [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] to unleash devastating new effects. Young Han Solo can also grant [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] to other allies, further increasing the power of his attacks. Vandor Chewbacca can use [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] to revive defeated Light Side Scoundrel allies! [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] will deliver new and exciting combat experiences to your squads.

Collect and power up the all new Scoundrels, Young Han Solo and Vandor Chewbacca, today in an all new set of Marquee Events!
NEWSLETTER_SOLO_VANDOR_TITLE: Young Han Solo and Vandor Chewbacca have arrived!
NEWSLETTER_SPECTRE_ONE_KANAN_DESC:
The powerful Jedi survivor, Kanan Jarrus, is ready to join the fray! Unlock Kanan by completing the Spectre One Event this month.

Kanan is a taunting Jedi that can cleanse debuffs from his allies and grant Protection Up. Kanan, under a Hera Syndulla leader, will grant other Phoenix Squadron members healing at the start of their turns if they are debuffed and give them a chance to counter attack.

You need to collect Kanan Jarrus in order to take advantage of the incredible Phoenix Squadron synergies, so jump into the Spectre One Event and add him to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_SQUAD_ARENA_CRYSTAL_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update moves the Crystal rewards from Squad Arena to Grand Arena Championships. As we seek to reinforce that Grand Arena Championships as THE competition in Galaxy of Heroes to rank and reward the players who best use the strongest rosters in SWGOH, these changes provide more evenly matched opponents, better rewards that incentivize combat, and an overall more straightforward ladder experience. All level 85 players will receive a daily Crystal reward based on their standing in Grand Arena Championships and earn additional Crystals based on their results at the end of each Round, Event, and Season. Squad Arena will have a larger focus on preparing players for Grand Arena Championships by providing additional Gear in Squad Arena Shipments.  Fleet Arena rewards remain unchanged at this time.

Players below level 85 will receive Crystals they previously earned in Squad Arena from Daily Quests.

See the Official Forums for more information.
NEWSLETTER_SQUAD_ARENA_CRYSTAL_TITLE: Squad Arena Crystal Rewards Moved to Grand Arena Championships
NEWSLETTER_SQUAD_MANAGEMENT_TOOLS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Organize your growing roster faster than ever with the new Squad Management tools. You will notice that the Character/Ship Inventory screen has received a visual update and we have added several new tabs on the left hand side to assist you in finding and arranging your squads.

Learn where to focus your resources next with the Recommended tab, which provides squad recommendations based on your account and Journey Guide progress. You can also find initial and advanced squad suggestions for each character in the game by tapping the new info button on that character's screen.

Create new tabs to organize your squads right from the Inventory screen. Easily move, rename or copy squads to other tabs with the tap of a button. You can even add units that aren't unlocked to help you plan for the next event or your newest squad!

This update also adds a Leader Synergy indicator to the pre-battle squad screen. Now you can quickly determine if your squad's leader ability partially or completely applies to the rest of your squad members or as you scroll through unassigned units in the pre-battle squad screen.

Enjoy the new tools and see you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_STAR_WARS_CELEBRATION_DESC:
It's time to celebrate [i]Star Wars[/i]!

This year’s [i]Star Wars[/i] Celebration fires off with the RISE TOGETHER Event, awarding players blueprints for Phoenix Squadron’s ships the Ghost and Phantom II. For those that may have missed them last month we’re also bringing back the bundles and packs for all Phoenix Squadron members.

In addition to the above festivities there will be Double Drops in the Cantina for 5 days, so be sure to join in the celebration!
NEWSLETTER_STARFORTRESS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The iconic [c][F0FF23]MG-100 StarFortress SF-17[-][/c] is arriving on the holotables! This rugged Resistance bomber will bolster its faction’s fleet by serving as a staunch tank as it searches for the enemies’ [c][F0FF23]Sweet Spot[-][/c].

Crewed by Rose Tico and Resistance Trooper, the StarFortress is capable of inflicting enemies with Target Lock, Evasion Down, and Daze, as well as removing buffs and Turn Meter from its targets. The StarFortress increases the survivability of the Resistance Fleet via its consistent Taunts, and can also recover Protection, Health, gain Critical Hit Immunity, and counter attack. Once in position, the StarFortress deploys its Concussion Mines to deal Max Health damage to enemies and disrupt the enemy fleet.

Unlock MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 during the upcoming [c][F0FF23]Galactic Chase[-][/c] event to add this Resistance tank to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_STARKILLER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The legendary [c][F0FF23]Starkiller[-][/c] arrives on the holotables! The son of two Jedi, Starkiller had an extremely powerful connection to the Force and served as Vader's personal assassin and secret apprentice. Legend has it Starkiller once used his abilities to bring down a Star Destroyer, and now as a Dark Side Unaligned Force User brimming with conflict, he’s ready to lift up a squad of Force Users on the holotables.

Capable of feats such as inflicting an entire enemy team with Stun as he deals damage to them, providing his allies full Health and Protection recovery, and being immune to Fear, Starkiller is ready for battle. He also introduces the new effects [c][F0FF23]Force Energy[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Unleashed[-][/c], and his Granted ability, [c][F0FF23]Size Means Nothing[-][/c], is sure to make an impact. Starkiller’s Omicron abilities elevate his team in Grand Arenas to new heights.

Crush your holotable foes by adding Starkiller to your roster via the all-new Legacy event, “[c][F0FF23]The Force Unleashed[-][/c],” that is always available in the Journey Guide. Now go, and remember that the dark side is always with you.
NEWSLETTER_STARKILLER_TITLE: Your Hatred Has Become Your Strength
NEWSLETTER_SUBSCRIPTION_PACK_ANNOUNCE_DE:
Limited time offer - Purchase the Daily Crystal Delivery and you’ll receive crystals in your inbox on each day of the promotion. On top of that you’ll receive bonus crystals upon purchase. 
Save them up for data cards or spend them to expedite character upgrading! 
Deliveries expire at the end of the day, so make sure to log in each day and collect them. 

Head to the Crystal store for more details.
NEWSLETTER_SUBSCRIPTION_PACK_MORE_CRYSTA: LIMITED TIME OFFER: Get 30% more crystals in the Crystal Subscription pack – available now in the Store until the end of December.
Get More Crystals in Crystal Subscriptions
NEWSLETTER_SUN_FAC_DESC: A new character has been added to Chromium Packs, Sun Fac. This Geonosian Tank punishes attackers with a variety of negative status effects. \n\nWill you be among the first to add this powerful Geonosian to your squad?
NEWSLETTER_SUPPLY_SABOTAGE_HERA_DESC:
Hera Syndulla has arrived and is ready to lead Phoenix Squadron into action! Earn shards for Hera by completing the first Star Wars Rebels Event, Supply Sabotage, this month.

Hera's powerful Leader ability unlocks the full power of her fellow Phoenix Squadron members. Using Hera as the leader will grant all Phoenix Squadron teammates each other’s Unique abilities, giving the squad a massive boost in battle!

Make sure you participate in the Supply Sabotage Event to unlock Hera; she is the key to granting amazing synergies to Phoenix Squadron!
NEWSLETTER_TARKIN_UPDATE_DESC:
The Imperial march moves to the stars! Grand Moff Tarkin becomes the Daily Login for June and receives a devastating faction pass making him a ruthless foe.

Head your Squad with Tarkin's leader ability Tighten The Grip, which now adds Defense Down on enemies that go below 100% health on an EMPIRE characters turn. Each Basic attack now increases his Potency, while Ultimate Firepower now does additional damage based on Potency, allowing you to set up a devastating attack. This is complimented by his Special ability, Intimidation Tactics, which temporarily grants himself a 50% Potency up buff. Lastly, Tarkin's ability arsenal is rounded out with Callous Conviction, gaining defense equal to his Potency!

Revisit the Galactic Empires unyielding commander of the Death Star and add him to your Squad today!
NEWSLETTER_TB_GEONOSIS_DESC:
Wat’s up Holotable Heroes,

Join the new Territory Battle, [c][F0FF23]Geonosis: Separatist Might[-][/c] starting this week! Will your guild choose to defend against the invading clone trooper army and earn brand new rewards, or will you continue to fight over the Rebel base on Hoth? Battling across the dusty Geonosian territories will be no easy task, but succeed and your guild can earn shards of [c][F0FF23]Wat Tambor[-][/c], leader of the Techno Union, and a new currency to buy blueprints of General Kenobi’s capital ship, [c][F0FF23]Negotiator[-][/c]. Prepare your strongest Dark Side units to take on waves of Clone Troopers, call in Droid reinforcements and even slay a terrifying monster from the Petranaki arena.

Check out the other newsletter for more details about the new characters and ships added with this update!
NEWSLETTER_TB_GEONOSIS_UNITS_DESC:
We’ve added 3 new units to the Holotables today!

General Kenobi was known as “the Negotiator” during the Clone Wars, but his Venator-class Star Destroyer also went by the same name. Unlock General Kenobi’s [c][F0FF23]Negotiator[-][/c] with a new currency from the next Territory Battle, Geonosis: Separatist Might, by fighting alongside the Separatists to stop the invading clone army. Kenobi brings along a few friends as well: Two Arquitens-class light cruisers flank Negotiator and provide fire support, plus the capital ship can call in a formation of Y-wings to assault the enemy fleet!

The Techno Union is at your disposal thanks to [c][F0FF23]Wat Tambor[-][/c]. His deep connections to the galaxy’s most advanced technology firms will provide your squad with a variety of tech upgrades that can transform your strategy. This powerful support character is unlocked from a Special Mission in the Geonosian Territory Battle and you’ll need to bring in a team of Geonosians for the fight.

A veteran of many fierce battles, the [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Brood Alpha[-][/c] is a strong Leader for the Geonosian faction who drives his swarm to victory with a flurry of attacks. This battle tactician never fights alone and can summon a Geonosian Brute to assist in engaging the enemy. The new [c][F0FF23]Hive Mind[-][/c] buff from Geonosian Brood Alpha sustains the team through heavy burst damage by constantly equalizing Health and Protection among Geonosian allies. The Geonosian Brood Alpha will be needed to enter the Special Mission to earn Wat Tambor shards.
NEWSLETTER_TB_HOTH_EMPIRE_DESC:
Territory Battles takes a darker turn with the arrival of the Empire on the planet Hoth in Imperial Retaliation.

This release includes the explosive Imperial Probe Droid, the formidable Colonel Starck, and the fearsome Hoth predator, the Wampa.

Now for the first time in Galaxy of Heroes, players can acquire a creature! Enemies will cower before the imposing might of the Wampa who attacks relentlessly, with each hit increasing his strength. Opponents who do not stop the Wampa fast enough will find themselves quickly overwhelmed and defeated.

Also incoming, the Imperial Probe Droid is the first character that inflicts Target Lock, providing the Empire a source of Expose. Colonel Starck provides Empire allies powerful critical buffs and is a fearsome addition to any Imperial Trooper squad.

Wampa can be found in the Guild Event Store. The Imperial Probe Droid can be found on the Imperial Retaliation map as a reward and limited time Packs and Bundles. Colonel Starck can be found in Guild Shipments and limited time Packs and Bundles.
NEWSLETTER_TB_REPUBLIC_OFFENSIVE_DESC:
[i]"More happening on Geonosis, I feel, than has been revealed."[/i] -Yoda

War rages across the surface of Geonosis as Count Dooku attempts to repel the Republic invasion. Gather your finest Clone Troopers and Galactic Republic characters and head to the Petranaki Arena to battle the terrifying Reek, but watch your back, the Nexu also stalks your squad and could be hiding around any corner. Stop these vicious beasts from ripping apart the Galactic Republic with an army of Clone Troopers or Padme and her close allies. Unlock new Clone Wars era characters and ships such as [c][F0FF23]Ki Adi Mundi[-][/c] or General Grievous' heavy cruiser, [c][F0FF23]Malevolence[-][/c], in this new [c][F0FF23]Territory Battle, Republic Offensive[-][/c].

Can your guild liberate Geonosis from Separatists' grip?
NEWSLETTER_TECH_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The next Bad Batch Clone Trooper to join the Holotables is [c][F0FF23]Tech[-][/c]! The highly technical trooper in scout armor serves as the brains of the Bad Batch and provides his allies support by handling the more delicate parts of their operations. He has modified his armor with advanced electronic systems that allow him to calculate complex trajectories, translate alien languages, and access many different types of computer systems.

While Tech is leaner compared to his clone counterparts, he is no less skilled in combat. He can use his [c][F0FF23]Brilliant Idea[-][/c] ability to deal damage to his enemies and dispel all debuffs from Clone Trooper allies while all Bad Batch allies gain Foresight, Stealth, and Tenacity Up. 

Unlock Tech in the all new Marquee event: [c][F0FF23]Clone Force 99 II[-][/c]
NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_BATTLES_DESC:
We are super excited to share our newest feature, Territory Battles! This is an epic, multi-phase battle that pitches the entire collection of characters and ships of every guild member against a progressively challenging, living battlefield.

-Increase your Galactic Power with every unit earned and upgraded

-Work collaboratively with your Guild to bring in over 7,000 units into battle and earn the best rewards together (All members earn equal rewards)

-Earn brand new characters Hermit Yoda and Rebel Officer Leia Organa

-Make your characters stronger than ever with Gear Tier XII

-Unlock special abilities like the Ion Cannon in Platoon Missions

-Find a Guild faster with Guild Search

Have fun and thanks for joining the fight!
NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_WARS_DESC:
Get prepared for the ultimate Guild vs. Guild showdown, Territory Wars, a new guild event that pits your Guild and collection against other Guilds and their collections for the true test of who is on top!

-Prepare your territories for invasion by setting defenses

-Conquer enemy territories as you annihilate their defenses

-Use all new Guild Leader/Officer commands to direct your guildmates in both Territory Wars and Battles

-Climb the leaderboard and show the world your guild's power

-Anticipate regular changes to keep gameplay varied and exciting! These could include unique unit bonuses and Platoon Missions.

If you're not already part of a Guild, there are so many other advantages to joining one now:

-Earn exclusive gear and characters like Hermit Yoda, General Kenobi, Han Solo, and Rebel Officer Leia Organa!

-Territory Battles: Coordinate your forces to crush the rebellion on Hoth (or push back the Empire)

-Raids: Fight the Rancor in his pit and an AAT on Geonosis

-Request and Donate gear

Go find a Guild Now!
NEWSLETTER_THE_ARMORER_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes,

It's hammer time. [c][F0FF23]The Armorer[-][/c] makes her way from the forge to the Holotables! Her expertise in forging Beskar, in addition to her wealth of traditional Mandalorian knowledge, ensured The Armorer would become a quick and steadfast ally of certain Outer Rim bounty hunters.

With her tools in hand, The Armorer is ready to distribute the new [c][F0FF23]Beskar Armor[-][/c] buff, increasing her allies' survivability by granting Defense, Health, Protection recovery, Critical Hit Immunity and Counter Chance.

In addition to The Armorer's abilities, she also introduces the brand new [c][F0FF23]Mandalorian[-][/c] faction tag to Galaxy of Heroes! This tag will also be added to the following characters: The Mandalorian, The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor), Jango Fett, Sabine Wren, Gar Saxon, Imperial Super Commando, and Canderous Ordo.

Make The Armorer part of your tribe by unlocking her in the all new Marquee Event WAY OF THE MANDALORE!
NEWSLETTER_THRAWN_MYTHIC_DESC:
The Holotable continues the relentless march of the dark side with the release of the [i]Artist of War[/i] Mythic event.

Gather your Phoenix Squadron and face Grand Admiral Thrawn or join forces with the Grand Admiral and crush the Phoenix Rebels! This new multi-tier Mythic event is intended for elder players and has valuable rewards should you succeed.

Master the [i]Artist of War[/i] today!
NEWSLETTER_THREEPIO_CHEWIE_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nFew pairings in Star Wars have had each other’s backs like [c][F0FF23]Threepio & Chewie[-][/c], who are arriving as a unique combo on the Holotables! The bond forged on Cloud City between one of our favorite droids and Wookiees showed the Empire this unlikely duo is a force to be reckoned with. In addition to being a unique combination unit, Threepio & Chewie offer new gameplay strategies by providing both damage and support abilities, ramping damage, and afflicting [c][F0FF23]Blind[-][/c] on enemies. Only an overgrown mophead would miss out on the chance to add Threepio & Chewie to their collection! So, don't do anything foolish and make sure to participate in the Marquee event, [c][F0FF23]Escape From Cloud City[-][/c].
NEWSLETTER_TIE_ADVANCED_PVP_TOURNAMENT01: Earn blueprints for Darth Vader's TIE Advanced x1 ship! This Imperial vessel is exclusively available in the BOARDING ACTION SQUAD TOURNAMENT starting Monday. In order to add this ship to your collection, this event requires players to be level 30 or higher.\n\nOnce unlocked, you will need to also have Darth Vader in order to use the TIE Advanced in combat. Dominate the leaderboard in the Boarding Action Squad Tournament to earn this iconic ship!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_ADVANCED_PVP_TOURNAMENT02: Earn blueprints for Darth Vader’s personal ship, the TIE Advanced x1! This imperial vessel is available in the BOARDING ACTION SQUAD TOURNAMENT starting Sunday. You will need to be at least level 30 in order to have a chance of adding this ship to your collection.\n\nOnce unlocked, this powerful ship can be piloted by Darth Vader and added to your fleet. Dominate the leaderboard in the Boarding Action Squad Tournament to earn Darth Vader's TIE Advanced x1!
The Boarding Action Squad Tournament Returns!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_ECHELON_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The [c][F0FF23]TIE Echelon[-][/c] is zooming onto the holotables! Piloted by First Order Officer, this impressive tank is ready to provide cover for its allies as they crush the opposition.

The TIE Echelon increases a First Order fleet’s survivability by granting Protection Up to itself and its allies. To keep its allies safe, TIE Echelon can call First Order allies to assist and then grant them Stealth. Enemy fleets will be forced to focus on the TIE Echelon only to find it's a serious challenge to defeat. This ship continuously gains Defense, Max Health, and Max Protection throughout the battle and recovers Health and Protection whenever a First Order ally lands a critical hit. When called upon for reinforcement, the TIE Echelon gains Taunt whenever a First Order ally's Stealth expires.

Unlock the TIE Echelon during the upcoming [c][F0FF23]Galactic Chase[-][/c] event to add this capable tank to your fleet collection!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_FIGHTER_DROP_DESC: The TIE Fighter Pilot is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 4 Mission B! This relentless attacker is a great addition to Empire squads with the ability to call down a "TIE Strike," dealing damage to all enemies and inflicting Buff immunity for 2 rounds. His two other abilities, "Targeting Computer" and "Evasive Maneuvers", give great synergy with other Empire units who can debuff enemy squads, granting him increased damage and turn meter with the former and a chance to gain Foresight with the latter. \n\nAdd the TIE Fighter Pilot to your squad today!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_FIGHTER_DROP_TITLE: TIE Fighter Pilot is now available in Cantina Battles!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_INTERCEPTOR_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Conquest 13 begins soon and blueprints for a new ship, the [c][F0FF23]TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype[-][/c], will be available for a limited time in this mode! Piloted by Second Sister, the TIE Interceptor is a powerful reinforcement for Empire fleets. Its Unique, [c][F0FF23]Prototype Design[-][/c], grants TIE Interceptor Foresight when an Empire, Inquisitorius, or Sith ally reinforces, and the allied Capital ship gains Turn Meter when the TIE Interceptor scores a critical hit.

The TIE Interceptor also introduces two new effects, [c][F0FF23]Ruthless[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Pursued Target[-][/c]. Ruthless is a buff that increases offensive capabilities while Pursued Target is a status effect which allows the TIE Interceptor to ignore Taunt to attack the units with Pursued Target. The TIE Interceptor also gains Turn Meter when it attacks enemies with Pursued Target.

Furthermore, as a leader of the Inquisitors, Darth Vader now reduces allied Empire Capital Ship cooldowns when TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype starts in reinforcements and TIE Advanced x1 is on the field. This effect is being added to the final tier of his Unique, [c][F0FF23]Advanced Targeting System[-][/c].

Earn TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype blueprints during the upcoming Conquest events!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_INTERCEPTOR_TITLE: The Empire's Inquisitors Join The Fleet
NEWSLETTER_TIEFIGHTERPILOT_DESC: The TIE Fighter Pilot has landed. Login daily this month to unlock this Imperial pilot. This relentless attacker is a great addition to Empire squads with the ability to call down a “TIE Strike,” dealing damage to all enemies and inflicting Buff immunity for 2 rounds. His two other abilities, “Targeting Computer” and “Evasive Maneuvers”, give great synergy with other Empire units who can debuff enemy squads.\n\nBe sure to login daily during the month of October and add this fearless pilot to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_TIEFIGHTERPILOT_TITLE: October’s Daily Login: TIE Fighter Pilot
NEWSLETTER_TOURNAMENT_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC: A new event is approaching! For more details on this event and its schedule check out the forum post found here https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/discussion/76100/event-information/
NEWSLETTER_TU1_BALANCE_CHANGES_CHANGELOG:
Greetings heroes!

We just released a major update to the balance of the game. Here are some details:

All units now have ability upgrades available. Make sure to go back to your Characters screen to check for new available upgrades!

All units have received a balance pass against their damage ratio values on damaging abilities. Underperforming units increased in damaging effectiveness whereas those over performing have been brought more in-line with intended results.

All Light and Dark Missions have been adjusted to accommodate for new unit balance changes.

Special Damage type abilities have been brought in-line with the Physical Damage type ability counterparts.

We expect that there may be some issues with ability behavior. As always, we will continue to release updates that include bug fixes for unit abilities.

We hope you will continue to enjoy Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes as we balance and improve the game to make it as fun and fair as we can!

-The Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes team
NEWSLETTER_TU1_CHANGES:
Attention Holotable masters, now you can build squads with all your favorite characters,regardless of alignment, with new Cantina Battles. Plus, check out these other new features:

Galactic War Mode – Unlocks at Level 40. Your characters’ health will not regenerate between battles!

Sim Tickets – These new reward drops, earned after scoring 3 stars on a mission, let you repeat missions to gain more rewards faster.

Updated Map – Get a look at the next boss you’ll face in Normal missions and which character shard you could earn in Hard missions.

Thanks for playing Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes. Let us know how we’re doing with a rating!
NEWSLETTER_TU11_QOL_DESC:
Get excited – everything you love just got better! Now you can:

• Earn the right to multi-sim Galactic War and Ship Challenges

• Receive bonus banners based on combat performance in Territory Wars 

• View which Territory War defensive squads were most successful 

• Search for units by name when selecting your squad

• Link accounts to play between Android and iOS devices

• Set inactive units as favorites and find all favorites easier

• Research and purchase shipments faster 

• View major improvements to the Raids Ticket (Daily) leaderboard

• and so much more!

Check out the full update notes over at the forums!
NEWSLETTER_TU12_DESC:
We've updated the Holotables and added some exciting new features!

Embark on Quests and tackle challenges from various Cantina characters and learn the lessons needed to become a Holotable champion! Demonstrate your mastery by completing an elite set of Prestigious Quests meant for only the strongest players to earn Player Titles and glory. Player Titles show your competitors the power of your collection and strategies!

Players can now join a Starter Guild beginning at level 22! Learn how Guilds work early with a Guild of players near your level before more advanced Guild content. Chat has also been updated to allow players to: send direct messages, create up to 5 Guild Chats, Exchange Gear directly in chat, and join Group Chats of up to 500 players. Guild leaders/officers can also now: schedule raid start times, raid damage allowed times, and Officers can now update the Guild Message in up to 5 Guild Chats.

Ships combat has been reworked! Prepare to take your Fleets to the next level with Reinforcement Abilities! All Ship ability kits and stats have also been reworked to make battles more exciting and strategic! Experience reworked Ships combat in Territory Wars, Territory Battles, Fleet Arena, and Ship Challenges. The Ship Ability Materials Challenge has been expanded to include a new tier where players can earn new rewards. We've also added 'Fleet Battles', a new Ships PvE table! Fleet Battles are locked for now, but are coming very soon. What Fleet will you choose to lead you to victory?
NEWSLETTER_TU12_TITLE: Improved Chat, Starter Guilds, Reworked Ship Combat, and much more!
NEWSLETTER_TU17_UPDATE02_SHIPS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Two brand new ships have landed on the holotables, the Galactic Republic’s [c][f0ff23]BTL-B Y-wing[-][/c] and the Separatist [c][f0ff23]Hyena Bomber[-][/c].

The BTL-B Y-wing is an aggressive bomber that can take a beating compared to the stripped down counter part used by the rebellion. Armed with proton bombs and a bubble turret to defend against incoming fighters, the Y-wing can attack even the most heavily defended targets and punch through the enemy’s Taunt. Get shards of the BTL-B Y-wing in an upcoming Marquee event!

The Separatists also gained a heavily armored bomber to assist their faction’s fleet. The Hyena Bomber is effective at protecting Vulture Droid allies and absorbing an incredible amount of fire power depending on how many Separatist and Droid allies are present but this droid controlled bomber is not just a tank. It can also launch salvos of Buzz Droids at the enemy to weaken their armor and provide allied Separatist ships powerful advantages. Get shards of the Hyena Bomber in the upcoming Galactic Chase starting Nov 1st!
NEWSLETTER_TU2_PVP_RANKED_REWARDS_DESC:
You will now earn Crystals, Arena Tokens, and Credits every day based on your ranking in the Arena. The better your position on the Leaderboard, the better your reward!
