NEWSLETTER_TU2_PVP_SEGMENTATION_DESC: Greetings players! We are changing the way that PvP leaderboards work in the game. Going forward, players will be segmented across multiple leaderboards and as a result, your rank may change.
NEWSLETTER_TU3_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC:
Greetings Heroes,

This latest update brings an exciting new challenge to players, the Grand Master’s Training Event. In this event you will be able to challenge Grand Master Yoda with a team of Jedi to earn Crystals, Credits and character shards for Grand Master Yoda himself!

Along with this new event comes new features such as the Shard Shop, a place where you can trade in excess shards you have for your 7 star characters, as well as various bug fixes and visual game improvements.

For complete details on this update please visit our forums at https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
NEWSLETTER_TU4_UPCOMING_FEATURES_01_DESC: Is your collection ready? Visit the forums to watch the all-new teaser video for our next major update!
NEWSLETTER_TU4_UPCOMING_FEATURES_02_DESC: More details on the next major update are available on the forums!
NEWSLETTER_TU4_UPCOMING_FEATURES_03_DESC: Are you ready for Guilds and Raids? Be sure to check out the forums to get more information on these exciting new features.
NEWSLETTER_TU4_UPCOMING_FEATURES_03_TITL: Guilds and Raids are almost here
NEWSLETTER_TUSKEN_SHAMAN_CHROMIUM_DESC:
Tusken Shaman is now available in Chromium Packs! This offensive healer is able to buff and heal his allies while rapidly inflicting Damage Over Time effects on his enemies.

Tusken Shaman is great for Tusken squads with his unique ability, “Master Storyteller”, providing all Tuskens with both Turn Meter and Health recovery for every defeated enemy. His abilities will also pair well with characters who debuff enemy units as each additional negative status effect increases his own abilities effectiveness!

Will you be adding this desert savage to your squad?
NEWSLETTER_TUSKEN_SHAMAN_CHROMIUM_TITLE: New Chromium Pack Character: Tusken Shaman
NEWSLETTER_TW_CLONE_WARS_DESC:
The Clone Wars era comes to the Territory Wars Holotable! For a limited time, Territory War bonuses have been upgraded and will affect the Territory Wars that begin on 11/3, 11/13, 11/17 and 11/27. Read on to see the high-level list of changes and be prepared for a new and exciting experience in your guild’s next Territory War…

New Specific Bonuses: The following characters will have specific bonuses in Territory Wars.

Characters: Mace Windu, General Grievous

Mystery Bonuses: Two characters (one Galactic Republic and one Separatist) have mystery bonuses you will only learn about when you enter your next Territory War.

For complete details, check out the details panel in Territory Wars or click the button below to go to the forums for a complete breakdown!
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_01_DESC: Territory Wars are coming soon! To prepare, check out these strategies that explain how to earn banners (points) to help secure victory for your Guild.
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_02_DESC: Before starting Territory Wars, you’ll want to assemble squads to defend your territories. Check out these recommendations on which characters make good defenders.
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_03_DESC: In Territory Wars, you will need to choose different squads to use on defense and offense. Check out these tips on which characters to reserve as attackers.
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_04_DESC: Certain territories in Territory Wars require ships. Here are some suggestions on which ships you might want to use.
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_05_DESC: The Guild that works together, wins together. Here are some valuable tips on effectively coordinating with your Guild members.
NEWSLETTER_TW_UPDATE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

We’re shaking things up in Territory Wars! We heard positive feedback from the community about the limited-time character bonuses for the 10th anniversary of The Clone Wars, so we're continuing on that path.

This upcoming Territory War has been created by YOU, the community! You've voted to determine which of your favorite characters to bring into battle and which ones will stay on the sidelines. Head over to the forums to find out if your favorite characters made the cut!

The forums also have more details on the current community-driven Territory Wars, and stay tuned there for future rounds of voting to help shape Territory Wars!
NEWSLETTER_UNITY_UPGRADE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today’s Update improves many of the underlying technologies that we use to create Galaxy of Heroes. These significant tech upgrades enable us to continue to support this amazing game for years to come and bring you the Star Wars experience better than ever.

It may seem like nothing has changed when you log in, but there are plenty of updates under the hood that allow for numerous improvements in the future. With a unified tool set and modernized APIs, these changes give the designers access to more tools and a smoother process for developing new content.

On the visual side, this update also enables us to create better character animations and cutscenes that truly capture the exciting moment of Star Wars. Some of those improvements you may have already seen in The Mandalorian characters or the Jedi Knight Luke event and this update allows us to do even more in the years to come.

This is a large, exciting update for the long term future of the game. We strive to provide you with the highest level of service because we believe in the game, and the community. That’s why we have invested time in upgrading the game’s technology, so we can all enjoy this game as passionate Star Wars fans for years to come.

Thank you all for your support!
NEWSLETTER_UNLOCKS_SEP_15_DESCRIPTION:
Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes includes many features that unlock as you collect characters and increase your Player Level. Here's the complete list of unlockable features and their requirements:

Light Side Battles: Use your light side characters to battle dark side characters. Unlocked at the beginning of the game.

Dark Side Battles: Use your dark side characters to battle light side characters. Unlocked after reaching Player Level 12 and collecting 3 or more dark side characters.

Squad Arena: Battle other players' squads using any characters in your Collection. Unlocked at Player Level 8.

Challenges: Uniquely difficult Battles that drop unique rewards. Unlocks at Player Level 15.

Galactic War: Fight a multi-battle campaign where character health does not regenerate to unlock various rewards. Unlocks at Player Level 40.

Events And Keys: Collect Keys that allow you to fight in Event Battles that drop valuable rewards. Unlocks at Player Level 52.

We will be adding more features over the coming months.
NEWSLETTER_UPCOMING_CHARACTER_CHANGES_DE:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

In today's Update, Darth Vader, General Skywalker, Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker, and Wat Tambor have had several changes to their kits in regards to ignoring Defense. Previously, we returned the resources used to upgrade these units beyond Relic 7 to your inbox and reset these units to Relic 7.

We have also updated several kits with Galactic Legends exceptions in addition to Raid Bosses exceptions. Related to this change, Dark Trooper was reset to Relic 5 if you had upgraded Dark Trooper beyond this level and any resources used to upgrade Dark Trooper above Relic 5 were returned to your inbox in the last Update.

Please visit the Official Forums for more information.
NEWSLETTER_UPDATED_CANTINA_ENERGY_MESSAG: With the introduction of Mods, we have reworked how Cantina Energy is refreshed. Previously, Cantina Energy refreshes scaled in cost far more aggressively than standard Energy refreshes. With this update we have brought the cost to refresh Cantina Energy down significantly so you can get the Shards, Ability Materials, and Mods you need!\n\nWe hope that you enjoy this change!
NEWSLETTER_UPDATED_WEBSITE_DESC: The official website for Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes has been revamped and now includes pages for game Strategies and Community contributions. Be sure to bookmark it in your browser and check in every week for new content.
NEWSLETTER_VADER_REWORK_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nExcuse the heavy breathing, but we are excited to announce a rework of [c][F0FF23]Darth Vader[-][/c], the man behind the galaxy's most iconic mask, infamous Sith Lord, and a dad who just wants to spend more time with his son. Counted on as the Emperor's most loyal subject, Darth Vader relishes destroying his foes, squashing rebellions, and reminding pompous subordinates to not "choke" on their aspirations. Although he's more machine now than man, there's always room for improvement. As such, Vader will be getting an entirely new ability, [c][F0FF23]Merciless Massacre[-][/c]. Look for the Vader rework just in time for "I Am Your Father's" Day, and together...you can rule the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_VULTURE_DROID_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

The Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid, also known as the [c][F0FF23]Vulture Droid[-][/c], is coming to the holotables! This Droid starfighter, commonly used by the Trade Federation, is a fast and agile attacker that is easily damaged, but also easily replaced. These mass-produced ships are capable of launching Buzz Droids at enemy ships and ripping through their armor, weakening it for further attacks. For the first time on the holotables, this ship doesn’t require any crew, which means you can unlock the Vulture Droid and use it to reinforce your armada immediately. Bolster your fleet with this Separatist starfighter today!

See you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_WEDGE_CANTINA_MISSION_MESSAGE: Wedge is now available in Cantina Stage 6 Mission F. This talented Corellian Rebel pilot was a veteran of the attacks on both Death Stars. A leader in Red Squadron, Wedge, is a Rebel attacker with strong offensive abilities that deal more damage based enemy health and debuffs, while providing increased offence and health recovery to Rebel allies.\n\nWill you be adding this Rebel pilot to your squad?
NEWSLETTER_WEDGE_CANTINA_MISSION_TITLE: Wedge is now available in the Cantina Battles!
NEWSLETTER_WICKET_ATST_EVENT_DESC: Welcome our final addition to the Ewok invasion - Wicket arrives in the Galaxy of Heroes! This powerful attacker finds his strength in numbers, granting incredible critical hit and stealth synergies to Ewok squads, while also dealing more critical damage for each Ewok present. In addition, Wicket's unique, Furtive Tactics, gives Wicket a chance to take another turn, each turn.\n\nTo celebrate Wickets arrival, we're introducing a brand new type of event, the Heroic Battle. Heroic Battles will have players fighting huge enemies and earning unique rewards in a recurring event. The first time the AT-ST appears it will yield rare Mods. Future appearances of the AT-ST will be players' source to obtain Wicket shards! Be on the lookout for future appearances of the AT-ST!
NEWSLETTER_WICKET_ATST_EVENT_TITLE: Wicket Arrives and the AT-ST Heroic Battle
NEWSLETTER_WRECKER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes!

[c][F0FF23]Wrecker[-][/c], the resilient and dauntless commando of Clone Force 99 has joined the Holotables! 

This extra large genetically engineered soldier protects his Clone Trooper and Bad Batch allies with a ferocity and strength that few other clones possess. After taking damage from his enemies, Wrecker turns his [c][F0FF23]Fury[-][/c] into a new undispellable buff, [c][F0FF23]Furious[-][/c], which boosts his abilities with additional effects.

Wrecker’s large stature and demeanor means he is not particularly suited for sneaking around and there are few words he hates more than "stealth". In battle, whenever Wrecker gains Stealth, he dispels it and gains Taunt. Wrecker would much rather rip enemy droids apart with his hands, use another droid as a melee weapon, or just blow the whole thing up. "Quiet" is not part of this clone’s vocabulary.

Unlock Wrecker in the all new Marquee event: [c][F0FF23]Clone Force 99 III[-][/c]

PLAYER_AGE_UP_MESSAGE_KEY:
Hi Holotable Hero,

Congratulations! We noticed that you are no longer a minor and have updated your account status to reflect your new rank of Adult.

You now have access to the following features:
You can now chat with other players in the game
Receive Push notifications on your device to remind you about events
Connect your account to Facebook
Create a Guild and become a Guild Leader or Officer
You can edit your in game name (Don’t use your real name!)
Send email invites to add allies to your friends list (excluded in some countries)

See you on the Holotables!

PLAYERPORTRAIT_501STARCTROOPER_DESC: Earned by getting 36 Stars in a single "Geonosis: Republic Offensive" Territory Battle.\n\nScore one for the Republic!
PLAYERPORTRAIT_501STCREST_DESC: Earned by completing the "Sky Guy" Quest.\n\nThe 501st fought by General Skywalker's side and turned the tide in many battles throughout the Clone Wars.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_501STCREST_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Star Fighter" Achievement.\n\nThe 501st fought by General Skywalker's side and turned the tide in many battles throughout the Clone Wars.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_ACKLAY_DESC: Earned by defeating the Acklay Special Mission in the "Geonosis: Separatist Might" Territory Battle.\n\nAcklays were used as execution beasts by the Geonosians in the Petranaki Arena. While usually effective, one met its match when it attempted to kill the wrong Jedi.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_AURRASING_DESC: Earned for defeating "Galactic Bounties I" event Deadly Bounty (G11+) tier.\n\nYou don't have to be a ruthless, trigger-happy assassin to succeed as a bounty hunter, but it certainly helps.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_B1BATTLEDROID_DESC: Earned by completing the "Droid Factory" Quest.\n\n"Roger, roger" is more nuanced than the average commander realizes.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_B28_DESC: Earned by completing the "Enemies of the Old Republic" Feat.\n\nLegends tell of a Sith Empire which spanned the galaxy.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_BASTILA_DESC: Earned by defeating the "Legend of the Old Republic: Ancient Journey" event (Tier IV).\n\nIn unity there is strength.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_BASTILASHAN_DARK_DESC: Earned by completing the "Path to Darkness" quest.\n\nFear of the dark side is a tool of control.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_BB8_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Top Secret" Feat. \n\nBB-8 is an excellent confidant for confidential information.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_BOSSK_DESC: Earned by completing the "Bounty Hunter (7 of 7)" Prestigious Quest.\n\nHunt your prey like a Bossk.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_BOUNTYHUNTER_DESC: Earned by completing the "Bounty Hunter (1 of 7)" Prestigious Quest.\n\nThere's no rest for the wicked, but at least you get paid overtime.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_C3PO_DESC: Earned by defeating Tier 7 of the Contact Protocol event.\n\nIt turns out there are over seven million ways to say "we're doomed."
PLAYERPORTRAIT_CADBANE_DESC: Earned by completing the "Bounty Hunter (6 of 7)" Prestigious Quest.\n\nAny job for the right price.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_CANTINAKEEPER_DESC: Earned by completing the "Shipments en Route" quest.\n\nThe Cantina keeper is always a good host, greeting patrons with cold refreshments, lively holotables and a new tutorial or three.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_CAPTIVEJEDI_DESC: Earned by completing the "Ancient Cartographer" Quest\n\nLegends say Q'rnaf B'lair may have fallen defending the Jedi Enclave from Malak.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_CAPTIVEJEDI_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Challenger" Achievement in the Star Forge Showdown.\n\nLegends say Q'rnaf B'lair may have fallen defending the Jedi Enclave from Malak.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_CHEWBACCA_DESC: Earned by completing the "One Famous Wookiee" Legendary Event (Tier VII).\n\nAs far as backup plans go, "having a Wookiee on your side" is a pretty good one.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_CLONETROOPERS_DESC: Earned by completing the "Three of a Kind" Feat.\n\nBack on Kamino, they've got a full house.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_CODY_DESC: Earned by completing the "Order 66" Feat.\n\nOrder 66 was one of 150 orders memorized by each clone trooper in the Galactic Republic.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_DARKSIDEHISTORIAN_DESC: Earned by defeating Tier III of the Emperor's Demise Mythic event.\n\nThose who learn from the past have the power to repeat it.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_DARTHMALAK_DESC: Earned by owning 7-Star Darth Malak.\n\nHe entered the darkness to save the light, but never came back.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_DARTHREVAN_DESC: Earned by completing the "Scourge of the Old Republic" event.\n\n"I have come to reclaim what is mine."
PLAYERPORTRAIT_DEFAULT_DESC: Begin your journey!\n\nThere is pride in being a unique and important part of the Grand Army of the Republic... just like every other Clone Trooper.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_DENGAR_DESC: Earned by completing the "Bounty Hunter (5 of 7)" Prestigious Quest.\n\nThe freedom and adventure of being a bounty hunter is its own reward, but a big heap of illicit credits is pretty good, too.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_DESTROYER_DESC: Earned by winning 1000 Fleet Arena battles.\n\nIf at first you don't succeed, consider orbital bombardment.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_EIGHTH_BROTHER_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the "Ruthless Efficiency IV" marquee event.\n\nLoyal and fierce, Eighth Brother was never afraid to strike first—proving himself to be an ideal Inquisitor for the Empire.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_EMBO_DESC: Earned for defeating "Galactic Bounties II" event Deadly Bounty (G12) tier.\n\nReady to fight at the drop of a hat.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_ESB1_DESC: Earned by completing the "Hoth Veterans" Feat.\n\nThe battle of Hoth was a major blow to the Rebellion, but a hollow victory for the Empire.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_ESB2_DESC: Earned by completing the "Tundra Predation" Feat.\n\nInsatiable appetite accompanied by vicious claws.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_ESB3_DESC: Earned by completing the "I Want That Ship" Feat.\n\nDarth Vader's use of bounty hunters over the Empire's own troops was cause for much dissension in the ranks.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_ESB3_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "I Want That Ship" Feat and in the Conquest Pass for Conquest 10.\n\nDarth Vader's use of bounty hunters over the Empire's own troops was cause for much dissension in the ranks.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_ESB4_DESC: Earned by completing the "Bespin Occupation" Feat.\n\nFollowing the carbon freezing of Han Solo, Lando Calrissian ceded control of the mining operation on Bespin to the Empire.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_ESB4_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Bespin Occupation" Feat and in the Conquest Pass for Conquest 13.\n\nFollowing the carbon freezing of Han Solo, Lando Calrissian ceded control of the mining operation on Bespin to the Empire.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_FINN_DESC: Earned by completing the "Brotherhood of the Traveling Jacket" Feat. \n\n"It looks good on you."
PLAYERPORTRAIT_FIRSTORDER_TIE_DESC: Earned by completing the "Fleet Battles" quest.\n\nThey probably didn't intend to make the engine scream like that, but nobody's complaining.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_FIRSTORDER_TIE_DESC_V2: Earned by completing the "Fleet Battles" Achievement.\n\nThey probably didn't intend to make the engine scream like that, but nobody's complaining.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_FLEETCOMMANDERS_DESC: Earned by completing the "Fleet Commander" Feat.\n\nSome do it for glory, others do it for the fancy nametag.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_FOEXECUTIONER_DESC: Earned by completing the "Execution Squad" Feat.\n\nSome troopers would do anything to get ahead.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_FULCRUM_DESC: Earned by completing the "Fulcrum Agent (4 of 4)" Prestigious Quest.\n\nThe center of balance... or the leverage to move worlds.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC10_PORT_1_DESC: Earned by completing the "Line of Succession" feat.\n\nLessons are learned from Master and passed to Padawan, and so the cycle continues.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC10_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "The Council will act as they deem necessary" feat.\n\nThe Jedi Council was the ruling body of the Jedi Order.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC11_PORT_1_DESC: Earned by completing the "Witches of the Mist" Feat.\n\nThe Nightsisters were an order of magick-wielding females from Dathomir, a planet with immensely powerful sensitivity to the dark side of the Force.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC11_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "The Coven's Secrets" Feat.\n\nDark magick combined with the potency of the dark side of the Force, a powerful but insatiable combination.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC11_PORT_3_DESC: Earned by completing the "Retribution" Feat.\n\nThe deceptive acts of the Nightsisters cannot go unpunished.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC12_PORT_1_DESC: Earned by completing the "The Guild" Feat.\n\nGreef worked with The Guild to offer jobs through bounty pucks.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC12_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "Our Identity" Feat.\n\nThe durability of beskar is unmatched.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC13_PORT_1_DESC: Earned by completing the "Utinni!" feat.\n\nThe Jawas have a tendency to pick up anything that's not tied down.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC13_PORT_2_DESC: Earned by completing the "Built Loyalty" Feat.\n\nI am fulfilling my base function. To nurse and protect.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_GAC17_PORT_1_DESC: Earned by completing the "A Risky Gamble" feat.\n\nExperimental unit Clone Force 99. They're defective clones with desirable mutations.

Iden gained a mastery of combat and flight at the Future Imperial Leaders Military Preparatory School on her home world of Vardos.

PROTECTORS_OF_THE_CHILD_SHARD_PACK_NAME: PROTECTORS OF THE CHILD SHARD PACK
Protocol_Activate_Ewok_Scout_QUEST_DESC: I guess I'll have to teach you everything...\n\nActivate your Ewok Scout now and train them so you can grow your Light Side roster!
Protocol_Activate_Ewok_Scout_QUEST_DESC_: I guess I'll have to teach you everything...\n\nActivate Rey (Scavenger) now and train them so you can grow your Light Side roster!
Protocol_Activate_Ewok_Scout_QUEST_REWAR: Unlocking characters is easy once you have their Character Shards.
Protocol_Activate_Royal_Guard_QUEST_DESC: You again...\n\nI thought you knew how this works by now. Activate Royal Guard to unlock a Dark Side character.
You again...\n\nI thought you knew how this works by now. Activate Kylo Ren (Unmasked) to unlock a Dark Side character.
Protocol_Activate_Royal_Guard_QUEST_REWA: My master, Fey Zara will not be pleased if I am not training players properly.\n\nYou better remember how to activate characters, or I'll be sandcrawler-scrap!
Protocol_Cantina_Shipments_QUEST_DESC: The best way to unlock a new character quickly is to buy its shards every day from one of the stores.\n\nTry making a purchase in the Cantina Battles Store using currency earned by doing Cantina Battles.
Protocol_Cantina_Shipments_QUEST_REWARDS: My advice is to focus on one character a time.
Protocol_Claim_Daily_Login_QUEST_DESC: You're here... Pity. I don't actually like you.\n\nWell, come back every day to collect a Daily Login Reward. Or don't!
Protocol_Claim_Daily_Login_QUEST_REWARDS: So you got a login reward, big deal.\n\nI've logged in every day this month, that's how I got the most rewards.
Protocol_Complete_Daily_Activities_3_QUE: Completing Daily Activities should be in your programming by now.\n\nWe could always wipe your data.
If you think that is too easy, try a Galactic War.
Protocol_Complete_Daily_Activities_4_QUE: I swear, these Cantina players get more bold every battle.\n\nYou don't have any hope of keeping up.
You just got a ton of experience by completing your Daily Activities, I don't see why you would care about my vocal processors calling you hopeless.
Protocol_Complete_Daily_Activities_5_QUE: My chassis is sparking!\n\nI have sprung an electrical leak and require your assistance, but Fey says you have to do your daily activities first. Help!
It's a good thing you're getting faster at those -- I might have melted.
Protocol_Complete_Daily_Activities_6_QUE: Complete Daily Activities and collect those rewards.\n\nOne of these days your Daily Activities will shift parameters, but not yet.
Daily Activities are like your daily maintenance.
Protocol_Complete_Daily_Activities_7_QUE: Daily... Activities... Activities... Activities.\n\nProcessors... overloaded... ... ... on-on... your... own-own...
... Loading ... Eh Hmm... Do you mind?
Protocol_Complete_Daily_Activities_QUEST: I swear, these Cantina players get more bold every battle.\n\nYou don't have any hope ... hope hope hope ... of keeping up.
I'm just assigned to you, I don't see why you would care about my vocal processors.
Protocol_Daily_Activities_2_QUEST_DESC: Complete Daily Activities for rewards.\n\nI want to make sure you're worth my time, so you better prove yousrelf.
Protocol_Daily_Activities_2_QUEST_REWARD: Daily Activities are a good source for bonus XP.
Protocol_Daily_Activities_2_TASK_DESC_1: Complete all Daily Activities in a single day
Protocol_Daily_Activities_QUEST_DESC: ... work-work... nice work... What? Why are you staring? I do say! You don't have time for this!\n\nYou'll have to finish those Daily Activities if you want to impress anyone around here!
Protocol_Daily_Activities_QUEST_REWARDS: You may be of some use yet.\n\nCompleting your dailies every day is the fastest way to level up.
Protocol_Daily_Login_QUEST_DESC: Login daily for rewards and energy.\n\nMy power cells are depleted... powering down to recharge.
Protocol_Equip_Gear_QUEST_DESC: Let's see if you can figure out the difference between a Chiewab Hypo Syringe and a Loronar Power Cell.\n\nEquip some more gear, if you can figure it out!
Protocol_Equip_Gear_QUEST_DESC_V2: Let's see if you can figure out the difference between a Chiewab Hypo Syringe and a Loronar Power Cell.\n\nUpgrade a character's gear level, if you can figure it out!
Protocol_Equip_Gear_QUEST_REWARDS: Not bad. At least you didn't install a droid caller using bacta gel like the last player!
Protocol_Equip_Gear_TASK_DESC_1_V2: Upgrade a character's gear level 1 time.
Protocol_Galactic_War_Store_QUEST_DESC: Oh! Don’t sneak up on me like that!
Protocol_Galactic_War_Store_QUEST_REWARD: My name is... Oh, it's you.
Protocol_Gear_1_QUEST_DESC: I thought you would give up by now.\n\n If you're up to it, try to equip some Gear to a character. Should be simple enough, even for you.
Protocol_Gear_1_QUEST_REWARDS: I guess I'll have to give you a more challenging quest. Let's see: defeat a Rancor, conquer Hoth... ha! You're not ready for those yet.
Protocol_Guild_Event_Store_QUEST_DESC: Spend Guild Event tokens to acquire great Gear and Character shards.\n\nGuild events rotate periodically.
Protocol_Guild_Event_Store_QUEST_REWARDS: If you ever need a good protocol droid in your Guild you know where to find me.
Protocol_Guild_Store_2_QUEST_DESC: Spend Guild Tokens on Gear and Character Shards.\n\nI was in a Guild of Droids once, they should have made me leader...
Protocol_Guild_Store_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Well at least I get to boss you around...
Protocol_Guild_Store_2_TASK_DESC_1: Spend 400 Guild Tokens in the Guild Store
Protocol_Guild_Store_3_QUEST_DESC: It’s quite possible your success is entirely due to my guidance.
Protocol_Guild_Store_3_QUEST_REWARDS: If Guild Tokens could talk, all mine would say are "Goodbye!" But in binary for extra flair.
Protocol_Guild_Store_QUEST_DESC: Head to the Guild Store for useful Gear and character shards, some of which is only easily found there.\n\nDo Guild activities and Raids to earn more Guild Store Tokens.
Protocol_Guild_Store_QUEST_REWARDS: Where's that drinks Droid? It's always causing trouble!
Protocol_Guild_Store_TASK_DESC_1: Spend 400 Guild Tokens to purchase a Guild Store item
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_1_QUEST_DESC: Oh, delightful -- you seek the Cantina title of JEDI KNIGHT! Fey will be most pleased.\n\nComplete these tasks to begin your journey.
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_1_QUEST_REWARDS: My word, your lightsaber skills with your Jedi are most impressive!\n\nKeep going and I'm sure you'll make JEDI KNIGHT!
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_1_TASK_DESC_3: Have Jedi Consular's Starfighter at 7 Stars
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_2_QUEST_DESC: Rumors had it that a JEDI KNIGHT was invincible. I'm not so sure: all the reason to ensure two of the most famed Jedi are fully powered-up on the Holotable!
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Jedi Knight Anakin is indeed looking fearsome!\n\nI'm not sure I'd want to provoke him...
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_2_TASK_DESC_1: Win 10 Squad Arena battles with Jedi
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_2_TASK_DESC_1_V2: Win 10 Squad Arena battles with only Jedi
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_2_TASK_DESC_2: Get Jedi Knight Anakin to Gear tier XII
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_2_TASK_DESC_3: Get General Kenobi to Gear tier XII
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_2_TASK_NAME_2: No One Can Kill a Jedi
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_3_QUEST_DESC: Goodness me, thankfully Jedi mind tricks don't work on droids! Though I have never met a Jedi.\n\nContinue the JEDI KNIGHT path and face the Separatists!
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_3_QUEST_REWARDS: It's no Jedi mind trick how well you're progressing! Great work, keep going.\n\nJust one more quest to earn the JEDI KNIGHT title!
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_3_TASK_DESC_1: Get Old Ben Kenobi to Gear tier XII
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_4_QUEST_DESC: Oh, how exciting! This is it! Complete these Jedi acrobatics to earn the Cantina title JEDI KNIGHT! You're so close!
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_4_QUEST_REWARDS: My word, Fey will be so pleased! Congratulations!\n\nYou earned the title Jedi Knight! Now keep going to earn the title JEDI MASTER!
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_4_TASK_DESC_1: Get 10 Jedi characters to Gear tier XI
Protocol_Jedi_Knight_4_TASK_DESC_2: Earn Rank 10 or better 5 times in Heroic AAT
Protocol_Jedi_Master_1_QUEST_DESC: Greetings, Jedi Knight! Your next task is to earn the title JEDI MASTER!\n\nYou'll need geared-up Jedi to pack a powerful punch to the AAT...
Protocol_Jedi_Master_1_QUEST_REWARDS: That AAT looks sad now that you've turned it into scrap.\n\nBut you're one step closer to becoming a JEDI MASTER!
Protocol_Jedi_Master_1_TASK_DESC_1: Earn Rank 3 or better 3 times in Heroic AAT
Protocol_Jedi_Master_1_TASK_DESC_2: Get 5 Jedi to Gear Tier XII
Protocol_Jedi_Master_1_TASK_DESC_3: Have Ahsoka Tano's Jedi Starfighter at 7 Stars
Protocol_Jedi_Master_2_QUEST_DESC: Qui-Gon Jinn was a revered JEDI MASTER. You'll have to defeat many Separatists to progress, just as he did.\n\nTrust your Jedi instincts!
Protocol_Jedi_Master_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Qui-Gon Jinn is cleaning up the Separatist forces.\n\nHe doesn't even need his Padawan! My, you're halfway to becoming a JEDI MASTER!
Protocol_Jedi_Master_2_TASK_DESC_1: Win 20 Squad Arena battles with Qui-Gon Jinn
Protocol_Jedi_Master_2_TASK_DESC_2: Get Qui-Gon Jinn to Gear XII
Protocol_Jedi_Master_3_QUEST_DESC: Only a JEDI MASTER can face General Grievous. You must face him with a full squad of Jedi.\n\nI predict the odds... oh nevermind, you'll sm-sm-smash!
Protocol_Jedi_Master_3_QUEST_REWARDS: You sliced and diced those holo-foes into bits and bytes!\n\nGreat work! Just a little more to earn JEDI MASTER!
Protocol_Jedi_Master_3_TASK_DESC_1: Defeat 200 Sith with Grand Master Yoda
Protocol_Jedi_Master_4_QUEST_DESC: This is the final challenge before becoming a JEDI MASTER.\n\nYou'll need two squads of geared Jedi, be ready to lead your armies to success!
Protocol_Jedi_Master_4_QUEST_REWARDS: You earned the title JEDI MASTER! I'll get the Kalpa sea-thread cake ready to celebrate.\n\nThe cake costs credits and tip is expected. Congratulations!!!
Protocol_Jedi_Master_4_TASK_DESC_1: Get 10 Jedi to Gear tier XII
Protocol_Level_Characters_10_QUEST_DESC: The Cantina Keeper said you have to keep up with your Training.\n\nI suppose this is better than serving drinks to the Cantina.
Protocol_Level_Characters_10_QUEST_REWAR: If you see that Astromech tell him to stay out of my charging station.
Protocol_Level_Characters_11_QUEST_DESC: Greetings Mol Eliza, my name is B7-N5 human-cyborg relations.\n\n... what? Of course I remember your name. My memory processors are functioning perfectly.
Protocol_Level_Characters_11_QUEST_REWAR: Take these rewards so I do not have to carry them.
Protocol_Level_Characters_3_QUEST_DESC: It's not-not-not my fault.\n\nYou have to earn training droids faster than you spend them.
Protocol_Level_Characters_3_QUEST_REWARD: You'll never catch up to the other Holotable players if you don't keep... leveling up... your characters.
Protocol_Level_Characters_4_QUEST_DESC: Keep your top 5 characters at a high level to excel in Cantina Battles\n\nAn oil bath is a luxury you cannot comprehend.
Protocol_Level_Characters_4_QUEST_REWARD: That Hutt keeps bragging about how he's the best Fleet Arena player in the Cantina...
Protocol_Level_Characters_5_QUEST_DESC: The best way to win is to train five characters up to your player level.\n\nNot that you'll listen to me anyways.
Protocol_Level_Characters_5_QUEST_REWARD: Keep training your characters to win Holo battles.
Protocol_Level_Characters_6_QUEST_DESC: Train characters to excel in Holotable battles.\n\nIf I may, Holotables in this cantina have been known to flicker... my theory is that they reset occasionally.
Protocol_Level_Characters_6_QUEST_REWARD: A reset for a Droid, however, is not a good idea.
Protocol_Level_Characters_7_QUEST_DESC: Train characters to level 40 to prepare for Galactic War.\n\nThe Galactic War table pits you against the squads of other players.
Protocol_Level_Characters_7_QUEST_REWARD: At this rate, you’ll land me in the scrap heap… or my master will sell me to junk traders.
Protocol_Level_Characters_8_QUEST_DESC: I suggest a new strategy: Let the other Holotable players win.
Protocol_Level_Characters_8_QUEST_REWARD: If you see Fey Zara, let her know I'm overdue for maintenance.
Protocol_Level_Characters_9_QUEST_DESC: That Hutt spilled Bantha milk on me, now I need maintenance.
Protocol_Level_Characters_9_QUEST_REWARD: Someone should teach him some manners.
Protocol_Level_Characters_QUEST_DESC: Pleased to meet you, I'm B7-N5. I'll give you some pointers as the new player around.\n\nTrain the Jedi Consular to level 2 to increase his power.
Protocol_Level_Characters_QUEST_DESC_V2: Pleased to meet you, I'm B7-N5. I'll give you some pointers as the new player around.\n\nTrain Ahsoka Tano to level 2 to increase her power.
Protocol_Level_Characters_QUEST_REWARDS: Congratulations! You'll need to train characters often to win more difficult battles!
Protocol_Mod_Store_QUEST_DESC: Collect Mods and assign them to key characters.\n\nIf you need help assigning Mods go talk to Dr. M'ak Nar.
Protocol_Mods_2_QUEST_DESC: Have you seen my Speed Data-Bus? It was right here?
Protocol_Mods_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Are you sure these are all your mods? Is one of them a Speed Data-Bus?
Protocol_Mods_3_QUEST_DESC: Don’t short-circuit, but you need to know that the Ships Room of the Cantina is only for players at level 65 or higher.
Protocol_Mods_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Garudda the Hutt can be ruthless, watch your step in the Ships room.
Protocol_Mods_4_QUEST_DESC: Upgrade Mods to unlock their maximum power.\n\nI've had some special modifications of my own.
Protocol_Mods_4_QUEST_REWARDS: You voided your warranty by upgrading too much and must now reset.\n\nI jest. I am working on my humor module, but perhaps it too needs an upgrade!
Protocol_Mods_5_QUEST_DESC: Fey once modded me for Speed so I could serve customers faster.\n\nI think she removed them during my recharge cycle.
Protocol_Mods_5_QUEST_REWARDS: Acquire Mods to boost your favorite characters.
Protocol_Omega_2_QUEST_DESC: Max out your character's abilities with Omega materials.\n\nI will be rooting for Garudda the Hutt in the next Territory War.
Protocol_Omega_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Well, maybe you beat Garudda the Hutt, but that still does not make us friends.
Protocol_Omega_3_QUEST_DESC: Do you hear that? Sounds like a stray Loth-cat.
Protocol_Omega_3_QUEST_REWARDS: I will never understand why your lot keeps pets.
Protocol_Omega_QUEST_DESC: Keep an eye out for Omega events and complete your Daily Activities to earn extra Omega materials.
Protocol_Omega_QUEST_REWARDS: I am not your personal event coordinator.
Protocol_Open_Data_Card_QUEST_DESC: Open a Data Card in the store if you think you can figure that out.\n\nSome data cards are free. Open data cards for Gear, Credits, Character Shards and more.
Protocol_Open_Data_Card_QUEST_REWARDS: Save some Data Cards for the rest of us!
Protocol_Promote_2_QUEST_DESC: Promoting a character helps your progress in any table you use them in.\n\nThe Squad Arena table has been crowded lately, I wonder why.
Protocol_Promote_2_QUEST_REWARDS: Do try to get along with the other customers.
Protocol_Promote_3_QUEST_DESC: Choose your favorite characters and focus on getting shards for them to speed up Promotion.\n\nI was once promoted to inventory manager...
Protocol_Promote_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Unlike your characters, a Droid's promotion isn't always a good thing.
Protocol_Promote_4_QUEST_DESC: I most certainly do not need your help.\n\nI'm operating perfectly within my parameters.
Protocol_Promote_4_QUEST_REWARDS: I'm fluent in over 6 million languages and I still find Holotable players puzzling.
Protocol_Promote_5_QUEST_DESC: I scrub the Holotables every day and you lot keep spilling everywhere.
Protocol_Promote_5_QUEST_REWARDS: Third class Droids get no respect.
Protocol_Promote_6_QUEST_DESC: My master is upset about a confrontation that took place in the Cantina last night.
Protocol_Promote_6_QUEST_REWARDS: Could you keep an eye out for Fey Zara?
Protocol_Promote_Jedi_Consular_QUEST_DES: Promote the Jedi Consular to increase his power.\n\nYou’re not the first holotable player I’ve had to explain this to...
Promote Ahsoka Tano to increase her power.\n\nYou're not the first holotable player I've had to explain this to ...
Protocol_Promote_Jedi_Consular_QUEST_REW: Now that you know how to promote a character, try to save it in your memory banks - if you can!
Protocol_Promote_QUEST_DESC: Next step: Promote a character\n\nThis may just be fun and games to you, but I’m serious, it’s my job to help you.
Protocol_Refresh_Cantina_Energy_2_QUEST_: Holotable players always want more energy, but if you ask me...
Reactor leaks have been known to cause brief Holotable outages.
Protocol_Refresh_Cantina_Energy_2_TASK_D: Refresh or Claim Cantina Energy 10 times
Protocol_Refresh_Cantina_Energy_QUEST_DE: Not now! Can’t you see you have a quest to complete?
Protocol_Refresh_Cantina_Energy_QUEST_RE: By my calculations this is your 100th quest completed.
Protocol_Refresh_Cantina_Energy_TASK_DES: Refresh or Claim Cantina Energy 3 times
Protocol_Refresh_Energy_QUEST_REWARDS: Take it from a Droid, missing energy recharge cycles ends up wasting Energy.
Protocol_Refresh_Energy_TASK_DESC_1: Refresh or Claim bonus energy 3 times
Protocol_Shard_Shop_2_QUEST_DESC: By my calculations you have amassed extra shards, trade them in at the Shard Shop to acquire Gear and Characters.
Protocol_Shard_Shop_2_QUEST_REWARDS: My master is big into recycling, no wasted Shards in this Cantina.
Protocol_Shard_Shop_QUEST_DESC: Nobody tells me anything, I just know how to listen carefully.
Protocol_Shard_Shop_QUEST_REWARDS: You get the pleasure of benefitting from my attentiveness.
Protocol_Sim_Battles_14_QUEST_DESC: Sim four battles to gain quick rewards.\n\nWhile you're doing that, I'll get an automated oil bath and de-carbonization buffing...
Protocol_Sim_Battles_14_QUEST_REWARDS: You're back already? I haven't even started my oil bath cause of you.\n\nAs you can see, simming a battle earns rewards way faster.
Protocol_Sim_Battles_9_QUEST_DESC: Hurry up! Sim battles that you've earned 3 stars on for immediate rewards!\n\nThe possibility of successfully earning 3 stars on all battles is approximately 3,720 to 1.
Protocol_Sim_Battles_9_QUEST_REWARDS: Sim Tickets don't grow on trees, you know! Use your sim tickets to earn the most important rewards quickly.
Protocol_Training_1_QUEST_DESC: Fey tasked me to help new players. I'll give you Quests to become a better Holotable player.\n\nTrain a character to increase their power!
Protocol_Training_1_QUEST_REWARDS: Oh my!\n\nYou managed to complete the Quest -- here are your rewards!
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_1_QUEST_DESC: Upgrade Character abilities to increase their effectiveness.\n\nI could use a good upgrade as well!
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_1_QUEST_DESC_: Upgrade Character abilities to increase their effectiveness. Ability upgrade materials can be found in Cantina Battles.\n\nI could use a good upgrade as well!
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_2_QUEST_DESC: Upgrade 4 abilities so I can tell the Cantina Keeper you're keeping up.\n\nReally you should be upgrading abilities without me reminding you.
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_2a_QUEST_DESC: Upgrade abilities regularly to prepare for difficult battles.\n\nEveryone requires maintenance sometimes.
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_2a_QUEST_REWA: I guess your memory banks haven't failed yet.
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_3_QUEST_DESC: I am the Droid you’re looking for.
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_3_QUEST_REWAR: Wait, is there another Droid you're looking for?
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_4_QUEST_DESC: Revisit the stores if you’re stuck, many contain gear to help you along.
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_4_QUEST_REWAR: Give me Mk III, I really want to upgrade my Droid abilities.\n\nWhat, you thought I didn't have a holotable squad?
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_5_QUEST_DESC: My servos squeaking?!\n\nCould you spare some materials for an upgrade?
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_5_QUEST_REWAR: Don’t short-circuit, here are your rewards.
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_7_QUEST_DESC: Greetings, my name is B7-N5, human-cyborg relations.\n\nHah, my memory processors appear to be functioning.
Protocol_Upgrade_Abilities_7_QUEST_REWAR: Take these items so I do not have to carry them.

RAID_TRIUMVIRATE_DESC: [23c8f5]Hidden away on Malachor V lies the Trayus Academy, ancient training ground of the Sith. There, three fearsome Sith Lords formed an alliance to train a new generation of Sith and crush the Jedi Order once and for all. To venture into the depths and face the Sith Triumvirate is to face certain doom.[-]
RAID_TRIUMVIRATE_PROMOTION: Earn Rare Gear and \nDarth Traya Shards!
RAID_TUTORIAL_FORTIFY_MSG_1: In this phase, some of your characters will be able to use [c][ffff33]Unbreakable Will[-][/c] to protect the team.
RAID_TUTORIAL_FORTIFY_MSG_2: After someone uses [c][ffff33]Unbreakable Will[-][/c], all enemies will target them for one turn, but they will survive ANY attack, no matter what - even Annihilate!
RAID_TUTORIAL_FORTIFY_MSG_3: Normally, [c][ffff33]Unbreakable Will[-][/c] can only be used once, but you can defeat [c][309AF5]Menacing[-][/c] minions to reuse it!
RAID_TUTORIAL_GRANTED_ABILITY_MSG_1: In the Sith Triumvirate Raid, there is no Escape Ability. Instead, there are new abilities you'll be using in each phase.
RAID_TUTORIAL_SOOTHE_MSG_1: In this phase, Sion will apply stacks of [c][ffff33]Cycle of Pain[-][/c] and [c][ffff33]Cycle of Suffering[-][/c] with his abilities. [c][ffff33]Cycle of Pain[-][/c] makes you stronger, but it also makes Sion stronger, so watch out!
RAID_TUTORIAL_SOOTHE_MSG_2: Your characters can use [c][ffff33]Soothe[-][/c] to remove Cycle of Pain and Cycle of Suffering from themselves.
RAID_TUTORIAL_SOOTHE_MSG_3: [c][ffff33]Pain[-][/c] makes Sion powerful, but it may also give you the strength you need to beat him... How much [c][ffff33]Pain[-][/c] can you endure?
RAID_TUTORIAL_STAND_ALONE_MSG_1: In this phase, Traya will use [c][ffff33]Bonds of Weakness[-][/c] to punish your characters for working together.
RAID_TUTORIAL_STAND_ALONE_MSG_2: Every time a character takes an action adds a stack of [c][ffff33]Bonds of Weakness[-][/c]. [c][ffff33]Bonds of Weakness[-][/c] deals damage that increases with each stack.
RAID_TUTORIAL_STAND_ALONE_MSG_2_V2: Every time your characters use an ability, Traya gains one stack of [c][ffff33]Bonds of Weakness[-][/c]. [c][ffff33]Bonds of Weakness[-][/c] deals damage that increases with each stack.
RAID_TUTORIAL_STAND_ALONE_MSG_3: To counter [c][ffff33]Bonds of Weakness[-][/c], each character can use [c][ffff33]Stand Alone[-][/c]. This ability allows that character to face Darth Traya alone.
RAID_TUTORIAL_STAND_ALONE_MSG_4: When [c][ffff33]Stand Alone[-][/c] is used all other allies become Suppressed, but grant bonuses based on their role to the character that used Stand Alone. Suppression is removed after Stand Alone expires.
RAIDABILITY_AATRAID_JAWA_DESC: Jawas have +50% Potency. In addition, whenever a Jawa uses an ability, they call another ally to Assist. This effect can't trigger more than once per turn.
RAIDABILITY_AATRAID_JEDI_DESC: Jedi recover 15% of their Max Health at the start of their turn.
RAIDABILITY_AATRAID_JEDI_DESC_V2: Jedi have +20% Critical Chance and recover 15% of their Max Health at the start of their turn.

REYEP09_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Rey has come a long way from her days as an orphaned scavenger on Jakku. Brave and fiercely loyal, this Force-sensitive human will stop at nothing to fight for what she believes in.

She struggled with the influence of the dark side after learning the truth of her lineage, but ultimately overcame her internal conflict and aligned with the will of the Force. Rey empowers allies of the Resistance and beyond to endure the throes of battle and strike back against galactic tyranny.
REYJEDITRAINING_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: After finding Luke Skywalker on Ahch-To, Rey stubbornly convinced him to teach her the ways of the Jedi. Armed with new knowledge and power, Rey is an insightful and resilient Tank - evading damage while inspiring and protecting her allies. Her defiant and determined personality draws allies to assist as she slashes her foes. Rey's growing Force powers let her control the battlefield with mind tricks while using connected lightsaber strikes to boost her damage.

Give the Separatist army a boost with character shards for General Grievous or one of the Separatist droids.

Each pack awards 1 card of character shards worth 10-330 shards.

Possible characters:

-B1 Battle Droid
-B2 Super Battle Droid
-Droideka
-General Grievous
-IG-100 MagnaGuard
SEPARATIST_DROID_ULTIMATE_BUNDLE_DESC:
Gather Separatist Droids under the leadership of General Grievous. This selection of character shards and gear will aid you in your goal of crushing the Galactic Republic.

Characters include:

-General Grievous
-B1 Battle Droid
-Droideka
-B2 Super Battle Droid
-IG-100 MagnaGuard

Purchase limit: 1
SEPARATIST_DROID_ULTIMATE_BUNDLE_TEXT: The Separatist Droid Ultimate Bundle and Separatist Droid Faction Pack are now available for a limited time!
SEPARATIST_LEADERS_BUNDLE_DESC:
Power up your Separatist leaders Asaj Ventress, Count Dooku, Nute Gunray, or Jango Fett with this bundle which offers gear salvage for their finishers!

Each bundle contains 1 card, which gives you a [b]25% chance[/b] at one of the following:

- 10 shards for Asaj Ventress plus enough salvage material for her finisher!
- 10 shards for Count Dooku plus enough salvage material for his finisher!
- 10 shards for Nute Gunray plus enough salvage material for his finisher!
- 10 shards for Jango Fett plus enough salvage material for his finisher!

Purchase limit: 2
SEPARATIST_LEADERS_BUNDLE_LP: Power up [c][F0FF23]Asaj Ventress[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Count Dooku[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Nute Gunray[-][/c], or [c][F0FF23]Jango Fett[-][/c] with this offer containing shards and enough gear salvage for their finishers! \n\nPurchase Limit: 2
SEPARATIST_LEADERS_BUNDLE_TEXT: Unlock the potential for Asaj Ventress, Count Dooku, Nute Gunray, or Jango Fett with this bundle that offers their shards as well as gear salvage for their finishers!

SHAAKTI_BUNDLE_DESC:
Power up Shaak Ti with this brand new bundle! This Galactic Republic Jedi is a particularly strong Leader for Clone Troopers. Each bundle includes 30 shards for Shaak Ti and [b]1,350 Crystals![/b]

[f0ff23]BONUS[-]: This bundle also includes materials to immediately power up Shaak Ti to:

Character level: 40
Gear level: V

Purchase limit: 1
SHAAKTI_BUNDLE_TEXT: Jedi Master Shaak Ti Bundle and Pack are now available in the Store for a limited time! The famous trainer of the Clone army is a stellar leader for the Galactic Republic. Unlock Shaak Ti in her Marquee event and power her up today!
SHAAKTI_BUNDLE_TITLE: Shaak Ti Bundle Now Available in Store
SHAAKTI_MEGA_PACK_DESC:
Power up Shaak Ti with this brand new pack!

Each pack guarantees at least 15 shards for Shaak Ti and may drop up to [f0ff23]330 SHARDS[-]!

Possible shard drops include: 15, 17, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 120, 145, 180, 230, 330
SHAAKTI_PACK_DESC:
Power up Shaak Ti with this brand new pack!

Each pack guarantees at least 5 shards for Shaak Ti and may drop up to [f0ff23]330 SHARDS[-]!

Possible shard drops include: 5, 7, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 50, 80, 145, 230, 330
SHAAKTI_PACK_DESC_V2:
Power up Shaak Ti with the Jedi Overseer Pack!

Each pack guarantees at least 5 shards for Shaak Ti and may drop up to [f0ff23]330 SHARDS[-]!

Possible shard drops include: 5, 7, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 50, 80, 145, 230, 330
SHARD_SHOP_EVENT_DESC: For the next 7 days you can now refresh the Shard Shop with Crystals. During this time you can purchase exclusive Raid Gear in addition to General Grievous and random character shards.\n\nThis Event ends on July 11th.
SHARD_SHOP_REFRESH_DESC: Now you can purchase exclusive Raid Gear in addition to General Grievous and random character shards. Check it out now!
SHARD_SHOP_REFRESH_NAME: Raid Gear now in the Shard Shop
ShardDetail_PromoteDescription: Collect {0} more shards to promote this character to {1}!\n\n
ShardDetail_ShipPromoteDescription: Collect {0} more blueprints to promote this ship to {1}!\n\n
ShardDetail_ShipUnlockDescription: Collect {0} more blueprints to unlock this ship!\n\n
ShardDetail_UnlockDescription: Collect {0} more shards to unlock this character!\n\n
SHARDSHOP_GEAR_UNLOCK1: Now you can buy more gear from the Shard Store!
SHARED_CURRENCY_CONQUEST_DESC: Earn Conquest Credits by winning Conquest battles. Use them for items in the Conquest Store, Conquest Merchants, and for unequipping Data Disks.
SHARED_CURRENCY_CONQUEST_DESC_V2: Earn Conquest Credits by winning Conquest battles. Use them for items in the Conquest Store and at Conquest Merchants.
Shared_Currency_Description: Used in crafting and to purchase certain shipment items.
Shared_Currency_ForcePoints_Desc: Earn Cantina Battle Tokens by winning Cantina Battles. Use them for items in the Cantina Battles Store.
Shared_Currency_Full_TU6.1: [c][FF1900]You've reached the maximum limit for {0}. You cannot accrue anymore.[-][/c]
SHARED_CURRENCY_GEONOSIAN_TERRITORY_BATT: Earn Mk II Guild Event Tokens through Territory Battles. Use them for items in the Guild Events Store.
Shared_Currency_Grind_Desc: Credits are required to upgrade your character's level, abilities, and star count.
Shared_Currency_Grind_Desc_TU13: Earn Credits from battles and other activities. Use them to upgrade your characters' levels, abilities, Star rarity, and gear, as well as your mods' levels and tiers. You can also use Credits for some items in Shipments, Weekly Shipments, and the Mod Store.
Shared_Currency_GrindTicket_Desc: Sim Tickets are used to complete 3-Star Battles instantly.
Shared_Currency_GrindTicket_Desc_TU3: Earn Sim Tickets from battles and other activities, and when refreshing Energy. Use them to complete 3-Star Battles instantly.
Shared_Currency_Guild_Desc: Earn Guild Tokens by participating in raids, other guild events, and the daily Guild Activity. Use them for items in the Guild Store.
Shared_Currency_GuildBank_Desc: Coins are produced by the Guild's members.\n\nOnly a Guild's Leader and its Officers can spend them to open Raids.
Shared_Currency_GuildBank_Full: [c][FF1900]Your Guild Bank Coins are at its maximum. You cannot accrue anymore.[-][/c]
Shared_Currency_GuildRaidDesc_01: Earn The Pit Tickets for your guild by participating in the daily Guild Activity.\n\nOnly a guild's leader and its officers can spend them to open the The Pit Raid.
Shared_Currency_GuildRaidDesc_02: Earn Tank Takedown Tickets for your guild by participating in the daily Guild Activity.\n\nOnly a guild's leader and its officers can spend them to open the Tank Takedown Raid.
Shared_Currency_GuildRaidDesc_03: Earn The Sith Triumvirate Tickets for your guild by participating in the daily Guild Activity.\n\n Only a guild's leader and its officers can spend them to open The Sith Triumvirate Raid.
Shared_Currency_GuildRaidDesc_04: Earn The Pit (Challenge) Tickets for your guild by participating in the daily Guild Activity.\n\nOnly a guild's leader and its officers can spend them to open the The Pit (Challenge) Raid.
Shared_Currency_Hyperdrive_Bundle_Desc: Unlocks the Hyperdrive Bundle, which upgrades a player to level 85, unlocks a large amount of activities, and grants a collection of characters, ships, and resources.
Shared_Currency_IGCEventKeycard_Desc: Credit Keycards are exchanged to activate the limited time Profit Mining Keycard Battle. Helpful for earning huge amounts of Credits!
Shared_Currency_Premium_Desc: Earn Crystals from battles and other activities. Use them for items in Shipments and Weekly Shipments, packs and data cards in the Store, as well as to refresh timers and Energy.
Shared_Currency_PVP_Desc: Earn Squad Arena Tokens based on your daily rank in the Squad Arena. Use them for items in the Squad Arena Store.
Shared_Currency_PVPShip_Desc: Fleet Arena Tokens are used to purchase characters and rare items from the Fleet Arena Store.
SHARED_CURRENCY_SEASONS_DESC: Earn Championship Tokens from Championship events and Feats. Use them for items in the Championship Store.
Shared_Currency_Shard_Desc: Earn Shard Store Tokens by converting excess shards and blueprints in the Shard Store. Use them for items in the Shard Store.
Shared_Currency_ShipGrind_Desc: Earn Ship Building Materials from battles and other activities. Use them to upgrade your ships' levels, abilities, and Star rarity, as well as some items in the Mod Store.
Shared_Currency_ShipPvp_Desc: Earn Fleet Arena Tokens based on your daily rank in the Fleet Arena. Use them for items in the Fleet Arena Store.
Shared_Currency_Social_Desc: Ally Points are used to purchase Bronzium data cards from the store.
Shared_Currency_Social_Desc_TU13: Earn Ally Points from battles in which you borrow an ally's character. Use them to open Bronzium Data Cards in the Store and for items in Weekly Shipments.

SHIPS_BOBA_FETT_SLAVEI_BUNDLE_DESC:
Become the most infamous Bounty Hunter in the Galaxy with the [f0ff23]Bounty Hunter Bundle[-]!

Get 4* [f0ff23]Boba Fett[-] (or shards to upgrade) and his feared ship: [f0ff23]Slave I[-].

Includes [f0ff23]80 shards[-] for Boba Fett and [f0ff23]80 blueprints[-] for Slave I.

Includes materials to immediately [f0ff23]level up[-] both Ship and Crew!
SHIPS_BOBA_FETT_SLAVEI_TEXT: Become the most infamous Bounty Hunter in the Galaxy with the BOUNTY HUNTER BUNDLE! Get 4* Boba Fett (or shards to upgrade) and his feared ship: Slave I. Includes materials to immediately level up both Ship and Crew. Head to the Store NOW!
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_1_QUEST_DESC: So you want to be a BOUNTY HUNTER? You'll need a collection of the galaxy's deadliest mercenaries.\n\nWant to step up?
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_1_QUEST_REWARDS: So you think you're good enough to earn the title BOUNTY HUNTER?\n\nHrmf, nice start but let's see you keep it up!
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_1_TASK_DESC_1: Get Boba Fett to Gear tier XII
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_1_TASK_DESC_3: Defeat 50 Wampas with Boba Fett present
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_2_QUEST_DESC: They say Greedo once worked for Jabba the Hutt himself.\n\nTo earn the title BOUNTY HUNTER, you'll need this cunning Rodian in your collection!
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_2_QUEST_REWARDS: You've got to be quick on the draw to be a BOUNTY HUNTER!
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_2_TASK_DESC_1: Get Greedo to Gear tier XII
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_3_QUEST_DESC: Armed with mechanical aim and 360-degree target tracking, no target escapes the fearsome IG-88.\n\nHe was one of the best BOUNTY HUNTERS in the galaxy! Destroy!
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_3_QUEST_REWARDS: Nice tracking. You're finding your targets with assassin droid IG-88.\n\nYou may just be a BOUNTY HUNTER yet!
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_3_TASK_DESC_1: Get IG-88 to Gear tier XII
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_3_TASK_DESC_3: Win 12 Battles with IG-88 in Territory Battles
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_4_QUEST_DESC: This changeling BOUNTY HUNTER could alter her appearance.\n\nShe once took a bounty on a Senator from Naboo...
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_4_QUEST_REWARDS: You know how to take care of BOUNTY HUNTER business with Zam!\n\nYou're halfway to your title - maybe you should just give up!
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_4_TASK_DESC_1: Get Zam Wesell to Gear tier XII
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_4_TASK_DESC_2: Complete Galactic Bounty event tier IV
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_4_TASK_DESC_2_V2: Complete Galactic Bounty I event tier IV
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_5_QUEST_DESC: Dengar was a rough and tumble bounty hunter, rushing into brutal close-quarters fighting, unlike lighter-stepped strategic hunters like Boba Fett and Cad Bane.
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_5_QUEST_REWARDS: Dengar's sheer destructive force and firepower was a reckoning for those he hunted.\n\nIf you keep going, you're almost to your title!
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_5_TASK_DESC_1: Get Dengar to Gear tier XII
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_5_TASK_DESC_3: Win 5 Territory War attacks with Dengar
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_6_QUEST_DESC: Cad Bane was one of the top BOUNTY HUNTERS during the Clone Wars.\n\nWith custom twin blaster pistols, rocket boots, and explosives, he was a match to any quarry.
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_6_QUEST_REWARDS: Holotable Jedi are scurrying like womprats from your deadly Cad Bane!\n\nHar har har! If you continue, you're almost at the title BOUNTY HUNTER!
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_6_TASK_DESC_1: Get Cad Bane to Gear tier XII
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_6_TASK_DESC_2: Finish off 200 enemies with Cad Bane
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_6_TASK_DESC_3: Defeat 500 Jedi with Cad Bane present
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_7_QUEST_DESC: As a feared BOUNTY HUNTER, Bossk's hunting instincts aided him in his profession.\n\nHe was especially renowned for hunting Wookiees. There's always a bigger Wookiee!
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_7_QUEST_REWARDS: I don't believe it!  Hrmf, I reluctantly congratulate you!\n\nYou earned the title BOUNTY HUNTER! Show it off in the cantina and inspire much envy!
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_7_TASK_DESC_1: Get Bossk to Gear tier XII
Ships_Bounty_Hunter_7_TASK_DESC_3: Win 50 Squad Arena battles with Bossk
SHIPS_CELEBRATION_PACK_APPLE_DESC: Celebrate the release of SHIPS in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes with this free pack.\n\nJump into the dogfight with Wedge Antilles' X-wing Starfighter!
SHIPS_CELEBRATION_PACK_GOOGLE_DESC:
Celebrate the release of SHIPS in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes with this free pack.

Jump into the dogfight with Biggs Darklighter's X-wing!

This pack also contains enough materials to level up Biggs Darklighter to 4* and Biggs Darklighter's X-wing to 2*.
Ships_PvE_QUEST_DESC: Do you like the band? They play requests for me, probably cause I'm the best Ships player.
Ships_PvE_QUEST_REWARDS: Haha, you think you can beat me in ships, delusions of grandeur.
Ships_PvP_QUEST_DESC: You can play at the Fleet Arena table when I'm done, scram.
Ships_PvP_QUEST_REWARDS: How many Capital Ships do you even have?

This limited-time Gear Bundle awards gear salvage for every single listed variety of core gear as well as the listed Gear 12+ salvage!

Each bundle contains multiple payouts, according to the following format:

[b]Card 1:[/b]

100% chance to drop 20 Mk 5 A/KT Stun Gun Prototype Salvage, 20 Mk 3 Carbanti Sensor Array Salvage, 20 Mk 3 Czerka Stun Cuffs Salvage, 20 Mk 5 Arakyd Droid Caller Salvage, and 20 Mk 8 BioTech Implant Salvage.

[b]Card 2:[/b]

The ArmaTek-group items included in this card are: Mk 12 ArmaTek Thermal Detonator Prototype Salvage, Mk 12 ArmaTek Key Pad Prototype Salvage, Mk 12 ArmaTek Fusion Furnace Prototype Salvage, Mk 12 ArmaTek Data Pad Prototype Salvage, Mk 12 ArmaTek Holo Lens Prototype Salvage, Mk 12 ArmaTek Stun Gun Prototype Salvage

The Czerka-group items included in this card are: Mk 12 Czerka Sensor Array Prototype Salvage, Mk 12 Czerka Security Scanner Prototype Salvage, Mk 12 Czerka Stun Cuffs Prototype Salvage, Mk 12 Czerka Shield Generator Prototype Salvage, Mk 12 Czerka Implant Prototype Salvage, Mk 12 Czerka Hypo Syringe Prototype Salvage

[b]Quantity of gear received from this card are determined by the follow probabilities:[/b]

[b]45% chance[/b] to get 10 each of the ArmaTek-group items and 20 each of the Czerka-group items.

[b]45% chance[/b] to get 20 each of the ArmaTek-group items and 10 each of the Czerka-group items.

[b]10% chance[/b] to get 25 each of the ArmaTek-group and Czerka-group items.

Purchase this valuable bundle before it leaves the Store!

Purchase Limit: 2

SUMMONUNIT_DESC:
- This unit's stats scale with the summoner's stats.
- This unit can only be summoned to the ally slot if it's available.
- This unit can't be summoned in raids.
- If an effect counts defeated units, this unit doesn't count.
- When there are no other allied combatants, this unit escapes from battle.
- A unit can't be revived if this summoned unit exists in their slot.
SUMMONUNIT_SHIPS_DESC:
- This ship's stats scale with the summoner's stats.
- This ship can only be summoned if there are fewer than 5 active ships.
- If an effect counts defeated ships, this ship doesn't count.
- If the Capital Ship is the only other allied combatant, this ship escapes from battle.

Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Han[-][/c]
Each Han takes a bonus turn at the start of the encounter. During this turn, each Han ignores Taunts and can only use his Basic ability, but it will Stun the target for 1 turn. This Stun can't be evaded or resisted. Additionally, each active Han grants a bonus to all other Han allies:
- [c][f0ff23]Captain Han Solo:[-][/c] +50% Max Health, and other Han allies can’t be defeated while Captain Han is active
- [c][f0ff23]Han Solo:[-][/c] +50% Critical Damage, and other Han allies have +35% counter chance while Han Solo is active
- [c][f0ff23]Stormtrooper Han:[-][/c] +50% Max Protection, and other Han allies grant 10% Turn Meter to all other Han allies when damaged by an attack while Stormtrooper Han is active
- [c][f0ff23]Veteran Smuggler Han Solo:[-][/c] +50% Health Steal, and other Han allies take a bonus turn whenever any Han ally is defeated while Veteran Smuggler Han is active
- [c][f0ff23]Young Han Solo:[-][/c] +50% Offense, and other Han allies have +35% chance to assist other Han allies while Young Han is active (limit once per Han per turn)
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_BOUNTYHUNTER01: Whenever a Bounty Hunter scores a Critical Hit, they Dispel all debuffs on themselves and gain +15% Critical Damage (stacking) for the rest of the battle.
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_FIRSTORDER_DES: Whenever any First Order ally suffers a Debuff or attacks with Advantage, they gain 5% Critical Damage and Potency (stacking) for the rest of the battle.
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_GRIEVOUS01_DES: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]General Grievous[-][/c] \nGeneral Grievous has +300% Offense. At the start of each turn, if Grievous is below 100% Health, he dispels all debuffs on himself and grants Taunt to the other healthiest Droid ally until the end of the turn. When a Droid ally is defeated for the first time in battle, Grievous dispels all debuffs on himself, resets all ability cooldowns, and gains 3 bonus turns.
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_MACEWINDU01_DE: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Mace Windu[-][/c] \nMace Windu has +100% Max Health, +480% Max Protection, +100% Counter Chance, and is immune to Shock, Daze and Stun. Additionally, when attacking Sith with his basic attack Mace deals +1000% damage. Whenever Mace suffers damage, Inflict Expose on all enemies for 2 turns which can't be evaded. If Jango Fett has Expose, Mace Windu's attacks will instantly defeat him (Damage Immunity does not prevent this effect).
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_RESISTANCE_DES: Resistance allies have +10% Potency for each Exposed enemy, and gain Protection Up (15%) for 2 turns whenever they damage an Exposed enemy.
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_SCOUNDREL01_DE: Scoundrels have +20% Critical Chance as long as they have Protection.
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_TROOPER01_DESC: At the start of battle, Imperial Troopers gain 5 stacks of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c]. When an enemy is defeated, all Imperial Troopers gain 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c], up to 10 stacks.\n\n[c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c]: When an Imperial Trooper is defeated, they consume 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c] from all Imperial Trooper allies, revive with 100% Health and 100% Protection, reset all their cooldowns, and gain a bonus turn
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_COUNTDOOKU_MYSTERY_: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Count Dooku[-][/c] \nForce Lightning ignores Protection and deals bonus damage equal to 80% of the target's Max Health if they are already Shocked. Whenever Count Dooku uses his Basic attack reduce the cooldown of Force Lightning by 1.
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_CUP01_DESC: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Coruscant Underworld Police[-][/c] \nCoruscant Underworld Police gains 500% Potency, 300% Max Health and deals 1000% more damage with his Basic attack when attacking Scoundrels. Whenever Coruscant Underworld Police inflicts Stun, he gains Protection Up (50%, stacking) for 2 turns.
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_GEONOSIAN_SWARM_DES: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Geonosians[-][/c] \nWhenever an ally uses an ability during their turn, all other Geonosians assist if they gained a buff this turn, dealing 200% more damage.

Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Geonosians[-][/c]\nWhenever an ally uses an ability during their turn, all other Geonosians that gained a buff this turn assist, dealing 200% more damage (max 1 assist per ally per turn).

Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Ships[-][/c]\nWhenever an ally uses an ability during their turn, all other Geonosians that gained a buff this turn assist, dealing 200% more damage (max 1 assist per ally per turn).
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_INDUSTRYOFWAR_ACTIV: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Geonosians[-][/c] \nCall heavy artillery to destroy target enemy and another random enemy, which can't be evaded.  When a Geonosian ally uses an ability, they reduce this ability's cooldown by 1. This cooldown can't be reduced any other way, is shared across all Geonosian allies, and starts on cooldown.
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_INDUSTRYOFWAR_PASSI: Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Geonosians[-][/c] \nAt the start of battle, Geonosians gain 75% Max Health and 100% Max Protection for each other Geonosian ally. When a Geonosian ally uses an ability, they gain Foresight for 1 turn.
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_UNSTABLEBATTERIES_D:
Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Droids[-][/c] 
Droids deal 100% more damage with attacks not based on Health, but have a 15% chance to be destroyed when damaged by an attack. Droids destroyed this way can't be revived.

Whenever a Droid is destroyed by Unstable Batteries, they deal damage to each enemy equal to 80% of that enemy's Max Health and inflict Burning for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted. This damage can't defeat enemies.

B1 Battle Droid can't be destroyed by Unstable Batteries, but can still trigger the Max Health damage and inflict Burning for 1 turn when it is damaged by an attack.

Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Droids[-][/c]
Droids deal 100% more damage with attacks not based on Health, but have a 15% chance to be destroyed when damaged by an attack. Droids defeated this way can't be revived.

Whenever a Droid is defeated, they deal damage to each enemy equal to 80% of that enemy's Max Health and inflict Burning for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted. This damage can't defeat enemies.

THECOSTOFOPPORTUNITY_MODIFIER_DESC: When a Player uses a Special Ability they lose 15% Max Health and Max Protection, gain 15% Offense, and all of the Boss’ allies gain 15% Turn Meter. Player’s allies have their cooldowns reduced by 3 at the start of their turns.
THECOSTOFOPPORTUNITY_MODIFIER_DESC_V2: When the allied Leader uses a Special ability, they lose 15% Max Health and Max Protection and all enemies gain 15% Turn Meter. Allies reduce their cooldowns by 3 at the start of each of their turns.
THECOSTOFOPPORTUNITY_OVERHEAD_INFO: Upon using a Special Ability, this unit will lose 15% Max Health and Max Protection, gain 15% Offense, and grant of the Boss’ allies 15% Turn Meter
THECOSTOFOPPORTUNITY_OVERHEAD_INFO_V2: When using a Special Ability, this character will lose 15% Max Health and Max Protection, all allies gain 15% Turn Meter
THECOSTOFOPPORTUNITY_OVERHEAD_INFO_V3: When using a Special Ability, this character will lose 15% Max Health and Max Protection, all enemies gain 15% Turn Meter
THEGREATERGOOD_MODIFIER_DESC: If the Boss has no Marked allies at the start of their turn, they randomly Mark one of their allies for 3 turns. If that unit dies while they have this Mark, the Boss gains that unit's Health, Protection, Speed, and Offense.
THEGREATERGOOD_MODIFIER_DESC_V2: If no allies are Marked at the start of the allied Leader's turn, a random ally is Marked for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted. If that ally is defeated while they are Marked by this modifier, the allied Leader gains that unit's Max Health, Max Protection, Offense, and Speed until another ally Marked by this modifier is defeated.
THEGREATERGOOD_MODIFIER_DESC_V3: If no enemies are Marked at the start of the allied Leader's turn, a random enemy is Marked for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted. If that enemy is defeated while they are Marked by this modifier, the allied Leader gains that unit's Max Health, Max Protection, Offense, and Speed until another enemy Marked by this modifier is defeated.
THEMANDALORIANBESKARARMOR_GUIDE_DESCRIPT: Rescued from certain death at the hands of Separatist battle droids by a group of Mandalorians, Din Djarin became a foundling, growing up steeped in Mandalorian ways and traditions. ULTIMATEABILITY_GLREY_DESC:
Requires 100% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate

[c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Rey gains 6% Ultimate Charge at the start of every character's turn.

Until the end of Rey's next turn, she enters a defensive stance and damage Light Side allies receive is reduced to 1. While in this stance, Rey can't act, has 30% less Speed, is immune to all detrimental effects, and can't be defeated. Upon activating this ability again, she deals true damage (ignores defense, but can't critically hit) to the enemy team split among them and all [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] is consumed. This attack can't be countered or evaded.
ULTIMATEABILITY_GRANDMASTERLUKE_DESC:
Requires 100% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate

[c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge:[-][/c] Jedi Master Luke Skywalker gains 8% Ultimate Charge whenever a Jedi ally gains Jedi Lessons or the duration of all their current stacks of Jedi Lessons is reset.

Jedi Master Luke Skywalker transforms into Jedi Master Luke Skywalker (Heroic) and dispels Jedi Lessons from all Jedi allies.

Dispel all debuffs on all Jedi allies and reset the cooldowns of their Special abilities. All Jedi allies gain Critical Chance Up and Critical Damage Up for 2 turns and gain Jedi Legacy and 35% Offense until the end of battle.

When Luke transforms, the max cooldown for [c][ffff33]They Grow Beyond[-][/c] and [c][ffff33]Efflux[-][/c] is reduced by 2.
ULTIMATEABILITY_JEDIMASTERKENOBI_DESC:
Requires 50% [c][FFA500]Ultimate Charge[-][/c] to activate

UNIQUEABILITY_AAT_WEAPON01_DESC:
This unit is immune to Turn Meter reduction effects and its weapons may attack and be attacked independently. When this weapon system is disabled, it will reboot after some time, but if all weapon systems are offline simultaneously, this unit will be become Toppled and grant Morale bonuses to the attacking party:

Morale I: All attacking units gain +100% Defense Penetration.
Morale II: Attacking units gain +25% Speed if all three of the AAT's weapon systems were disabled within one of its turns.
Morale III: All attacking units gain +50% Critical Damage if any of them suffered a direct hit from the Main Cannon and survived until the AAT was Toppled.

When the AAT recovers from Topple, Morale bonuses are lost, and the AAT and its side cannons gain 100% Turn Meter.

Bounty Hunter allies have +10% Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense, and ignore Taunt on Crewless or Droid ships. At the start of battle, Bounty Hunter allies gain Tenacity Up for 2 turns, and Empire allies gain [c][ffff33]We Don't Need Their Scum[-][/c] for the rest of the battle, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.

Whenever a Bounty Hunter ally deals damage with a Basic ability, they inflict Target Lock on the target enemy for 1 turn. The first time allies inflict Target Lock 20 times on enemies, each active enemy, enemies who are called in from Reinforcements, or summoned, are inflicted with Breach and Target Lock. These effects can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted, and last until the end of the battle.

[c][FFCC33]Reinforcement Bonus:[-][/c] Reinforcements gain Breach Immunity and Chaff for 2 turns

UNIQUEABILITY_SITHPALPATINE01_DESC:
Sith Eternal Emperor is immune to taunt effects and Turn Meter reduction. Deceived enemies can't counter attack, and Deceived Rebel and Jedi enemies can't gain bonus Turn Meter.

At the start of Sith Eternal Emperor's turn, if no enemies are Deceived, the weakest Light Side enemy becomes Deceived for 2 turns. Deceived can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted.

At the start of each Linked enemy's turn, Linked enemies lose 20% Max Protection, quadrupled for Jedi, and Sith Eternal Emperor gains 25% of the amount lost. Linked raid bosses instead gain Expose for 2 turns, which can't be resisted.
UNIQUEABILITY_SITHPALPATINE01_TIER_01_DE:
Sith Eternal Emperor is immune to taunt effects and Turn Meter reduction. Deceived enemies can't counter attack, and Deceived Rebel and Jedi enemies can't gain bonus Turn Meter.

At the start of Sith Eternal Emperor's turn, if no enemies are Deceived, the weakest Light Side enemy becomes Deceived for 2 turns. Deceived can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted.

At the start of each Linked enemy's turn, Linked enemies lose 20% Max Protection, quadrupled for Jedi, and Sith Eternal Emperor gains 25% of the amount lost. Linked raid bosses instead gain Expose for 2 turns, which can't be resisted.

Linked enemies can't critically hit, and damage they deal is decreased by 25% (excludes Galactic Legends).
UNIQUEABILITY_SITHPALPATINE01_TIER_02_DE:

At the start of Sith Eternal Emperor's turn, if no enemies are Deceived, the weakest Light Side enemy becomes Deceived for 2 turns. Whenever a Deceived enemy uses an ability, their weakest ally without Deceived becomes Deceived for the max duration Sith Eternal Emperor could inflict on them (limit once per turn), and Sith Eternal Emperor recovers 2% Protection. Deceived can't be copied, dispelled, or resisted.

At the start of each Linked enemy's turn, Linked enemies lose 20% Max Protection, quadrupled for Jedi, and Sith Eternal Emperor gains 25% of the amount lost. Linked raid bosses instead gain Expose for 2 turns, which can't be resisted.

Linked enemies can't critically hit, and damage they deal is decreased by 25% (excludes Galactic Legends).

UNIQUEABILITY_STARKILLER01_DESC:
Starkiller has +5% Critical Chance.

Starkiller gains 4 stacks of [c][ffff33]Force Energy[-][/c] (max 100 stacks) each time he deals damage to an enemy. At 100 stacks, he loses all stacks of Force Energy and gains [c][ffff33]Unleashed[-][/c] until the end of the battle.

When Starkiller gains Unleashed:
- He gains +70% Critical Chance
- He dispels all debuffs on himself
- He takes a bonus turn
- His cooldowns are reset
- If there are no Galactic Legend allies, gains the Special ability [c][ffff33]Size Means Nothing[-][/c].

[c][ffff33]Force Energy:[-][/c] At 100 stacks, lose all stacks and gain Unleashed

[c][ffff33]Unleashed:[-][/c] Abilities gain additional effects; can't gain Force Energy

[c][ffff33]Size Means Nothing:[-][/c] Limit one use per battle.

Deal damage equal to 80% of Starkiller's Max Health to all enemies and Stun them for 1 turn, which can't be resisted. All allies recover 100% Health and Protection. If this ability defeats an enemy, Starkiller takes a bonus turn. This ability can't be evaded.
UNIQUEABILITY_STARKILLER01_DESC_TFU_EVEN:
Starkiller has +30% Counter Chance, Critical Chance, Defense, Defense Penetration, and Offense, and he is immune to Fear.

UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_01: Congratulations! That Rebel team is pretty amazing.\n\nLet's work on getting your own Rebel Squad!
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_02: You're ready now for the [f0ff23]JOURNEY GUIDE[-]. It will help you unlock [f0ff23]LEGENDARY[-] characters like Commander Luke Skywalker.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_03: Tap on the Objectives button to head to the Journey Guide.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_04: As you can see, there are a lot of Legendary Characters to unlock.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_05: You can work towards them however you feel is best, but I would suggest using your Rebel Squad to unlock Emperor Palpatine first.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_06: Tap on the Emperor Palpatine tile to enter the event page.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_07: On this page, you will learn about Emperor Palpatine's strengths, abilities, and synergies.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_08: Next, let's take a look at the [f0ff23]ACTIVITY[-] tab.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_09: Here you can learn about the required characters needed to unlock Emperor Palpatine. As I mentioned before, you will need at least 5 Rebel characters to start the [f0ff23]EMPEROR'S DEMISE[-] legendary event.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_10: Tap this button to enter the event.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_11: After beating [f0ff23]TIER V[-] of the Emperor's Demise legendary event, you will be able to activate Emperor Palpatine.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_12: Emperor Palpatine and a squad of Empire units can be used to unlock R2-D2, who then sets you on the path to Commander Luke Skywalker!
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V2_13: Keep playing and collecting and you will have your own amazing teams!
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V3_01: You're ready now for the [f0ff23]Journey Guide[-]. It will help you unlock [f0ff23]Legendary[-] characters like Commander Luke Skywalker.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V3_02: Tap on the [f0ff23]Journey Guide[-] button to head to the Gallery.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V3_03: As you can see, there are a lot of Legendary Units to unlock.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V3_04: To make it easier to follow, Journey Guide Units are split into three groups: Solo Journeys, Guild Journeys, and Galactic Legends.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V3_05: Let's get started by selecting Emperor Palpatine.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V3_06: Here you can learn everything you need to be successful on your Journey.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V3_07: The Battle Chain at the top shows your current progress.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V3_08: The Requirements and Recommendations for the selected battle are displayed under the Battle Chain.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V3_09: First, lets set our Goal by selecting Begin Journey.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V3_10: With our Goal set, the units and gear required for the next battle are now marked throughout your Collection.
UNIT_GUIDE_INTRO_V3_11: After beating [f0ff23]Tier V[-] of the Emperor's Demise legendary event, you will be able to activate Emperor Palpatine.
