MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_1-1: Greetings Holotable Heroes! I am pleased to announce that Admiral Raddus, the brilliant Admiral who helped secure the first major Rebel victory against the Empire at the Battle of Scarif, has arrived to the Holotables!
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_1-2: Admiral Raddus's Basic attack, [c][ffff33]Protective Shot[-][/c], deals Special damage to target enemy and grants the weakest ally Protection Up (grants bonus Protection).
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_2-1: Admiral Raddus's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Inspiring Maneuver[-][/c], grants all Rebel allies Protection Up and Protection Recovery, grants all Tank allies Taunt (enemies must target this character), and calls all Rogue One allies to assist. If Admiral Raddus's target is Dark Side and they are debuffed, their cooldowns are increased by 1. In addition, Inspiring Maneuver grants all Rogue One allies Spark of Rebellion.
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_2-2: In addition, Inspiring Maneuver grants all Rogue One allies a new buff, [c][ffff33]Spark of Rebellion[-][/c], which grants additional Offense (increases ability damage) and Speed, Max Health and Protection recovery, and any Empire enemies defeated by a character with this buff can't be revived.
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_2-3: If Spark of Rebellion is dispelled, the owner of the buff gains extra Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn), extra Protection Up, and 5% Upload progress.
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_3-1: [c][ffff33]Blue Squadron Air Support[-][/c] dispels all debuffs from all Light Side allies and deals Special damage to all enemies. If Admiral Raddus is in the Leader slot, all allies gain 5% Upload progress, and if this ability defeats an enemy, they gain an additional 8% Upload progress.
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_4-1: For each Rogue One ally at the start of battle, Rogue One allies gain Health, Potency (ally debuffs are harder to resist), Speed, and Tenacity.
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_4-2: When an Empire enemy gains bonus Turn Meter, they are inflicted with Daze (can't assist, counter attack, or gain bonus Turn Meter). If a Rogue One ally is critically hit by an enemy, that enemy gains Expose.
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_4-3: While in Grand Arenas, Rogue One allies gain Protection and Spark of Rebellion at the start of battle. When Spark of Rebellion is dispelled from an ally, they gain Critical Chance Up (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit), Critical Damage Up, (increases the damage of critical hits), Defense Up, Health Up, Offense Up, Potency Up, and Protection Up.
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_5-1: Admiral Raddus's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Transmission from Scarif[-][/c], gains additional Defense (reduces incoming damage) and Tenacity (enemy debuffs are harder to inflict). If Jyn Erso is an ally, she gains the new buff [c][ffff33]Spark of Rebellion[-][/c] at the start of the encounter, and when she loses Spark of Rebellion, she regains it. While Admiral Raddus is active, Jyn Erso can't be defeated.
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_5-2: [c][ffff33]Spark of Rebellion[-][/c] grants Offense (increases damage) and Speed (takes turns more often), Health and Protection recovery on attack, and any Empire enemies defeated by this character can't be revived. If Spark of Rebellion is dispelled, the owner of the buff gains bonus Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn) and Protection Up.
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_5-3: If Admiral Raddus is in the Leader slot, all allies gain the granted ability [c][ffff33]Hope[-][/c], which will revive all allies and all allies recover 100% Health and Protection, then deal true damage and inflict Protection Disruption (Protection is temporarily disabled) and Healing Immunity (immune to Health and Protection recovery) to all enemies. Hope requires 100% Upload progress to activate and can be used one per battle.
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_5-4: Gain Upload progress by resisting debuffs, damaging enemies with Expose (receives additional damage from attacks), and using Special abilities. Jyn Erso gains additional Upload progress when she uses any ability. Additionally, all allies gain Upload progress when Spark of Rebellion is dispelled. At 100% Upload progress, Admiral Raddus gains a bonus turn and Hope is dispelled from all other allies.
MSG_EVENT_ADMIRALRADDUS_5-5: Hope is an ability that can be used once per battle. When used, it will revive all allies and all allies recover 100% Health and Protection, then deal true damage and inflict Protection Disruption (Protection is temporarily disabled) and Healing Immunity (immune to Health and Protection recovery) to all enemies.
NEWSLETTER_ADMIRAL_RADDUS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Admiral Raddus[-][/c], a Mon Calamari who played a key role stealing the plans to the Death Star from Scarif, is coming to the holotables!

Raddus is a new leader for the Rogue One faction and introduces a new buff, [c][F0FF23]Spark of Rebellion[-][/c], which provides these allies with additional Offense and Speed. This buff is also one of the ways to gain Upload progress which, when complete, allows the use of the granted ability [c][F0FF23]Hope[-][/c]. Hope revives all allies, deals true damage to all enemies, and inflicts enemies with Protection Disruption. In honor of another great Rogue One leader, Raddus has callouts specifically to Jyn Erso to help keep her alive and perpetually apply the Spark of Rebellion buff on her.

His Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Rebel Assault[-][/c], inflicts Expose on enemies who critically hit Rogue One allies. The Omicron for this ability focuses on Grand Arenas where Rogue One allies gain additional Protection, start the battle with Spark of Rebellion, and when they lose Spark of Rebellion they gain a spread of buffs.

Add Admiral Raddus to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “SPARK OF REBELLION” Marquee event, and fight for the Rebellion!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_FINN_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

In today's Update, [c][F0FF23]Finn[-][/c] has a new Omicron ability tier added to his [c][F0FF23]Balanced Tactics[-][/c] Leader ability which boosts non-Galactic Legend Resistance allies in Territory Battles.

With the new Omicron ability unlocked, these allies gain additional Max Health and Protection and revive at the start of each encounter. Finn also begins each encounter with Determination and gives allies counter chance and immunity to critical hits while he has this buff. Furthermore, Resistance allies inflict Expose when using a Special ability and when damaging an enemy who has Expose, also deal additional damage to other enemies.

This new ability tier for Finn is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.

DATACRON_HELP_1_BODY: Datacrons are an effective way of improving the power of an entire squad in the Grand Arena and Territory War game modes.\n\nAll Datacrons have multiple upgrade levels, each including bonus stats that affect your entire squad or powerful bonus mechanics that apply to specific units.
DATACRON_HELP_2_BODY:
Unlocked Datacron levels have additional requirements. Every member of a squad with a Datacron assigned must meet the minimum requirements for each level in order for the squad to gain the benefits of that level. If any member of the squad does not satisfy the minimum requirement of a Datacron level, then that level’s benefit is not applied to any member of the squad.

For example, a Datacron level requiring Relic 5 units only applies its benefits if all members of the squad are Relic 5 or higher. If any unit is Relic 4 or below, then that level’s benefits are not applied to any member of the squad.

However, if a bonus mechanic applies only to a single, specific character in a squad, then only that character must satisfy the requirement of that Datacron level to receive its benefits, provided that the requirements of all previous bonus mechanics in that Datacron have been met.
DATACRON_HELP_3_BODY: Upgrading Datacrons requires a variety of materials; pay attention to what's needed to upgrade yours! When a Datacron is upgraded, it selects a random bonus. Each level of the Datacron specifies if this will be a bonus stat or mechanic. Bonus mechanics are only rolled within the scope of previous bonus mechanics on the Datacron.\n\nFor example, if a Datacron's first bonus mechanic is specific to Light Side characters, its later bonus mechanics are always specific to Light Side factions and characters. As another example, a Datacron with a bonus mechanic specific to the First Order will not roll a later bonus mechanic specific to the Empire or Nightsisters; it remains focused on the First Order faction and characters.
DATACRON_HELP_4_BODY:
Datacron bonus mechanics can be re-rolled for a cost in materials. Each re-roll on a Datacron increases in cost.

Only the most recent unlocked bonus mechanic on a Datacron can be re-rolled until the Datacron has been maximally upgraded. Once a higher-level bonus mechanic has been unlocked, previous ones become locked. Bonus stats initially cannot be re-rolled.

Once a Datacron is fully upgraded, all of its levels can then be re-rolled, including both bonus stats and mechanics. However, a Datacron's bonus mechanics still cannot re-roll outside the locked scope of all bonus mechanics on the Datacron.

For example, a Datacron with bonus mechanics affecting Light Side, Resistance, and BB-8 cannot have its Light Side ability re-rolled to a Dark Side mechanic. However, it can be re-rolled to a different Light Side mechanic.
DATACRON_HELP_5_BODY: Datacrons have a set lifespan. When a Datacron set reaches the end of its lifespan, all owned Datacrons within that set are automatically dismantled.\n\nAny unwanted Datacrons can be dismantled at any time, creating materials that can be used to upgrade other Datacrons.

Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Title Update introduces a new feature [c][F0FF23]Datacrons[-][/c]! Datacrons are a unique way to upgrade your entire squad with special temporary bonuses in Grand Arena Championships and Territory Wars. Each Set of Datacrons focus on a number of factions or characters and brings those squads to the next level with powerful abilities and stat boosts. New Sets of Datacrons will roll out regularly, and during any given month, there will be up to three different Sets of Datacrons live each with their own combination of perks.

The Exhibition for Datacrons is live now! Get Datacrons and upgrade materials from Conquest, Shipments and Territory Wars along with special Login Calendars with everything you need to get started!

See you on the Holotables!

GRANDINQUISITOR_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: Once a Jedi Temple Guard, this Pau'an turned to the dark side when promised access to the Jedi Archives by Darth Sidious. He was granted the title "the Grand Inquisitor," and tasked with hunting down the remaining Jedi who had survived Order 66. He would mercilessly hunt down countless Jedi across the galaxy, but eventually met his end against Kanan Jarrus and his apprentice Ezra Bridger.

NEWSLETTER_GRAND_INQUISITOR_DESC:
The [c][F0FF23]Grand Inquisitor[-][/c] has arrived to the holotables!

Master of the Inquisitorius, the Grand Inquisitor is the highest ranking of all Inquisitors who reports directly to Darth Vader. Charged with hunting down Jedi who survived the Great Purge and other Force sensitives, Grand Inquisitor studied the ways of the Jedi in order to understand their fighting style but ultimately fell to Kanan Jarrus.

His leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Master Inquisitorius[-][/c], provides Inquisitorius allies with a variety of stat boosts based on their role. Jedi who attempt to evade the Inquisitorius are punished with damage through his unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Compassion Leaves a Trail[-][/c]. Grand Inquisitor also introduces a new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Torture[-][/c], that increases damage taken and lowers defense when attacked, all the while preventing bonus turn meter.

Grand Inquisitor's Omicron ability upgrades bring Inquisitors to new heights in Territory Wars. When these abilities are fully upgraded Purge will automatically be reapplied when it expires, Jedi enemies take damage when they gain Protection Up, and Grand Inquisitor has a chance to instantly defeat a Jedi enemy.

Gather your Inquisitorius for their training in the all new "DARK TIMES" Legendary Event. This event will only be around for a short time before it returns in the future, so don't miss your opportunity to impress your worth to Vader and lead the Inquisitorius to victory.

NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_VENTRESS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

In today's Update, [c][F0FF23]Asajj Ventress[-][/c] has a new Omicron ability tier added to her [c][F0FF23]Rampage[-][/c] Unique ability which boosts Nightsister allies in Grand Arenas.

With the new Omicron ability unlocked, whenever an ally or enemy is defeated Nightsister allies gain Turn Meter and recover Protection. Additionally, these defeats also reset the cooldown of Asajj's Endless Wrath ability which will inflict Healing Immunity and reduce enemy Defense and Max Health (excluding Galactic Legends).

This new ability tier for Asajj Ventress is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_VENTRESS_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tier for Asajj Ventress
NEWSLETTER_RAVENS_CLAW_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Kyle Katarn’s ship, the [c][F0FF23]Raven's Claw[-][/c], is docking with the holotables! Replacing his original ship the Moldy Crow, the Raven's Claw was used in a period of his life where he had to relearn his abandoned Force abilities.

Through strong synergy with Home One in the Raven's Claw's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Guiding Foresight[-][/c], non-Scoundrel Rebel allies gain Foresight and can ignore Taunt effects while they have it. Raven's Claw also provides Defense Up and Offense to non-Scoundrel Rebel allies through its [c][F0FF23]Battle Flow Manipulation[-][/c] Unique ability. Furthermore, it can inflict Daze and Target Lock on enemies with its [c][F0FF23]Out of the Sun[-][/c] Special ability and dispel buffs with its Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Force-Guided Laser Cannons[-][/c] when it attacks twice with Foresight.

Unlock the Raven's Claw during the upcoming Galactic Chase event to add this ship to your fleet collection!
NEWSLETTER_RAVENS_CLAW_TITLE: Just a Guy with a Lightsaber... and a Ship

MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_1-1: Greetings Holotable Heroes! I am pleased to announce that the Wookiee bounty hunter turned pit fighter turned mercenary Krrsantan has arrived on the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_1-2: Krrsantan's Basic ability [c][ffff33]Knuckle Duster[-][/c] will inflict Potency Down (debuffs are harder to inflict) and has a small chance to Shock (can't heal, gain buffs, or gain bonus Turn Meter) the target.
MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_1-3: If all of Krrsantan's allies are Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, Shock will apply with every strike.
MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_2-1: Krrsantan's first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Ferocious Fusillade[-][/c], deals damage to the target while giving him Defense Up (increased Defense stat, which reduces incoming damage) and Taunt (enemies must target this character) for 2 turns.
MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_2-2: If all of Krrsantan's allies are Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, they'll gain Health and Protection for each other Hutt Cartel ally and Krrsantan gains Protection Up (grants bonus Protection).
MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_3-1: Krrsantan's second Special ability is [c][ffff33]Dismember[-][/c]. This will inflict [c][ffff33]Disarm[-][/c] on the target which will hinder their Critical Damage and Offense and whenever they use a Basic ability they are inflicted with Damage Over Time (inflicts damage at the start of their turn).
MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_3-2: If all of Krrsantan's allies are Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, this will also increase their cooldowns by 1, inflict Ability Block (can't use Special abilities during their turn) and increase Krrsantan's Max Health.
MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_4-1: Krrsantan gains Defense and Max Health at the start of battle with his Unique ability [c][ffff33]Champion of the Fighting Pits.[-][/c] Additionally he recovers Health and Protection whenever he loses Taunt.
MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_4-2: If all of Krrsantan's allies were Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, he gains Taunt and Speed Up at the start of each encounter and Taunts whenever he loses it if the allied Leader has more than 50% Protection. In Grand Arenas he is immune to Ability Block and cooldown increase, and he will Taunt and recover the allied Leader's Protection the first time they drop below 50% Protection.
MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_4-3: When fully upgraded, if Krrsantan is defeated he will revive once per battle at the end of the allied Leader's next turn.
MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_5-1: While he is the Leader, Krrsantan brings [c][ffff33]Formidable Ferocity[-][/c], giving Scoundrel allies Health Steal, Max Health, and Max Protection.
MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_5-2: Krrsantan's Bounty Hunter Contract requires you to defeat the enemy Leader, and allied Scoundrels can contribute to this contract. This will give additional Health Steal and Max Health to his Bounty Hunter and Scoundrel allies.
MSG_EVENT_KRRSANTAN_5-3: Krrsantan gains the following whenever a Bounty Hunter Contract is completed: Critical Avoidance (reduces chance of being critically hit), Taunt for 2 turns, and recovers Health and Protection. Additionally, if the allied Leader is both a Galactic Legend and Hutt Cartel, he gains Damage Immunity (can't be damaged) for 2 turns and Tenacity (increased chance to resist debuffs).

NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_FULCRUM_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

In today's Update, [c][F0FF23]Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)[-][/c] has a new Omicron ability tier added to her [c][F0FF23]Perseverance[-][/c] Unique ability which boosts her in Territory Wars.

NEWSLETTER_KRRSANTAN_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Krrsantan[-][/c], the vicious Wookiee warrior, is coming to the holotables!

Krrsantan is a Bounty Hunter Tank who specializes in protecting his Hutt Cartel allies. His Special ability [c][F0FF23]Dismember[-][/c] introduces a new debuff [c][F0FF23]Disarm[-][/c]. Disarm reduces a unit's Critical Damage and Offense and inflicts them with Damage Over Time whenever they use a Basic ability. Hutt Cartel allies stack Offense when critically hit through his Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Formidable Ferocity[-][/c], and Krrsantan can gain Taunt and recover Health and Protection through his Special ability [c][F0FF23]Ferocious Fusillade[-][/c].

His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Champion of the Fighting Pits[-][/c], grants him additional Defense and Max Health, along with Health and Protection recovery when he loses Taunt. If all allies are Hutt Cartel, he also Taunts at the beginning of the encounter and will revive at the end of the allied Leader's turn the first time he is defeated. The Omicron for this ability focuses on Grand Arenas where he gains additional Max Protection and, if all allies are Hutt Cartel, he is immune to Ability Block and cooldown increase.

Add Krrsantan to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “ONE INFAMOUS WOOKIEE” Marquee event!

NEWSLETTER_BEN_SOLO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Conquest Volume 7 begins soon and shards for a new character, [c][F0FF23]Ben Solo,[-][/c] will be available for a limited time in this mode! Through the power of a Force Dyad, Ben lifts Rey to new power levels.

Ben's abilities bring damage to Light Side and Rey led teams, with his Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]A Shadow Within,[-][/c] dealing more damage to tanks and his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Family Legacy,[-][/c] inflicting Armor Shred. In Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade on his Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Redeemed,[-][/c] his attacks also ignore protection.

Through his [c][F0FF23]Force Dyad[-][/c] Unique, if all allies were Light Side at the start of battle and there is any version of Rey in the allied Leader slot, all allies gain [c][F0FF23]Instant Defeat Immunity[-][/c] for 1 turn at the start of each encounter. Furthermore, while Ben Solo is active Rey can't be defeated, and Ben Solo can't be defeated while Rey is above 50% health. In Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade, Ben can also revive when under a Galactic Legend Rey lead and grant his allies Instant Defeat Immunity.

Earn Ben Solo shards during the upcoming Conquest events! Additionally, Ben Solo will be summonable with a data disk acquired after beating Sector 3 in any Conquest difficulty modes during the upcoming events.

MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_1-1: Greetings Holotable Heroes! I am pleased to introduce Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian). This cunning scoundrel was able to infiltrate Jabba's Palace and earn the respect of the Hutt himself during a daring rescue operation on Tatooine, and now his skills are yours to command on the Holotables!
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_1-2: Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian)'s Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Double Dealer[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy and grants Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) a stack of [c][ffff33]Deep Cover[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_1-3: Deep Cover grants extra Defense Penetration (ignores some of the target's Defense stat) and Potency per stack (max 5).
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_2-1: Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian)'s Special ability, [c][ffff33]Cutter vibro-ax[-][/c], deals Physical damage to the target enemy. This ability gains Defense Penetration and Offense for each stack of Deep Cover that Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) has.
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_2-2: When Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) uses this ability while he has 5 stacks of Deep Cover, he will inflict the target enemy with Armor Shred (reduced Defense stat) until the end of battle, multiple stacks of Damage Over Time (inflicts damage at the start of their turn), and this ability has a chance to refresh its cooldowns.
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_3-1: Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian)'s Special ability, [c][ffff33]Covert Coordination[-][/c], dispels debuffs on the target ally and grants them stacks of Deep Cover equal to the amount on Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) along with a variety of buffs.
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_3-2: If the target ally is Light Side, they gain Potency Up (debuffs are harder to resist) and Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available). If the target ally is Dark Side, they gain Defense Up (increased Defense stat, which reduces incoming damage) and Health Up (increases Max Health). If the target ally is Hutt Cartel, they also gain Speed Up (takes turns more often) and Retribution (will counter attack when damaged).
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_3-3: When Covert Coordination is used, the target ally will also be called to assist and they will gain a bonus turn.
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_4-1: Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) gains Defense Penetration with [c][ffff33]Agent On The Inside[-][/c], and grants Defense Penetration and Potency to any allies with any stacks of Deep Cover. At the start of Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian)'s turn, he gains a stack of Deep Cover. If all allies were Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) immediately gains 5 stacks of Deep Cover.
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_4-2: While Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) has 5 stacks of Deep Cover, he gains the granted ability [c][ffff33]Hutt's Favor[-][/c], which consumes all stacks of Deep Cover on Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) and deals Physical damage to the target enemy. This ability will deal more damage based on the number of debuffs the enemy has, and will grant Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) [c][ffff33]Trusted Agent[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_4-3: Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) gains Defense Penetration and Offense for each stack of Trusted Agent that he has. While Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) has at least one stack of Trusted Agent active, he will attack again when using his Basic attack.
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_4-4: While in Territory Wars, allies gain additional bonuses while they have Deep Cover, and whenever Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) gains a stack of Deep Cover, he grants a stack of Deep Cover to an ally that doesn't have it.
NEWSLETTER_SKIFF_GUARD_LANDO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian),[-][/c] who went under cover in Jabba's Palace to help save Han, is coming to the holotables!

Skiff Guard heavily uses the new buff [c][F0FF23]Deep Cover,[-][/c] which provides Defense Penetration and Potency. If Skiff Guard has enough stacks of Deep Cover, his Special ability [c][F0FF23]Cutter Vibro-ax[-][/c] inflicts Armor Shred with a chance to refresh the cooldown of the ability. He can also support another ally with his Special ability [c][F0FF23]Covert Coordination,[-][/c] which dispels debuffs on them then calls them to assist and grants them a bonus turn.

His Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Agent on the Inside[-][/c] gives a new granted ability [c][F0FF23]Hutt's Favor[-][/c] when he gains enough stacks of Deep Cover. This granted ability does bonus damage to the target enemy based on their Max Health for each debuff on them. In Territory Wars with the Omicron upgrade, this ability also increases the stats for allies with Deep Cover and allows it to spread more often to them.

Add Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “[c][F0FF23]GUARD DUTY[-][/c]” Marquee event!

NEWSLETTER_DATACRON_SET4_DESC: Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nStarting with Datacron set 4, [c][F0FF23]Security Primer[-][/c], we are slowing down the release cadence for Datacrons in order to provide more time for players to unlock and digest the impact of each set of Datacrons to their roster. A new Datacron set will be releasing once every two months and each set will last four months. This also means there will only be 2 sets of Datacrons live at any given time instead of 3, making it easier to discover how all current Datacrons interact with each other and further reducing the overall complexity.

NEWSLETTER_PROFUNDITY_DESC:
Hello Holotable Heroes,

The Rebels are uploading precious information to a new Capital Ship on the Holotables! A pivotal fighter in the Battle of Scarif, Admiral Raddus succeeded in taking down the shield to receive the crucial Death Star plans that the Rebellion needed in their most desperate hour.

The [c][F0FF23]Profundity[-][/c] charges its Ultimate ability [c][F0FF23]Admiral, We Have the Plans[-][/c] by increasing its Download progress from other Rebel ships. When the Ultimate is activated, the Profundity will drop the Tantive IV which the enemy capital ship will not be able to resist and jump into lightspeed to follow, leaving its ships stranded on the battlefield. With potent Special abilities, [c][F0FF23]Unconventional Maneuver[-][/c] will inflict more debuffs as it deals more instances of damage and [c][F0FF23]The Rebel Fleet Has Arrived[-][/c] will inflict Marked on Stealthed enemies. Through the Unique ability [c][F0FF23]I Say We Fight[-][/c], all units are immune to Turn Meter manipulation and Rebel Cargo ships are immune to critical hits.

Achieve dominance on the Holotables by adding the Profundity to your ships roster through the all new Journey Guide Fleet Mastery event!
NEWSLETTER_PROFUNDITY_TITLE: He's Returned to His Ship. He's Going to Fight.

PROFUNDITY_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: An Alliance warship that was a converted Government tower, Profundity was commanded by the mayor of the city of Nystullum, Raddus most notably in the daring battle above Scarif. The Profundity acted as the command ship for the Alliance Fleet above Scarif as Rogue One was attempting to transmit the Death Star plans. Upon receiving the fateful transmission, but before jumping into hyperspace, the Profundity was disabled by Devastator, an Imperial Star Destroyer, and boarded by Darth Vader. As Darth Vader sought to retrieve the stolen plans, a crew of Rebels were able to escape aboard the Tantive IV that was docked aboard the capital ship giving the Rebel Alliance hope.

MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_1-1: I am pleased to announce that we are bringing to the holotables the Bounty Hunter Boushh!
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_1-2: For a time, Boushh was a disguise donned by Leia Organa in the Rebels' attempt to rescue Han Solo from Jabba the Hutt.
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_1-3: The Bounty Hunter was known for their bargaining tactics and use of Thermal Detonators, and these aspects were key factors in Leia's deception.
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_1-4: Boushh (Leia Organa)'s Basic Ability is [c][ffff33]Ambidextrous Assault[-][/c]. With this attack Boushh will inflict damage on her target while at the same time inflicting them with a Thermal Detonator (an undispellable debuff that inflicts damage after a number of turns have elapsed).
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_1-5: Boushh's Thermal Detonators will explode on their own after two turns of them existing on the target, dealing additional damage.
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_1-6: If the Leader of Boushh's squad has the tags Bounty Hunter, Hutt Cartel, and/or Smuggler, this ability gains additional effects!
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_2-1: Boushh is renowned for the use of Thermal Detonators and with the ability [c][ffff33]Inventive[-][/c], Boushh (Leia Organa) can prematurely detonate all Thermal Detonators on all opponents. Then she'll inflict an additional Thermal Detonator on everyone on the opposing side.
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_3-1: Boushh's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Fearless[-][/c], makes her immune to Fear and will start her off with the buff [c][ffff33]My Kind of Scum[-][/c], giving her increased Defense and Max Health.
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_3-2: Additionally she will put the effect [c][ffff33]Deadly Bluff[-][/c] on all her opponents. While under this effect, enemies who receive any Thermal Detonators will be inflicted with an additional one at the end of the turn.
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_3-3: If all allies were Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, Deadly Bluff prevents out of turn attacks and lowers the Speed of any opponents inflicted with a Thermal Detonator.
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_4-1: Boushh (Leia Organa) wears [c][ffff33]Ubese Ogygian Cloak[-][/c] armor, giving her additional bonus stats, and if her entire squad is Hutt Cartel, makes her immune to Stun (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn) and Ability Block (can't use Special abilities during their turn).
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_4-2: Light Side Smuggler allies will also gain these bonuses as well as an increased chance to critically hit.
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_4-3: With her Omicron active, she will gain the following effects in Guild Raids: Reduce the cooldown of Inventive, and whenever Fearless inflicts an additional Thermal Detonator, if the ally in the Leader slot is Hutt Cartel, all Hutt Cartel allies gain bonus stats that last until the end of battle.
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_5-1: Boushh (Leia Organa)'s Leader ability gives her Bounty Hunter allies additional Max Health and Max Protection, and Deadly Bluff lowers the Tenacity of her opponents.
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_5-2: Additionally, at the end of any turn where an enemy has both Deadly Bluff and a Thermal Detonator, dispel all buffs on them.
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_5-3: Completing her Contract involves defeating an enemy from the damage of Thermal Detonator, which will then reward all Bounty Hunter allies with immunity to Stun and defeated enemies can no longer be revived.
MSG_EVENT_BOUSHH_5-4: Boushh's payout will inflict multiple Thermal Detonators on all enemies, and all of her abilities inflict an additional Thermal Detonator until the end of battle. If all allies were Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, the cooldown of Inventive is immediately refreshed and reduced until the end of battle.
NEWSLETTER_BOUSHH_LEIA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Boushh (Leia Organa)[-][/c], the fearless and inventive Bounty Hunter disguise donned by the Rebel leader Leia Organa, is coming to the holotables!

Boushh is a Bounty Hunter Attacker who specializes in Thermal Detonators. Her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Ambidextrous Assault[-][/c], inflicts a Thermal Detonator while her Special Ability, [c][F0FF23]Inventive[-][/c], detonates all Thermals on all enemies before applying more. Her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Fearless[-][/c], introduces a new buff, [c][F0FF23]My Kind of Scum[-][/c], which stacks Health and Defense as well as giving a new effect, [c][F0FF23]Deadly Bluff[-][/c], which enemies start the encounter with and adds effects to Boushh's abilities such as adding Thermal Detonators to enemies who receive one that turn.

Her second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Ubese Ogygian Cloak[-][/c], provides her and Light Side Smuggler allies with various stat boosts. Introducing the first Raid Omicron upgrade to the game, when fully upgraded this ability also provides stacking stat boosts when Fearless inflicts Thermal Detonators while in Raids.

Add Boushh (Leia Organa) to your roster by unlocking her in the all-new “MY KIND OF SCUM” Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_MOB_ENFORCER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Mob Enforcer[-][/c] has received a rework to her kit! In addition to synergy with Hutt Cartel she will also change roles from a Tank to Support to better reflect her identity. 

The following changes have been made to her abilities:

- "[c][F0FF23]Dirty Fighting[-][/c]" Basic ability now has a 100% Defense Down chance (previously 80%) and inflicts additional debuffs when the ally in the Leader slot is Hutt Cartel and if the target already had Defense Down.
- "[c][F0FF23]Thermal Detonator[-][/c]" Special ability will now explode all Thermal Detonators on the target before applying one and has a chance to grant her a bonus turn.
- "[c][F0FF23]Underworld Moxie[-][/c]" Unique ability now grants her additional stat bonuses for each Hutt Cartel, Scoundrel, and Smuggler ally, as well as reducing the cooldown of "Thermal Detonator" when an ally falls below 30% Health.

FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_BATCH_01: [f0ff23]Batch Manage[-] allows you to sell and upgrade many mods all at once. Use a saved Filter to speed up your mod workflow.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_BATCH_UPGRADE_01: [f0ff23]Reveal All Secondary Stats[-] will automatically upgrade mods to the minimum level that identifies all four secondary stats. This is particularly useful when upgrading multiple mods of different rarities.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_ENHANCE_01: Enhance Mod is a one-stop location for all your mod tinkering needs. Here you can upgrade, slice, calibrate, and sell an individual mod.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_ENHANCE_02: Remember, mod slicing is only available on Mk V and VI mods. Mod calibration requires a MK VI mod.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_FILTERS_01: Mod Filters help you find mods that meet your exact stat and attribute needs.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_FILTERS_02: Besides the basic options, you can also filter for mods that [f0ff23]include or exclude[-] specific stats, mods that have all [f0ff23]secondary stats revealed[-], and mods with a preferred [f0ff23]slice count[-] or [f0ff23]slice quality[-].
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_FILTERS_03: Additionally, you can [f0ff23]save mod filters[-]. This handy function allows you to quickly retrieve mods when equipping, selling, or upgrading.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_01: Aha! It's time for some advanced mod alteration techniques. [f0ff23]Mod Calibration[-] will let you [f0ff23]transfer a slice[-] between secondary stats.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_02: You start by selecting a stat for [f0ff23]slice removal[-]. It's best to [f0ff23]choose a stat you don't want[-] on this mod.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_03: Once you've selected a stat, tap this button to start. Calibration will [f0ff23]remove[-] a random slice from your selected stat and [f0ff23]apply a new slice[-] to a random stat.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_04: Calibration is a [f0ff23]volatile[-] process. When a slice is reapplied, it could go back to the same stat you remove it from.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_05: Don't forget, you'll need [f0ff23]Micro Attenuators[-] to perform a calibration.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_06: There's also a [f0ff23]limit[-] on the number of times a mod can be calibrated. Earn more [f0ff23]calibration attempts[-] by slicing the mod.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_SLICE_01: Slicing a mod always make it stronger, but how much stronger you ask? The details matter!
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_SLICE_02: Each secondary stat visualizes its [f0ff23]slices[-] here. The bigger the bar, the closer the slice is to its [f0ff23]maximum possible[-] value.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_SLICE_03: Additionally, [f0ff23]slice quality[-] will average together all the slices for a stat and give you a percentage value. Higher values mean the stat is closer to [f0ff23]peak performance[-].

NEWSLETTER_MOD_CALIBRATION_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Our latest Title Update introduces a number of quality of life changes for Mods and a new feature, [c][F0FF23]Mod Calibration[-][/c]! Mod Calibration allows you to tune your Mods even further by transferring slices between stats to create the best Mod for your roster. Each Mk VI Mod can be Calibrated a limited number of times using the new currency, Micro Attenuators, and gives you the chance to improve your good Mods into great Mods.

Managing your Mods is easier than ever! Quickly explore your Mod inventory with new tools for batch upgrading and saving filters for Mods. The new Mod Enhance screen is now a one stop spot to slice, upgrade, sell, and now Calibrate your Mods.

There are a ton more Quality of Life improvements in this update that help you quickly find your most important Mods. We have highlighted Speed secondaries in the Store and batch manage views, added a new set of filter options, and show the average Slice Quality for each upgraded Mod.

All of these changes help open up managing Mods to more players while respecting the investment players have had in the system over the years. We hope you enjoy the new and improved Mods experience and would love to hear your feedback on the Official forums!

See you on the Holotables!

NEWSLETTER_JABBA_GL_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Galactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Jabba the Hutt[-][/c] has slithered onto the Holotables! One of the most powerful crime lords in the galaxy, Jabba strikes fear with an ominous laugh.... and a pet Rancor.

His Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]His High Exaltedness[-][/c], provides multiple statistical and mechanical benefits for Bounty Hunter, Smuggler, and Hutt Cartel allies. He also provides important synergy to allies with [c][F0FF23]My Kind of Scum[-][/c] and can't be directly targeted by enemies while this buff is present in his squad.

Jabba utilizes the new buff, [c][F0FF23]Hired Muscle[-][/c], to bestow his allies with extra Tenacity and immunity to Daze and Fear (when in the presence of the mighty Jabba, what else could seem so fearsome?). Additional benefits are also provided based on the allies' role.

His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Illustrious[-][/c], turns an enemy's benefit into a boon for his allies by providing bonus Turn Meter for his team whenever an enemy gains it for theirs.

Stay on Jabba's good side, because his Ultimate ability, [c][F0FF23]There Will Be No Bargain[-][/c], instantly defeats the target enemy and provides Health and Protection recovery for Bounty Hunter, Hutt Cartel, and Smuggler allies with Hutt Cartel allies also gaining bonus Turn Meter. Although they are not instantly defeated, raid bosses and Galactic Legends will still suffer dearly at the hands of Jabba's Ultimate when it is used against them.

Obtain Jabba the Hutt now through the all-new event [c][F0FF23]Greetings, Exalted One[-][/c], which can be accessed via the Journey Guide.
NEWSLETTER_JABBA_GL_TITLE: I Seek An Audience With Your Greatness
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_CASSIAN_ANDOR_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Cassian Andor's[-][/c] kit! Cassian has a new Omicron tier added to their [c][F0FF23]Groundwork[-][/c] Unique ability, which disguises him as an enemy unit in Territory Battles. While disguised, Cassian retains his Unique ability and is considered a member of Rogue One, but will also inherit the kit of the unit he is posing as. Additionally, whenever Cassian uses an ability, he gains Turn Meter for each debuffed enemy, and whenever he uses a Special ability, he inflicts Ability Block, Buff Immunity, Healing Immunity, and Defense Down, and K-2SO is called to assist.

This new ability tier for Cassian Andor is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_CASSIAN_ANDOR_TITL: New Omicron Ability Tier for Cassian Andor
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_GAMORREAN_GUARD_DE:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Gamorrean Guard[-][/c] has received a touchup to their kit! These changes will help him serve as a Hutt Cartel Tank who synergizes with Galactic Legend Jabba the Hutt.

His new Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Loyal Enforcer[-][/c] grants him additional Max Health for each Hutt Cartel ally. If the leader is Hutt Cartel, Gamorrean Guard can Taunt when an ally falls too low on health, and if Jabba is the leader Gamorrean Guard will also recover health whenever Jabba uses a Special ability.

When this ability is fully upgraded with an Omicron, in Territory Battles Gamorrean Guard and his Hutt Cartel allies gain multiple defensive stat boosts and other Hutt Cartel allies will gain Damage Immunity the first time they fall too low on health.

Upgrade your Gamorrean Guard now and protect the Hutt Cartel!

Bounty Hunter, Hutt Cartel, and Smuggler allies have +30 Speed, +30% Mastery, and +30% Max Health. Damage Hutt Cartel allies receive is decreased by 30%

MSG_EVENT_HONDO_1-1: With the holotables welcoming Hondo Ohnaka, I finally have a use for some of these old holo-recordings I inherited.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_1-2: Hondo was known for his tall tales and, you know what, I'll just play the recordings...
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_1-3: Have I told you about the time me and my crew took down two Mandalorians? The corridors of Cloud City were never quite the same after that encounter.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_1-4: Hondo's Basic Attack, [c][ffff33]I Smell Profit[-][/c], deals damage to the target and also gives Hondo a stack of [c][ffff33]Ransom[-][/c] (Gain Max Health and Tenacity). If the target is Light Side, Hondo removes Turn Meter from them. If the target is Dark Side, Hondo gains Turn Meter himself.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_2-1: Let me tell you about the time I faced off against a Sith Lord while fighting beside the greatest Jedi of all time...
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_2-2: Hondo can make most opponents his [c][ffff33]Captive[-][/c] through his Special Ability, [c][ffff33]I Don't Want to Kill You Per Se[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_2-3: The Captive's Speed is set to 0 and they can't gain bonus Turn Meter or perform out of turn attacks.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_2-4: The Captive is freed at the start of Hondo's second turn, when the enemy squad gains 25 buffs, or if Hondo is defeated.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_3-1: Of course, the Imperial Inquisitors once thought I was harboring a Jedi. Which I was, but she was paying me a lot of credits so it is completely beside the point.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_3-2: Hondo can call an ally to attack using the Special Ability [c][ffff33]Insolence? We are Pirates[-][/c]. This ability will also cleanse debuffs from Scoundrel allies and has additional effects based on the alignment of the unit called to assist.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_3-3: Hondo will also gain Defense Up (increased Defense stat, which reduces incoming damage) and Offense (increases ability damage) for the rest of the encounter for each stack of Ransom he has when he uses this ability.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_4-1: And then there was that time on Endor that I rescued the famous Luke Skywalker and his friends from the native Ewoks who thought they would make a delicious meal!
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_4-2: [c][ffff33]That's Just Good Business[-][/c] is Hondo's Unique ability that gives him bonuses to his Health Steal (health recovery from dealing damage), and the ability to gain Ransom when he evades an attack.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_4-3: Hondo also gains bonuses based on how many stacks of Ransom he has. If the Captive target is defeated before Hondo has 10 stacks of Ransom, Hondo will flee.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_4-4: In Grand Arenas Hondo's Omicron Ability will give him Turn Meter to start the encounter based on the number of Scoundrel or Smuggler allies.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_4-5: Additionally, Hondo gains additional Critical Chance (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit), Critical Damage (increases the damage of critical hits) / (decreases the damage of critical hits), Defense Penetration (ignores some of a target's Defense stat), and Speed (takes turns more often) if there is an enemy with the Captive debuff at the start of his turn.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_5-1: During the Clone Wars, I kidnapped the fabled Separatist leader Count Dooku! He... never quite forgave me for that little transgression.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_5-2: Hondo's second Unique ability, [c][ffff33]I Guess We Won't Be Friends[-][/c], gives him benefits in reaction to other characters gaining buffs, bonus Turn Meter, or when they are called to assist.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_5-3: Additionally, if Hondo had two or more other allies at the start of the encounter and is the last character remaining on his side, he gains several stats and 100% Turn Meter.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_BONUS-1: As a pirate, I would often run afoul of the system authorities. Usually a handshake containing credits is all it takes, but there was one time that I happened to encounter some of the Empire's most incorruptible officers.
MSG_EVENT_HONDO_LEGACY-1: Finally, there was my encounter with Jabba the Hutt, his Majordomo, and I am pretty sure even Boba Fett was there!
NEWSLETTER_HONDO_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Hondo Ohnaka[-][/c], notorious pirate with escapades spanning from the Clone Wars to the days of the Resistance, is coming to the holotables!

Known for serving himself above all else, Hondo introduces the first use of the [c][FFFFFF]Neutral[-][/c] alignment tag to the game. This alignment is distinct from Light and Dark side so will not count for either, but he will be available for use in all Territory Battles.

Hondo also introduces the [c][F0FF23]Captive[-][/c] debuff that sets an enemy's speed to zero (excluding Galactic Legends and Raid Bosses) and the longer the enemy stays captive, the more stats Hondo receives for his frustration of waiting for his [c][F0FF23]Ransom[-][/c] to be paid. Ransom provides bonuses to Hondo depending on how many stacks he has. In Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade on his Unique ability [c][F0FF23]That's Just Good Business,[-][/c] Hondo will gain additional stats when there is a Captive enemy and starts the battle with bonus turn meter.

Through his second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]I Guess We Won't Be Friends[-][/c], Hondo makes sure he always gets his cut by gaining bonus turn meter whenever anyone does and will become stronger if all his allies have fallen and he is left to protect himself.

Add Hondo Ohnaka to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “GOOD BUSINESS” Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_HONDO_TITLE: Oh, The Stories I Could Tell. So Many of Them True.
PLAYERPORTRAIT_HONDO_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the first run of the "GOOD BUSINESS" marquee event.\n\nHondo's mercurial allegiance was as much a hindrance as it was a benefit to his "allies".
PLAYERTITLE_MARQUEE_HONDO_DESC: Earned by completing the Legacy tier in the "GOOD BUSINESS" marquee event.\n\nHondo's legacy stretches from the earliest days of the Clone Wars all the way to the time of the First Order. And, on rare occasion, the stories he tells even happen to be true!

CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TB_JABBA_MISSIONS_01_: Welcome back to the holotables! I am happy to share that new holodata has been discovered related to Jabba the Hutt's exploits during the Hoth and Geonosis Territory Battles.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TB_JABBA_MISSIONS_02_: They all feature this adorable old Weequay who seems to be telling some tall-tales.You can find these new recordings in the fourth phase of the dark side Hoth and Geonosis Territory Battles now!
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_GEONOSISMISSION_M: We've discovered a new recording concerning Jabba the Hutt's involvement in this Territory Battle! Let's take a listen.
You know, Jabba and I once fought Kenobi, Skywalker, and his apprentice on Geonosis. One could say we were the champions of the Petranaki arena.
...and that was the first of many, many victories over the Jedi. They really could learn a thing or two from me.
That's not how Ahsoka tells it. I don't think she was even at the Battle of Geonosis.
Well, what does she know. Come along, that's enough chit chat.
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_HOTHMISSION_MESSA: We've discovered a new recording concerning Jabba the Hutt's involvement in this Territory Battle! Let's take a listen.
Why just let me tell you about the time I helped Jabba capture the notorious criminal, Han Solo...
Oh, this ought to be good.
...and THAT is how we brought Solo to justice. Before Jabba the Hutt's untimely demise, of course.
Uh huh. You know it was Boba Fett who captured Han, right? My friend Han. Who I rescued.
That's ridiculous. Anyway, it's your turn to deal.

MSG_EVENT_BT1000_1-1: Doctor Aphra was infamous for her two droids, Triple Zero and BT-1, and now we've got both of them on the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_1-2: BT-1's [c][ffff33]Overcharged Laser[-][/c] will fire three shots and inflict the target with a Damage Over Time effect (inflicts damage at the start of their turn).
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_1-3: 0-0-0's Basic ability [c][ffff33]Fatal Shock[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Shock (can't heal, gain buffs, or gain bonus turn meter). If the target is a non-Droid and already had Shock, it will Stun them instead.
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_1-4: Defeating an enemy with this ability will give 0-0-0 a stack of Translation (a variety of bonuses based on how many stacks a character has).
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_2-1: 0-0-0's Special ability [c][ffff33]Specialized in Torture[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Torture (take additional damage, reduced Defense, and can't gain bonus Turn Meter) on the target.
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_2-2: If the target already had Torture, deal damage to all enemies and all Dark Side allies gain a stack of Translation.
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_2-3: BT-1's Special ability [c][ffff33]Agent of Destruction[-][/c] will deal damage to all enemies, inflict Expose (receives additional damage from attacks) and a stack of Damage Over Time.
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_2-4: If the primary target had Target Lock (certain abilities have improved interactions against Target Lock), they will receive another stack of Damage Over Time as well as Burning (deals damage each turn and decreases chance to evade attacks).
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_3-1: 0-0-0's Unique ability [c][ffff33]Interrogation Protocol[-][/c] will grant Dark Side allies Critical Damage (increases the damage of critical hits).
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_3-2: And whenever a Dark Side ally uses an ability on an enemy with Torture, they will gain 1 stack of Translation (max 3). Those same allies will gain Potency (debuffs on enemies are harder to resist) for each stack of Translation on them (doubled for Droids).
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_3-3: BT-1's Unique ability [c][ffff33]Homicidal Counterpart[-][/c] gives him bonus Critical Damage (increases the damage of critical hits) for Droid allies, Potency for Dark Side allies, and Speed (takes turns more often) for Scoundrel allies. When 0-0-0 is an active ally, BT-1 will assist whenever 0-0-0 uses a Special ability, and gains a new ability named [c][ffff33]Kill Them All[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_3-4: Kill Them All will deal damage to all enemies and call 0-0-0 to assist.
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_4-1: BT-1's other Unique ability is [c][ffff33]Blastomech Prototype[-][/c], which increases his Offense (increases ability damage).
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_4-2: In addition, whenever BT-1 defeats an enemy he gets a bonus turn where he must activate [c][ffff33]Haywire[-][/c], damaging all other characters, including your own (this damage can't defeat them).
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_4-3: 0-0-0's second Unique ability is [c][ffff33]Drain Organics[-][/c], which will see that whenever 0-0-0 or BT-1 gains Translation, the other receives it as well.
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_4-4: Additionally, at the start of 0-0-0's turn, a random non-Droid enemy without Target Lock gets Target Lock, and when defeating an enemy the attacking ally gains Health and Protection, and additional bonuses if that ally is a Dark Side Droid or BT-1.
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_5-1: Both BT-1 and 0-0-0 have Omicrons that are active in the 3v3 Grand Arena game mode.
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_5-2: 0-0-0's Specialized Torture will extend how long Torture lasts as well as recovering Health and Protection for himself and BT-1. If this ability defeats an enemy, Dark Side allies gain Offense, doubled for Droids.
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_5-3: BT-1's Unique ability Homicidal Counterpart also has additional effects in 3v3 Grand Arena with the Omicron tier activated.
MSG_EVENT_BT1000_5-4: If either droid defeats an enemy, their cooldowns are refreshed and they both recover Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn).
NEWSLETTER_TRIPLEZERO_BT1_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]0-0-0[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]BT-1,[-][/c] Doctor Aphra's droids and products of the good sir Tarkin's initiative, are coming to the holotables!

0-0-0's Special ability [c][F0FF23]Specialized in Torture[-][/c] fulfills its namesake by inflicting Torture on enemies and granting Translation to Dark Side allies if the target already had Torture. In 3v3 Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade, Torture will last longer on the target and if this defeats an enemy, Dark Side allies will stack Offense. His first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Interrogation Protocol,[-][/c] provides Translation to Dark Side allies when they use an ability on enemies with Torture, and his second Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Drain Organics[-][/c] allows 0-0-0 and BT-1 to grant each other Translation if they gain it and gives Turn Meter to Dark Side allies when they defeat a non-Droid enemy.

BT-1's Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Overcharged Laser[-][/c] and Special ability [c][F0FF23]Agent of Destruction[-][/c] lay down debuffs including Damage Over Time and Expose. If 0-0-0 is an ally, BT-1 assists 0-0-0 through his first Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Homicidal Counterpart[-][/c] and in 3v3 Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade, if either of them defeats an enemy they refresh their cooldowns and gain Turn Meter. This ability also gives the granted ability [c][F0FF23]Kill Them All,[-][/c] which calls 0-0-0 to assist. His second Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Blastomech Prototype[-][/c] gives BT-1 plenty of Offense and if he defeats an enemy, he becomes so excited that he takes a bonus turn to use the granted ability [c][F0FF23]Haywire[-][/c] which damages everyone on the field. 0-0-0 was right when he called BT-1 a selfish little murder bucket!

NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_LUMINARA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Luminara Unduli's[-][/c] kit! Luminara has a new Omicron tier added to her [c][F0FF23]Master Healer's Blessing[-][/c] Special ability for the Grand Arena game mode. This upgrade will now provide a Dispel and Tenacity Up to allies, as well as Speed for Luminara. Additionally, the Healing Over Time stacks that this ability grants will now recover Protection when they trigger, provide Critical Avoidance and immunity to Turn Meter reduction while they are present, and if an enemy dispels them Luminara will reduce the cooldown of this ability to get them back up quickly. While longterm players should enjoy the return of Luminara as a plug and play healer to their squads, note that these effects do not work on units that have Protection Up.

This new ability tier for Luminara Unduli is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_LUMINARA_TITLE: New Omicron Ability Tier for Luminara Unduli
NEWSLETTER_SCYTHE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Conquest Volume 8 begins soon and in preparation for the Grand Inquisitor's event to return in December, we have blueprints for a new ship, [c][F0FF23]Scythe[-][/c], that will be available for a limited time in this mode! Crewed by both the Grand Inquisitor and Fifth Brother, the ship turns Tarkin's Executrix into a flurry of TIE fighters to quickly outnumber opponents.

When under Executrix command, the Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Two Moves Ahead[-][/c] summons two crewless TIE fighters at the start of battle and inflicts Marked on ally TIE fighters while they have Foresight. Additionally this ability increases ally empire ship Max Health, Offense, Potency, and Speed. Scythe's Special abilities [c][F0FF23]Intimidating Fly-over[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Predatory Instincts[-][/c] help the Scythe and TIE fighters stick around with health recovery and Protection Up, as well as a dispel of enemy buffs that provides stacks of [c][F0FF23]Formation[-][/c] to allies which further boosts their Health, Offense, and Potency.

The Reinforcement ability [c][F0FF23]Surprise and Fear[-][/c] is aptly named as it inflicts Fear on all enemies and summons two TIE fighters to help recover fallen spots in the battle.

Earn Scythe blueprints during the upcoming Conquest events and prepare for the return of Grand Inquisitor in December!

ABILITYUPGRADE_BASICABILITY_SANASTARROS_: +20% Damage; if the enemy already had Vulnerable, inflict Vulnerable to all enemies for 1 turn
ABILITYUPGRADE_LEADERABILITY_SANASTARROS: Rebel Scoundrel Tanks have +30% Max Health
Rebel Scoundrel Tanks have +30% Max Protection
Rebel Scoundrel Tanks gain 15% Turn Meter whenever a non-Tank Rebel ally or Sana is damaged by an attack

MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_1-1: Sana Starros, Doctor Aphra's sometimes partner, sometimes rival, is headed to the Holotables!
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_1-2: Sana was a smuggler and mercenary who found herself working for the Rebellion more than once, but has a penchant for leading Scoundrels during her more interesting jobs.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_1-3: Sana Starros' Basic attack, [c][ffff33]Cheap Shot[-][/c], will inflict Vulnerable (will be critically hit if able) on the target. If they already had Vulnerable, then all enemies are inflicted with it instead.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_2-1: Sana's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Lessons in Coercion[-][/c], will dispel debuffs on non-Tank Rebel allies, as well as herself.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_2-2: It will also give those allies Critical Chance Up (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit) and Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available), and finally call all Stealthed allies to assist.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_2-3: Rebel Scoundrel Tanks, however, will instead recover 20% Protection when Sana uses this ability.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_3-1: Sana's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Smart-targeting Scatterblaster[-][/c], will deal damage to all enemies and inflict them with Tenacity Down (lowered chance to resist debuffs).
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_3-2: Enemies who were Target Locked (certain abilities have improved interactions against Target Lock) are dealt damage again, and Staggered (lose 100% Turn Meter if damaged by an attack).
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_4-1: Sana's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]A Professional I Can Trust...ish[-][/c], gives her counter chance and Critical Chance (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit). Additionally she will assist non-Attacker Rebel Scoundrels who use a Special ability, and recover Protection when doing so.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_4-2: Sana gains Turn Meter whenever an enemy is Target Locked. At the start of Rebel ally's turns, as well as whenever Sana evades an attack or attacks out of turn, non-Scoundrel allies are inflicted with [c][ffff33]Suspicious[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_4-3: Suspicious allies lose Speed, but gain 100% Critical Chance.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_5-1: As a Leader, her [c][ffff33]Rebel Sympathizer[-][/c] ability makes Rebel Scoundrel Tanks gain multiple stats, and they may gain Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn) when their allies are damaged. Allies may gain bonus stats when they gain bonus Turn Meter.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_5-2: Rebel Scoundrels who remove Turn Meter from enemies will also make them lose Max Health. When Rebel allies and Sana deal damage more than once in a turn, they gain Max Health, and whenever they critically hit, they inflict Target Lock and can reduce Rebel Scoundrel Tanks' cooldowns by 1.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_5-3: In [c][ffff33]Territory Wars[-][/c], Sana's Omicron tier will give immunity to Daze (can't assist, counter attack, or gain bonus Turn Meter), and, at the start of battle, have Rebel Scoundrel Tanks Taunt (enemies must target this character). Scoundrels start with Tenacity Up, and Sana's Target Lock can't be resisted.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_5-4: Additionally her Omicron makes it so whenever Rebel allies and Sana deal damage multiple times in a turn (to one or multiple targets), dispel all buffs on all enemies and inflict Healing Immunity (immune to Health and Protection recovery) on them.
NEWSLETTER_SANA_STARROS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]Sana Starros[-][/c], the Trustworthy-ish Smuggler who has fought alongside the best (and worst) the galaxy has to offer, is coming to the holotables!

Even though Sana did not join the Rebellion she often assisted them, especially fellow Scoundrels. Her Leader ability [c][F0FF23]Rebel Sympathizer[-][/c] highlights this by providing extra Max Health to these allies when they do Area of Effect damage, dishing out additional damage when they remove turn meter, and reducing their cooldowns in certain scenarios if they are a Tank.

With an Omicron ability upgrade in Territory Wars, her leader ability also makes Rebel Scoundrel allies immune to Daze, start the battle with Taunt if they are a Tank, and dispel all buffs and inflict Healing Immunity whenever they do Area of Effect damage.

Sana also synergizes with Target Lock by inflicting it whenever an enemy is critically hit by a Rebel or Sana, then her Special ability [c][F0FF23]Smart-targeting Scatterblaster[-][/c] will deal extra damage and Stagger Target Locked enemies. Her unique ability [c][F0FF23]A Professional I Can Trust...ish[-][/c] grants Sana turn meter whenever an enemy is inflicted with Target Lock.

Sana's intentions introduce a new debuff [c][F0FF23]Suspicious[-][/c], which lowers Speed but increases Critical Chance for her non-Scoundrel allies. Her Unique ability also has her assist non-Attacker Rebel Scoundrels, and when she does so Rebels and her recover Health and Protection.

Add Sana Starros to your roster by unlocking her in the all-new “PARTNER IN CRIME” Marquee event!

NEWSLETTER_REVA_DESC:
The Inquisitorius are looking to bolster their ranks once again with the addition of [c][F0FF23]Third Sister[-][/c] from the Obi-Wan Kenobi series on Disney+. Third Sister's shards are earned via a Special Mission on Tatooine in Phase 3 of the new Territory Battle, Rise of the Empire.

Third Sister brings to the table a brand new Leader ability in [c][F0FF23]Harbored Aggression[-][/c], allowing Inquisitors to explode out the gate by applying five stacks of Purge at the start of the battle. Following up with her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]No More Hiding[-][/c], she will Ability Block enemies with Purge all the while dispelling herself of any pesky debuffs.

Her Special abilities, [c][F0FF23]Unyielding Onslaught[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Reckless Sweep[-][/c], will also take advantage of Purged enemies. Unyielding Onslaught will deal additional damage while Reckless Sweep will inflict Healing Immunity and give Inquisitorius allies Turn Meter. Meanwhile, her Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Driven by Revenge[-][/c] grants her Hatred, ensuring she will revive after being defeated, and the first time she is defeated, she gains Hatred again, meaning odds are good she'll come back into the fight twice in any given battle!

With three Omicron abilities in Grand Arenas, she looks to make the Inquisitorius squad live up to their deadly reputation in that game mode.

Collect this powerful character through the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle, and exact revenge on your enemies on your own terms.
NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_BATTLE_RISE_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes!

Our latest Territory Battle, [c][F0FF23]RISE OF THE EMPIRE[-][/c], is hitting the Holotables. Starting on December 12th, your guild can select this new Territory Battle if the guild has a total of 200 million GP or more. The surviving Jedi are in hiding, Palpatine has been declared Emperor, the rumblings of Rebellion have begun to stir, and the Hutt Cartels are keeping their heads low and profits high. Every alignment and the entire galaxy are in play in this Territory Battle, meaning your entire roster will be tested in various locations throughout the Star Wars universe. Battles will be fought harkening back to the time period from the end of Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith on Mustafar and Coruscant, and taking you all the way to the time of the Rebellion in Star Wars: A New Hope on Scarif, Tatooine, and the Empire's first Death Star. Battles on the ground and in space are located within the same zone, so your guild will need to fight everything on all fronts if they hope to get three stars in any given phase.

Operations are the new name for Platoons and now support both Characters and Ships so careful planning must be made to ensure they are filled to strengthen or weaken the Operation Abilities tied to that phase. A mix of existing Planetary Modifiers (from Galactic Challenges) and new ones will ensure every combat and special mission is its own unique challenge, so remember to share your winning strategies with your guild.

As with all Territory Battles, many missions will require specific units or factions. As you battle across the galaxy, you will find missions requiring you to bring the Grand Inquisitor, Jabba the Hutt, Scythe, or Doctor Aphra, at or better than specific Relic levels.

The Rise of the Empire Territory Battle runs for 6 days, with 24-hour phases, to have your guild complete their battles and deployments. The earliest phases are tuned for Relic Level 5 characters and ship crews, with the difficulty increasing each phase. Grab your lightsabers, warm up your X-wings, and make sure you're on Jabba's good side, the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle starts soon!
NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_BATTLE_RISE_TITLE: The More You Tighten Your Grip, the More Star Systems Slip Through Your Fingers

THIRDSISTER_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION: The Third Sister was a member of the Inquisitorius tasked with hunting down Jedi that survived Order 66. As a youngling named Reva during Order 66, she witnessed, and experienced first-hand, the ruthlessness exhibited by the fallen Jedi Anakin Skywalker, now known as Darth Vader, in the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. After being left for dead in the temple, she would eventually find a new life and identity as the Third Sister in the Inquisitorius. Her knowledge of Darth Vader's former identity helped drive her to seek revenge against him by attempting to capture his former master, Obi-Wan Kenobi, to draw out Vader and lower his guard.
THIRDSISTER_T1_TO_T6: Health mods allow Third Sister to take enemy attacks with ease.
THIRDSISTER_T7_AND_UP: Speed and Health mods allow Third Sister to inflict meaningful debuffs on the enemy and stay healthy.
UNIQUEABILITY_ACKLAY02_DESC_TB3: The Acklay uses 2 abilities per turn and has +50% Tenacity. Whenever it takes damage, it gains 5% Turn Meter, which can't be prevented. The Acklay is immune to Ability Block, Daze, Fear, Health Down, Shock, Stagger, and Stun, as well as cooldown increase.\n\nWhen the encounter begins, the Acklay becomes Enraged. While Enraged, the Acklay deals 100% more damage. While the Acklay is not Enraged, it has -20% Speed, -25% Offense, and -50% Tenacity.
UNIQUEABILITY_CASSIAN_OMICRON_MAGMATROOP: Whenever Magmatrooper scores a Critical Hit, he recovers 20% Health.\n\nWhile Magmatrooper is active, Imperial Trooper allies have +10% Health Steal.
UNIQUEABILITY_CASSIANANDOR01_TIER08_DESC:
At the start of each encounter, Rebel allies gain Protection Up (20%) for 3 turns, Rebel Attacker allies gain Defense Up for 3 turns, Rebel Support allies gain Potency Up for 3 turns, and Rebel Tank allies gain Tenacity Up for 3 turns. If K-2SO is present, he gains all of these buffs.

[c][e7e7e7]While in Territory Battles:[-][/c] At the start of battle, if all allies are Rogue One, Cassian Andor takes a bonus turn to disguise himself as an enemy character until the end of battle. While disguised, Cassian retains his Unique ability and alignment and is part of the Rogue One faction in addition to his disguise's alignment and faction. At the start of each encounter, all Rebel allies gain Defense Up, Potency Up, and Tenacity Up for 3 turns. Whenever Cassian uses an ability, he gains 12% Turn Meter for each debuffed enemy, he inflicts Ability Block and Buff Immunity for 1 turn and Defense Down and Healing Immunity for 2 turns on target enemy, and K-2SO is called to assist, dealing 97.8% more damage.

- [c][B5E7F5]Rebel Assault Territory Battle:[-][/c] Cassian disguises as Snowtrooper Ops (Elite).
- [c][B5E7F5]Republic Offensive Territory Battle:[-][/c] Cassian disguises as Wat Tambor.
- [c][B5E7F5]Rise of the Empire Territory Battle:[-][/c] Cassian disguises as a modified version of Magmatrooper.

As Vader's assistant, Aphra built a droid army to defeat the Imperial cyberneticist, Cylo. Escaping Vader, she returned to a life of adventure, retrieving the Ordu Aspectu's Rur crystal, kidnapping Hera Syndulla, and serving time at Accresker Jail. Whenever a Dark Side ally inflicts a debuff, they gain 5% Offense for 1 turn and Aphra gains 5 Siphon until the end of the encounter.

Whenever an enemy falls below 30% Health, they are inflicted with Expose and Speed Down for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
LEADERABILITY_DOCTORAPHRA_TIER_06_DESC:
At the start of battle, Doctor Aphra gains Max Health and Max Protection equal to 30% of her Potency, and if BT-1 or 0-0-0 are an ally, she gains 50% Turn Meter for each. Dark Side allies have +20% Offense. Allied Dark Side Droid, Darth Vader, and Krrsantan also have +20% Max Health.

Whenever a Dark Side ally inflicts a debuff, they gain 5% Offense for 1 turn and Aphra gains 5 Siphon until the end of the encounter. LEADERABILITY_DOCTORAPHRA_TIER_07_DESC:
At the start of battle, Doctor Aphra gains Max Health and Max Protection equal to 30% of her Potency, and if BT-1 or 0-0-0 are an ally, she gains 50% Turn Meter for each. Dark Side allies have +20% Offense. Allied Dark Side Droid, Darth Vader, and Krrsantan also have +20% Max Health.

Whenever a Dark Side ally inflicts a debuff, they gain 5% Offense for 1 turn and Aphra gains 5 Siphon until the end of the encounter. If the Dark Side ally is a Droid, Darth Vader, or Krrsantan, they instead gain 10% Offense for 1 turn and Aphra instead gains 10 Siphon until the end of the encounter. Whenever Doctor Aphra, BT-1, or 0-0-0 inflict a debuff or are critically hit, they gain 10% Turn Meter.

Whenever an enemy falls below 30% Health, they are inflicted with Expose and Speed Down for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.

[c][E7E7E7]While in 5v5 Grand Arenas:[-][/c] Dark Side Droid and Dark Side Scoundrel allies have +50% Critical Avoidance and +30 Speed. Aphra has +50% Potency. Whenever a Dark Side Droid or Scoundrel ally inflicts a debuff on an enemy, they gain 10% Turn Meter (limit once per turn).
LEADERABILITY_MOFFGIDEONS1_TIER_07_DESC_:
Dark Side allies have +30% Max Health and Max Protection, and Imperial Trooper allies have +15% Offense.

At the start of battle, if all allies are Imperial Troopers and Moff Gideon has exactly one Tank ally, two Attacker allies, and one additional Support ally, excluding summoned allies (in 3v3 Galactic Challenges or Grand Arenas, if all allies are Imperial Troopers and Moff Gideon has any combination where the team includes no more than one Tank, two Attackers, and/or an additional Support ally the conditions of this ability will be met):

- Whenever an enemy with the Leader tag uses an ability, Imperial Trooper allies gain 10% Offense (stacking) until the end of the encounter
- Whenever an enemy with the Leader tag takes a turn, Moff Gideon gains 1 stack of Insight
- Imperial Trooper allies have an additional +25% Offense and revive with 50% Health and Protection the first time they are defeated each encounter
LEADERABILITY_ROGUEARCHAEOLOGIST_HAN_DES:
Light Side allies have +20% Defense and Protection.

Whenever a Light Side ally grants a buff, Han Solo gains 10 Siphon until the end of the encounter and all allies gain 10% Defense for 1 turn.

Whenever an enemy falls below 30% Health, they are inflicted with Breach and Health Down for 2 turns.
LEADERABILITY_SANASTARROS_TIER_07_DESC_V:
Rebel Scoundrel Tanks have +30% Defense, Max Health, and Max Protection and gain 15% Turn Meter whenever a non-Tank Rebel ally or Sana is damaged by an attack. Rebel allies and Sana have +30% Offense and Potency. At the start of battle, Rebel allies and Sana gain Protection Up (100%) until they use an ability.

Whenever a Rebel ally or Sana has less than 100% Turn Meter and gains bonus Turn Meter, they gain 25% Critical Damage (stacking) until they critically hit an enemy. If a Rebel Scoundrel removes Turn Meter from an enemy, that enemy also takes damage equal to 20% of their Max Health, which can't be evaded. This damage can't defeat enemies. The first time each turn Rebel allies and Sana deal damage more than once, they gain 25% Max Health (stacking, max 200%) for the rest of the encounter. Whenever Rebel allies or Sana critically hit an enemy, they inflict Target Lock for 1 turn, which can't be evaded. Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Target Lock, reduce Rebel Scoundrel Tanks' cooldowns by 1.

[c][e7e7e7]While in Territory Wars:[-][/c] Rebel Scoundrels and Sana are immune to Daze. At the start of battle, Rebel Scoundrel Tanks Taunt for 1 turn and Rebel Scoundrels and Sana start with Tenacity Up for 1 turn. Target Lock can't be resisted from this ability. The first time each turn Rebel allies and Sana deal damage more than once, dispel all buffs on all enemies and inflict Healing Immunity for 1 turn.

NEWSLETTER_DOCTOR_APHRA_DESC:
[c][F0FF23]Doctor Aphra[-][/c] has arrived to the holotables!

Aphra's doctorate may be in archaeology but her true passion is treasure hunting. An unpredictable nature leads her on chaotic adventures in which she must use her wits and inventions to come out on top (most of the time). From Darth Vader to Luke Skywalker, Aphra's colleagues have run the gamut, but her trusty droids have never let her down. Okay, there was that one time 0-0-0 and BT-1 led a crime syndicate on Son-Tuul and blackmailed her into serving them. But who's counting?

Aphra and her droids like debuffs, so she can siphon Potency from enemies and do damage based on her Potency with her special abilities [c][F0FF23]Dangerous Tech[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Rogue Archaeology[-][/c]. Her Leader ability [c][F0FF23]Suspended Doctorate[-][/c] and Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Droid Savant[-][/c] provide her with opening Turn Meter as well as Speed for her droids. Furthermore, they will also gain Turn Meter when they are critically hit or inflict a debuff, so they waste no time in their quest for destruction.

Her Omicron abilities are active in 5v5 Grand Arenas to complement her droids' Omicrons in 3v3 Grand Arenas so that the squad can exact a plethora of domination in that game mode. While her Omicrons are active she does even more damage based on her Potency, grants extra Speed and Turn Meter to herself and her droids, can protect her droids with Damage Immunity when they fall too low on Health, and exacts quick revenge by inflicting a slew of Damage Over Times for each relic level they have if they are defeated.

Add Doctor Aphra to your roster in the all new "ROGUE ARCHAEOLOGIST" Legacy Event. Create mayhem with her and her droids that will long be remembered!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_DARTH_TRAYA_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

Today's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Darth Traya's[-][/c] Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Lord of Betrayal[-][/c] in the Grand Arenas game mode!

With this upgrade, Sith allies will gain Critical Damage, Max Health, and Offense both at the start of battle as well as whenever Traya dispels a debuff from them. Additionally, Darth Nihilus, Darth Sion, and Darth Talon will refresh their cooldowns the first time they start falling too low on health. This allows them to quickly storm back into the battle with Talon starting her Dark Frenzy, Nihilus lashing out an Annihilate, or Sion reinforcing himself with Hatred.

This new ability tier for Darth Traya is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
