MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_1-1: Zorii Bliss, the cunning head of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, has joined the Holotables!
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_1-2: A scoundrel and smuggler who ran spice, she attempted to remain neutral despite the growing hostility of the First Order, but was forced to choose a side when an old acquaintance came to her for help.
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_1-3: Her Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Twin E-851 Blasters[-][/c], deals damage to the target enemy with additional bonuses if Zorii is Stealthed (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available).
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_2-1: Zorii's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Captain's Medallion[-][/c], dispels debuffs on Resistance allies, provides benefits for those debuffs being dispelled, allows her to gain Stealth, and calls Resistance allies to assist.
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_3-1: With Zorii's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]I've Done Worse For a Lot Less[-][/c], she will deal damage to an enemy target with extra damage for each Expose (receives additional damage from attacks) that was triggered. If an enemy was Exposed, Zorii Stuns (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn) them, and if she defeats an enemy with this ability, she Exposes all enemies.
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_4-1: Zorii's first Unique ability, [c][ffff33]There's More of Us[-][/c], provides stat boosts for Resistance allies with different boosts based on the number of allies and enemies. Resistance allies gain Tenacity Up (increased chance to resist debuffs) when any of them gain it, and receive additional benefits while they have Tenacity Up.
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_4-2: With her Omicron active in the Grand Arenas game mode, whenever Zorii is Stealthed at the start of her turn, all enemies who don't have Expose will become Exposed.
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_5-1: [c][ffff33]Spice Runner Skills[-][/c] provides benefits for allies whenever they trigger an Expose on enemies. It also gives your allies Turn Meter and additional buffs the first time they fall below full Health.
NEWSLETTER_ZORII_BLISS_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][ffff33]Zorii Bliss[-][/c], leader of the spice runners on Kijimi who fought alongside Poe at the battle of Exogol, is coming to the holotables!

Zorii has strong synergy with Exposes to lesser used Resistance characters, especially when they are lead by Poe or Finn. With either of them as the Leader, her Unique ability [c][ffff33]There's More of Us[-][/c] grants stacking Offense to some Resistance who gain turn meter, spreads Tenacity Up when one ally gains it, and grants a chance to inflict Expose when an ally with Tenacity Up attacks. With an Omicron ability upgrade in the Grand Arenas game mode, this ability also spreads Exposes to those who aren't Exposed when Zorii begins her turn Stealthed. Her Special ability [c][ffff33]I've Done Worse For a Lot Less[-][/c] will stack damage for each Expose that has been triggered so she can set up a big hit.

Her second Unique ability [c][ffff33]Spice Runner Skills[-][/c] will start her off Stealthed to boost her other abilities, as well as provide her Resistance and Smuggler allies with extra survivability the first time they lose health. Her Special ability [c][ffff33]Captain's Medallion[-][/c] brings her back into Stealth then dispels her Resistance allies, grants turn meter for each dispel, triggers Taunts on Poe, Finn, and Holdo, then all Resistance allies assist.

If you wannabe Resistance, you gotta get Zorii Bliss. Unlock her in the new “Resistance Runner” Marquee event!

NEWSLETTER_ADMIRAL_TRENCH_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

With great ruthlessness comes great responsibility. Conquest Volume 9 begins soon and shards for a new character, [c][ffff33]Admiral Trench[-][/c], will be available for a limited time in this mode! A Separatist admiral known for his cunning and ruthlessness, Trench synergizes with Wat Tambor's Tech and Nute Gunray's Extortion to turn the tide of battle.

Trench's leader ability [c][ffff33]Feared Tactician[-][/c] provides stats for allies with Tech and enemies with Extortion, including a percentage boost to Speed, making his team especially quick out of the gate when paired with Wat Tambor and Nute Gunray. Additionally, this ability provides a way for Jango (who starts with Damage Immunity under Trench) to not be Stealthed by Dooku if he has Baktoid Shield Generator Tech. Jango's Burning will also prevent enemies from assisting, countering, or gaining bonus Turn Meter. The Omicron upgrade for Territory Wars gives Mastery, Turn Meter gain when an enemy dispels a debuff, and stacking Offense and Speed the first time each enemy is reduced below 100% Health.

His Special ability [c][ffff33]Net Positive[-][/c] introduces the Tactical Supremacy buff, which provides increased Critical Damage and Potency, Protection recovery at start of turn, and additional benefits if it is dispelled. The Omicron upgrades for his Unique [c][ffff33]I Smell Fear, and It Smells Good[-][/c] and Basic [c][ffff33]Unfinished Business[-][/c] abilities (the first Omicron on a Basic ability) in Territory Wars provide opportunities to lower enemy stats like Critical Damage and Tenacity, as well as increase survivability for himself and his allies.

Earn Admiral Trench shards during the upcoming Conquest events!

NEWSLETTER_TIE_DEFENDER_DESC:
Hi Holotable Heroes,

[c][F0FF23]TIE Defender[-][/c], piloted by the elite Iden Versio, is coming to the holotables!

The TIE Defender is set up well to bolster the Empire fleet with the reinforcement ability [c][F0FF23]We Weren't Expecting Special Forces.[-][/c] This grants the new status effect [c][F0FF23]Special Forces[-][/c] that empowers the TIE Defender's other abilities through extra damage, Turn Meter for itself and its Capital ship, and a Stun that can't be evaded, dispelled, or resisted.

TIE Defender has good evasion and foresight synergy from its Unique abilities [c][F0FF23]P-sz9.7 Twin Ion Engine[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]TIE/x7[-][/c]. The latter provides Foresight when TIE Defender has at least one stack of Resilient Defense, which it gains from landing critical hits from its Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Wingtip L-s9.3 Laser Cannons[-][/c], making it quite tricky to take out. This is amplified by the TIE Defender counting as a TIE fighter, making it a strong reinforcement for the Executrix lead fleet with Scythe.

Unlock the TIE Defender in the upcoming Galactic Chase event!
